A: The beautiful, vibrant visuals and a progression system where players not only sort nuts but also fix their garden by gradually ""repairing"" the flowers. Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)? A: The beautiful, vibrant visuals and a progression system where players not only sort nuts but also fix their garden by gradually ""repairing"" the flowers.
howToPlay: Organize the nuts To play Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color, start by tapping on the nut you want to move, then select the screw where you want to place it. You can only place a nut on another screw if it’s either empty or if the top nut on that screw matches the color of the nut you’re moving. This simple rule sets the stage for the puzzle-solving challenge, as you’ll need to strategically plan your moves to ensure each screw ends up with nuts of a single color. As you progress, the game introduces more nuts and a wider range of colors, making the puzzles increasingly complex. New challenges, such as hard mode levels, add an extra layer of difficulty by hiding the color of nuts until you move a piece from above them. These added twists will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills as you work through each level, striving to complete the puzzle with fewer moves and greater efficiency. Use helpers It’s at this point that you may need to use the undo, reset, and extra screw options, which are available on every level. description: Soccer Random is a funny physics-based soccer game where every match feels unpredictable from the first kick. A perfect-looking attack can suddenly miss, while a strange jump may turn into an unexpected goal. This mix of timing, reaction, and random physics gives Soccer Random its playful identity. It is easy to understand in seconds, but every match still creates surprising moments. One of the strongest parts of Soccer Random is how the game changes between rounds. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable through pure logic — no guessing required. If you get stuck, a step was missed somewhere, and it can always be traced back. Begin with cells that have the most filled neighbors: fewer options make it easier to identify the correct digit. As cells are filled in, the choices for adjacent ones narrow down — the puzzle unfolds as a chain of logical steps. Use the notes mode to write down multiple candidates in a cell and eliminate them as the grid fills up. This is especially useful at Hard and Expert levels. Additional modes come with extra rules. In X-Sudoku, digits must also be unique along both main diagonals. In Windoku, extra highlighted regions apply the same uniqueness rule. In Killer Sudoku, groups of cells must add up to a given sum. In Kropki, markers between cells define relationships: a white dot means the two digits differ by 1, a black dot means one is exactly twice the other. Train your mind!

Whether you're assembling chic outfits or selecting the perfect accessories, each decision propels your paper doll into the spotlight, making her a true fashion icon. Your styling choices not only reflect your unique taste but also guide your doll's journey through thrilling adventures and challenges.

Sort the gems by color and place them into the matching cells. With every correct move, the image becomes brighter and more complete. Simple controls, satisfying gameplay, and a calm atmosphere make each level enjoyable and easy to play. - Select a crystal and identify its color. - Move it to a matching cell on the board. - Use the storage area when the required cell is blocked. - Plan your moves to avoid filling the storage slots. - Use hints or boosters when you need help. - Place all crystals correctly to complete the picture!
howToPlay: 1. Pick sparkling diamonds and sort them by color. 2. Move each diamond into the matching cell on the board. 3. If the right spot is temporarily unavailable, use the storage area. 4. Turn small blueberries into juicy strawberries and strawberries into ripe cherries! The game features 26 incredible characters, each with their own personality and catchphrases. Use powerful bonuses: - "Multicolor" merges with any fruit - "Meteor" breaks through the fruits to the bottom of glass - "Bomb" explodes small fruits and gives X10 points - "Grow" increases all identical fruits by one - "Magnet" allows you to pull the interfering fruit out of the thicket - "Microscope" temporarily reduces all fruits to micro sizes - "Tornado" shakes the glass Spin the wheel of fortune, get daily rewards, and buy upgrades in the store. Realistic physics, beautiful animations, and pleasant music create a cozy atmosphere. Start your adventure in the «Merge Fruit Characters - Fruit Kingdom» right now!

For example, two Baby Blue Blueberries will turn into Princess Stella "Little Beak" Strawberry-Belle, and two sisters will turn into Champion Cherry "Bouncy Bunny" Cherryton. Clicking allows you to make a quick throw, while holding and moving activates a laser sight for more accurate hits. Fill the glass, but be careful, if even one fruit falls out of the glass, the game will end. Use the space wisely, and develop your own system! Use bonuses to progress faster in the game. Spin the wheel of fortune to receive random rewards, and don't forget to check out the daily quests - completing them will earn you useful bonuses. Upgrade your abilities in the store and progress through the levels, unlocking new features and characters. Become a leader in points and levels, chat with others, and share your achievements!

title: Arrows Out!
description: Arrow Escape is a puzzle game that delivers fast-paced, strategic challenges for players who enjoy logic-driven gameplay and intense escape scenarios. Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle where you must carefully study the arrow paths and decide which arrow to tap first in order to clear the board. One correct move can open the way forward, while a single mistake can trigger a chain reaction that costs you a heart. As you progress, the game evolves into a full arrow maze escape experience featuring twisting paths, looping routes, and increasingly complex layouts. Some stages feel like isolated arrow-filled arenas where every direction represents either danger or opportunity, turning each decision into a tense test of planning and precision. The core mechanic revolves around tapping arrows out in the correct order. When arrows collide, you lose a heart, and with only three hearts available, every move matters. Make three mistakes and the attempt ends immediately, pushing you to think carefully before each tap. To complete a level, you must clear all arrows before time runs out, creating a high-pressure challenge that tests both focus and reaction speed. Gameplay blends intuitiv…

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex. The game supports both 1 player and 2 player modes, making it perfect for solo progression or competitive sessions with a friend. As you collect Brainrots, they start generating income in your base. That income allows you to unlock stronger pickaxes and hammers, break higher tier eggs, and expand your base up to 3 floors. With full upgrades, you can store up to many Brainrots and build a strong passive economy. The gameplay becomes even more dynamic with risks and events. Brainrots disappear if you fail to bring them to the safe zone in time. Skeleton enemies chase you when you carry them, creating constant tension. You can also collect tickets, which unlock cosmetics, pets, and even allow you to steal Brainrots from other players. If you enjoyed the collecting and progression loop in Steal Brainrot Eggs, this game expands that idea with more action, danger, and player interaction.
howToPlay: Start breaking eggs to collect Brainrot characters. Carry the Brainrots to your base before their timer expires. Avoid skeleton enemies while carrying Brainrots. Earn money from your base and upgrade your tools. Expand your base floors to increase capacity. Collect tickets and use them for cosmetics and special actions. Steal Brainrots from other players if you have enough tickets. Use rebirth to increase your earning multipliers. Move: W, A, S, D Run: Left Shift Hit: Left Mouse Click or F Jump: Space Pick Up or Sell: E Rebirth: T Egg Index: H

title: Sudoku
description: The playing field is a grid with 9x9 cells, divided into smaller grids with a side of 3 cells. Thus, the entire playing field consists of 81 cells. title: Escape School Duel
description: Escape School Duel is a fast, funny, and tense escape challenge set inside a school that does not want to let you leave. Q (K) - change weapons; W, A, S, D (arrows) - move; E (M) - apply / activate; F (J) - super weapon. X, Space (L, KeyPad 0) - shooting; Mouse - look / shoot; For mobile devices, use touch input.

title: Talking Veggies: Meme Merge
description: Welcome to Talking Veggies: Meme Merge! Drop and merge hilarious talking vegetables in this addictive physics-based puzzle game. Combine two identical veggies to create a bigger one, all the way up to the legendary Boss Watermelon! Earn coins, buy crazy upgrades for your jar, and open gacha boxes to unlock rare meme skins with powerful buffs. Can you reach the ultimate high score without spilling your veggies?
howToPlay: Desktop: Left-click anywhere above the jar to drop a vegetable. Mobile: Tap anywhere on the screen to drop a vegetable. Goal: Drop and merge identical vegetables to evolve them into larger ones. Keep merging to score points, but be careful — if the vegetables overflow the top of the jar, it's Game Over! Spend your earned coins in the shop for upgrades, and use crystals to open boxes.

title: Bloxorz: Color Block Roll
description: A rolling-cube puzzle where color is everything. Roll a painted cube to the exit, landing only on tiles that match the face touching the ground. Solve 60 levels of color-matching paths — with platforms that rotate, move, and teleport — in a satisfying test of spatial thinking. Fans of classics like Bloxorz will feel right at home.
howToPlay: Move — WASD or Arrow keys Move (mouse) — hold the left button and drag in a direction, then release Move (touch) — swipe in a direction Move one step at a time. Choose up, down, left, or right to reach the goal.

title: Ten Link - Number Games
description: Ten Link is a relaxing yet brain-teasing number puzzle. Clear the board by linking pairs of numbers that are either the same or add up to 10 — connect them across rows, columns, diagonals, or even from the end of one line to the start of the next. Colors do the thinking with you: every matching group shares one color, so you can spot valid pairs at a glance. Out of moves? Add a new wave of numbers and keep the chain going. Four difficulty modes, a fresh Daily Challenge every day with monthly trophies, and a level system that grows your Calculation, Observation and Focus as you play.
howToPlay: Tap (or click) two numbers to link them. A pair is valid when the two numbers are equal or add up to 10, and the path between them is clear — horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or wrapping from the end of a line to the start of the next one. Clear every number on the board to win the stage. Fill a whole row and it disappears. If no moves are left, press ADD to copy the remaining numbers to the end of the board, or use a HINT to reveal a pair. Controls: mouse click or touch only — no keyboard required.

title: Collection Shuffle
description: Collection Shuffle Shuffle, sort, and complete every summer collection! Collection Shuffle is a colourful casual puzzle game where every move changes the board. Insert an item into a column, push the other items forward, and carefully organise matching summer objects together. Plan your moves wisely, because each level gives you only a limited number of chances. Create complete collections of fruits, beach equipment, tropical drinks, sea creatures, and other vibrant summer items to clear the puzzle. The rules are simple, but finding the perfect sequence becomes increasingly challenging! Features * Unique push-and-shuffle puzzle gameplay * Bright and polished summer-themed artwork * Dozens of carefully designed levels * Simple controls that are easy to learn * Limited-move challenges that reward smart planning * A wide collection of colourful items * Relaxing gameplay with satisfying animations * No time pressure—solve each puzzle at your own pace Can you organise every item and complete all the collections? Start shuffling and become the ultimate Collection Shuffle master!
howToPlay: 1. Select a card and insert it into the top of a column. 2. The new card pushes every card in that column downward. 3. The bottom card is pushed out and returns to the position of the card you selected. 4. Use this circular movement to rearrange the board and group matching items together. 5. Complete every required collection before you run out of moves. Plan each shuffle carefully. One move changes several positions at once!

title: Cardivo Adventure
description: Cardivo Adventure is a relaxing card-sorting puzzle game where every card belongs to a themed collection. Move cards between stacks, uncover hidden matches, and organize colorful sets before you run out of moves. Thoughtful level layouts, satisfying animations, useful boosters, and steadily increasing challenges make every round a fresh little adventure.
howToPlay: Goal: Sort every card into its matching themed stack to complete the level before you run out of moves. How to play: - On desktop, use the left mouse button to select and move cards. - On mobile and tablet, tap or drag cards with one finger. - Match cards with the correct category and clear all required cards from the board. - Use boosters when you need help with a difficult layout. - Complete the level to unlock the next challenge. If you run out of moves, retry the level and plan a different sequence.

title: Color Blast Puzzle
description: Get ready for a colorful and satisfying puzzle adventure with Color Blast Puzzle! Tap and clear groups of matching colored blocks, create powerful chain reactions, and complete challenging objectives across exciting levels. Every level gives you a limited number of moves, so plan your actions carefully and think ahead. The bigger the group you clear, the more rewarding your moves become. Use strategic clicks to create impressive combos and unlock powerful boosters that can clear multiple blocks at once. With bright colorful graphics, satisfying popping effects, unique level objectives, and increasingly challenging layouts, Color Blast Puzzle is easy to learn but challenging to master. Challenge your brain, improve your strategy, and blast your way through every level. Can you complete them all and become the ultimate Color Blast Puzzle master?
howToPlay: Tap matching blocks: Tap groups of two or more blocks with the same color to clear them from the board. Complete the objectives: Each level has specific goals, such as clearing a certain number of colored blocks. Plan your moves: You have a limited number of moves, so choose each tap carefully. Create bigger matches: Clear larger groups of matching blocks to earn higher scores and create powerful effects. Use power-ups: Use available boosters and special items to clear difficult areas and complete challenging levels. Win the level: Complete all required objectives before running out of moves. Controls: Tap or click on matching blocks to make your move.

title: 2248: Merge & Slash
description: 2248: Merge & Slash combines the classic 2248 puzzle mechanics with exciting battles. Build chains, unleash powerful attacks, defeat monsters, collect coins, and unlock new upgrades. The longer the chain, the stronger your attack. Can you make it to the end and defeat every monster?
howToPlay: Build chains following the 2248 rules: the first two tiles must match, and each following tile must be one level higher. For example: 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 5. After merging the chain, a new Level 6 tile will appear, and you'll receive an Attack Card. The longer the chain and the higher the tile levels, the more powerful the attack. The last tile in the chain determines the attack's element. Fire, Ice, Lightning, and other elements add bonus elemental damage. Chains longer than five tiles have a chance to trigger a special effect, such as a Critical Hit, Stun, Life Steal, or other powerful bonuses. Defeat enemies to earn experience and collect coins. Spend your coins on upgrades to increase your Health, boost elemental damage, improve the chance of triggering special effects, and become even stronger. Fight your way through increasingly dangerous enemies and see how far you can go!

title: Blob Twist – Color Puzzle
description: A fun and colorful puzzle game where you twist, dodge obstacles, and guide your blob to the finish. Test your timing and reflexes across challenging levels!
howToPlay: Move and twist the blob to avoid obstacles and reach the finish point. Use Arrow Keys or WASD to control your character. Plan your moves, avoid hazards, and complete each level to win.

title: Bucket Brigade
description: Bucket Brigade Bucket Brigade is a cozy toy-themed puzzle game where you guide a rescue convoy across a sunny beach. Children have left toys and sandcastles behind, and the beach needs to be cleared before the summer heat melts your plastic vehicles.
howToPlay: Keyboard & Mouse Controls 1 - Select Ambulance 2 - Select Crane 3 - Select Dump Truck W / S - Drive Q / E - Rotate crane cabin Mouse Up / Down - Move crane arm Left Mouse - Close claw Right Mouse - Open claw Esc - Pause / Back Gamepad Controls RT / R2 - Drive forward LT / L2 - Reverse / Brake LB / L1 - Rotate crane cabin left RB / R1 - Rotate crane cabin right Left Stick Up / Down - Move crane arm A / Cross - Close claw / Confirm B / Circle - Back / Cancel / Pause X / Square - Switch vehicle

title: Miscast
description: Miscast is a fast 1v1 wizard duel about timing and reading your opponent. Build a loadout of 3 spells and climb an 8-mage ladder — ach rival teaches one new trick and hands it to you when you win. The whole game is watching the enemy's cast bar and deciding in the moment: cut a big cast with Dispel, brace with a Rune Ward or bounce it with a Mirror, or gamble that your damage lands first. Commit to a spell and you're locked in — and your foe sees it coming. Feint your own casts to bait their defenses, then punish. Duels last 60–90 seconds. When you've beaten the ladder, take on the Daily Challenge (same seed for everyone, climb the leaderboard) or see how deep you go in Endless survival. Features: - 8 spells, dozens of viable loadouts (repeats allowed — three Firebolts is a real build) - 8 distinct mage opponents, each a new tactic - The bluff: cancel your own cast to bait a defense - Daily Challenge with leaderboard + Endless survival mode - Quick 60–90s duels · Mouse, keyboard, and touch · English & Portuguese
howToPlay: - Pick 3 spells: tap them or press keys **1–8**, then **Enter** to duel. - In a duel, cast with a **tap** or keys **1 / 2 / 3**. - Watch the enemy's cast bar: **Dispel** to interrupt, **Rune Ward / Mirror** to defend, or out-damage them. - Re-tap the spell you're casting to **cancel** it (feint). - **P** to pause.

title: Cat Snack Defense
description: Cat Snack Defense is a casual tower-defense strategy game where you deploy unique cats to protect precious fish crackers from waves of hungry animals. Each cat has different abilities, attack styles, and roles, so choosing the right team and placement is essential. Your objective is to survive every enemy wave and keep the goldfish cracker alive. You win by defeating all attackers before they destroy the cracker. Collect rewards, unlock new cat cards, and build a stronger defense.
howToPlay: Mouse click or tap: Select cards, buttons, and menus Drag and drop: Place cat cards on the battlefield Click or tap deployed cats: View their stats Click or tap the language button: Switch between Chinese and English

title: Poofruits: Merge the Fruit
description: Eleven fruits, from blueberry to watermelon, and every one of them has a face. They blink, squint when something lands on them, beam when they merge, and start to doze off if you leave them alone. The physics is honest: a dropped fruit rolls, shoves its neighbours and can set off a chain of merges worth far more than you planned. Stacking well beats stacking fast. Now and then a bomb turns up in the queue. It scatters whatever has settled into a jam and gives a crowded cup a second chance. There is a leaderboard and a personal best, kept in your Yandex account so it survives a change of device. A run is short, losing costs you nothing, and you will want to start again at once.
howToPlay: Drag your finger or the mouse along the top of the screen and the fruit follows. Let go to drop it into the cup. Two identical fruits that touch become the next one up: blueberry makes a cherry, cherry makes a kumquat, and so on to the watermelon. Merges chain, so one good drop can clear half the cup. Swipe down to fling the fruit instead. It drives into a tight pile and opens a way through. Watch the line near the top. If the fruit stays above it, the run is over. Put the big ones at the bottom and leave the small ones room up top, so they have time to find their pair. The bomb can be dropped like any fruit, or tapped where it lies to set it off.

title: Island Survival
description: 🏝️ "Island Survival" is a unique blend of match-3, survival, and strategic crafting in a vibrant pixel art style. 🎯 Your goal — complete 6 stages, build a raft, and escape the deserted island. Start with primitive tools, build a house, furnish the interior, smelt ore, create workbenches, and prepare for your sea getaway. 🔄 The key twist: raw resources (stone, wood, food, water, leaves, fire, ore) reset between stages — you can't hoard indefinitely. But everything you craft (ropes, planks, ingots, nails, tools, raft parts) carries over to later stages. This forces you to plan every move: what to craft now, and what to save for later? Your foresight is the key to success! ⚙️ Progression stages: from a campfire and stone knife — to a furnace, workbench, iron tools, and finally raft assembly. Each stage brings new challenges and new recipes. 🚢 Ready to test if you can survive, build a raft, and escape?
howToPlay: 🎯 Goal — complete 6 stages, build a raft, and escape the deserted island. 🎮 Core mechanic — an 8×8 board with 6 types of tiles: stone, wood, food, water, leaves, fire. Match 3+ tiles in a row to collect the corresponding resource into your inventory. Combos of 4 give a bonus resource. Combos of 5 give a "wild" tile (replaces any material). 🔨 Crafting — open the menu to see recipes. To craft an item, you need the required amount of resources. All crafted items (ropes, planks, ingots, nails, tools, raft parts) are permanent and carry over between stages. 🔄 Resource reset — raw resources (stone, wood, food, water, leaves, fire, ore) reset at the end of each stage.

title: Yummy Shelf
description: Yummy Shelf is a relaxing 3D sorting and matching puzzle game. Organize colorful food items, match three identical products, and clear every shelf before time runs out. Use helpful boosters to overcome tricky layouts and complete increasingly challenging levels.
howToPlay: Tap three identical food items to match and remove them from the shelves. Clear all items before the timer expires to win the level. Plan your moves carefully and use Freeze, Hint, Shuffle, or instant-clear boosters when needed.

title: Laser Nodes
description: Line up all the lasers through the nodes to beat the level. Bounce lasers off mirrors with infinity reflections later on in this brain-teasing game that is very hard!
howToPlay: Drag the laser shooters to move the lasers, you will need to line up the lasers through the nodes. You can use mirrors to bounce the lasers for infinity directions!

title: Car Parking Driving Game
description: Car Parking Driving Game is a realistic 3D driving game that puts your parking skills to the ultimate test. Drive through challenging parking courses, avoid obstacles, navigate tight spaces, and complete exciting missions using smooth, realistic vehicle controls. Explore detailed environments while improving your precision and driving techniques. Every level introduces new parking challenges that require careful steering, braking, and timing. Earn rewards by completing missions, unlock new vehicles, and become a true parking expert. Whether you enjoy casual driving games or realistic car simulators, this game offers hours of fun with satisfying gameplay and progressive difficulty. Features 🚗 Realistic car driving and parking physics 🅿️ Challenging parking missions 🌆 Detailed 3D environments 🎮 Smooth keyboard and mobile controls 🚘 Multiple vehicles to unlock ⭐ Progressive difficulty across many levels ⚡ Responsive handling and realistic driving mechanics 🌐 Play instantly in your browser
howToPlay: W / up arrow key = accelerate A / left arrow key = turn left D / right arrow key = turn right S / down arrow key = brake C = change camera view Mouse Click To Interact

title: Block Puzzle: Jewel Block
description: Block Puzzle: Jewel Block is a colorful endless puzzle game where you place glossy jewel pieces onto a grid and clear complete rows and columns. Plan every move, build satisfying combos, chase a new high score, and use helpful boosters when the board gets crowded. Its bright arcade presentation, quick drag-and-drop controls, and score-focused strategy make every round easy to start and hard to put down.
howToPlay: Drag a jewel piece from the tray and drop it onto an empty area of the board. Fill a complete horizontal row or vertical column to clear it and earn points. Clear multiple lines and make consecutive clears to build bigger combos. The game ends when none of the available pieces can fit, so keep space open and plan ahead. Use the available boosters when needed and try to beat your saved high score. Controls: - Mouse: hold the left mouse button to drag a piece, then release to place it. - Touchscreen: touch and drag a piece, then lift your finger to place it. - Menu buttons: click or tap to pause, continue, restart, return home, or mute music and sound.

title: Hungry Cars
description: You are a car that gets stronger by eating other cars! Get stronger and unlock customization options every run!
howToPlay: Go to cars with a lower power level to eat them and get stronger. Avoid stronger cars or get damaged. Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow): Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow): Move downward. ← (Left Arrow): Move left. → (Right Arrow): Move right. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick.

title: Slap Battle: Arena Online
description: Multiplayer slap battle. 🖐️ Collect slaps by defeating players. Modes: Arena, Ring, and 67. Inspired by Slap Battles!
howToPlay: Welcome to the chaotic world of slaps 🖐️ — a fast-paced multiplayer slap battle inspired by Slap Battles! Your main goal is to collect as many slaps as possible. Slaps are the main currency in the game — the more players you hit, the more slaps you earn. Use your slaps to unlock stronger gloves and become more powerful in battle. Game modes: ⚔️ Arena — free-for-all chaos 🥊 Ring — stay on the platform and don’t fall 🏃 67 — reach the end while avoiding dangerous heads Every match is full of action, chaos, and competition 😂 Can you become the player with the most slaps?

title: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape
description: +1 SPEED KEYBOARD ESCAPE is a fast-paced arcade game where every key press makes you faster! Press keys, build your speed, overcome challenging stages, and survive as long as possible. The faster you become, the harder the obstacles get. Can you reach the ultimate speed and last stage?
howToPlay: HOW TO PLAY ⚡ Press keys to gain speed! ⌨️ Use your keyboard to increase your speed and escape the obstacles. The faster you go, the harder the stages become. Reach new speed levels, survive longer, and complete all stages! Controls PC - Press keyboard keys to accelerate - WASD / Move - Mouse: Look around Mobile - Use the joystick to move - Tap controls to interact Good luck and reach maximum speed!

title: Mine Master
description: Mine Master is a casual merge and digging game. Combine matching shovels to create stronger tools, dig through layers of blocks, collect coins, and complete level goals. Upgrade your equipment and unlock rewards as you progress deeper underground.
howToPlay: Tap two matching shovels to merge them into a higher-level shovel. Select a shovel and tap “Down” to dig through the blocks below. Collect coins, complete the required objectives, and keep upgrading your tools to advance through each level.

title: Mellow Escape
description: Mellow Escape is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you move blocks, clear the path, and help a curious little character reach the exit. Solve handcrafted puzzles, earn stars and coins, unlock new themes and character skins, and progress through increasingly challenging levels — all at your own pace, with no timers or pressure.
howToPlay: Move the blocks by dragging or swiping them across the board. Clear a path for the blue character and guide it to the exit to complete the level. Try to solve each puzzle using fewer moves to earn more stars. Progress through the campaign, collect coins, and unlock new themes and character skins. On desktop, use the mouse to drag the blocks. On mobile devices, simply touch and swipe.

title: Ashfall Industries
description: Ashfall Industries is a comic atompunk idle management game about turning a battered wasteland into a thriving industrial frontier. Start with a humble Rustwater Pump, collect Scrap, and build a network of increasingly ambitious operations: greenhouses, salvage yards, radio stations, caravan routes, drone workshops, refineries, and more. Every operation can be upgraded for bigger payouts and faster cycles. Hire distinctive Crew Chiefs to automate production, then invest in Retrofits that improve output, speed, costs, and Lucky Find rewards. When your industry is ready for a fresh start, trigger Reclamation to earn Reactor Cores and unlock permanent Recovery Protocols that make every rebuild stronger. Core Features - Build 15 original wasteland operations, from clean-water pumps to the Horizon Reactor. - Collect Scrap, level up production, and hit new Benchmarks for bigger rewards. - Hire Crew Chiefs to automate your best operations while you expand the business. - Buy Retrofits to improve output, cycle speed, salvage efficiency, and Lucky Finds. - Catch Lucky Finds for boosted payouts and satisfying bursts of progress. - Use Reclamation to reset strategically, earn Reactor Cores,…
howToPlay: How to Play 1. Buy an operation and click its Run button to begin producing Scrap. 2. Spend Scrap to level up operations, unlock more businesses, and improve your income. 3. Hire Crew Chiefs to automate production cycles. 4. Purchase Retrofits and collect Lucky Finds to accelerate your growth. 5. Use Reclamation when you are ready to earn Reactor Cores and rebuild faster. Mouse - Left-click buttons to run operations, collect rewards, make purchases, and navigate menus. Touchscreen - Tap to use the same controls.

title: Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell
description: Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell is a bright and addictive merge game where every jelly earns you points! Merge identical jellies, fill the jar to the brim, and sell the result to earn more and more. The higher the jelly level, the more points you get. Simple controls, satisfying physics, and a constant sense of progress make the game perfect for short sessions and relaxing gameplay. Watch the jar fill up as jellies merge into more valuable forms and your score grows with every sale. Upgrade your stats, increase capacity, and turn ordinary jellies into a true record-breaking machine!
howToPlay: 🎮 How to Play Jellies fall into the jar New jellies appear from the top and drop into the container. Merge identical jellies When identical jellies touch, they merge into a more advanced and valuable version. Fill the jar Keep an eye on the fill level — the more jellies inside, the closer you are to selling. Sell the contents When the jar is nearly full or completely filled, sell the jellies to turn them into money. Upgrade your progress Improve key parameters: — jelly level — sale income — jar capacity — progress speed Earn even more Each upgrade boosts your profits and unlocks new jelly tiers.

title: Jewel Gem Puzzle
description: Jewel Gem Puzzle & Create with Pixel Art Puzzles Enter a vibrant world of glowing jewels where creativity and puzzle-solving come together in perfect harmony! Designed for easy, relaxing fun, this one-of-a-kind experience combines color sorting, pixel art creation, and satisfying casual gameplay all in one. With smooth, user-friendly controls and levels that gently grow more engaging, it’s the perfect way to unwind while keeping your mind active.
howToPlay: How to Play: Color, Sort, & Craft Beautiful Pixel Art - Sort Jewels by Color with Ease: Just tap and arrange sparkling jewels into their matching color groups. No confusing rules or complicated steps—just simple, enjoyable sorting action. - Plan & Organize Your Workspace: Keep your jewel shelf neatly arranged and think ahead to clear each puzzle efficiently. Every small choice helps you complete the picture smoothly. - Uncover Stunning Pixel Art Masterpieces: As you sort and place each jewel, watch as hidden pixel art designs slowly come to life. Every level reveals a brand-new, dazzling image to enjoy. - Enjoy Endless Creative Satisfaction: There’s no pressure—just calm, rewarding gameplay that turns every moment into a peaceful artistic break.

title: Harvest Haulers
description: Harvest is an idle tap game about running a fruit farm. Tap the hopper to shake loose fruit, dumping it onto trucks on the belt. Full trucks drive off and pay gold. Spend gold on upgrades: more fruit per tap, bigger trucks, a faster belt, extra lanes.
howToPlay: - Tap / click the hopper — releases a burst of fruit into the funnel below it. - Tap a truck on the belt to dispatch it early if you don't want to wait for a full load. - Tap an upgrade card in the shop rail to spend gold and boost your production.

title: Wobble Run
description: Wobble Run is a 13+ arcade balance runner. You auto-run a leaning stack of wet-ink cans across Sky Docks, Slice Street, and Hive Yard. Catch more to grow taller. Tip is the only fail. • Three worlds, 16 levels each • Touch or mouse to steer into the lean • Cosmetics unlock from play — no accounts, no IAP • Stack wet. Don’t tip. Height is easy. Balance is the game.
howToPlay: Touch / drag or mouse to steer Desktop: A/D or arrows Steer into the lean to recover Tip and you spill — catch every can and coin for a Perfect

title: Merge Elementals: Castle Defense
description: 🏰 The horde is marching on your castle. All that stands in its way is a wall and a handful of elementals. 🔥💧🌍 Merge identical fighters to push them up the tiers. Fire, water and earth cross into wind, lava and nature, which cross again into ice, energy, spirit and sandstorm. Twelve elements: some burn an area, some slow the horde, some delete a single target. ✨ Between waves, level up magic and take three spells into battle: fireball, frost storm, chain lightning, meteor shower, dragon call. 🌋 The campaign never ends: swamp, snow peaks, desert tombs, fungus forest, lava inferno, void and meadows. Ten waves per world, the last a boss 👹. Your army and gold carry over between worlds, so progress is never lost. 🎁 Chests, keys, scrolls, castle upgrades, daily rewards. ☁️ Cloud saves: start on your phone, continue on desktop. 🎮 Merge, tower defense and strategy in one. Free to play, no download, no sign-up.
howToPlay: 🖐 Drag identical elementals onto each other: two fighters of the same type and tier fuse into the next tier. Gold only buys tier one — everything above comes from merging, and grid space is tight, so think about what you combine. ▶️ Once your line-up is ready, hit Start Wave. Merging locks during combat: your fighters aim and shoot on their own, while your job is to cast spells on time and keep the wall standing. 💰 Every kill drops gold. 🔁 Wave over — back to the prep phase: buy, rearrange, upgrade. The last wave of each world is a boss, and beyond it lies the next biome. 💎 If the wall does go down, you can revive on the spot for gems and carry on.

title: Fat Hedgehog Boris
description: Fat Hedgehog Boris is a funny platformer where every hit makes Boris fatter and changes how he moves. Run, jump, defeat enemies, collect coins, avoid dangerous traps, fight bosses, and reach the finish while trying to keep Boris in good shape.
howToPlay: Move left and right using the arrow keys or the on-screen controls. Press Space to jump. Press Space again while in the air to perform a downward attack. Defeat enemies from above, break certain blocks, collect coins, avoid traps, and reach the end of each level. Taking damage makes Boris fatter and harder to control.

title: Cockroach Tower Defense
description: Cockroach Tower Defense is a top-down survival game where you defend your base against relentless roach swarms using auto-firing weapons. Exterminate bugs to buy mid-run upgrades, and spend your earned "Public Support" between runs on permanent stat boosts to survive increasingly difficult enemy variants and boss waves.
howToPlay: PC Left Mouse Click: Interact with the in-game buttons. Mobile Tap: Interact with the in-game buttons.

title: Dream Home: Merge Story
description: Dream Home: Merge Story is a cozy game about merging items and renovating a home. Combine identical items on the board, unlock higher-level items, and complete orders. Completing tasks rewards you with stars. Spend them on renovations, furniture, and new interior elements as you gradually turn an old house into a beautiful and cozy home. Keep an eye on your energy, plan your moves, and make sure there is enough free space on the board. Crystals can help you restore energy faster, while additional rewards let you keep playing. Complete tasks, discover new items, and watch your new home transform room by room.
howToPlay: Merge two identical items on the board to create a higher-level item. Keep combining items to produce the objects needed for your current orders. 1. Find two identical items and merge them. 2. Create higher-level items. 3. Complete the orders shown at the top of the screen. 4. Earn stars for completed tasks. 5. Return to the room and spend stars on renovations and upgrades. 6. If you run out of energy, wait for it to recover or refill it using an available option. Try not to fill the entire board: free cells are needed for new items and future merges.

title: Escape the Monster
description: You wake up at the bottom of a monster's lair. Fifty floors of maze stand between you and the way out. Each floor has one exit. Find it before the monster finds you, and don't take too long, because the longer you stay the faster it moves. Four different monsters live down here and each one hunts a different way. Some chase you, some wait for you, and one walks straight through walls. On the dark floors you can't see any of them coming. You just hear the music change. Grab gems on your way out. Some doors stay locked until you find the crown. If you're carrying a mask, the next monster to touch you is stunned instead of taking a life. Clear all fifty floors to escape. Then try Endless mode, where the floors keep going and all that matters is how deep you get. Gems buy new cloaks, lanterns and masks. Nine of them can't be bought at all, and must be earned.
howToPlay: Reach the green door on each floor before the monster catches you. You have three hearts. Every floor you clear takes you one closer to the surface, and every ten floors is a safe floor with no monster on it. The monster speeds up the longer you stay, so keep moving. Gems you collect buy hearts on the safe floors and unlock new looks between runs. Some floors lock the exit until you find the crown. Some give you a mask that will stun the next monster that touches you instead of costing you a heart. Clear all fifty floors to escape into the garden. Endless mode unlocks after floor nine and runs forever. Can you climb the leaderboard? CONTROLS Arrow keys or WASD to move. ZQSD also works on AZERTY keyboards. On mobile, swipe anywhere on the maze, or use the on-screen pad when playing upright. P pauses. M mutes.

title: Fruit Mahjong
description: Fruit Mahjong is mahjong solitaire with a twist you can see from every angle. Juicy fruit tiles are stacked into layered arrangements in front of an ancient jungle temple — and the match you're hunting for might be sitting on the far side. Drag to orbit the board, spot the pair, clear the stack. One six-minute clock runs across all 50 levels. Every board you clear buys you ten more seconds, so the deeper you go, the tighter it gets. Match fast to build a combo: each pair in a chain scores more than the last, and the match chime climbs in pitch as your streak grows — break the chain and the multiplier resets. Boxed in? Burn a hint to clear a pair for you, or shuffle the remaining tiles into a fresh layout. Run out and you can watch a short video to earn another. Your best score is saved, so every run is a chance to beat it. Tags: mahjong, match, puzzle, solitaire, 3D, fruit, casual, timed, brain Rules Clear the board by matching two identical fruit tiles. A tile can only be taken if it has a clear side. Tiles hemmed in on both left and right, or both front and back, are locked until you clear around them. Pick a tile, then pick its match. A wrong pair makes both tiles wobble and st…
howToPlay: Controls Select a tile — click or tap it. Your pick is shown at the top of the screen. Rotate the board — drag with the mouse or one finger. It spins a full 360°. Zoom — mouse wheel, or pinch with two fingers.

title: Ice Slide
description: Ice Slide is a simple, casual, and addictive sliding puzzle game! Your goal is easy: slide the block to fill all empty tiles on the board. 🌟 FEATURES: - 1000 fun and challenging levels. - Simple one-finger swipe controls. - Beautiful custom skins to unlock. - Daily rewards and lucky spin. - Play offline anytime! Relax your brain and start sliding now!

title: Up, Up, and Oops!
description: Climb an endless tower of floating tiles in this fast-paced 3D arcade action game. Read the path, choose the correct direction, and move before time runs out. howToPlay: Climb the floating path by choosing the correct action for the next tile. If the path continues straight ahead, jump forward. If it turns, press the direction in which the path continues. These modes give you three lives, and losing all three ends the run unless you use your one available revive. In Online Race, compete for two minutes and reach a higher step than the other racers. Falling returns you to the latest checkpoint, placed every 20 steps. Desktop Controls: W or ↑: Move upward. S or ↓: Move downward. A or ←: Move left. D or →: Move right. Spacebar: Jump forward. Mobile Controls: UP, DOWN, LEFT, and RIGHT Buttons: Move in the selected screen direction. JUMP Button: Jump forward in the direction your character is facing.

A persistent HUD displays a countdown timer for the Slender-inspired Tallman, a page counter, a flashlight battery indicator, and a mini-map for navigation. The setting is a classic horror woodland characterized by tall, spindly trees a…

Track your score, unlock cool titles, and see how far you can go without hitting the red line. Perfect for quick sessions or long strategic runs—Merge 2048 is simple to pick up, but hard to master!
howToPlay: Desktop: Drag by clicking the left mouse button , and leave the button to drop the block. Mobile: Drag with touch screen and block is dropped when the drag ends.

title: Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!
description: «Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!» is a casual puzzle game with physics and action destruction, where the challenge is to break a ragdoll stickman and plunge into a ragdoll simulator! Dive into a world of chaotic destruction and fun with the game «Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!». Throw your stickman and smash it to pieces. The game in the best traditions of Ragdoll physics will give you hours of fun, where every hit and every fall turns into a show of destruction! Ready to cope with the challenges? Complete all the tests, smash and break!
howToPlay: 🕹Drag the stickman onto the selected objects and watch the chaos unfold. Try to experiment with different objects to maximize damage. 🎯 Choose from a variety of objects to smash, hit, and drag the stickman. Each object has unique properties for maximum impact.

title: Anime Avatar Maker: Anime Doll
description: Game features: ✨ Choose different skin tones, hair styles, hair colors, eyes expressions and stylish dresses with lots of decoration items. ✨ Various hairstyles, different themes, and dressing up anime characters! ✨ Beautiful graphic art and high quality sound, well-arranged anime background scenes, a different photo experience! ✨ 2 different modes: Doll maker and PK
howToPlay: ✨ Create unique looks for various styling challenges and compete with other players at once. ✨ Don't forget to take a photo and save your creations to your phone

title: Sprunki Adventure 3
description: 🎮 Welcome to the exciting world of "Sprunki Adventure 3"! 🏞️ Embark on an exciting adventure with Sprunki! Explore colorful locations, meet unique characters, and complete fun quests. Each character can give you a special task, and completing it will earn rewards and bring you closer to uncovering the mystery. 🧩 Complete character quests 🌍 Explore different locations 🎁 Earn rewards for completing quests 🟠 Help Orange Sprunki achieve the main goal! Your main mission is to help Orange Sprunki open a mysterious chest. What is hidden inside? Treasure, an ancient secret, or something unexpected? Only the most curious players will discover the truth!
howToPlay: PC Controls: Move — W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys; Jump — Space; Run — Shift; Crouch — Ctrl; Interact — E; Open Menu — Tab; Open Inventory — I; Zoom Camera — Right Mouse Button (RMB); Bonus Speed from Ads — Z; Bonus Jump Power from Ads — X. Mobile Controls: Move — Joystick; Jump — Jump Button; Run — Run Button; Crouch — Crouch Button; Rotate Camera — Right side of the screen; Open Inventory — Button in the top-left corner; Interact — Button with the "E" icon; Open Menu — Button in the top-right corner.

title: ZAP
description: Play ZAP, the thrilling online puzzle card game! Match cards by color or number to clear your hand and block opponents. Fast-paced, fun, and competitive - perfect for card game lovers!
howToPlay: There are various strategies you can use to maximize your chances of winning at this ZAP game. The main principle is to get rid of all your cards before everyone else. You can do that by matching the color or number of the card placed down before yours. If you don't have a playable card, you must draw cards from the pile until you do. When you have one card left, press the "1" button, otherwise you will be punished with two penalty cards!

title: Draw or Delete LoveStory
description: Dive into the engaging realm of Draw or Delete LoveStory, a fascinating puzzle game where you play a detective revealing a couple's secrets. Manipulate scenes by drawing or deleting elements on your phone or computer. Enjoy this thrilling adventure filled with surprises, all at no cost online.
howToPlay: Look at the picture, read the task, draw or erase the element and complete the task! It's simple and very fun!

title: Word String
description: 🧠 Challenge Your Mind with Word Chains! 🧠 Do you love word games, brain teasers, and puzzle challenges? Get ready for a unique twist on wordplay with Word String Puzzle! Use the first given word, then uncover the next word, which either forms a compound word or completes a famous phrase. Keep guessing and linking words to create an exciting word chain that will test your vocabulary, logic, and creativity!
howToPlay: 🔡 How to Play? 🔡 ✔️ Start with the first word. ✔️ The next word must either: 🔹 Form a compound word with the previous word (e.g., “Sun” → “Flower” → “Pot”) 🔹 Complete a well-known phrase (e.g., Orange → Juice ("Orange Juice") ✔️ Keep linking words until you complete the full chain!

title: Crazy Bus Station!
description: ✨This is an exciting puzzle game in which you have to drive buses in brightly colored parking lots, solving complex problems and helping passengers find their cars. 📕 Brief features of the game: 📘 ✅ Unique gameplay: Each level offers new and challenging challenges. 🎯 ✅ Variety of vehicles: Collect stylish and unique vehicles. 🚕 🚗 🚙🚌 ✅ For all ages: From easy to advanced levels. 👲👴 ✅ Colorful graphics: Immersive world with beautiful cars and characters. 💛 Enjoy the game! 🎮
howToPlay: This is an exciting puzzle game in which you have to drive buses in brightly colored parking lots, solving complex problems and helping passengers find their cars. The aim of the game is to match cars with passengers and clear the parking lot. The car moves away in the direction of the arrow if you click on it. The car's path must be free, otherwise it will not be able to leave the parking lot. If there are difficulties you can always use the queue sorting and car shuffling boosters.

title: Dinosaur Shifting Run
description: Imagine sprinting across a scorching desert as a human adventurer, then transforming into a mighty dinosaur to smash through obstacles in a lush jungle! Unlike other runner games, Dinosaur Shifting Run offers unique challenges in every level, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. Dinosaur Shifting Run is packed with features that guarantee an epic adventure! - Easy Gameplay: Master the art of Dinosaur Shifting Run with simple taps and laughs all the way to the finish line! - Dinosaurs Galore: Have a variety of amazing dinos, each with awesome abilities, to keep the fun fresh! - Ever-changing Levels: Conquer tons of thrilling levels with unique challenges – you'll never get bored! - Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in vibrant environments brought to life with eye-catching graphics – prepare to be wowed!
howToPlay: - Transform the character to suit the environment. - Make sure you choose the right one to become the winner. - The higher level it is, the more difficult game-play it is.

title: Round Rush Jam
description: Round Rush Jam is a bright casual puzzle game where every piece can move only in the direction of its arrows. Plan the order of your moves, open escape routes, and clear each hexagonal board before you run out of moves. New obstacles, linked pieces, rotating paths, and useful boosters keep every level fresh and satisfying.
howToPlay: Tap or left-click a colored piece to send it along the direction shown by its white arrows. A piece leaves the board only when its path is clear, so move blocking pieces in the right order and use boosters when a puzzle gets tricky. Remove every colored piece before the move counter reaches zero to win the level. Controls: left mouse button on desktop; tap on mobile and tablet. No keyboard controls are required.

title: Hexa Master
description: Hexa Master is an addictive puzzle game that brings together color matching and hexagonal sorting for a truly satisfying challenge. Each move tests your ability to merge layers wisely. Are you ready to become a true Hexa Master?
howToPlay: Stack colorful hex blocks on a dynamic grid to create explosive chain reactions. Use powerful boosters to overcome complex levels

title: Idle Chicken Farm
description: Idle Chicken Farm is an idle/merge farming game where players start with a single chicken and build a thriving egg production business. Earn money by selling eggs, merge chickens to unlock stronger breeds, and upgrade your coop, production line, and delivery system. The game's unique hatchery mechanic lets players choose between selling eggs for guaranteed profit or incubating them for a chance to hatch new chickens and earn bonus rewards. With simple controls, strategic decision-making, and satisfying progression, Idle Chicken Farm offers a fun and rewarding gaming experience.
howToPlay: Build Your Ultimate Egg Farm! Start with a single chicken and grow it into a thriving egg production empire. Collect and sell eggs, merge chickens to unlock stronger breeds, upgrade your coop and production line, and expand your farm with new facilities. Take a risk by incubating eggs for a chance to hatch new chickens and earn valuable rewards! Desktop Controls Left Mouse Click: Interact with all game elements. Click & Hold + Drag: Collect and sell multiple eggs by dragging the cursor across them. Mobile Controls Tap: Interact with all game elements. Tap & Drag: Collect and sell multiple eggs by dragging your finger across the eggs.

title: Yatzy
description: Yatzy is the ultimate classic dice game that brings endless fun and excitement! Experience the thrill of rolling five dice to score the best combinations and outsmart your opponents. Whether you're a casual player or a Yatzy master, this game is perfect for you! Similar to games like Yacht and Yahtzee, Yatzy combines elements of strategy and luck, making it both challenging and entertaining. Whether aiming for a 🎲 Full House, a 📏 Straight, or the elusive 🏆 Yatzy (five of a kind), each roll offers a new opportunity to outscore your opponents.
howToPlay: Roll five dice to score the highest total over 13 rounds. Your Goal: Get the best possible combinations each round. Roll Up to 3 Times: Choose which dice to keep or re-roll. Pick a Category: After rolling, select a scoring category — each can be used only once. Scorecard: Upper Section: Count dice by number (Ones to Sixes). Lower Section: Use combos like Full House, Straights, or Yatzy (5 of a kind). Bonus: Score 63+ in the Upper Section for +50 points. Extra Yatzy? Get 100 bonus points! Highest total wins!

title: Draw Bridge - Brain Game
description: Draw Bridge - Brain Game is an exciting and challenging brain game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. In this bridge-building adventure, your task is to draw paths for the car to safely navigate through obstacles and reach its destination. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of bridge construction and puzzle-solving as you draw roads to rescue the stranded car! Core: A highly engaging physics-based puzzle runner where players must dynamically construct bridges to guide their vehicle across challenging environments. Loop: Player progression is centered on horizontal customization. Successfully clearing unique levels rewards players with soft currency, which can be spent on acquiring new vehicle cosmetics, skins, and dynamic exhaust animations. There is no vertical stat progression, emphasizing skill-based puzzle-solving and aesthetic collection. Start: Features immediately intuitive and accessible controls, ensuring a minimal friction onboarding process and allowing players to quickly engage with the core creative mechanic. Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Sta…
howToPlay: - Touch the screen to start drawing. - Hold and drag across to make the shapes you want. - Once you finish, release your finger and the car will run.

title: Color Sort Puzzle Milk Tea Sorting
description: Color Sort Puzzle: Water Sorting is a fun and addictive liquid sorting puzzle game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills. Your goal is simple: sort the colored water into separate bottles until each bottle contains only one color. But don’t be fooled — as levels progress, the puzzles become more complex and require careful planning! 💡 Why you’ll love it: Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay Smooth and satisfying pouring animations Relaxing visuals with vibrant colors No time limits — play at your own pace Hundreds of challenging levels Perfect brain training and stress relief Whether you want to relax or test your logic skills, this game offers the perfect balance of challenge and calm. Can you solve all the levels and become a sorting master?
howToPlay: Tap or click a bottle to pick it up, then select another bottle to pour the colored water. You can only pour water into a bottle if: * The top color matches the target bottle’s top color * Or the target bottle is empty * And there is enough space in the bottle Sort all the colors into separate bottles to complete the level. Plan your moves carefully and use logic to solve increasingly challenging puzzles!

title: Paint the Keyboard
description: "Paint your keyboard" is a vivid game about developing your own keyboard field. Run on the keys, paint them with a roller and get paid for each press. Buy new paints, boost your character's speed, increase the width of the roller and the paint supply. Open new areas of the keyboard and hire workers who will press the keys with you. Start a new round of development with constant additions and discover artists for self-painting. Turn a small field into a huge bright keyboard workshop!
howToPlay: A game about painting keys: press buttons, earn money, hire workers and expand the keyboard. On the computer: WASD — move. Hold down the right mouse button and move the mouse — rotate the camera. Mouse wheel — zoom in and out of the camera. On a mobile device: The joystick is moving. Swipe on the screen — rotate the camera. Move two fingers together or apart to indicate the camera's proximity and distance. To fill the roller with paint, go to the paint tank.

title: Escape from Wave for Brainrots
description: Welcome to the game "Escape from Wave for Brainrots"! 🌊🧠 A giant tsunami is already coming — and only you can save the Brainrots! Grab them, run away from the wave and get them to the base before it's too late. The faster you act, the more chances you have to save the rarest and most valuable brainrots. Boost your speed to take the brainrots further and faster. 🧠 Find rare Brainrots — from ordinary to truly legendary. 🏠 Deliver them to the base, expand the collection and become a real savior. Each new brainroot is a step towards progress, new opportunities and even more action. Test your reaction, strategy and speed — because the tsunami is not waiting! Can you save all the brainrots and become the main hero of the base? Run, rescue and collect the rarest ones before the wave catches up with you! 🌊🔥
howToPlay: For the computer: - Press the WASD keys or the ⬅️⬆️⬇️➡️ arrows. - Rotate the camera by moving the mouse with the right mouse button held down - Interaction with animals by pressing the E key - Jump to the Space For the phone: - Move using the joystick on the left side of the screen - Rotate the camera using the right side of the screen - Interact with animals using a pop-up window above the animal - Jump on the button on the right side of the screen

title: Snack Sort
description: Master the vending machine puzzle challenge! Clear colorful vending machines by sorting snacks into matching groups. With hundreds of satisfying levels, Snack Sort combines simple tap mechanics with brain-teasing puzzle strategy. Can you organize the chaos and empty every shelf? Features ✓ Hundreds of levels to master ✓ Colorful, appetizing snack graphics ✓ Simple one-tap controls ✓ Relaxing yet challenging puzzle gameplay ✓ Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle marathons Can you sort them all?
howToPlay: Goal: Match all snacks of the same type to clear the vending machine Controls: Tap any snack to move it to an empty slot at the bottom Strategy: You have 5 sorting slots - use them wisely! Plan your moves carefully to avoid getting stuck Progression: Complete each level to unlock the next challenge. Levels get progressively trickier with more snack varieties and complex arrangements

title: Stealth robbery of a house together
description: Stealth robbery of a house together: steal things, hide from the guards, take the loot to the van. Play with a friend on the same device. Play alone or with a friend on the same device. Your task is to take out as much furniture and valuables as possible from the house without being caught by security! The house is carefully guarded: guards are patrolling, and if you get in their line of sight, run! Use the abilities The goal of the game is to collect items from the house and take them to the van to complete the progress bar and complete the level! The more valuable the items are, the faster the scale increases.

title: Soda Sandbox
description: Thirsty for a fun sandbox game? Dive into Soda Sandbox - a world of bottles, chaos, and epic adventures! Travel vibrant worlds as a soda bottle seeking thrilling flavors. Stroll Volcano Island streets, battle rival bottles, drift cars in endless deserts, and clash in high-speed fights. Switch to build mode for ragdoll physics tests. One rule: have a blast! Spark creativity: Customize bottles, tweak surroundings, experiment with ragdoll physics - unleash imagination in this bottle game! Challenge your mind: Hunt tricky map secrets like vanishing water in survival-style puzzles. Only true explorers prevail! Master drifts: Race cities, jump ramps, flip bottles mid-air, conquer deserts - become a pro drifter. Battle wildly: Grab guns or weapons, smash soda foes in mad fights testing survival skills. Soda Sandbox mixes fighting, racing, survival, and creative modes. Smash tracks, stun with flips, arm for gunfights, or adventure freely. Taste every map's flavor! Ready, set, PLAY!

title: 99 Nights in the Forest. Horror Multiplayer
description: A terrifying multiplayer horror where players must survive side by side in a dark forest. Each night, a mystical deer-monster comes out to hunt, its footsteps and roar echoing in the darkness. You have a limited time — 99 days — to save the lost boys and escape the forest. At your disposal is a workbench where you can craft weapons, flashlights, and supplies to protect yourself and survive. Cook food using a cauldron. Explore the forest, gather resources, build shelters, and do everything you can to make it through another night. But remember — the monster never sleeps, and with each passing night, it becomes more dangerous. Game Features: -Atmospheric multiplayer horror. -Cooperative survival against the deer-monster. -Crafting weapons, flashlights, and supplies. -Goal: save the boys and escape the forest. -Unlock new character classes. *After surviving in the forest, only the money you’ve found and earned is saved — to unlock new characters — along with your achievements.
howToPlay: WASD – move E – interact with objects Complete achievements and save the boys. Unlock new character classes to gain fresh gameplay experiences. *After surviving in the forest, only the money you found and earned is saved — it can be used to unlock new characters and achievements.

title: Sniper for Brainrots
description: Sniper for Brainrots is an action-packed collection and survival game where every successful shot unlocks a brand-new Brainrot. Use your sniper rifle to hit the balloon above a Brainrot, instantly transform into it, and race to the Safe Zone before a massive tsunami catches you. The farther you shoot, the rarer the Brainrot you can collect but the faster the wave becomes. Build your collection, expand your Base, unlock powerful sniper rifles, customize your character, and compete with friends in this addictive Brainrot adventure featuring 87 unique collectibles!
howToPlay: Player 1 Move: WASD Jump: Space Sprint: Shift Scope: F or Right Mouse Button Zoom: Mouse Wheel or Shift while scoped Shoot: Left Mouse Button or Space while scoped Interact: E Upgrade Brainrot: Q Open Rebirth Menu: T Player 2 Move: Arrow Keys Jump: L Sprint: K Scope: Right Shift Zoom: K while scoped Shoot: L while scoped Interact: O Upgrade Brainrot: U Mobile: Touch controls are automatically enabled on mobile devices. Mobile supports Single Player mode only.

title: Defender: Tanks Merge
description: Defender: Tanks Merge is a thrilling online strategy game where you create a powerful army by merging unique tanks with abilities. Face increasing waves of enemies, using auto-merge, bombs, and mines to strengthen your tactics. Play for free on desktop or mobile and enjoy hours of strategic fun!
howToPlay: Controls: - Drag tanks together to merge - Drag unwanted tanks to the trash can - Tap ability buttons to use and select the target area - Cancel abilities by tapping any ability button or base area - Mines can't be placed near tanks—plan ahead

title: Game Factory
description: A full-featured game development studio right on your device! Choose from 6 genres — platformer, clicker, shooter, match-3, runner, or tower defense — and create unique games from scratch. Draw pixel sprites, customize levels, pick music, and share your creations with friends! Create, test, publish, and earn coins for your games. Upgrade your studio, unlock new genres and sprite packs!
howToPlay: 1. Click "Create Game" and choose a genre 2. Customize the settings: speed, gravity, number of enemies, and more 3. Go to Drawing — create your own unique sprites or pick from ready-made ones 4. Choose a music track in the Sounds tab 5. Click Test — play your game! 6. When everything is ready — click Publish and earn coins and XP 7. Share your games with friends using a code — they'll be able to play your creation!

title: MR RACER Stunt Mania
description: MR RACER : Stunt Mania is a thrilling 3D arcade racing game designed for mobile devices, offering endless excitement for casual and competitive players alike. Experience heart-pounding action, jaw-dropping stunts, and adrenaline-filled races as you take on challenging tracks and fierce AI opponents. Whether you’re racing for fun or aiming to master every level, MR RACER : Stunt Mania delivers a unique and immersive gaming experience that will keep you hooked! 🏎️ Features that Will Keep You Racing! 🔥 Stunning Racing Gameplay • Control your car with intuitive single touch. • Accelerate with ease, steer smoothly, and dominate the track! • Perform insane stunts on ramps and obstacles. 🏆 Exciting Levels & Stunning Themes • Level-Based Progression : Race across many thrilling levels spread across various unique themes. • Experience breathtaking themes like Toy House, Metaverse, Port, Candy-Land, Desert, and more! 🤖 Dynamic AI Opponents • Race against 5 intelligent AI cars that will push your skills to the limit. • Engage in intense collisions that will test your strategy and reflexes! 🚗 Unlockable Cars & Upgrades • Choose from many unique cars to fit your racing style. • Upgrade at…
howToPlay: MR RACER Stunt Mania is a high-octane 3D arcade racing game packed with extreme stunts and thrilling tracks. Race through exciting levels, perform jaw-dropping jumps, and compete against intelligent AI opponents. Simple controls, stunning themes, and nonstop action make every race an adrenaline rush. Game Features: • Fast-paced 3D arcade racing with insane stunts and jumps • Simple and intuitive controls suitable for all players • Level-based progression with increasing challenges • Multiple stunning themes like Toy House, Metaverse, Port, Candy-Land, Desert, and more • Race against 5 dynamic AI opponents in every level • Unlock and drive a variety of unique cars • Upgrade car attributes: Handling, Acceleration, and Top Speed • Challenging obstacles including ramps, flying objects, and hazards • Earn in-game currency by winning races and finishing strong • Smooth UI with Garage, Shop, and post-race rewards system Controls: Keyboard Controls W / ↑ Arrow – Accelerate A / ← Arrow – Steer Left D / → Arrow – Steer Right S / ↓ Arrow – Brake Mouse Controls: Click & Hold – Accelerate Swipe Left / Right – Steer Mobile Touch Controls: Tap & Hold – Accelerate Swipe Left / Right – Steer

title: Home Design - Match 3
description: Dive into a fun blend of creativity and strategy with Home Design - Match 3. Solve puzzles, design your ideal home, and unleash powerful boosters. Tackle challenging tasks and earn rewards to enhance your decor. Get ready to personalize your living spaces on any device!
howToPlay: - Match 3 or more items - Use boosters - Complete level objectives Just use your mouse or tap on the screen, and all the beauty will unfold!

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.
howToPlay: Move your character around on the screen to attack and defeat enemies. Make sure not to get hit when you pick up the gems dropped. Upgrade your weapons and abilities. Use the power-ups if you're in a tough spot.

title: Jump to the Rhythm of Songs! Musical Ball!
description: 🎵 Dive into the world of bright music, fast jumps and fun rhythms with the game "" This is a musical rhythm game, where each of your jumps is a hit in the music beat! Complete all the levels, jumping on the tiles to your favorite songs and trends of 2025! Are you ready to feel the rhythm and test your agility? 🎮 When creating, we were inspired by such popular games as "Jump to the Rhythm of the Hit! Cat Disco!" and "Tiles Hop Music & Ball Game". The result is a fun arcade game, where the ball moves along the platforms to the rhythm of popular hits. 🕹️ Features of the game: - Simple and intuitive controls: on the phone - swipe left or right, on the PC - move the mouse with the button held down. - Colorful 3D graphics - Popular music tracks - Possibility to play online for free, without registration - on mobile or PC - Leaderboard: compete with friends and rise to the top!
howToPlay: 🎯 Jump on the tiles and try to reach the end of the music track! 🕹️ The game controls are simple and intuitive! On the phone📱 — move your finger left or right to move the ball. On the computer💻 — hold the left mouse button and move the mouse. 🏁 Complete as many levels as possible, earn points and unlock new music tracks!

title: Ludo Legend
description: Play a game of Ludo! Everyones favourite board game! Play alone or with your friends on one device! Just pass it on! Colorful design and easy mechanics will keep you playing for hours!
howToPlay: Get your tokens from start to finish with rolls of a die. First, release them on the roll of 6. Roll a die and decide which token you move. Get all of them into a safehouse first and you win! But watch out, your opponents can kick your token back to their starting position when they land on the spot with one of your tokens!

title: Block Shooter: Shoot the Blocks!
description: Destroy blocks with an ever-growing arsenal of powerful weapons. Earn coins, unlock new guns, and upgrade them to deal even more damage. Level up each weapon with unique upgrade cards. Once it reaches Level 10, it keeps firing automatically while you use to another weapon. Build the ultimate arsenal and destroy blocks faster than ever.
howToPlay: 💥Core Gameplay: - Shoot from cannons to destroy blocks. - Earn coins for every block destroyed. - Unlock new cannons, each with its own unique power and shooting style. 🚀 Progression: - Every cannon has its own upgrade cards. - Collect and buy cards to level up your cannons. - Each level increases damage, fire rate, and other stats. - Upon reaching level 10, a cannon becomes passive. - Passive cannons continue to fire automatically while you control another cannon. Upgrade your arsenal and destroy massive block structures even faster! Controls: Left mouse button / Tap: that's it.

title: Aliens Hunter
description: You are an alien hunter and your mission is to use your abilities to find the aliens hidden in the city and use your gun to accurately shoot the aliens to get rewards. Each round has different aliens hiding in different locations. You have to accurately choose, aim and shoot to complete the level mission.
howToPlay: Use your abilities to find the aliens hidden in the city and use your gun to accurately shoot the aliens to get rewards.

title: Bingo Mania
description: A casual bingo progression game. Complete Kitchen Quest levels to gather ingredients, cook recipes from cupcakes to a grand feast, and unlock Bingo Battles at level 25 where you can play against other players in the game! In Kitchen Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — numbers are called, you daub matching cells, and complete patterns (lines, corners, themed shapes) to win. Every victory earns ingredients and recipe progress through stages: gather, prep, cook, decorate, and serve. Cook your way through five kitchen tiers: cupcake, pizza, burger, cake, and a grand feast. Serve your first dish in just 5 levels, then tackle longer recipes as difficulty ramps up with more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles. At level 25, unlock Bingo Battles — timed head-to-head duels against rival chefs. Outscore them before time runs out in ranked Trophy Duels or casual practice matches. There’s also a Chef Battles ladder gauntlet, daily tasks, leagues, and seasonal rewards. Portrait-first mobile design makes it easy to play on the go.
howToPlay: How to play Numbers are called one at a time — tap matching cells on your bingo card. Complete the target pattern and the game calls BINGO! automatically. Win ingredients and serve your first dish in 5 levels. Reach level 25 to unlock multiplayer bingo battles.

title: BMG Crash Test
description: BMG Crash Test🚗🚧 This is a realistic simulator where you can test various cars - from standard sedans to modern sports cars - on extreme tracks with dangerous hammers, springboards and other obstacles💥🚧. Test her cars for strength using rotating hammers, powerful presses and crazy jumps! Participate in crash tests and set new records! Choose your favorite cars and enjoy destroying them!
howToPlay: Destroy various wheelbarrows on large maps with lots of hammers, crushers, ramps, presses, and obstacles! Controls: TAB - Pause B - Slow down time N - next car Move - WASD Spacebar - Handbrake C - Camera Change For mobile devices use the game interface!

title: Dead Land: Survival
description: Dead Land: Survival is a multiplayer survival simulator set in a post-apocalyptic setting. The familiar world is destroyed – cities are in decay, with thousands of bloodthirsty zombies roaming their streets. Improve your hero, restore your shelter, venture beyond the safe zone in search of equipment, food, and crafting resources. Create new gear, join forces with other players in clans. FEATURES: • Battles against zombies. • Crafting weapons and equipment. • Restoration of the survivors' settlement. • Play with friends – raid elite bosses and participate in clan challenges! Join the battles right now!
howToPlay: How to repair items? Broken items can be repaired in the Workshop building under the Repair tab. How to install a new chest in the warehouse? To do this, you need to free up space in the warehouse. Remove one of the installed boxes, clearing it of items, and then place the new chest in its spot. What are lighters, cigarettes, matches, pine cones, and other items for? Most in-game items may be needed for completing settler quests, and some items can be used to upgrade buildings and shelters. You can either accumulate items in advance or collect them as needed, selling excess items to the trader in the settlement. Choose a strategy that suits you best. I collected 75 ears and can't enter Amelia's Diner, even though I brought them with me. To unlock the location, move the infected ears from your inventory to the slot with the requirement 0/75. How to start the game from the beginning? Go to Profile, then Settings. Click on the "Start Over" button.

title: Black Hole: Eat the Universe
description: Tap to feed a hungry black hole. Devour atoms, then planets, stars, and whole galaxies. Upgrade your pull, unlock skins and hats, spin for boosts, and collapse the universe to bank Dark Matter — then grow back faster. How big can your void get? Grow a hungry black hole from atoms to galaxies — upgrade, prestige, and devour the universe.

title: Fortress Clash
description: Fixed the reported issue: progress was not restored after a reload. Root cause: bridge.storage.get() returns the saved value already parsed as an object, while the game expected a JSON string and parsed it again, which threw and silently discarded the save. Changes: - storage.get() now accepts both shapes (object and string). - The save is loaded BEFORE gameplay is shown: a loading screen is displayed and input is ignored until storage.get() resolves, so a fresh default save can no longer overwrite real progress during startup. - Saves carry a revision counter, so after "finish a level, then buy an upgrade" the newest copy always wins instead of an older one at the same level. - Any pending write is flushed on page hide / unload, so the last action before a reload is never lost. Verified in the QA tool: state written before Reload game is fully restored after it.
howToPlay: Pick a block or unit from the bottom tray, then tap the grid to place it on your cart and build your fort and army. Blocks cost coins; every win pays out coins and lets you choose a bonus reward. Press Battle to launch - your archers and units fire at the enemy fort automatically. Win by destroying the enemy king: knock him off his cart, bury him in rubble, or blast through his walls. title: Solitaire 8 Collection
description: Eight solitaire classics in one collection: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf, Yukon and Scorpion. Surrender and watch the winning line play itself out. And it keeps the deepest record of your play in the genre: win rate with real confidence intervals, your first 50 games against your last 50, a six-month calendar of every session, best times, longest streaks, and your efficiency measured against the computer's own solution. Card backs and table themes unlocked by playing — never sold. Your progress follows you between devices.

In Pyramid you remove pairs that add up to thirteen. Mouse — Click a card and the game sends it where it belongs. Or drag it exactly where you want it. Click the stock pile to deal. Touch — Tap a card to play it, or drag to place it yourself. Tap the stock to deal. Keyboard — The whole game is playable without a mouse: Arrow keys move between cards and piles · Enter or Space picks up, drops or plays the focused card · Z undo · P hint · N new deal · M game menu · Esc closes any panel.

You can also zoom in and out to control your view, making it easier to spot matches and plan your moves. The goal is simple: clear all tiles by matching pairs, but as levels progress, layouts become more complex and require sharper focus and better positioning. The core mechanic is straightforward—tap one candy tile, then find and select its identical pair to remove both. Timing and awareness matter, especially when tiles are layered or partially hidden. Smooth controls and a clean 3D design make the experience relaxing yet engaging, whether you're playing for a quick break or a longer session.

And also try our other monster school games!
