Watch for glowing hints on the character’s face, they show where she needs a makeover. As you play, unlock new cosmetics, hairstyles, and accessories to make your character truly stand out.

title: Idle Magic Academy Tycoon
description: Idle Magic Academy Tycoon is a charming management simulator that puts you in charge of a growing academy of sorcery. You design classrooms, recruit skilled Magisters, and gather powerful artifacts to shape each lesson. As headmaster, you guide students from simple theories to advanced combat spells, expanding your academy into a legendary center of magic. Manage your academy wisely, constantly improve the quality of education, and transform your institution into a legendary center of arcane mastery! Develop your Academy’s infrastructure, collect Arcanum Spheres, and research magical technologies. Build your own center of magical education — step by step, classroom by classroom, artifact by artifact [Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about? What do players do? A: This is an idle tycoon game set in a magical academy. You build and upgrade various facilities, train students, and generate profits. Q: What is the game's hook? To upgrade the content of the selected room, choose the desired item and click the “Upgrade” button. Access to all main game mechanics is available from the main screen.

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

title: Meow Pair Pop

Take on the role of a monarch who must revive a ruined settlement, turning it into a thriving capital, and expand your territories by conquering new lands.

You can also upgrade your chief overseer - Make it faster - Improve his weapons - Carry more prisoners at the same time Once you have brought order to one prison, try doing the same in others! The game will be interesting for players of all ages. Everyone will find something interesting for themselves! This is an exciting trip for one person. The fate of the prisoners is in your hands. Great power goes hand in hand with great responsibility. Don't let me down =)!

Control: - For PC. Character control - "WASD", "arrows" or hold the left mouse button and drag the mouse in the desired direction. Shooting - the hero shoots automatically. - For Mobile devices. Character control - press your finger on the screen and drag your finger in the desired direction. Shooting - the hero shoots automatically. - To interact with any activities, you just need to stand on them as a character.

Slide each shaped block through the gate with the matching color, plan around obstacles, and solve every layout before time runs out. Compact levels, satisfying movement, and helpful boosters make every stage a quick but thoughtful challenge.

Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat. In this game, vampires disguise themselves as ordinary people, animals and even objects. Use unique exterminator kits and detectors to expose the hidden enemies. Unlock new areas, complete various levels and defeat the Vampire Lord to save the citizens. KEY FEATURES: - Vampire Exterminator Kits: Get new tools to fight the bloodsuckers. - Search Among Us: Vampires can be anyone - from neighbors to trees. - Rescue Citizens: Free people from vampire isolation. - New Locations: Complete levels in different areas of the city. - Vampire Tactics: Vampires become more cunning with each level. - Story Levels: Each location reveals a unique story.

Find all the successful ways to escape – whether you're solving puzzles in a room or surviving on an island. Test your logic, think outside the box, and uncover the one true path to freedom. Will you make it out? Good luck – your escape begins now.
howToPlay: Find all the successful ways to escape from the rooms and the island. Use your computer mouse to control the game. If you have a mobile device, use a stylus or your finger.

title: Sworded io - Spin and Rub
description: Sworded io - Spin and Rub is a fast-paced arcade sword-fighting game where you’ll test your reflexes, tactics, and timing against waves of fierce opponents. Upgrade your fighter, unleash spells, and conquer battle arenas through pure skill and clever strategy. Features Massive weapon variety: swords, axes, knives, and more Impactful power-ups to shift the tide of combat Two thrilling modes, Domination and Battle Royal Spin-powered action with dynamic, fast-paced gameplay Compete and rise as the ultimate warrior
howToPlay: Controls PC Controls Use WASD / arrow keys / drag left-click to move around. Mobile Controls Use the in-game joystick to move around.

title: Steal Car Duel
description: Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal Brainrot Duel into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades! Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode. Core Features: 40+ unlockable cars across 8 rarity tiers. Real-time stealing, dueling, and defense mechanics. Functional Weapons Shop and Market systems. Cosmetic customization with outfits, wings, and pets. Solo and local 2 Player support. Progressive income and rarity-based rewards. Game Modes: Solo Mode: Hunt for rare cars, raid rival garages, and defend your own collection. 2 Player Local Mode: Face a friend on the same device, steal their cars, block their progress, and see who builds the best garage. Rarity System: Standard – Basic models, perfect for starting your journey... Custom – Personalized versions with balanced performance and earnings! Street – Sportier cars built for strong garage.…
howToPlay: Player 1 Move: W A S D Jump: Space Steal / Buy: E Hit: F or Left Mouse Sprint: Left Shift Player 2 Move: Arrow Keys Jump: L Steal / Buy: O Hit: K Sprint: J

title: Swing Obby for Brainrots
description: Swing Obby for Brainrots in this game, you need to ride and enhance your Obby to rescue the Brainrots. Join in and start playing!
howToPlay: To grab the hook and fly, press the spacebar. Use the W, A, S, and D buttons during flight for better control.

title: Airport Controller
description: Experience the excitement of managing an airport in "Airport Controller," an engaging simulation game. Oversee landings, takeoffs, and air traffic, while handling aircraft maintenance and passenger boarding. This free game tests your ability to maintain order during hectic airport moments.
howToPlay: Airport Controller Game is a simulation where the player takes on the role of an airport manager, tasked with guiding planes to their destinations and managing the chaos of the airport. Drag planes to the correct locations, refuel, repair, and board passengers as you handle the growing traffic. Ensure safe landings and takeoffs, all while managing the resources of your busy airport. Can you keep everything running smoothly and avoid delays and accidents? The clock is ticking! Keyboard Move Plane - Drag with mouse to take the plane to the desired location Pause - P

title: Patch Garden
description: Patch Garden is a cozy rectangle logic puzzle where every seed clue grows into one perfect garden patch. Drag across the grid to draw rectangles, match each clue's area, and fill the whole board without gaps or overlaps. Start with simple tutorial gardens, then progress through hundreds of increasingly clever levels with mystery seeds, exact-size clues, larger boards, and tougher deduction challenges.
howToPlay: Grow the Perfect Garden! In Patch Garden, your goal is to fill the entire board with clean rectangular patches. Each seed clue belongs to exactly one rectangle, and the rectangle must match the clue's area. Think carefully, avoid overlaps, and cover every cell to complete the level. Desktop Controls: Mouse: Click and drag across the grid to draw a rectangular patch. Ctrl+Z: Undo your last move. E: Activate Erase mode, then click a placed patch to remove it. H: Use a hint to highlight a helpful solution area. Ad Hint Button: When your free hints run out, watch a rewarded ad to unlock one extra hint. Mobile Controls: Touch Drag: Drag from one cell to another to draw a rectangular patch. Undo Button: Tap to undo your last move. Erase Button: Tap to activate Erase mode, then tap a placed patch to remove it. Hint Button: Tap to highlight a helpful solution area. Ad Hint Button: When your free hints run out, watch a rewarded ad to unlock one extra hint.

title: Obby Toilet Line
description: Obby Toilet Line starts in the most chaotic place imaginable: a gas station restroom line. Around 30 different characters are already waiting, and the queue stretches all the way past the store entrance. Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end. This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn. This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn. To advance to the next spot, you must collect the required amount first. And there’s pressure, because sometimes the character behind you can act fast and push you back one place, making it even more important to keep earning and climbing. Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do? A: It's an idle game where you have to wait in line for the toilet and then enter the magical VIP world of idle games. Q: Is there a storyline in the game? A: There is no storyline, but the task is crystal clear. Wait in line, enter the VIP zone,…
howToPlay: Player 1 WASD: Move Space: Jump and line skip E: Interact F: Hit bugs Shift: Sprint Player 2 Arrow Keys: Move K: Line skip and interact L: Jump and hit bugs J: Sprint

title: Slinky Color Sort
description: Experience the fun of color therapy with this unique puzzle. Try the newest Color Sort game, perfect for relaxation, and enjoy the Slinky Sort Puzzle. Explore multiple levels in a game designed to relax you. Join Slinky Color Sort Puzzle, an addictive game that offers both challenge and relaxation with the task of sorting colorful rings. Join in and get your brain fired up with colorful excitement!
howToPlay: ✓ Drag and drop to move slinky rings by simply tapping the same color ✓ Only the same color can be moved at a time ✓ You can only move a ring onto another ring if both rings are the same color ✓ Place slinky rings of the same color in a single stack ✓ Solve logic puzzles with your color matching skills

title: Color Cube Puzzle
description: Color Cube Puzzle is a relaxing logic puzzle where you need to plan every move and position shapes correctly on the board. Move shapes to the cube conveyors. If the cube color matches the shape color, the shape starts filling with cubes. When a shape is completely filled, it disappears from the level. Your goal is to fill all shapes and clear the level. There are no timers, no bombs and no rush — you can take your time and think through every move. It is impossible to lose, you can always try a different solution. As you progress, new mechanics, obstacles and puzzle elements will appear. You can also use three boosters to help you complete difficult levels. The game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing but thoughtful puzzle games.
howToPlay: ► Move colored shapes around the board ► Move shapes to the cube conveyors ► If the colors match, the shape will start filling with cubes ► When a shape is fully filled, it disappears ► Fill all shapes to complete the level ► Use boosters if the level is difficult ► Think ahead — wrong moves can block your path Each level is a new puzzle where planning and the order of actions are important.

title: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines
description: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines is a logic game where you connect matching colored elements and draw paths across the board, planning every move. The levels gradually become harder: more colors appear, there’s less free space, and more situations where it’s easy to make a mistake. The game is great for relaxing while still giving your brain a workout — short levels, clear rules, and a real challenge closer to the final stages.
howToPlay: On each level, connect pairs of the same color with lines and fill the board neatly without blocking other colors. • Tap a colored element and draw a line to its matching pair. • Lines must not cross, and you usually can’t leave extra gaps. • If a move doesn’t work out, use undo/redo or restart the level. • Your goal is to connect all color pairs and complete the level.

title: Monster Tile Party
description: Monster Tile Party is a bright, family-friendly triple-tile puzzle game. Pick tiles from a layered board, collect three matching monster tiles, and clear every level before your tray fills up. Cheerful original characters, satisfying match effects, helpful boosters, daily rewards, and a growing level map make every quick round feel like a tiny party.
howToPlay: Select an uncovered tile to move it into the tray. When three identical tiles enter the tray, they are removed automatically. Clear all tiles from the board to win the level. If the tray fills before the board is cleared, the level ends. Use Undo, Shuffle, and Extra Slot boosters when you need help. - Desktop: move the pointer and use the left mouse button to select tiles and UI buttons. - Mobile: tap tiles and UI buttons with one finger. - No keyboard controls are required.

title: Archer Ragdoll
description: Get ready for the exciting adventure that awaits you: • Experience the incredible ragdoll archer physics that will leave you breathless; • Feel the realistic physics of arrows and armor - each arrow loudly ricochets and bounces, creating unpredictable situations; • Discover unique arrows with unique gameplay features that will add variety to your game; • A damage system awaits you, where each part of the body receives a different level of damage, making the game even more realistic; • Upgrade your hero to become a real master archer; • Fight interesting opponents and powerful bosses for a real challenge; • Enjoy beautiful and pleasant graphics, where explosions, sparks and splashes will envelop you like “Fire”; • Participate in the general ranking of players to show your skills; • Constantly level up with daily player ratings.
howToPlay: Control the archer using the mouse or by touching the screen on the left highlighted part of the screen. Hold the mouse (finger) behind the archer's back to draw the bow (no need to pull it horizontally). Keeping the bow drawn, aim and release.

title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
description: Get spooky and stylish with K-Pop Halloween Dress Up! Dress the Huntrix girls in hauntingly chic outfits like Witch, Pumpkin Queen, Vampire Idol, and more. Mix costumes, accessories, and spooky face paint to create bold Halloween looks for your favorite idols. Show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween K-pop style in this fun dress up game!
howToPlay: 1. Choose Your Character: Start your Halloween adventure by picking one of the three K-pop idols. Each idol has her own fierce personality and magical charm. 2. Select a Halloween Costume: Every girl has two exclusive Halloween looks to try. Dress Rumi as a Witch or Pumpkin Queen, style Mira as a Vampire Idol or Demon Diva, and transform Zoey into a Ghost Princess or Corpse Bride. 3. Apply Spooky Makeup: Add the perfect finishing touch with themed face paint to match each costume’s vibe. 4. Customize Accessories: Choose the best jewelry and props to complete your K-pop Halloween look. 5. Preview and Save Your Creations: Once your idol’s transformation is complete, take a screenshot of your stylish masterpiece and share it with friends or on social media.

title: Volley Beans
description: 🏐 GET READY TO SERVE UP SOME FUN! 🏐 Jump into the wackiest volleyball game ever! Control adorable wobbly beans in fast-paced matches that'll have you laughing and competing for hours. ⭐ WHY PLAYERS LOVE VOLLEY BEANS: - Hilarious physics-based gameplay - Play solo against AI or challenge friends online - Quick 2-minute matches perfect for any break - Unlockable characters and customizations - Easy controls, impossible to put down! 🎮 GAME MODES: - Career Mode: Climb the volleyball championships - Online Multiplayer: Challenge players worldwide - Local Play: Pass-and-play with friends - Tournament Mode: Compete in special events 🏆 FEATURES THAT MAKE US DIFFERENT: - Unique wobbly character physics - Colorful, eye-catching graphics - Satisfying sound effects and music - Regular updates with new content Perfect for volleyball fans, casual gamers, and anyone who loves fun sports games with a twist!
howToPlay: Control the game with your mouse and keyboard. Use the left mouse click to jump, double click to smash the ball, and press SPACE to start the game and enter the action.

title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
description: Are you ready for an object search game that's as cute as it is challenging? Dive into Find 100 Capybaras, an adventure where you'll have to find and collect 100 adorable, cute capybaras hiding in beautiful places! 🌿 Explore stunning locations with lush forests, charming villages, secret dungeons and unknown planets. 🏘🐉🪐 Discover all the hiding places of our furry friends and test your observation skills. 🔍 Enjoy bright graphics and a delightful soundtrack that will accompany you throughout your journey.
howToPlay: Are you ready for a hidden object game that's as cute as it is challenging? Jump into "100 Hidden Capybaras" – the ultimate hidden object adventure where your mission is to find and collect 100 adorable capybaras, each hiding in beautifully designed scenes! 🌿 Explore stunning environments filled with lush forests, charming villages, secret dungeons, and unknown planets. 🏘🐉🪐 Discover all hiding spots for our fluffy friends as you put your observation skills to the test. 🔍 In the black and white picture provided, find the capybara that is displayed in the upper right corner of the screen. Click on its location, then look for the next one. Enjoy vibrant graphics, and a delightful soundtrack that will keep you engaged throughout your journey.

title: Draw Action
description: Draw lines and defeat enemies effortlessly! The game is best suited for those who want to let off steam and relax now. Various attack schemes are available to you, depending on which pattern you draw. The enemy is making a desperate attack on you. Can you win without taking damage?
howToPlay: Goal: defeat all enemies on the level. To win, beat the enemy until his health is reduced to zero. Or you can push the enemy out of the location so that he falls into the water and dies. To make a hit, tap on the leg or arm of the blue character and draw a pattern. Draw lines and strike enemies wisely using tactics. Do not forget to improve the characteristics of your character. Over time, more and more deadly combo attacks will be available to you. But the enemies are getting stronger, more agile and their number is growing. Become a winner in the exciting game “Draw Action" right now!

title: Bubble Tower
description: Bubble Tower 3D is a relaxing 3D bubble-pop / color-match puzzle game. You rotate a tower (or cylinder) loaded with colored bubbles around its vertical axis. Your goal is to shoot bubbles, matching colors to connect groups of the same color. When matched, those bubbles pop/drop off the tower. There are many levels; difficulty increases as you go. More bubble colors, trickier arrangements, limited shots, etc. Also there are diamonds or special gems you can collect in certain levels. These may unlock “shiny shapes” or cosmetic things. The graphics are clean, simple, and meant for relaxing casual play. It mixes mental challenge (where to shoot, color matching) with a soothing visual.
howToPlay: A tower appears with a cluster of bubbles of various colors. There’s a shooter that holds the next bubble to fire. You can rotate the tower around (usually by dragging left/right or using onscreen controls) to bring bubbles of matching color in position. Tap or drag to aim, then let go (or tap a location) to shoot the bubble toward the tower. Match it with other bubbles of the same color. When you connect 3 or more bubbles of the same color, those bubbles pop/drop off. Bubbles that are hanging (i.e. no longer connected to the base or other bubbles) also fall off. Some levels include diamonds or special gems placed in certain parts of the bubble structure. You need to target those, maybe by matching bubbles around them or popping surrounding bubbles to let them fall. You win a level if all bubbles (or the required ones) are cleared. If you run out of shots (or fail to clear the required bubbles), you lose and must retry.

title: Sniper Shooter-Save The Fish
description: This game is a physics-based puzzle experience that reimagines the bubble shooter genre. Built around a rotating hexagonal structure, each level challenges players to adapt to changing angles, motion, and gravity. With an ocean-themed visual style and a light narrative about a crab rescuing a clownfish, the game delivers a fresh combination of strategy, physics, and immersive design.
howToPlay: Aim and launch bubbles toward the hexagonal structure. Impacts may trigger rotation, changing the direction and behavior of bubbles in real time. Use timing, angles, and structural movement to clear bubbles and complete level objectives.

title: MFPS:Military Combat
description: Engage in gunfights, survive the chaos, eliminate rivals and rise as champion of the battlefield . '
howToPlay: WASD keys to move, Left Mouse Click to attack, Right Mouse Click for special actions . '

title: Find a Pair 3D
description: 🔎🔍Welcome to the game "Find a Pair 3D". In this game, the player is tasked with finding two identical items from a pile of objects and merging them. For every successfully merged pair, the player earns one star. As the player progresses through levels, new and increasingly diverse items appear, making the game more challenging. The goal is to merge as many pairs as possible to accumulate stars. Additionally, the game features a leaderboard where players can compare their scores and compete for the top position. The higher the level, the more difficult the item combinations become, adding excitement and complexity to the gameplay.
howToPlay: Drag objects onto the round platforms at the bottom of the screen. To complete the level, you need to find all pairs of objects.

title: HexaSort
description: Отличная головоломка с сортировкой Сортируй гексы по цветам Выкладывай их так, чтобы плитки одного цвета оказались рядом. Тогда стопка исчезнет!
howToPlay: Выкладывай плитки на игровой стол. Старайся расположить плитки одного цвета рядом, тогда столбики сольются и исчезнут! Используй подсказки 🙂

title: Gun Clone
description: Gun Clone is a thrilling arcade runner where players can upgrade and duplicate powerful weapons. This free online game promises fast-paced action, featuring both genders. Navigate through various levels, defeat foes, and customize your arsenal for a captivating gaming experience perfect for short or long play sessions.
howToPlay: Moving is done using your finger or mouse cursor. Shooting occurs automatically. Upgrading weapons occurs at the level or in the main menu.

title: Falling Dummy
description: Push the dummy off the roof of the tallest building on the construction site and watch it break all its bones. Control the body of the little man as he falls and break as many limbs as possible! Do you want to relax after a hard day? Then this game is made for you! In this anti-stress game, your main goal is to make the dummy break as many limbs as possible when falling from tall buildings! Control the flight of the dummy, direct its body to the floor level, concrete structures, construction cranes and other construction objects to break even more bones of the dummy! Game features: - Relaxing gameplay - Bright stylized 3D graphics - Interesting levels - Cool skins
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to break as many bones as possible on the dummy by directing it into obstacles while falling from a height.

title: Robby: Build Bridge To Brainrots
description: Collect wood! Build a bridge to reach the brainrots! 🌉 Improve the collection and storage of wood! ⚡ Get to new islands and collect more cool brainrots!
howToPlay: Catch and put brainrots on the base, improve the collection and storage of wood to go further. WASD Management Space - Jump Pcm - Rotate the camera E - Install/take a brainroot F - Throw it away

title: Summon Tribe
description: Summon Tribe is a simple merge-and-defense game where you combine identical units to create stronger ones to stop enemies. It’s easy, mostly for passing time, and it also supports idle play.
howToPlay: Merge facilities, traps, and turrets to build the strongest defense. Plan carefully in limited space and defeat your enemies! Choose your skills to boost your defense and find the best combo to survive.

title: Loose Change: Cashier Simulator
description: A relaxing coin sorting puzzle where you arrange coins by year and value. Plan each move, clear the board efficiently, use boosters when stuck, and improve your best score with every run.
howToPlay: Drag a coin to move it into an available slot. Sort coins by matching their year and value, clear completed groups from the board, and try to finish with as many moves and boosters left as possible.

title: FISH FACTORY
description: FISH FACTORY is a cozy 3D fishing and production tycoon set in a polished voxel world. Explore a large living island and unlock five distinct fishing areas. Complete a collection of 100 fish species: every catch depends on the location, time of day, rod and tackle. Choose the exact casting point, hit the moving target and carry your catch to the receiving station. Build conveyors, upgrade workshops and open your own fresh-fish shop. Visitors arrive to buy fish, net manipulators gather catches, and a fishing parrot can occasionally bring an extra fish. Day turns into night, lanterns light up, nocturnal creatures appear in the water, and voxel animals roam the island. Grow at your own pace and turn a small pier into a profitable fishing village.
howToPlay: On desktop, move with WASD. Zoom the camera with the mouse wheel or the + and − buttons. Walk to the water, press SPACE, aim at an available spot and confirm the cast. While reeling, click when the moving bar enters the highlighted zone. Land several accurate hits to place the fish in your keepnet. On mobile, move the fisher with the round joystick, tap the fishing button and choose the casting point with your finger. Use + and − to adjust the camera. Carry the catch into the bright circle by the receiving station. Fish are automatically placed on an available conveyor, and coins are paid after processing. Use the shop to buy rods, tackle, clothing, workshops, new fishing areas, lanterns and other upgrades. Follow the tutorial to learn the full route from casting to your first rod upgrade. Ads are optional and only provide extra bonuses.

title: Little Princess Dress Up
description: Why You'll Love Little Princess Dress Up: ✨ Fashion Battles with Other Players: Showcase your style skills by battling it out with other players. May the best fashion creator win! ✨ Capture Your Creations: Take pictures of your dressed-up dolls and save them to your gallery. Share your designs with friends or keep them as your fashion portfolio. ✨ Special Princess Dresses: Access a collection of special dresses, including princess gowns that will make your doll look like royalty. ✨ Adorable Chibi Graphics: Dive into a game with cute and adorable graphics that will melt your heart with every outfit you create. ✨ Healing Sounds: Enjoy the healing soundtracks that make your dress-up experience even more relaxing and enjoyable. ✨ Be a Doll Avatar Maker: Create your favorite character with a wide range of customization options, bringing your ideal chibi doll to life.
howToPlay: You're bringing a character to life with an extensive wardrobe of clothes, accessories, shoes, and dresses. Accompany your stylish creations with adorable pets, adding an extra layer of cuteness to every outfit.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description: Join the ultimate puzzle challenge in Cube Drop Puzzle Test your strategic thinking in this addictive game where you must drag and drop furniture-shaped blocks to match colors with their corresponding stick figures. Plan your moves carefully as you navigate limited space and increasingly complex levels. With its vibrant visuals and easy-to-learn mechanics, Cube Drop offers endless hours of brain-teasing fun! Key Features: Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Combine the best of block puzzles and color-matching games. Challenging Levels: Navigate tricky layouts and test your problem-solving skills. Intuitive Controls: Simply drag and drop to play! Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy colorful graphics that bring each puzzle to life. Progressive Difficulty: Start easy and work your way up to more challenging levels. Ready to drop into the fun? Download Cube Drop Puzzle and start solving today!
howToPlay: 🧩 How to Play - Drag and move the holes across the board - Match each cube to its correct color block hole - Let the glasses drop smoothly into the hole - Solve each puzzle step by step, using logic and strategy - Complete the level when all coffee cups fall into the right place

title: K-Pop Puzzle Hunters
description: In this free puzzle game, K-Pop fans and enthusiasts can piece together stunning images of Huntrix, Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger from the beloved K-Pop Demon Hunters universe. With puzzles ranging from 16 to 100 pieces, players can choose their challenge and utilize hints when needed. This game perfectly blends strategy, logic, and fandom fun, making it a great fit for anime lovers, fans of K-Pop, and puzzle enthusiasts. Start solving today to become the ultimate Puzzle Hunter.
howToPlay: 1. Choose an image – Select one of 12 stunning pictures inspired by Huntrix, Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger. 2. Pick puzzle difficulty – Break the image into 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces depending on how challenging you want it to be. 3. Assemble the puzzle – Drag and drop the pieces into the correct spots to rebuild the picture. 4. Use the hint button – Stuck? Press “Hint” to see how the final image should look. 5. Complete and enjoy – Once finished, admire your K-Pop-inspired masterpiece and try another image! Perfect for casual players, puzzle lovers, and K-Pop fans who enjoy relaxing yet brain-stimulating games.

title: Kind Shelter - Animal Care and Treatment
description: A relaxing ASMR animal-care game where you treat and style adorable pets. As a caring vet and stylist, you’ll examine and heal stray cats and other furry friends, bathe and groom them, remove parasites, and perform delicate treatments. After care, dress them up with cute outfits, accessories, and hairstyles. Enjoy soothing sounds, cozy vibes, and the harmony of every touch!
howToPlay: First, choose the pet you want to save and transform. Use the mouse or simply tap the screen to select tools and perform actions. Follow instructions to care for the pet’s skin, eyes, ears, and claws. For cosmetic procedures, just tap the desired tool and drag it over the corresponding area of the pet. The game controls are intuitive, allowing you to easily switch between actions and choose the necessary tools.

title: A Mother's Grief
description: Winter, 1892. In a remote cabin, a grieving mother named Elara lost her daughter, Lily, to a fever. Consumed by grief, she performed a forbidden ritual hidden inside the cabin's walls to bring her daughter back. The girl returned - but her eyes were black, her voice a whisper of static, and she spoke in tongues. The thing that came back has worn Lily's face for eight years... and it is still in the cabin. Waiting. You are a hunter of places with dark histories. Enter the house. Look. Prove what happened.
howToPlay: - Walk through a fully explorable 1892 cabin: hallway, living room, bedroom, kitchen, fireplace nook and the L-leg evidence room. - Find and photograph 8 haunted objects - Lily's rag doll, the grimoire, the bone blade, the pentagram, the demon-child and more. - Every photograph you take is a piece of evidence. Open your journal (TAB) to read the cabin's history and pin each proof to the evidence board. - Real first-person controls with mouse look, sprint, crouch, a flashlight, an old film camera with a working viewfinder (battery, shots, date/time), flickering ceiling lights and dust-filled air. - Dynamic audio: footsteps on wood, camera shutter, an atmospheric ambience track and a whisper that gets closer the longer you stay. - Survive the finale: the demon-child is waiting at the foot of the bed. Photograph her before she learns your name - then get out. CONTROLS W A S D ....... Move Mouse ......... Look Shift ......... Run C ............. Crouch E ............. Interact / open doors / pick up gear / pin photos F ............. Flashlight (after you take the lantern) SPACE ......... Raise / lower the camera (after you take it) Left Click .... Take a photograph through the lens TA…

title: Mini Golf Battle
description: Mini Golf Battle is a fun and casual mini golf challenge where your goal is simple: hit the ball into the hole with as few shots as possible. The game combines easy controls with tricky levels full of slopes, angles, and obstacles that test your timing and precision. Each level is designed to get a little harder, so you’ll need to aim carefully, control your shot power, and plan the best path to sink the ball. It’s a relaxing yet addictive golf experience made for quick play sessions.
howToPlay: Drag/swipe in the direction you want the ball to move. Pull back and release to adjust the strength of your shot. The longer you drag, the stronger the hit. Try to sink the ball into the hole in the fewest strokes possible. Watch out for walls, ramps, and barriers that can deflect your ball. Use angles to bounce around corners smartly. Fire Power: This bonus gives your ball a flaming speed boost. It’s useful for long straight shots or when you want to quickly cross a large gap. Best used when you need maximum distance in a single strike. Wing / Glide Power: This bonus allows your ball to glide smoothly as if it has wings. It reduces friction and gives your ball a longer travel path with better control. Ideal for precision shots where you want distance but also don’t want to overshoot too wildly. Spring / Bounce Power: This bonus acts like a spring-loaded push. It helps your ball bounce forward with extra force, perfect for overcoming obstacles or making tricky jumps. Best for courses with barriers, ramps, or platforms where normal shots can’t reach.

title: Grow Empire
description: Strategically upgrade your walls, towers, and warriors. Defend your city from the attacks of elephants, siege guns and waves of enemy troops, covering the sky with arrows and fire. Defeat your enemies by clashing with Egyptian, Italian, Gallic, Iberian and Carthaginian warriors, and expand your empire across Europe and Africa. Conquer their cities and get chests with gems, gold, potions and maps! Defend your colonies and replenish your bank with gold. Become the leader that Rome claims to be.
howToPlay: Your task is either to defend the fortress or to attack! Release troops to attack or defend - they will fight automatically. To defeat the enemy, use various abilities and upgrade your warriors.

title: Secret Parkour
description: Tower of Hell Parkour with Secrets and Surprises! Jump, run, and reach new heights in this thrilling game! Avoid the lava and conquer all the "regions" - from easy to extremely challenging levels! Hidden Waterfall: Discover secret platforms and jump into the waterfall to find a hidden room filled with coins and trophies! Collect enough trophies to unlock the secret wall and gain access to a new portal and a unique character skin! Parkour through City Skyscrapers: Face increasingly difficult challenges, dodge rotating obstacles, and show off your agility! Use hidden shortcuts to reach the top faster! Show everyone you’re a true parkour master!
howToPlay: The goal: get to the end. Control: WASD - movement. Space bar - jump. TAB - pause. F - dash. Shift - cursor. Mouse wheel - zoom in/out. On the phone: Use the game interface.

title: God Of Entropy
description: A falling‑sand simulation with both story and sandbox modes. Freely experiment with dozens of elements, trigger chain reactions, build or destroy creations, and unlock fun achievements
howToPlay: Story Mode – Complete each level’s goal using the available elements to progress the story Sandbox Mode – Experiment without limits, create your own scenes, and unlock achievements Controls: Select element – Click an icon in the left toolbar Draw element – Left Click + drag Draw straight line – Shift + Left Click + drag Adjust brush size – Mouse wheel or on‑screen slider Pause / Menu – ESC key

title: Animal Royal
description: "The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals." You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious. howToPlay: Controls: WASD - drive Space - handbrake Shift - boost C - change camera R - reset car N - new vehicle K - repair B - slow motion Tab - pause Mobile users: tap on-screen buttons. Objective: wreck, tune, and explore to your heart's content!

title: Winter Tale: Secrets and Mergings
description: A magical puzzle awaits you in the heart of a winter fairy tale! Together with brave heroes, you must return the magic of Christmas to the snowy forest. Uncover ancient secrets as you restore the lost enchantment. What awaits you: • Unravel mysteries: Each item you merge on the board is a step toward uncovering the forest’s main secret. • Create magic: Complete tasks, earn rewards, and use them to restore unique fairy-tale artifacts. • Enjoy the enchantment: Immerse yourself in a world of colorful graphics and animations that feel as if they’ve come straight from the pages of a storybook. • Don’t miss a day: Take part in daily events and quests to earn valuable prizes. This is an adventure where every puzzle brings you closer to a miracle. Are you ready to restore the spirit of Christmas?
howToPlay: Dive into a magical winter tale! A mysterious puzzle game awaits you. • Create magic: Merge identical items to unlock fascinating combinations and collect rare magical artifacts. • Become part of the story: Complete exciting quests and uncover all the secrets of the winter tale. • Do good: Spend resources to build a better New Year. • Play with pleasure: Intuitive controls, perfectly tuned for touchscreens and mouse, let you fully immerse yourself in the game. This charming adventure makes every new item combination a step toward unraveling the mystery and reaching the heart of winter magic!

title: Mr Shooter
description: Mr Shooter, a Balloon popping desert plant on a mission... A mission to pop all the Balloons in the world! The objective is simple: Pop all the Balloons to win! Unlock and select new powerful cards as you progress through the game. With hundreds of creative and varied levels, this game will keep you entertained for hours.
howToPlay: Tap anywhere on the screen to shoot needles from Mr. Shooter. Your goal is to hit the spinning cactus targets with your needles. Don’t hit other needles already stuck in the target or you’ll lose! Each level gets faster and trickier can you beat them all?

title: Supermarket Empire
description: Supermarket Empire is a simulation game where you become the master of your own retail kingdom! Take charge of managing and growing your supermarket as you aim to build a thriving empire. Earn money and expand your store by offering a wide range of products that cater to the needs of your customers!
howToPlay: Use WASD / arrow keys / drag the left mouse button to move around. Serve your customers and make them happy!

title: Last Knight: kings throne
description: This is a casual dodge arcade escape game. Play as a cute little character and keep escaping from chasing monsters on the random map. It perfectly combines fast-paced evasion gameplay, random buff items and fresh cartoon art style, bringing you relaxing and thrilling spare-time fun! Game Highlights Flexible free movement: Drag to control your character freely and change directions anytime to avoid incoming monsters.Random pickup buff system: Collect randomly spawned props including speed boost and monster freeze to get away from dangerous encirclement.Progressive difficulty curve: More monsters spawn and their moving speed rises continuously as your survival time extends. Game Advantages Easy risk avoidance tactics: Use terrain space to circle monsters and prolong your survival time for higher scores.No complicated rules: Pure casual design without tedious tutorials, instantly jump into matches after opening the game.Unlimited endless mode: Keep challenging your personal best score repeatedly for higher leaderboard rankings. Game Features Simple intuitive operation: Support drag control on mobile and mouse control on PC, all players can master in seconds.Compact random maps: Every…
howToPlay: Drag to control your character freely and change directions anytime to avoid incoming monsters.Random pickup buff system: Collect randomly spawned props including speed boost and monster freeze to get away from dangerous encirclement.Progressive difficulty curve: More monsters spawn and their moving speed rises continuously as your survival time extends.

title: Connect Associations
description: A set of words hides several meaningful connections. Find four words that share a theme and merge them step by step into one group. Correct matches reveal categories, while later levels introduce fresh word sets and ice obstacles. The relaxed pace gives you time to consider every move. Hints can keep the solution moving when a connection is especially tricky. Complete levels, earn coins, and watch your overall progress grow.
howToPlay: 1. Find two words that belong to the same theme. 2. Tap the first word and then the second, or drag one onto the other. 3. Keep adding related words until the group contains all four. 4. Every correct merge damages the ice. Free frozen words before using them. 5. Reveal every category to complete the level. Incorrect pairs cost one attempt. If you get stuck, shuffle the words or use a hint.

title: Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground
description: 🎯 Ready for some fun action with ragdoll stickmen? The game "Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground" will hook you from the first level! Become a sharpshooter, control a rotating gun and destroy funny yellow mobs in a bright casual 3D shooter. This simple playground shooter is inspired by the popular games "Playground Man! Ragdoll Show!" and "Melon Playground". Here you will find everything you need for a fun action: ragdoll physics, stickmen, different guns and interesting levels. Click "Play" and show your sniper skills! 🔥 Game Features 🔥 Simple one-tap controls: just shoot at the right moment Bright 3D graphics with funny ragdoll physics and funny jelly stickmen Exciting gameplay: use items on levels to effectively destroy enemies Play online from your mobile or PC without downloading. Various weapons: from a pistol to powerful guns.
howToPlay: 🔥 Game Goal: Shoot the ragdoll stickmen and destroy them all on the level! Clear the level of mobs and become the best shooter in the playground shooter! 🕹️Controls: 🖥️On PC: Click the left mouse button at the right moment to fire the rotating cannon at enemies. 📱 On mobile: Tap the screen to fire the cannon at the perfect moment. 💡 Tip: Use exploding barrels and other objects to deal more damage.

title: OIL RIG Driller
description: Drill Tycoon is a top-down idle tycoon set in a sun-baked desert oil field. Sink your rigs, haul the crude to the refinery, stack the barrels in your yard and sell them to the trucks rolling in on the loading road. Reinvest every dollar: faster rigs, a bigger depot, and a hired crew that keeps drilling while you are offline. Unlock gas, gold and finally diamonds, each with its own rig, plant and price. What sets it apart from the usual idle game: your crew works to real demand instead of just the nearest target, and your rigs wear down and need maintenance, so the field never quite runs itself.
howToPlay: Move with WASD or the arrow keys on desktop, or drag anywhere on the screen on mobile. Walk up to a rig to drill it, carry the load to the matching plant to refine it, then drop the barrels at the depot. Trucks help themselves and pay at the office, so stand on the green cash ring to collect the money. Step onto an upgrade pad to buy it: new rigs, new plants, more backpack space, faster machines and extra workers. Keep your rigs running by fetching wrenches from the workshop. Goal: unlock all 19 upgrades and build the richest oil empire.

title: Parking Master: Urban Challenges
description: Explore the dynamic environment of city driving in "Parking Master: Urban Challenges," an engaging 3D simulation that hones your parking skills. Maneuver through complex urban settings with lifelike vehicles, ideal for anyone looking to improve their driving abilities on mobile or desktop platforms.
howToPlay: Your task is to park the car in a certain area without getting into an accident and doing it as quickly as possible. Follow the arrows to find a parking space. The progress is saved when the level is completed. To go to the next level, you need to pass the previous one. WASD or arrows — movement and rotation of the car. The space bar is the handbrake. E or ~ — open the game menu. M — switch the camera.

title: Christmas Girls Dress Up
description: Celebrate the holidays in Christmas Girls Dress Up, a festive fashion game where you style four friends for a magical Christmas celebration! Each girl has a unique theme: gingerbread cutie, Nutcracker elegance, Santa sweetheart, and Grinch-inspired glam. Mix and match tops, dresses, hairstyles, shoes, and accessories to create cozy, cheerful outfits. Create unique Christmas outfits for our girls, express your creativity, and enjoy the ultimate Christmas dress-up fun filled with sparkle, style, and holiday vibes!
howToPlay: Use your mouse to play this game on a desktop, tap to play on mobile devices. Browse through the category items, and select the items you like the most.

title: Cats Block Puzzle
description: Just drag and drop cats onto the puzzle board and see if you can make them all fit perfectly! 🧩 Each puzzle has its own unique shape and gets more challenging as you play, which will make your brain think differently. With every puzzle you solve, it gets more challenging. Will you be able to fit all the kitties? 😼 As you master each puzzle, you can collect adorable new cats to personalize your gameplay! PUZZLE CATS FEATURES: PLAY WITH CUTE CATS - Enjoy a variety of adorable cats like cute cats, fat cats, and even some angry cats! 😺 - Try to fit all the cats in the puzzle without upsetting them! FUN BLOCK PUZZLES - Challenge yourself with engaging block puzzles, but now with cute cats instead of regular blocks! 🐾 - Arrange the blocks to fit the board and move to the next level! COLLECT NEW CATS - Solve puzzles and level up 🎉 - Collect new cats as you progress in levels! - Dress up your cats with cute costumes! TRAIN YOUR BRAIN - Improve your thinking and spatial reasoning with these shape-based puzzles 🧠 - Puzzles become tougher as you advance, keeping the challenge fresh!
howToPlay: Just drag and drop cats onto the puzzle board and see if you can make them all fit perfectly! Each puzzle has its own unique shape and gets more challenging as you play, which will make your brain think differently. With every puzzle you solve, it gets more challenging. Will you be able to fit all the kitties? 😼

title: Machine Eater
description: Create blocks using the resources you collect, expand your ship, and strategically place structures with different features on the blocks you create before selecting your enemy on the radar. Use your strategy skills to eliminate the enemies you detect on the radar. The structures you collect from enemies will add depth to your strategy.
howToPlay: Controls Use WASD / arrow keys / mouse to move the character.

title: Strategy of war: Tanks and helicopters
description: War Strategy: Tanks and Helicopters is an engaging online strategy game where you lead forces to seize enemy strongholds. Play seamlessly on various devices without downloading. Enjoy tactical combat as you use tanks and helicopters to succeed in this skill-testing military challenge—no registration needed.
howToPlay: Select a base to move or attack, click once for half the troops, twice for all, and remember that moving between ground and air bases requires double the troops.

title: Game of Warrior
description: Game of Warriors is a Strategy TD (Tower Defense) game with a unique style in its genre. Set in a magical world you will have to upgrade your defenses and mighty soldiers to survive and siege enemy territories to conquer them. The rival alliance of the evil kingdoms has pushed what remains of the human civilization to a corner of the world, isolated and forgotten, plunged into misery and trying to survive harshly. Ready the horses, hire your warriors and prepare the spears for battle, the war horn will sound again and our titans will destroy the enemy walls and towers. The age of dark empires have come to an end, it's time to recover what rightfully belongs to us, it's time for revolt, war and revenge! Features: - Tower Defense (TD) and Strategy game style. - 1500+ defensive waves. - 100+ territories to conquer. - 30+ soldiers to upgrade. - 1000+ building upgrades. - 4 different races to conquer (Goblins, Skeletons, Worgens and Orcs). Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do? A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game. You need to upgrade your soldiers, fortress, and attack other territories, turning them into your colonies. Q: What is the unique feature…
howToPlay: Your task is either to defend the fortress or to attack! Release troops to attack or defend - they will fight automatically. To defeat the enemy, use various abilities and upgrade your warriors.

title: Savage Defenders
description: A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life. The village is a place where magic and nature merge. Its inhabitants, divided into four factions (archers, spearmen, stone throwers and shamans), have been defending their home from the dangers of the jungle for centuries. But everything changes when an alien organism falls from the sky - capable of taking over the minds of creatures. Now the tribe must prepare for war, enchant the jungle, build defensive towers and fight back the invader before it is too late.
howToPlay: Game Objective: Defend the village from alien invaders using tactics, magic and the power of warriors. Don't let the enemies break through to the heart of the settlement! Main Mechanics: Build towers - place archers, spearmen, stone throwers and shamans at strategic points on the map. Improve defense - spend resources to strengthen towers and unlock new abilities. Use magic - activate shaman spells to slow down, stun or cause massive damage to enemies. Control the waves - watch the enemy routes and adapt your defense to different types of threats. Tips for victory: Combine towers - some warriors are better against light enemies, others against armored ones. Save resources - do not build everything in a row, first assess the strength of the next wave. Study the enemies - each type of invader has weak points! Are you ready for battle? Become a legend of the tribe and save the jungle from destruction!

title: Big Boom! Building Smash!
description: 💣 Ready to dive into a world of chaos and mayhem? If you’ve enjoyed games like Captain TNT and Noob Demolisher, then our game is about to become your new favorite! Blast buildings, smash through obstacles, and create total havoc on every level! You’ll face hundreds of crazy missions where every move could lead to epic explosions and complete destruction! 🧨 ⚙️ What’s in Store: - Thrilling levels with unique challenges and missions - Realistic 3D graphics and dynamic effects - Play online on any device – from your phone to your PC - Leaderboards where you can compete with others and prove you’re the ultimate demolisher 🚀 Play solo or with friends, blow up everything in sight, and have a blast with all the destruction!
howToPlay: 💥 Your goal? Blow up buildings with dynamite, bombs, and rockets! Tear down everything in your path and turn any structure into rubble. 🕹️ Game Controls: - On desktop: Use your mouse to rotate around objects by holding down the left button. Set your explosives in the perfect spots for maximum impact. - On mobile: Swipe your finger across the screen to choose where to place the explosives. Rotate the object and drop bombs wherever you like. 🚀 Pro Tip: Upgrade your weapons to cause even more destruction and boost your efficiency! 🎯 Blow things up, smash through obstacles, and enjoy the chaos!

title: PoppyTile
description: Join travelling through PoppyTile village with challenges in both match-3 and mahjong genres! Meet the charming girl Poppy who will be by your side during the throughout your journey! Match 3 identical tiles to gradually clear the board. Progress further across the map with increasingly difficult levels. Use boosters to complete levels as quickly and comfortably as possible. Classic boosters: - Add an extra slot, - Cancel the last action, - Mix tiles on the board - Use an idea! How far can you go? See you in PoppyTile!
howToPlay: Tap/click on 3 same tiles to choose them and release the underneath tiles. Clear the whole board to complete a level

title: Makeup Fruits
description: Have you ever imagined giving a watermelon a makeover? How about adding a flutter of eyelashes or a swipe of lipstick to a juicy melon? In Makeup Fruits, your mission is to help these delightful fruits dazzle with beauty. It's all in your hands to adorn them with the perfect makeup and accessories for their stunning transformation! Click to select the fruit you want to transform into a beauty icon, then proceed to choose and apply a variety of makeup options. Explore a diverse selection of brands, powder colors, eyelashes, lipsticks, stickers, and more! At the end, you'll be able to take a "selfie" of your fabulous creation to share with your friends. You'll also earn "gems" as a reward for your work. These gems can be used to unlock exciting new items and keep the fun going!
howToPlay: Use your mouse to select a fruits and then drag and drop makeup headbands, select lipstick, eye colors and many many other components to create a beautiful Makeup Fruit!

title: Cannon Balls
description: Try to be the master of destruction, heat up the buildings neatly and show no mercy! In 'Cannon Balls 3D' it depends on how skillfully you place the shots so that the structures collapse as efficiently as possible. Watch your ammo, because it's limited. But don't worry. There will also come a time when you will bring the cannon to the edge of functionality. Especially when the great bombs are used. So what are you waiting for?
howToPlay: Aiming & Shooting: On desktop/browser: Move your mouse to aim the cannon and click the left button to fire. On mobile: Drag your finger (or stylus) to aim, and tap once to shoot. Weak Points and TNT: Target weak spots in the structure (like glass or foundation blocks) to maximize collapse. Hitting TNT (when present) triggers chain reactions to clear multiple blocks at once. Bomb Power-Ups: A bomb meter fills up as you shoot shapes and earn points. When full, tap the bomb icon to switch cannonballs to bombs temporarily. You’ll normally get only three bombs per level, so use them wisely on tougher structures or large clusters.

title: Zombie vs Gorilla
description: Defend the Sacred Garden in Zombies vs Gorillas! Step into the wild frontlines and protect your lush banana garden in Zombies vs Gorillas, an action-packed lane defense strategy game! Take command of a fearless squad of gorillas and loyal allies to hold the line against relentless waves of invading zombies, mythical monsters, and colossal world bosses. Catch falling bananas to keep your ammo stocked, launch rapid banana barrages across multiple lanes, and level up your gorillas in real time with battle upgrades. With 40 exciting stages across 4 unique worlds, unlockable heroes, and epic boss showdowns, lead your gorilla squad to victory and show the undead who rules the jungle!
howToPlay: Your primary goal is to prevent waves of zombies and mythical enemies from breaching your defense line on the left. Keep your ammo loaded by grabbing bananas falling from the sky, then command your gorillas to fire banana projectiles at approaching enemies in each lane. Clear all enemy waves and take down the final boss to win the level! Collect gold coins to purchase permanent shop upgrades and recruit powerful allies like Bora, Mira, and Kaya to boost your defense. Desktop Controls: Left Mouse Click: Click on falling Bananas and Coins to collect ammo and gold. Click on a Gorilla to throw a banana along that lane. Click the (+) Button above a gorilla to upgrade its attack power. Click UI buttons to pause, toggle game speed (1x / 2x), and navigate menus. Mobile Controls: Tap (Touch Screen): Tap falling Bananas and Coins to collect ammo and currency. Tap any Gorilla to shoot bananas down that lane. Tap the (+) Icon above a gorilla to upgrade its level during battle. Tap on-screen buttons to pause or speed up gameplay.

title: Mafia Wars
description: Mafia Wars is an action-packed shooting game where you play as a cowboy vigilante who fights against the corruption of mafia. Play engaging and immersive levels with various kinds of bosses. You must be careful with how you use your bullets, as saving them will come in handy in difficult battles.
howToPlay: During battle, tap on characters to mark the location for the player to shoot at, but bear in mind that the bullet takes a bit of time to reach there. Switch between weapons when needed, and use automatic weapons when there is a swarm of enemies. Do not forget to unlock support and powerful defense barricades; you cannot win certain matches without them. Desktop Interact with the game UI to select and upgrade weapons. During battle, use a mouse click to trigger the player's weapon fire. Mobile Interact with the game UI to select and upgrade weapons. During battle use the touchscreen to trigger the player's weapon fire.

title: Mix Monsters: Fun Merge
description: Mix Monsters: Fun Merge is a captivating puzzle game that lets you combine quirky characters into unique creatures. Accessible on multiple platforms without the need for downloads or registration, it offers an enjoyable and creative experience suitable for all ages, perfect for quick entertainment and skill development.
howToPlay: - Cross different monsters to get eggs; - You need to break the egg! Eggs are different: Common, Rare and Legendary; - After breaking the egg, a unique monster hatches!- Cross different monsters to get eggs; - You need to break the egg! Eggs are different: Common, Rare and Legendary; - After breaking the egg, a unique monster hatches!

title: Master of Numbers
description: Experience the excitement of mathematics with Master of Numbers, a fast-paced online game. Race to collect beneficial numbers while dodging harmful ones, enhancing your math and strategy skills as you progress through increasingly challenging levels. Play on your phone or computer for an engaging mental workout.
howToPlay: The goal: to reach the finish line by typing the maximum possible number. Absorb numbers smaller than yours highlighted in blue. If you encounter a red number larger than yours, you will lose your number and you will have to start over. Avoid electric saws, cross bridges and jump over ditches. At the finish line you will find a lot of walls to destroy

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.
howToPlay: The player must answer quiz questions by selecting the correct answer from four options. Players can use hints to assist in answering. Progress is tracked through a bar that fills as they play, allowing them to unlock and use clues for future questions.

title: Same Room Same Day
description: Experience the thrilling psychological horror of "Same Room Same Day." As Rosaline, explore a terrifying building filled with monstrous beings. Face intense challenges, collect crucial supplies, and confront your deepest fears to uncover secrets and seek tranquility in a frightening digital landscape.
howToPlay: Full Gamepad support required Controls: Move: WASD Look Around: Mouse Shoot: Left Click Aim: Right Click Reload: R Flashlight: F Jump: Space Interact: E Sprint: Shift

title: Number Shooter: Ball Blast
description: Number Shooter is an endless arcade shooter built around one idea: the number on the ball IS your score. Numbered balls slide in from the walls and bounce around while your cannon fires nonstop. Every hit chips their number down, and when it reaches zero the ball bursts into two smaller ones — so a single big ball cascades into a screen full of targets. You never clear a level; the waves just keep coming and getting harder. Between shots you grab drops that raise your fire rate and damage mid-run, and the coins you collect buy permanent upgrades, 15 ball themes and 10 cannons that carry over to your next run.
howToPlay: Goal: survive as long as you can and score as high as you can. There is no finish line — waves keep coming and the numbers keep growing. Your run ends the moment a ball touches your cannon. Controls - Hold the mouse button (or keep your finger on the screen) to play. Release to pause. - Move the cannon: drag left and right, or use the Arrow keys (← →) or A / D. - The cannon fires by itself, so aiming is all about where you stand. Tips - Score = the damage you deal. Chipping a big number down earns you every point of it, so you do not have to land the final hit to be rewarded. - Catch the drops that fall from broken balls: ⚡ raises fire rate, 🔥 raises damage, and $ is coins. - Special items come from the first ball of a wave — multi shot, shield, slow and magnet. - Every wave showers bonus coins, and every 5th wave pays out a lot more. - A shield blocks one hit. Without it, one touch ends the run. - Spend coins in the Shop on permanent upgrades (fire rate, attack, item duration) — those stay forever.

title: Pixel Color Flow
description: Pixel Color Flow is a fun, satisfying color matching puzzle game where you clear a board of pixel cubes by sending cute pigs onto a conveyor. Each pig drops balls onto only the cubes of the same color, so your main challenge is choosing the right order and managing the queue to clean the board efficiently. Every pig has an ammo count (shown as a number above its head). When it runs out, the pig leaves. If ammo is still left, the pig can move into one of 5 waiting slots, ready to be sent again when you tap. The conveyor also has a capacity limit, so smart timing matters don’t overflow it.
howToPlay: Check the pixel board and spot which colors need clearing first. Tap a pig to send it onto the conveyor. The pig will shoot/drop balls automatically onto matching color cubes only. Watch the ammo number above the pig—each shot uses ammo. When ammo becomes 0, the pig leaves the run. If it still has ammo, it can move into one of 5 waiting slots. Tap again to send pigs from the waiting slots back onto the conveyor. Manage the conveyor capacity (if it’s full, you must wait). Keep repeating until you clear all cubes and complete the level.

title: Cooking Shawarma Idle Game
description: We are providing a stunning and engaging gameplay experience that delivers a real simulation of running a shawarma business. From managing different shawarma and fast-food items to handling customers in real time, every moment feels like you are operating your own busy food stall. Upgrade your kitchen, speed up your service, and take your shawarma shop to the next level as you grow your culinary empire. Your journey begins with a small shawarma stand, humble yet full of potential. As the Shawarma Restaurant Master, you will dive deep into the art of making perfect shawarma—from choosing the best meat cuts to marinating them with the ideal blend of spices. Every step matters, and every decision affects the final taste and customer satisfaction. Enhance your slicing knife, lavash station, and cooking speed to boost profits and keep customers happy. Add ketchup, mayo, fries, pickles, and many other extras to customize each order based on customer demands. Have you ever dreamed of cooking delicious dishes from around the world and exploring different cultures? All of that becomes possible in Our Shawarma Game!

Cut the Meat: Hold Right Mouse Button and drag to slice the meat. Fill the Shawarma: Click the Right Mouse Button multiple times on ingredients to add them to the shawarma. Serve the Order: Hold Right Mouse Button, then drag the completed item to the customer. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Mobile Controls (Touch) Fry Chips: Tap and hold to fry the fries. Cut the Meat: Tap and drag to slice the meat. Fill the Shawarma: Tap multiple times on ingredients to add them. Serve the Order: Tap and hold, then drag the completed item to the customer.

Make icing on the cake 🧁 and start by running your own cooking master to deal with a lot of customers every month in sweet ice cup cream games. Cake Maker Girls Cake Games Be the best cake maker ever in…
