title: Zombie Rage: Merge 3D
description: Grandpa is eager for adventure again! Survive in a harsh zombie world. This time, Grandpa has to save the world from evil zombies. Zombies can drive and shoot! And Grandpa can destroy evil spirits! Fight the most dangerous mutants. Buy cool guns, find unique attachments, assemble your own unique gun and go into battle! Many locations, go through the whole world, from hot deserts to sea battles! Features: - Unique weapon assembly system. You can create a unique gun, install a barrel, butt, replace the handle, put a cool sight, install a silencer or compensator. - Many different enemies: zombie motorcyclists, shooters, Giants, zombies on jeeps, motorcycles. Dangerous bosses: Train with zombies, helicopters, Jeeps, Drones, etc. - Stylized graphics! - Cool special effects and sounds! - Realistic physics and spectacular destruction! Grandpa to battle!
howToPlay: To win, you need to destroy your pursuers. Controls Mobile: Touch the screen and move it to aim, shooting will start automatically. PC: Shooting: left mouse button Sight: right mouse button Sight control: by moving the mouse Weapon switching: 1, 2, 3, 4 Reload - R

title: Slide Block Jam
description: Slide Block Jam: The Ultimate Puzzle Adventure Unleash your puzzle-solving skills in Slide Block Jam, the ultimate block puzzle game that will challenge your mind and keep you hooked for hours! In this captivating and strategically engaging game, your goal is simple: move colorful blocks to their matching colored doors to clear the way. However, each level introduces new obstacles and challenges, requiring you to think carefully and plan your moves to master every puzzle. Endless Puzzles, Limitless Fun Prepare yourself for puzzles designed to test both your logic and strategic thinking. As you progress, the levels become increasingly intricate and creative, keeping you engaged with new challenges at every turn. Whether you're sliding blocks to clear space or navigating through tough barriers, the thrill of solving each puzzle intensifies.
howToPlay: How to Play: * Slide the blocks: Move the colorful blocks to their matching colored doors. * Solve each puzzle: Plan your moves carefully to clear the path and complete the puzzle. *Think strategically: Every level presents a new challenge, so use your wits to find the most efficient way to clear the blocks. * Unlock new challenges: With each level you complete, new and more difficult obstacles open up, keeping the excitement going!

title: I am Crazy Bird
description: Become a Bird! Step into the wings of a fearless city bird and unleash pure chaos across an open world. Fly freely, pull off crazy tricks, steal food, use wild and unexpected weapons, explore rooftops and streets, complete missions, and become a true urban legend. In this sandbox adventure, every flight is full of laughter, surprises, and total freedom.
howToPlay: WASD – Movement Spacebar – Take off into the sky Shift – Boost while flying Left Mouse Button – Hit, interact with the world E – Pick up / drop item F – Mem Mobile Controls: Joystick – Movement Right Button – Take off into the sky Drag Joystick Up – Boost while flying Right Button – Hit Touch Screen – Interact with the world Right Button – Pick up / drop item Right Button – Mem

title: The Secret of the Toy Factory
description: An atmospheric first-person horror game where you must explore an abandoned factory and uncover its dark secrets. Solve puzzles, search for useful items, and carefully investigate the dark rooms—danger can appear at any moment. The factory is filled with intense chases, unexpected jump scares, and encounters with Plush and BOTY. Hide, run, and use your surroundings to survive. Every corridor hides a new mystery, while strange notes and traces of the past gradually reveal what happened at the factory and why its toys came to life.
howToPlay: A keyboard and mouse are required to play on PC: WASD — Move E — Read notes Tab — Return to the main menu For mobile devices: On-screen joystick — Move “Main Menu” button — Return to the main menu “Read Note” button — Read notes

title: Brainrot Crusher Idle
description: Brainrot Crusher Idle is a satisfying idle clicker game where you crush bizarre Brainrots to earn money and grow your factory. Start with a simple crusher and unlock increasingly strange Brainrots that generate bigger rewards. Upgrade your crushers, boost your income, automate production, and unlock powerful enhancements to maximize your profits. Complete objectives, discover new Brainrots, and optimize your strategy to build the ultimate Brainrot crushing empire. 💰 Earn money even while you're away. ⚙️ Upgrade powerful crushers and boost your income. 🧠 Unlock dozens of unique Brainrot characters. 🚀 Buy permanent upgrades to accelerate your progress. 🎯 Complete quests and achievements for extra rewards. 💎 Collect premium currency and unlock powerful bonuses.
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: Left Mouse Button: Click to control the character and interact with the in-game UI. Mobile Controls: Tap: Tap to control the character and interact with buttons and the in-game UI.

title: Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Step into the addictive world of Snaptaire: Jigsaw Solitaire brainteasers - the ultimate fantasy jigsaw puzzle games that challenges your brain and tests your skills. Slide colorful cards and uncover stunning HD jigsaw graphics on mobile. Whether you're looking for fantasy jigsaw puzzles for free, a smooth slide puzzle game for the Christmas countdown, or engaging Christmas games, this jigsolitaire game has it all.
howToPlay: Slide cards anywhere! Just press and drag a card to move it. When cards with matching patterns touch each other, they automatically lock together, and you can move the whole connected group as one piece it's that easy! Be careful with tricky placements that might break your groups apart, especially during the fast paced Christmas countdown mode.

title: Sudoku Block Puzzle
description: Sudoku Block Puzzle is a combination of sudoku and wood block puzzle games. It is a simple yet challenging and addictive free block puzzle you won’t be able to put down. Match blocks to remove them by completing lines and cubes. Keep the board clean and beat your high score in this block puzzle! Watch blocks blast away as you play! Challenge your IQ and win the block puzzle game! Sudoku Block Puzzle features: ✔ 9x9 block puzzle board. Merge blocks on the 9x9 grid, which should be familiar to all sudoku fans, to build lines and squares. ✔ Blocks of various shapes. Strategically stack blocks on the sudoku board to destroy them and keep the board clean. ✔ Complete Daily Challenges to get unique trophies while playing block puzzles. ✔ Combos. Master the block puzzle game by destroying multiple tiles with just one move. ✔ Streak. Score more points by eliminating blocks with several successful moves in a row. Go full blast and destroy as many blocks as you can!
howToPlay: 1. Drag a block onto the board (blocks can't overlap). 2. Clear blocks by completing: - A full row - A full column - A full 3×3 square (Sudoku-style) 3. The game ends when all blocks can't fit anywhere on the board.

title: Papa Cherry Saga
description: Welcome to the world of sweets! Papa Cherry Saga is a colourful match-3 puzzle where you collect cookies, marshmallows, chocolate, and other treats. Swap pieces to make a row of 3 or more of the same kind. Match 4 in a line to create a Striped Cookie. Match 4 in a T or L shape to make a Bomb. Match 5 in a row to get a Rainbow Bomb that clears all pieces of one color. Combine power-ups together for devastating effects. Charge up the Chef by activating power-ups on the field, and he will reward you with a bonus. Hundreds of levels with varied goals: collect specific sweets, break obstacles, guide gingerbread cookies to the bottom. Use boosters like the Glove, Rolling Pin, Lollipop, and Undo to beat the toughest challenges.
howToPlay: Drag a piece toward an adjacent one to swap them. If the swap creates a match of 3 or more identical pieces in a row or column, they are collected and new ones drop in. Match 4 in a line to create a Striped Cookie that clears an entire row or column. Match 4 in a T or L shape to make a Bomb that explodes in a 3x3 area. Match 5 in a row to get a Rainbow Bomb that clears all pieces of one color. Combine power-ups together for even stronger effects. Activate power-ups on the field to charge the Chef — once full, he sends a bonus power-up to the board. Use the boosters at the bottom of the screen — they do not cost a move. The Glove removes any single piece. The Rolling Pin clears one row and one column. The Lollipop removes all pieces of a chosen color. Undo rewinds the last move.

title: Obby Car Keyboard Parkour
description: Jump behind the wheel and take on a unique keyboard-themed obstacle course! Speed through challenging parkour tracks, dodge dangerous obstacles, and reach the finish line to unlock exciting new areas. Every new car increases your speed, helping you conquer even tougher levels. Earn rewards, collect powerful boosts, unlock rare supercars, and keep improving your performance. Rebirth to gain permanent bonuses and become even faster with every run. Enjoy simple controls, colorful graphics, a wide variety of vehicles, and endless progression. Challenge yourself, master every obstacle, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate keyboard parkour champion!
howToPlay: On PC: WASD - control the car Hold RMB and move the mouse - control the camera Space - jump TAB - pause R - back to the start On mobile: on-screen controls

title: Ultimate Lawn Mowing Simulator: Mower Master
description: 🌿 Ultimate Lawn Mowing Simulator: Mower Master 🚜✨ Relax, cut, clean, and master the art of perfect lawn mowing in this satisfying grass-cutting simulator! Enjoy smooth animations, realistic mowing effects, and the peaceful sound of fresh-cut grass as you become the ultimate Mower Master. 🌟 Product Features: 🔸 Smooth Mowing Animations: Enjoy ultra-satisfying mowing effects and realistic grass cutting. 🔸 Ever-Changing Landscapes: Mow across gardens, parks, farms, and wide open lawns. 🔸 Simple Swipe Controls: Easy-to-learn controls for players of all ages. 🔸 Multiple Mower Types: Walk-behind mowers, ride-on mowers, and robotic automatic mowers. 🔸 Challenging Mowing Jobs: Take on tasks in home lawns, public parks, private estates & farms. 🔸 HD Graphics & Realistic Physics: Experience authentic mowing mechanics and vibrant visuals. 🔸 Unlock Amazing Mowers: Upgrade and unlock advanced grass-cutting machines. 🏡 Product Description: Welcome to Ultimate Lawn Mowing Simulator: Mower Master, the most relaxing and satisfying grass-cutting game of 2025! 🌱 Step into the role of a professional lawn care expert and take control of powerful mowing machines. Your job? Trim every blade o…
howToPlay: 🕹️ How to Play: 👉 Swipe to Move – Control your mower with smooth swipe gestures 🌱 Cut All Grass – Cover every patch to complete the job 🚜 Switch Mowers – Choose the best mower for each task 🪙 Earn Rewards – Finish jobs to unlock better mowers

title: Screw Color Puzzle
description: Experience the exciting challenge of "Screw Color Puzzle," an engaging online game that puts your skills to the test. Match screws with their corresponding colors in a captivating setting. Enjoy this free game on your computer or phone for hours of enjoyable, brain-stimulating entertainment.
howToPlay: Solve screw puzzle! Match color of the screws with screw case's color! Remove all the screws to progress through the levels. Challenge and test your IQ!

title: Car Wash DIY
description: Clean, Repair, and Shine in the Car Wash DIY Game! Jump into a satisfying world of car maintenance where you can wash, clean, and repair vehicles with easy-to-play, relaxing tasks. Whether you're scrubbing off dirt, fixing scratches, filling fuel, or adding the perfect shine, this game offers calming, enjoyable gameplay for everyone. With easy controls and simple mechanics, anyone can dive into the fun. Whether you’re a casual player or looking for a relaxing escape, our game provides a perfect balance of creativity and stress relief, designed to keep you engaged for hours.
howToPlay: Use your finger to scrub or tap the dirty areas of the car. Drag or tap to use tools (sprayer, sponge, sander, polish). Fix scratches by tapping or dragging the repair tool. When cleaning, make sure to cover all dirty spots to finish the task.

title: Hidden Objects: Recipe Collection
description: Exciting puzzle game where attention and observation play the main role! Set off into a cozy kitchen world where dozens of objects are hidden among pots, plates, mugs, and spices. Your task is to find them all as quickly as possible and earn the maximum number of points. After each level, a pleasant bonus awaits you — a real cooking recipe that can be used in real life! The game not only develops attention, memory, and logical thinking, but also inspires new culinary discoveries. Simple controls, pleasant graphics, and a homely atmosphere make it an ideal choice for children and adults. The game runs directly in the browser — free, without registration, and without downloading. Test your attentiveness, discover new recipes, and become a master of culinary search! Suitable for playing on a phone, tablet, and computer.
howToPlay: Explore the kitchen carefully—dozens of items are cleverly hidden on the screen, from dishes and utensils to food and spices. Tap or click each item from the list below to find it, but be attentive—some objects may be partially hidden or look very similar to others! Stuck on a tricky item? Use a hint to help you out. Complete each level to earn a bonus: a delicious recipe you can try in real life. The game trains attention, focus, and memory while providing a fun, cozy, and engaging experience. With simple controls, charming graphics, and intuitive gameplay, it’s perfect for children and adults alike. Play instantly in your browser for free, with no registration or downloads required. Test your observation skills, uncover hidden objects, unlock tasty recipes, and become a master of culinary discovery throughout each exciting kitchen level!

title: Towers 505
description: Demonstrate your strategy of indestructible defense by erecting towers to stop the hordes of monsters trying to break through your line; not only strength is important here, but also intelligence, because each wave of monsters requires new tactics, improvements and the perfect location of towers. This browser-based tower defense game features a classic 2D top-down perspective with stylized cartoon art. Players defend a winding orange path by strategically placing various defense turrets, such as wooden crossbow towers and stone fortifications, to stop waves of approaching monsters emerging from a dark purple abyss. The core gameplay loop involves spending earned gold coins to build and upgrade structures, periodically clicking to activate magical spells like fireballs and frost blasts to slow down or destroy enemies. Progression is level-based, with ten locked stages visible on the level selection screen. The visual style is bright and vibrant, dominated by a green grassy field, stone walls, and brown autumnal trees, all rendered with thick outlines and flat colors. The UI is comprehensive, displaying a gold coin counter, a kill tally with a skull icon, a health heart indicating t…
howToPlay: Use the buttons on the screen to control, build and upgrade towers, cast spells, and most importantly, don't let the monsters get to the main tower!

title: The Biggest Number
description: 🔢 The Biggest Number is a fast-paced 3D number runner and casual math game where every choice can make you stronger—or end your run! Collect numbers equal to or smaller than yours and grow as large as possible. Dodge bigger red numbers, spinning saws, gaps, and traps. Choose the best math gates: add and multiply to boost your value, but watch out for subtraction and division! ➕ ✖️ ➖ ➗ ✨ What awaits you: • Fast arcade runner gameplay • Shield and magnet boosters • Starting-number and income upgrades • Colorful levels, achievements, and leaderboards • A satisfying finish where you smash through walls 🏁 Love number games, math runners, and quick arcade challenges? Build the biggest number, break every wall, and set a new record! 🚀
howToPlay: 🎯 Goal Reach the finish with the biggest number possible and smash through as many walls as you can! 🎮 Controls On desktop, use A/D or the Left/Right arrow keys. You can also hold the left mouse button and drag. On mobile, swipe left or right. 📱 🔵 Grow your number Collect numbers equal to or smaller than yours. Avoid larger red numbers—they will stop your run. ➕ Choose the best gates Addition and multiplication make you stronger. Subtraction and division reduce your number, so pick your route carefully! ✖️ 🛡️ Use boosters A shield protects you from danger, while a magnet pulls useful numbers toward you. 🪙 Upgrade Earn coins and improve your starting number and income to progress faster. 🏁 Ready to become the Number Master? Start running, build The Biggest Number, and smash every wall! 🚀

title: +1 Speed per Step | Obby Mode
description: Welcome to +1 Speed per Step | Obby Mode. Every step makes you faster! Complete obstacles to earn wins! Rebirth to gain bonuses! Upgrade your steps! Buy new trails! Climb to the top of the leaderboard! [Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about and what do you do? A: It's an arcade game focused on obby and speed. You need to run to increase your speed and raise your level. Q: What is the game's hook? What will keep players engaged? A: A unique obstacle course, a rebirth system, leaderboards, and high-quality block graphics.

title: Truck Slam
description: Two monster trucks. Two spinning maces. One survives. Smash enemies in single-player or duel a friend in 2-player mode on the same screen. Win battles, collect cogs, upgrade your wheels, body and mace — and keep slamming.
howToPlay: Drive your truck into the enemy and swing your mace to crush them — but watch out, they're swinging too. Desktop — Player 1: A/D move, Q jump, S or Space swing. Player 2 (2-player mode): ←/→ move, ↑ jump, ↓ or Enter swing. Mobile: on-screen buttons for left, right, jump and swing. Single-player: clear levels, collect cogs, choose an upgrade after each victory. 2-player: best of the round wins.

title: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy
description: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is a fast-paced, casual action game where you let out your frustration on a few dummies in all sorts of scenarios. You will need quick reflexes and punches to unleash the blows it will take to knock your opponent out. Stay sharp, keep punching, and enjoy every moment of cathartic stress relief. How to Play Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is simple on the surface and fairly easy to play, but that is exactly what makes it so addictive. You control a floating arm wearing a boxing glove, and your only mission is to punch every dummy you see, along with other objects. Move the glove, line up your swings, and knock the targets out of the scene. Once they are all knocked out, you can move to the next level. Each level presents a new setup of dummies. Sometimes there is a single dummy sitting quietly on a bench. Other times, groups are standing together, chatting, dancing with a rat, posing like the Creation of Adam, typing at a computer, balancing on unicycles, or even a bunch of dummies carrying a casket. The variety keeps things surprising and funny as you move from one level to the next.
howToPlay: There is no strict progression or difficulty curve. Some levels are very simple, while others require a bit more timing. The game runs on physics, so punches can have dramatic chain reactions. You might knock two or three dummies aside with one well-placed swing. There is no timer, no pressure, and no limit to how long you can play. The focus is pure fun. Punch the dummies, enjoy the chaos, and move on to the next scene! Click on the screen to punch the annoying dummies.

title: Obby: Mine Crasher
description: 🔨 Obby: Mine Crasher Hit the anvils with a hammer, gain power and smash the stone walls! For each destroyed block, you get cups (trophies). Spend them on pets, which enhance the impact on the anvils: the more powerful the satellite, the faster the walls break down and further you go through the obby levels. Hitting the anvil → improving strength 🔹 Walls to splinters → Cups to pocket 🔹 Cups → pets → even more power Are you ready to become the ultimate dungeon destroyer? Come in and start smashing! 🔥 Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do? A: It's an idle game where you need to hit the anvils, increase your strength, and break walls. Q: Is there a storyline in the game? A: There is no storyline, but the goal is to level up, become stronger, earn the best pets, many trophies, and power. Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in? A: The pleasant visual style of the game, daily rewards, a wheel of fortune, pets, and a lot of progression. Q: Are there bosses and how are they different? A: Instead of bosses, there are walls that become more challenging with each broken wall. Q: What currencies are there and what can they be s…

Desktop : Use "Left" and "Right Arrow" keys to move around Use "Up Arrow" and "Space" key to jump Use "A" to attack Use "W" to toggle bullet time Use "Q" to select between the boys Mobile: Tap on gui buttons on screens to perform actions

title: Knife Tower
description: Race up a colorful tower, throw knives into every block, and reach the top before your rival. Time each shot around the bouncing ball, build combos with precise hits, collect coins, unlock new knives, and upgrade your speed, combo range, and income.
howToPlay: Tap and hold to throw knives into the tower. Avoid hitting the bouncing ball. Land accurate shots to break blocks, create combos, and climb faster. Reach the final block before your opponent to win. Use earned coins to unlock knives and improve your upgrades.

title: Spider Evolution
description: Spider Evolution is a thrilling arcade game that lets you evolve from a tiny spider into a powerful creature. Engage in exciting gameplay as you outwit opponents and enhance your skills. Enjoy this free online experience without downloads, and take control of the spider realm from your computer.
howToPlay: Keyboard arrow keys or A D keys to control player to move left or right, or use mouse control with right slider or left slide.

title: Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!
description: Welcome to "Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!" - an exciting action game with a sword, where you fight against an army of monsters! Get ready for an epic battle and test your agility and blade skill. Survive in the monsters' lair and become a real sword master! 🎮 A game inspired by popular projects such as "War of the Knights: Sword Arena Battle 3D", "Sword Master: Slash Enemies!" and "Swing Sword: Slash Enemies into Pieces!" Here you will find a mix of the themes of "poppy playtime", "rainbow friends", "hagi wagi", "repo" and the atmosphere of the "Dendy World"! ⚔️ Game Features: - Simple and clear controls - Stylish 3D graphics in retro dandy and repo style - Exciting gameplay with chopping enemies - Various levels and enemy characters - A large selection of sword skins - A leaderboard where you can compete with friends ⚡ Ready to join the fight? Then take your sword and start the battle with monsters!
howToPlay: 🎯 Your goal is to defeat all the monsters in the arena using your sword! Cut down your enemies and stop the monster invasion. The further you go, the harder it gets! ⚔️ 🕹️ Controls: On PC 💻 — hold down the left mouse button and move the cursor to attack. On phone 📱 — swipe your finger across the screen to strike with your sword. 🔥 Tips: ✅ Watch your enemies' movements and strike first! ✅ Combine attacks to deal more damage. ✅ Don't forget to upgrade your sword as you progress through the game!

title: Check Wednesday Phone!
description: Check Wednesday Phone! creepy-cute game inspired by the Netflix series. Read messages, solve mysteries, explore Nevermore’s secrets and play gothic mini‑games. Enter Wednesday Addams' digital world in this dark, twisted game. Check emails from Nevermore students, change your gothic phone theme, play eerie mini‑games, and explore her secret-filled dorm. Earn coins doing tasks Wednesday would probably mock — but you’ll need them to unlock the next mystery.
howToPlay: Tap Wednesday’s phone to begin. Read cryptic emails, change to delightfully gloomy wallpapers, earn coins, and explore her eerie room. Click on strange objects, crack passwords, and uncover secrets hidden in Nevermore. Watch for new messages—they guide the story.

title: Daddy Escape
description: Get ready for an Epic Puzzle adventure like no other! Daddy Escape - Pull the Pin is here to challenge your wits, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills. Help Daddy make his daring escape by pulling the right pins and overcoming a series of mind-bending obstacles. Who is Daddy? Well, he's not your ordinary dad! Daddy is an adventurous and fearless explorer who always finds himself in tricky situations. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to guide Daddy through a maze of perilous traps, ingenious contraptions, and devious puzzles. Can you lead Daddy to safety?
howToPlay: Your goal is to safely navigate Daddy through each level to the exit door. But beware, there are pins blocking his way! Tap and pull the pins in the right order to clear a path for Daddy. Use your cunning to avoid traps, outsmart enemies, and collect valuable treasures along the way.

title: Bowling Stars

[Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do? A: A classic bowling game with engaging gameplay. Q: What is the game's unique hook? What keeps players coming back? A: Earning trophies allows players to unlock higher-quality bowling balls, helping them defeat more experienced opponents.
howToPlay: Classic bowling rules apply. Swipe across the screen to set the trajectory and curve to the ball you throw. Defeat your opponents and upgrade your bowling balls.

title: Nail Salon
description: Nail Salon is a creative and fun nail beauty art experience where you transform clients’ nails into dazzling works of beauty. Step into a vibrant salon, welcome your customers, and unleash your artistic skills to create stunning makeovers. Express your creativity with endless designs and colors, making each client’s nails truly shine. 💅✨
howToPlay: In Nail Salon, you start by painting nails using a stencil to guide your design. After painting, you’ll file the nails into a perfect shape, and then choose an adhesive jewel to add the final decorative touch. As you progress, you’ll unlock more options, from detailed stencils to marble designs and more.

title: My Bakery
description: Build your confectionery empire in Family Bakery. Bake delicious treats, serve guests, and decorate your café in this cozy simulator designed for everyone. Have you ever dreamed of running your own café? This bakery game gives you the opportunity. Your task is to bake pastries and satisfy customers to grow your business. Why You Should Play Simple and Engaging Mechanics: Customers arrive, you bake pastries, and serve them quickly. Pleasant Atmosphere: A vibrant and warm design creates a relaxing mood. Constant Progression: Unlock new recipes and expand your dining area. Perfect for Relaxation: Easy-to-learn gameplay makes it a great game to unwind and relieve stress.
howToPlay: To control, you need to press the WASD keys or use a mouse if you're playing on a computer. If you're playing on a phone, you need to use your finger.

title: Liquid Sort Puzzle
description: Liquid Puzzle is a color game to fill each glass with one colored water to complete each level. Start sorting colored water! Rearrange the contents of the glasses so that each ends up filled with only one color. Sorting must follow logical constraints you typically can only pour into a glass if the colors match at the top and there’s enough room
howToPlay: Tap or click a glass, then another to pour. You can only pour if: The color on top matches between glasses. The receiving glass has enough capacity. Your aim is to finish each level with minimal moves though Liquid Sort Puzzle

title: Funny Bone Surgery
description: Leah went to play stakeboard on the street. But she was distracted and hit a car! She got a nasty broken arm and foot. Help fix her injuries and broken bones!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Zombie Check: Survival Shelter
description: Zombie Check: Survival Shelter is a tense quarantine inspection simulator set during a zombie outbreak. Survivors arrive one by one. Your job is to inspect their bodies, scan for symptoms and decide their fate: send to camp, quarantine, or eliminate. Symptoms can be hidden, suspicious, or evolve over time. One wrong decision can kill an innocent person or infect the entire camp. Use the scanner, examine bodies, unlock weapons and make choices under pressure. Each day brings new people, higher risks and tougher decisions. Will you survive long enough to reach the bunker and save humanity? "Core: A high-stakes social deduction and resource management game set during a global zombie epidemic, where players must identify and neutralize infected individuals to secure the survival of the human race in an underground bunker. Loop: Progression is driven by successful identification and correct processing of incoming individuals. Flawless daily performance (correctly determining the infected from the healthy) is rewarded with in-game currency, fostering a cycle of precision and reward. Start: A comprehensive tutorial module ensures immediate accessibility and full comprehension of the core…
howToPlay: PC: Rotate the camera with the cursor AD or arrow keys - rotate the character left/right Right-click - use fists 1 - Send to camp 2 - Send to quarantine 3 - Send to liquidation Tab - switch cursor Q - put away tool E - equip tool Z - teleport to quarantine X - teleport to the inspection zone Mobile controls: Rotate the camera by swiping to the right side of the screen Rotate the character to the left side of the screen

title: OrbaDrone - Robot Escape
description: ℹ️About You’re an Orb-shaped drone with the ability to repel and attract objects, awakened in a strange cave-like structure in a post-apocalypse scenario. Discover strange materials with unusual properties and use them to navigate in this dangerous and mysterious place. 🌟Features ● 50 levels to complete ● 3 types of difficulties ● 4 mini-games ● Customize the drone with skins that have different abilities ● 2D physics mechanics ● 2D light effects and environments ● Control customization to choose your preference
howToPlay: Mobile: Use a joystick to navigate and 2 buttons to control your abilities. Desktop: Use the arrow keys to move, use A to attract and S to repel

title: Thousand Suns
description: Thousand Suns is a 5-minute galactic conquest battle where you and four AI rivals race from a single home planet to control an entire galaxy. Build up your production, out-tech your rivals, and send your fleets across the stars: every match compresses an empire-building war into the time it takes to grab a coffee. How to Play Thousand Suns You start with one planet and one goal: expand before someone else does. Your homeworld constantly builds ships on its own, and you send that growing fleet outward to claim neutral worlds or crush enemy territory. Every planet you take adds more production, more options, and more pressure on the four bots also racing to dominate the galaxy.
howToPlay: Left Click a planet or starbase you control = select it Left Click another planet or starbase while one is selected = deploy your fleet there — attack if it's enemy or neutral, reinforce if it's your own Left Click your selected planet again = deselect it Click and Drag from one of your planets to another = connect a ferry lane, so newly produced ships automatically flow to the destination Left Click an existing ferry lane = disconnect it Left Click the pulsing arrow above a leveled-up planet = choose your next upgrade (Industry / Agriculture / Research) TAB = quit to the main menu

title: Tank 1944
description: Tanks 1944 is an exciting game about realistic tanks. battles. Choose a tank, learn how to fight, develop your own game strategy and tactics. The game features: - Realistic physics. - Great graphics, shadow objects, grass physics. - Extended gameplay of tank battles. Ready to start the fight? Then choose a tank and go to victory!
howToPlay: Your goal is to defeat everyone on the battlefield! Choose a tank, start the game, calculate the shot of the gun, and pull the trigger. The opponent must be defeated! Good luck!

title: Checkmate
description: Step into the world of Checkmate, a strategic chess-inspired game featuring 500 unique maps and 24 challenging achievements. Engage in intense battles on diverse boards, each requiring a fresh approach. As black squares off against white, aim for the elusive checkmate and prove your mastery. Whether youre a chess pro or a newcomer, the game offers an accessible interface for all skill levels. Unlock achievements, explore diverse maps, and experience the thrill of outsmarting your opponent in this ultimate game of kings and queens. Check and mate your way to victory!
howToPlay: Standard chess rules apply. However, the following exceptions exist: - The player is Black and must checkmate the White king. - The Black king may or may not be present. - Black moves from bottom to top, and White moves from top to bottom (this is important due to the pawns).

title: Swimming Pool Romance

howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to interact

howToPlay: Move with WASD on desktop, or touch anywhere on screen for a joystick that follows your finger. Tap cars to repair them, walk up to workers to collect their earnings, and open the phone menu to hire staff and buy upgrades that grow your garage, supermarket, and gas station.

title: Toy Soccer Cup
description: Toy Soccer Cup is a fast, pick-up-and-play table football game where you flick toy players to smash the ball into the net. Battle through tournaments and world leagues, customize your team with kits, balls and pitches, and challenge real players in 1v1 online matches. Easy to learn, hard to put down!
howToPlay: Drag any of your toy players to aim, then release to flick them and strike the ball — score more goals than your rival before the timer runs out. On mobile, touch and drag; on desktop, click and drag with the mouse (no keyboard needed). Win matches to earn coins, unlock new teams and gear, climb the leagues, and take on other players in real-time online duels.

title: Hoppy Bird
description: Get ready to flap, hop, and soar! Hoppy Bird takes the classic arcade formula to new heights with exciting new mechanics and game modes. Test your reflexes as you navigate through endless pipes, but watch out—it’s not just about flying anymore! Key Features: - 3 Unique Game Modes: Master the classic Normal mode, defy physics in Moon mode (Low Gravity), or test your limits in Hardcore mode (2x Speed, No Revive!). - Power-Up Your Flight: Collect active boosters like Shields for protection, Magnets to attract coins, and Double Score to climb the ranks faster. - Shop & Customization: Earn coins to unlock a variety of cool skins, including the stealthy Ninja, the Red Rocket, and more. - LiveOps & Rewards: Complete Daily Quests and participate in Gold Rush events to maximize your earnings. - Global Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide and prove you are the ultimate bird pilot. Simple to play, impossible to master. How far can you hop?
howToPlay: Objective: Fly as far as possible without crashing! Your goal is to navigate Hoppy Bird through an endless series of pipes to achieve the highest score.
