title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you''ll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.
howToPlay: Drag joysticks to move your right and left hands Climb higher, but avoid slippy surfaces

title: Capy Cafe
description: Capy Cafe is a cozy idle-management game where you run an adorable café as a hard-working capybara barista. Harvest fresh strawberries and tea leaves, brew fragrant teas, shake up bubble tea and boba, and blend creamy smoothies — then serve them to a steady stream of happy customers. There are no buttons to fumble with: just waddle up to a station and your capy gets to work automatically. Reinvest your earnings to unlock new drinks and stations, and hire helper capybaras to keep every corner of the cafe humming while you expand. What starts as a tiny tea stand grows into a bustling boba empire — one cup at a time. Simple one-thumb controls, satisfying progression, and the most relaxing café this side of the riverbank. Genre: casual idle tycoon / shop-management sim.
howToPlay: Welcome to Capy Cafe! Run the coziest café in town as an adorable capybara barista. Brew fragrant teas, shake up bubble tea and boba, blend fresh strawberry smoothies, and keep your happy customers served. Harvest your ingredients, unlock new stations, hire helpers, and grow your little cafe into a bustling boba empire! Desktop Controls: - ↑ / W: Move upward. - ↓ / S: Move downward. - ← / A: Move left. - → / D: Move right. - No buttons needed — just walk up to a plant, brewer, fridge, or the cashier and pause beside it. Your capybara picks up ingredients, brews drinks, and serves customers automatically. Some stations want you to stand still while they work. Mobile Controls: - Floating Joystick: Touch and hold anywhere on the screen — a joystick appears under your paw. Drag to move in any direction. - Push for Speed: A gentle drag strolls; push the joystick further to scurry at full speed. - Auto-Serve: Step next to any station or customer and pause — harvesting, brewing, and serving all happen on their own.

title: Obby: King of the Hill
description: 👑 Welcome to “Obby: King of the Hill”! A fun online obby game where everyone races to reach the top and become the true King of the Hill! Game features: 🌀 Exciting obby challenges — run, jump, and overcome tricky obstacles. 👊 Fun player interactions — bump into rivals and knock them off the mountain. 👑 King of the Hill mode — reach the top and try to hold your position. 🎭 Funny falls and chaotic moments — every match is full of surprises. 🎨 Bright 3D graphics and simple, easy-to-learn gameplay. 🚀 Climb higher, compete with other players, and prove that you deserve the crown! Are you ready to reach the top and stay there? 🏔️👑
howToPlay: 🎮 Controls (PC): W / A / S / D — move character Space — jump LMB — club attack Camera — RMB + mouse movement 📱 Controls (Mobile): Joystick — move Jump button — jump Attack button — club attack All actions are performed using easy on-screen buttons. 🚀 Progress & Power-Ups Climb the mountain, knock down rivals, and earn experience during matches. The more you play, the stronger and more stable your character becomes.

title: Italian Brainrot Difference
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Italian Brainrot Difference! Immerse yourself in vibrant, whimsically illustrated scenes bursting with Italian charm, and uncover the sneaky, often hilarious differences between two images. Every level is packed with unexpected twists, clever visual gags, and delightful details designed to challenge even the keenest eyes. Think you can spot them all before the clock runs out? Dive in and prove your sharpness!
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: Mouse click: click on the point you find difference Mobile Controls: Tap: tap on the point you find diference

title: Tower Colour Crash
description: Crash the Tower! Only the best crashers will be able to destroy all towers in this 3D physics game. Try to let all towers collapse with the amount of given balls. But you will only destroy the shapes with the same colour as you ball. Use the powerful earthquake or shotgun power ups, to create huge chain reactions, which will lead into the towers destruction. Beautiful designed levels and shapes will await you, so don’t waste any second and become the greatest tower crasher of ‘em all!
howToPlay: - Start each level by choosing the right angle to hit the tower, swipe right or left. - Throw the Ball on Blocks of the matching colour to destroy it! - Make the Tower collapse!

title: Hole Eats All: Eat Them All
description: Hole Eats All is a fun 3D casual arcade game where you control a hungry hole and eat everything you can find! Move around colorful levels, collect objects, grow bigger, and clear the stage before time runs out. Complete challenging levels, unlock upgrades and boosters, and become the ultimate eating hole!
howToPlay: Control the hole and move around the level to eat objects. Start by eating smaller objects, grow bigger, and then eat larger objects that become available as your size increases. Your goal is to collect enough objects and complete each level before the timer runs out. Desktop Controls WASD: Move the hole. Arrow Keys: Move the hole. Mobile Controls On-Screen Joystick: Drag the joystick to move the hole in any direction. Complete the level by eating the required objects before time runs out. Use boosters and upgrades to help you complete difficult levels.

title: Screw Jam Puzzle
description: Welcome to Screw Jam Puzzle, where the challenge of unscrewing puzzles and sorting colorful screws, pins, and nuts takes center stage! Dive into an immersive world of wood and bolts, where every unscrew brings you closer to solving the ultimate screw pin jam puzzle. With each twist, you'll match colors and sort nuts and bolts to clear your path through tricky levels. Tackle hundreds of unique levels designed to test your logic and strategy. As you unscrew, sort, and solve puzzles, you’ll face new and exciting screw pin jam challenges. Unlock levels, refine your skills, and enjoy the thrill of unscrewing complex puzzles while earning rewards along the way. Every level brings a fresh twist on the classic nuts and bolts puzzle adventure.Prepare for a jam-packed puzzle experience, where you’ll navigate wood structures, solve unscrew puzzles, and discover new mechanics with every update. Whether you're into sorting colors or untangling nuts and bolts, Screw Jam offers a puzzle experience that will keep you hooked.
howToPlay: Unscrew each board drop them one by one. Match and fill each screw box with screws of the same color; fill them all to win. No time limits play at your own pace. Unlimited levels with endless Nuts & Bolts strategies to discover. Use boosters to help you out in challenging situations.

title: Blade & Bedlam
description: A top-down, physics-based, medieval melee fighter! Block projectiles and melee attack with your weapons and try to hit the enemies! Survive for as long as you can by dodging attacks, quickly killing enemies and buying items form the shop between rounds!
howToPlay: Use the Mouse to swing your weapon and W A S D to move your character. Right click or press Shift to dodge roll. Buy items to upgrade your knight and survive the waves of chaos. Look for special items to assist in smiting your foes. Take on the ultimate challenge and defeat all the bosses.

title: Slice & Soar
description: Are you ready to soar through the skies and slice everything in your path? With the Slice & Soar, you can slice through objects in the air and collect as many points as possible. But it's not just about slicing - you'll need to use your strategic skills to avoid obstacles and master the art of timing to emerge victorious. Challenge yourself with new levels and obstacles that will put your cutting skills to the test. Beat the competition to become the ultimate Slice & Soar champion. With its addictive gameplay and easy-to-use interface, Slice & Soar is the perfect game for players of all ages. And with the option to play online or offline, you can enjoy it anytime, anywhere.
howToPlay: You use touch controls (swipe / drag) to slice through the objects. You need good timing: slicing at the right moment to hit the right object without hitting obstacles. Some levels or patterns will require more accuracy: avoid missing or touching forbidden items. The aim is to get as many points as possible by cutting things, while avoiding obstacles.

title: Farm Defenders
description: By day you farm. By night you fight for it. Farm Defenders is a farming sim wrapped around a last-stand survival shooter, and the two halves need each other. Your crops pay for your firepower. Your firepower protects your crops. Every wave you clear is bigger than the one before, and every coin you spend decides whether you see the next sunrise. 🌱 GROW YOUR FARM Plant, water and harvest your fields, then stock the storage to turn produce into coins. Hire farmhands to work the land while you plan, upgrade your storage, and unlock new plots as your profits grow. The farm never stops earning. 🧟 HOLD THE LINE Start the wave when you are ready — nothing moves until you say so. Then the horde comes through the gates and throws itself at your fence. When the fence falls, the run is over. Your character aims and fires automatically, so the real skill is positioning: read the pressure, cut off the gate that is breaking, never let them settle. 🔫 GEAR UP Four weapons, each with its own upgrade path — Rifle, Shotgun, RPG and Flamethrower. Add a combat drone, hire soldiers to fight beside you, and raise defense towers that hold the gates you cannot reach. Unlock new character skins along th…
howToPlay: Touch or mouse — press and drag ANYWHERE on the screen. The joystick appears right under your finger, so there is no fixed pad to hunt for. Keyboard — WASD, arrow keys or ZQSD. Both work at once. Use whatever feels right.

title: Bricks Buster
description: Bricks Buster is a fun and addictive arcade game! Aim, shoot, and break bricks to clear levels. Use power-ups, plan your shots, and enjoy endless brick-breaking action!
howToPlay: Swipe to aim and release to shoot the balls. Break all the bricks before they reach the bottom. Each brick shows the number of hits needed to destroy it. Use power-ups to clear tough levels faster. Bounce shots off walls to hit more bricks and create combos. The level ends when all bricks are cleared or reach the bottom. Keep aiming smart and breaking bricks to achieve high scores!

title: RPG Idle Clicker
description: RPG Idle Clicker is an incremental game where you embark on an adventure to slay monsters. Click to deal damage, earn gold, and unlock powerful swords to enhance your attacks. Upgrade your blades and recruit auto-attacking heroes who battle monsters every second, even while you are offline. With stunning WebGL visuals, face tougher enemies and epic bosses in this browser-based game. Whether you prefer active gameplay or idle progression, RPG Idle Clicker offers endless growth. Get ready and become the ultimate monster hunter!
howToPlay: Tap the enemy to deal damage and eliminate them. Interact with the UI buttons to upgrade sword levels, heroes, equip items, and much more.

title: 99 Nights In The Forest
description: You find yourself in a dark and mysterious forest where the only goal is to survive for 99 nights. As darkness falls, a monstrous deer emerges from the shadows to hunt you down. Your only chance of survival is to keep the fire burning, since it is the only thing that scares the creature away. During the day, you must gather resources — wood, food, and useful items — to prepare for the night. With every passing night, the challenge becomes harder: temperatures drop, the forest grows darker, and the monster becomes more relentless. The game combines horror, survival, and rogue-like elements. You need to carefully manage limited resources and constantly watch over the fire to stay alive. Immersive sounds and a tense atmosphere keep you on edge until the very end. Will you survive and make it through all 99 nights?
howToPlay: Controls are simple and intuitive. Use the keyboard and mouse to explore, gather resources, and fight for survival. • LMB – Attack • E – Action / interact • Q – Drop item • WASD – Move character (forward, back, left, right) • TAB – Inventory • F – Eat / use food • Shift – Run • C – Crouch

title: The Road Home: Granny Escape
description: The Road Home: Granny Escape is a terrifying 3D horror survival game where your only goal is to escape a haunted house filled with danger, puzzles, and fear. You're not here by accident — Granny and Grandpa brought you here on purpose, and they won’t let you go easily. 🕯 The Story Your trip home took a dark turn. While riding a bus through a remote forest, a massive tree crashed down onto the road. You stepped out to investigate… and everything went black. You wake up in a locked, eerie house. The windows are boarded up. The doors are sealed. And something is watching you. You soon realize the terrifying truth: you’ve been kidnapped and trapped by an evil Granny and her mad husband. This isn’t just a place — it’s a prison designed to break you. 🎯 What You Must Do -Explore the dark and haunted house -Solve puzzles and unlock secret passages -Craft useful items from the resources you find -Avoid Granny and Grandpa — they can hear your every move -Survive deadly traps and unpredictable chases -Make your way to freedom before it’s too late ⚙️ Game Features -A chilling 3D horror experience with immersive atmosphere -Evil and intelligent enemies who react to sound and movement -Multip…
howToPlay: WASD — Move C — Crouch Space — Jump The main goal is to escape from the old people's house. Find useful items and use them to your advantage.

title: Cricket Mania
description: Step up to the crease and test your reflexes in Cricket Mania, a next-generation online cricket game that combines timing, precision, and high-score challenges. If you love real cricket, stick cricket, or doodle cricket, you’ll instantly feel at home. Simple to play yet tough to master, Cricket Mania is built for players who enjoy fast matches, realistic animations, and skill-based gameplay. Every delivery tests your instincts - one mistimed shot, and you’re out! Whether you’re a casual fan or a competitive gamer, Cricket Mania delivers authentic batting fun anytime, anywhere.
howToPlay: The goal is simple — score as many runs as possible before losing your wickets! Gameplay Flow: 1 🏃 Bowler Runs In: Watch the bowler’s motion to predict the delivery. 2 ⚾ Ball Delivery: Visual cues reveal the type — Straight, Slow, or Fast. 3 🕒 Timing Window: Press Left or Right when the ball reaches the sweet spot. 4 💥 Shot Outcome: Perfect timing = clean boundaries; late = you’re bowled!

title: School Escape Obby
description: Dive into the thrilling world of School Escape Obby — a vibrant online game in roblox style with stunning graphics and diverse locations! Tackle unique challenges in each zone, from school corridors to mysterious dungeons. Customize your character with hundreds of stylish skins and compete with friends in multiplayer mode. Every obstacle tests your agility and wit: jump, dodge, and solve puzzles to escape the school! Perfect for all skill levels, the game combines fast-paced platforming with creative level design. Regular updates, eye-catching visuals, and competitive leaderboards make this game a top choice for fans of obstacle courses. Join millions of players worldwide and prove your skills!
howToPlay: Escape from school, play for time Controls on PC: Shift - show cursor WASD - move. Space - jump. TAB - pause. F - push enemy E - interact with objects (you can also interact with them by clicking the mouse) On phones: on-screen controls

title: Warrior Bee Apocalypse
description: Warrior Bee Apocalypse is an action and upgrade game. The warrior bee faces hordes of enemy insects to survive. Collecting diamonds to improve your items and skills.
howToPlay: The main objective of the warrior bee is to eliminate hordes of enemy insects to complete the levels and collect gems to upgrade the bee. Desktop Controls: Use the WASD keys or the ARROW KEYS to move the bee. Approach enemies and she attacks automatically. 1, 2 or 3 keys to use the special items. Mobile Controls: On mobile devices tap and drag of the screen to move the bee. It will automatically attack when it is close to the enemy. To use special items, tap on them in the lower right corner.

title: Block Blast jewel puzzle
description: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle - Think Fast. Stack Smart. Rule the Leaderboard! Dive into Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle, the ultimate block puzzle game that mixes calm strategy with thrilling competition. Easy to play, hard to master - and impossible to stop playing! Game Features: Classic Mode: Relax and clear blocks endlessly at your own pace. Timer Mode: Race against time — think fast before the clock runs out! Level Mode: Conquer challenging stages that test your logic and precision. Smooth & Colorful Gameplay: Drag, drop, and fit blocks with satisfying visuals. Global Leaderboard: Compete with players worldwide — climb the ranks and prove your puzzle skills! Perfect for All Ages: Simple mechanics, deep strategy — pure fun for everyone. If you love Tetris, Block Blast, or brain-training puzzle games, this one’s for you. Start stacking, clearing, and claiming your spot at the top today!
howToPlay: Desktop / PC: Mouse or Touchpad: Drag and drop blocks into the grid. Mobile / Touchscreen: Tap & Drag: Move blocks into place with your finger.

title: Mars Colony
description: Rob the Robot, you have been given a crucial mission: to prepare Mars for human settlement! Mine resources. Build factories. Recycle resources. Prepare Mars for human settlement! "Mars Colony" is an idle game. The game is similar to "My Little Universe."
howToPlay: Use the joystick to move. If you have a keyboard, you can use: WASD or arrow keys to move. Move Rob to a resource and he will begin mining it. Move Rob to a production facility and he will begin processing the resource, and a production acceleration panel will appear. To speed up resource processing, quickly click the panel that appears. Move Rob to a construction zone and he will invest resources in the building. Move Rob to a warehouse and the resource movement panel will open. Move Rob to the transport assistant control zone and the assistant control panel will open.

title: Sprunki in Backrooms
description: 🎮 Welcome to Sprunki in Backrooms! 🟨🚪 You’ve found yourself trapped in the mysterious Backrooms, where endless yellow corridors hide countless dangers. Your only way to escape is to collect 15 rolls of duct tape scattered throughout the maze. 🟨 Explore eerie Backrooms locations 🧻 Collect all 15 rolls of duct tape 🚪 Find the exit and escape the Backrooms! Can you escape before the Backrooms trap you forever? 👀
howToPlay: PC Controls: Move — W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys; Jump — Space; Run — Shift; Crouch — C; Interact — E; Open Menu — Tab; Open Inventory — I; Zoom Camera — Right Mouse Button (RMB); Bonus Speed from Ads — Z; Bonus Jump Power from Ads — X. Mobile Controls: Move — Joystick; Jump — Jump Button; Run — Run Button; Crouch — Crouch Button; Rotate Camera — Right side of the screen; Open Inventory — Button in the top-left corner; Interact — Button with the "E" icon; Open Menu — Button in the top-right corner.

title: Space Rolling Balls Race
description: Game Title: 🌌 Space Rolling Balls Race 🌠 Product Description: Get ready for an exciting 3D adventure in Space Rolling Balls Race, a fun, addictive, and fast-paced rolling ball game set in outer space! 🌍✨ Control your rolling ball through thrilling cosmic tracks filled with obstacles, traps, jumps, and moving platforms. With simple fingertip controls, smooth physics-based gameplay, and catchy background music, every level will test your reflexes, timing, and focus! 🚀 Features: 🎯 Easy to play, hard to master rolling ball gameplay 🌠 Challenging 3D levels with cool space environments ⚡ Smooth controls and realistic physics 🎵 Addictive sound effects and rhythm-based fun 🪐 Suitable for all ages — perfect casual game for everyone 💫 If you love ball games, rolling games, parkour challenges, or reflex-based runners, Space Rolling Balls Race is the ultimate game for you! Roll, dodge, and race your way through space to become the ultimate ball racing master! 🏆
howToPlay: How to Play 🎮 ✨ Follow these simple steps to master Space Rolling Balls Race: 🔹 Swipe or drag your finger on the screen to move the ball. 🔹 Avoid traps and obstacles that appear on the track. 🔹 Stay on the path — falling off means game over! 🔹 Collect power-ups to boost your score and progress faster. 🔹 Keep up with the rhythm — the music helps guide your timing. 🔹 Challenge yourself to beat your best distance and reaction speed!

title: Cat Puzzle: Draw To Kitten
description: «Cat Puzzle: Draw to Kitten» is an addictive casual puzzle game where you need to help cute pets reunite by drawing a safe line for cats to their kittens to get home! If the cats collide, they will become dizzy and you will lose. Use your skills by playing this game and immerse yourself in the atmosphere now! 😻 GAME FEATURES: 💣 Variation of enemies and obstacles; 🎭 Variety of kitten and cat skins; 🎨 Cute and bright graphics; 🎮 Simple gameplay; 💀 A variety of levels with increasing difficulty.
howToPlay: 1. Drag your finger over the cat and start drawing a line towards the kittens; 2. Be careful, avoid enemies and obstacles on the way; 3. Make sure all cats take their kittens home safely!

title: Robby Superhero Obby
description: The game is similar to the popular roblox OBBY mode. Check yourself if you can get to the end by overcoming all obstacles. There are 10 superpowers in the game. On the first map, you will be able to destroy walls. Shrink to a tiny size to fit into small passages. Jump high. Use X-ray vision to see hidden objects. Stop time. On the second map, you can turn off gravity to jump further. Change the angle of gravity to run on walls and ceilings. Use the jetpack to climb higher. Use a protective aura to avoid taking damage. And you can also become invisible. Reach checkpoints, get cups and unlock new skins for your character.
howToPlay: Your task is to get to the end of the level using different superpowers. If you fall, you will start from the place of the last checkpoint. Control (computer): ● WASD - Movement ● Right Click - Camera Overview ● Space Jump ● Tab or Escape Pause ● Keys 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 - Activating Superpowers Control (phone): ● Using the game interface ● Move in any place - Camera view

title: Space Break
description: Space Break is a casual pixel space shooter with great graphics and lots of locations! Get into the fight against aliens in this pixel-art shooter game! Upgrade your ship, explore different galaxies and defeat bosses! Fight the alien invaders! Space Break is a great casual game to kill time. What's in the game? - Randomly generated waves of aliens for a new experience in each level. - Endless gameplay, levels will never end - Unique spaceship skins - Boss battles - Control with 1 finger or mouse - All levels are randomly generated Be careful - the game can be addictive!
howToPlay: Choose the type of your ship, pump it up and start playing! The goal of the game is to pass the level passing through waves of enemies, at the end of each level you are waiting for a battle with the boss. Playing continuously you gain points, the further you pass the higher your record will be. On your phone, use your finger to move from side to side to control the ship. On your PC, use your mouse by holding down the left mouse button to control the ship.

title: Cube Sort
description: CubeSort is a colorful 3D tap-and-sort puzzle. Each level is a floating sculpture built from patterned tiles — cubes, spheres, stairs, arches, and hundreds of surprising shapes. Rotate it freely, find the tiles that match the open buckets, and tap them away before your tray overflows. Simple to pick up, tricky to master: gray riveted tiles block your way, hidden "?" tiles keep their pattern secret until you dig next to them, and the order you clear tiles in decides whether the tray survives. Every one of the 500 levels is verified to be solvable — no luck required, just sharp sorting. 500 handcrafted-feel levels, all guaranteed solvable 14 tile patterns, distinct shapes for colorblind-friendly play Free 3D rotation and zoom — inspect every corner Blocker and mystery-tile gimmicks that ramp up the challenge Quick sessions: one level takes a minute or two
howToPlay: Drag empty space to rotate the cube. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Tap a tile on the surface — if it matches an open bucket, it flies in. No matching bucket? The tile waits in the tray. If the tray fills up, the level fails. Fill a bucket to complete it — the next bucket opens, and matching tray tiles fly in automatically. Gray riveted tiles can never be removed. Dig around them. "?" tiles reveal their pattern when you clear a tile right next to them. Stuck? Watch a short ad to open an extra bucket or add a tray slot. Complete every bucket to clear the level. 500 levels await!

title: Locked in Grandma’s Basement 2: Revenge - Horror Escape
description: Locked in Grandma’s Basement 2: Revenge – Horror Escape is the chilling sequel to the cult classic point-and-click horror game. After managing to escape once, Grandma has found you again — and this time, she’s locked you in an even darker, more twisted place. Explore eerie rooms, solve cryptic puzzles, and uncover cursed objects and grotesque clues. Use your logic and courage to find tools, unlock hidden paths, and perform a disturbing ritual to escape. Every item has a purpose, every detail tells a story — and Grandma is always watching. Will you manage to escape again, or will you become her next ritual offering? Perfect for fans of horror, escape rooms, and point-and-click adventures.
howToPlay: This is a classic point-and-click adventure with a first-person view. You don’t move around freely — instead, you explore each scene from a fixed perspective. Click on objects to examine them, collect useful items, and use them in the right places to solve puzzles and progress through the story. Every interaction matters, so pay attention to details and think logically to escape.

title: Obby Fishing: Catch the Megalodon
description: Feel like a real angler! Different fish species require a special approach. Keep a close eye on the float, feel the tension of the line during the bite, and show your skill to reel in a rare trophy! From tiny crucian carps to giant legendary creatures - catch them all! 🛒 Upgrade Your Gear Start with a simple bamboo rod and earn coins to become a true pro! 🌀 Open Portals to Other Worlds! This isn't just fishing in a pond! By collecting enough rare fish or completing achievements, you can activate a magic portal and travel to a brand new dimension for fishing! 📈 Achievement & Collection System Collect a unique catalog of fish from each world, complete daily quests, and earn rewards. Become a legend by catching the rarest fish of all - the MEGALODON!
howToPlay: ✅ How to Play: ✅ ❗️ For Computer ➡️ Movement - WASD or Arrow Keys. ➡️ Jump - Spacebar. ➡️ Sprint - Shift. ➡️ Use Abilities - R and T. ❗️ For Phone ➡️ Movement – Use the left thumbstick. ➡️ Camera Rotation – Swipe the screen. ➡️ Jump – Press the button with the person icon. ➡️ Use Abilities – Press the two buttons to the right of the jump button.

title: Insect Clicker
description: Insect Clicker is a clicker game where you multiply the tarantula coin by clicking. You can buy various upgrades to increase the output of insect, and buy new skins to make you the best insect in world.
howToPlay: Desktop Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game UI. Mobile Use the finger to interact with the in-game UI.

title: Spin and Collect
description: Spin & Collect is the ultimate collecting game! Every spin awards coins, gems, and rare items. Complete sets to unlock powerful bonuses, win jackpots, and watch your collection grow even offline with AFK rewards. From Common to Legendary, will you be able to collect them all? Optional rewarded ads accelerate your progress without interrupting the game. Perfect for casual players and those looking to complete everything! Double Wheels: Basic Wheel for constant progression + Premium Wheel for colossal jackpots Epic Collections: Unlock items from Common to Legendary rarity Set Bonuses: Complete collections to get permanent bonuses and multipliers AFK Rewards: Keep earning coins even offline; progress is constant! Mobile Optimized: Smooth one-tap gameplay, ideal for quick sessions on the go
howToPlay: 🖱️ Click/Tap "SPIN" to spin the wheel and win rewards 📦 Inventory Button - View your collection and completed sets 🎬 Optional Ads - Watch to speed up progress 🔊 Audio Toggle - Control music and sound effects

title: BS Simulator
description: UNLOCK AND UPGRADE BRAWLERS Unlock and upgrade a variety of Brawlers! Level up your Brawlers and collect unique skins. TROPHY ROAD Collect trophies to earn rewards and advance to new leagues! BRAWL PASS - More than 140 rewards! - Complete daily quests and unlock exclusive rewards. LEADERBOARDS Compete with real players from all over the world! DAILY BONUSES Log in to the game every day and receive exclusive bonuses! In addition, the game has mini-modes.
howToPlay: - Open Brawl Boxes to unlock Brawlers, earn coins and gems, and improve your progress! - Upgrade your Brawlers! - Complete quests and get tokens to complete the BRAWL PASS! - Earn trophies to advance your Trophy Road and win exclusive rewards! - Log into the game every day to get daily bonuses! - Take advantage of special offers in the shop, they are updated several times a week! - Customize your profile: player icon, name, name color (if you have a Brawl Pass, you can put a gradient color!) - Play mini-games, you can earn good rewards in them!

title: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro!
description: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro! — a fun snowy adventure where you play solo or with a friend, leveling up your tree to make it the coolest in the world! Collect rare toys, play mini-games, and show everyone your tree is the top 🎄❄️ ❄️ What’s waiting for you: • Play solo or co-op on one device 🤝 • Toy collection — from common to ultra-rare, decorate and upgrade your tree 💎 • Crafting — combine items to make legendary decorations 🔧✨ • Mini-games — earn coins, boosts, and rewards 🎮 • Snow battles — throw snowballs and have fun ☃️💥 • Huge tree — level it up and make it even cooler 🎄🔥 • Leaderboard — the more epic your tree and collection, the higher you climb 🏆 • Daily bonuses — gifts and freebies every day 🎁 Collect toys, craft the best decorations, and turn your tree into a legendary snowy world icon ❄️👑 [Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about, and what do you do? A: It is a 2D game where you grow and decorate your own Christmas tree by playing various mini-games. You earn ""gifts"" as currency, and the larger your tree grows, the more rewards you receive. Q: Is there a storyline in the game? A: Not exactly, but the premise is that you need to save Christmas…
howToPlay: Play together on one device — each controls their own character while leveling up the tree and causing snowy chaos! ❄️🎄 🎮 Player 1 Controls: • A / S / D — move • W — jump • Q — action The rest you’ll figure out on the fly 😉 🎮 Player 2 Controls: • ← / ↓ / → — move • ↑ — jump • Enter — action Everything else is pretty intuitive 😎 Work as a team, throw snowballs, play mini-games, and make your tree the coolest ever! ☃️🔥

title: Adventure Crazy Ramp Bike Stunt Game
description: Get ready to ride like a pro in Adventure Bike Ramp Game – Crazy Stunt Game, the most thrilling bike stunt simulator of 2025! Perform impossible jumps, flip through mega ramps, and race at extreme speeds in this action-packed motorcycle stunt game. A perfect blend of adventure, racing, and stunt challenges – built for players who love adrenaline! Choose your favorite stunt bike, upgrade engines, unlock crazy tracks, and show your racing skills in this mega ramp stunt game. Jump over obstacles, dodge traps, and complete missions to become the ultimate stunt master. The realistic physics, 3D graphics, and smooth controls offer an unforgettable extreme bike riding experience. Ride through sky-high ramps, compete in stunt challenges, and prove you’re the best stunt rider! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a hardcore bike stunt lover, this game brings nonstop entertainment.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys to ride and balance your bike. Press the left arrow to lean backward and the right arrow to lean forward. Use the up arrow to move forward and the down arrow to reverse when needed. Collect coins during your ride to unlock new and more powerful bikes as you progress!

title: Super Car Soccer Arena
description: Super Car Soccer Arena unleashes high-speed action where powerful sports cars replace traditional soccer players! Jump into the arena, boost across the field, and smash the giant ball into your opponent’s goal. Master drifting, aerial flips, and explosive turbo moves to outplay rivals in this thrilling car-soccer showdown. With fast matches, smooth controls, and dynamic arenas, every game feels intense and unpredictable. Score goals, unlock new cars, and become the ultimate champion in this extreme fusion of racing and football. Start your engines and dominate the arena! Race into the arena, smash the ball toward the goal, and outscore the enemy team before time is up. Use nitro, drift, and dominate the match!
howToPlay: Experience full control of your supercar in the ultimate soccer arena! Use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys to move your car—drive forward, reverse, and steer left or right with precision. Press Shift to activate Nitrous Boost for explosive speed during attacks or defense. Hit Space to apply the Brake and make sharp stops or controlled drifts. Use the Mouse to freely look around, giving you better awareness of the arena and ball position. Tap C to change the camera view, switching between dynamic perspectives for better gameplay. If your car flips or gets stuck, press R to reset your car position instantly.

title: Summer Rider 3D
description: Hit the waves in Summer Rider 3D, a sun-soaked surf adventure inspired by high-speed endless runners. Glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, collect shimmering starfish, and push your reflexes to the limit as the speed cranks up. With a colorful summer theme and upbeat tropical soundtracks, the game offers endless fun for both solo and competitive players. [Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about and what are the main objectives? A: It's an arcade game where you surf and have to overcome various obstacles on your board. Q: Is there a story or narrative arc? A: There is no storyline; the objective is to avoid crashing your surfboard while navigating around rocks, waterfalls, and a lot of dangerous obstacles. Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? What makes it appealing to players? A: The game stands out because there are few similar surfing games. It features good graphics, enjoyable music, and many surfboard skins. Q: What are the most engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)? A: The very relaxing, summer-themed location.
howToPlay: ARROW KEYS or WASD: Move left, right, or jump to navigate waves and obstacles. On MOBILE, tap left/right to steer, both sides to jump! Collect starfish to unlock new surfboards or jet-skis. Aim for the five-starfish bonuses on rocks for bigger rewards, but time your jumps carefully. As your distance increases, the speed ramps up stay sharp to maintain control.

title: Laser Survivor
description: Laser Survivor, a cyberpunk roguelike action-adventure set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse, the last hope for humanity rests in the hands of five heroes fighting hordes of demons pouring through a dimensional rift. Featuring pixel art visuals, randomized weapons, chiptune soundtracks, and relentless survival gameplay, every run is a test of adaptation and skill. Story The world has fallen. A dimensional rift has unleashed an unstoppable flood of demons, tearing through what remains of civilization. But from the chaos, five warriors rise. Each wielding unique powers forged for survival in this cyberpunk hellscape. Dropped at random into corrupted maps, they must adapt with whatever weapons and passive abilities they find, carving their path through waves of enemies, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering the truth behind the rift. The fate of Earth depends on them. Heroes Blaze: Fires homing bullets that lock onto the nearest enemy, ensuring no demon can escape. Neon: Projects a protective energy shield that damages anything foolish enough to get close. Hunter: Drops explosives that create deadly zones, controlling the battlefield with traps. Slash: Slices enemies apart with razor-s…
howToPlay: Arrow keys, or WASD for movement of the characters with keyboard, or Mouse. Touch controls on Mobile for movement of the characters.

title: TRAFFIC JAM ESCAPE 3D
description: Clear the roads in Traffic Jam Escape 3D! Solve challenging traffic puzzles, free cars from gridlock, and master the art of strategic driving. Get ready to play Traffic Jam Escape 3D, the addictive mobile traffic puzzle game where you control chaotic city streets and free cars from gridlock! Every second counts - one smart move can clear the road, one mistake can block it forever. Are you skilled enough to guide every car out of the jam? In Traffic Jam Escape 3D, your goal is simple but challenging: tap cars, follow the arrows, and plan their path to freedom. Avoid collisions, dodge obstacles, and keep traffic moving smoothly. With each level, timing and strategy become even more important - one wrong move could create a crash and block the way. Every stage offers a brand-new challenge. You’ll need to think ahead, plan the order of moves, and figure out the best escape route for each vehicle. From narrow alleys to busy intersections, the puzzles get tougher and more exciting as you progress. Featuring a wide variety of vehicles - from tiny cars to large trucks - you’ll need to adapt your strategy to guide each one safely out of the mess. The more you play, the sharper your skills…
howToPlay: Tap cars to drive them out and clear the traffic jam! Collect gems to decorate your room, finish levels fast for more points, and use boosters like rockets or helicopters to beat tough stages.

title: Car Battle
description: Car Battle is an adrenaline-fueled driving brawler where your war vehicle doubles as both weapon and armor. Take on foes in solo campaigns or challenge friends in intense two-player duels, with each fight spanning five action-packed stages. Upgrade your car, refine your tactics, and unlock unique avatars to personalize your fighter as the battles grow more challenging.
howToPlay: Use A/D or Left/Right arrow keys to move the car, Space to jump, and Mouse/Touch to interact with game UI.

title: Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang
description: Meet Kalulu — your new favorite mukbang streamer! Make delicious desserts, host ASMR streams, and win over your viewers' hearts! 🍓 Create crunchy Tanghulu Skewer juicy berries, dip them in sugar syrup, and enjoy the perfect crunch! Experiment with strawberries, grapes, and other treats to create the most beautiful Tanghulu. 🧋 Make refreshing Boba Tea Mix aromatic tea, add tapioca pearls, and create drinks that will delight your audience! 🎥 Host ASMR Mukbang streams Go live and watch Kalulu eat the dishes you prepared! The relaxing eating sounds will help attract more viewers. Fulfill their requests and receive donations! 🎨 Customize everything around you Create the perfect streaming space: choose wallpapers for the room, change the desk, and pick out stylish outfits for Kalulu. Make your studio look cozy and vibrant! Join the relaxing world of mukbang with the cute Kalulu!
howToPlay: Welcome to the world of mukbang streaming, where the charming and funny Kalulu is your main character! Help him become a true internet star! 🍜 Become the best mukbang streamer! Your main goal is to host live streams, eat delicious food, and attract as many viewers as possible. The more entertaining your stream, the more popular you become! ✨ What can you do in the game? Make Tanghulu: Start your journey by preparing the biggest hit — sweet and crunchy Tanghulu! The cooking process itself is pure joy. Unlock Boba Tea: Surprise your subscribers with variety! Visit the Shop: Don't feel like cooking? No problem! Stop by the shop, where you can always buy ready-made food for your stream. Grow your audience: The more diverse food you try on stream, the more viewers will join you. Break records and become a top streamer! Ready to start your delicious adventure? Kalulu is waiting for you!

title: Mergetopia
description: 🌍 Mergetopia A delightful 2D casual merge game where evolution happens one merge at a time! 🐾 Dive into a Realm each filled with popular sea animals characters waiting to be discovered, merged, and evolved. Your goal? Build and discover the Creatures — one bubble pop and one merge at a time!
howToPlay: PC/Desktop: Use the left mouse button to click, drag and merge Mobile: tap to click, hold and drag to merge

title: Color Brawls
description: Color Brawls is a thrilling online game where you compete using bright colors to defeat rivals. Play instantly on any device without downloads or sign-ups. Enjoy this fast-paced adventure anywhere, featuring various locations and unique challenges, perfect for those looking for a fun and engaging experience.
howToPlay: *PC Controls* WASD / arrow keys = move Left-click = shoot Tab = pause *Mobile Controls* Joystick = move Swipe = look Button = shoot

title: Animal Hospital
description: There's a queue of patients outside the reception window — but after midnight, it isn't only sick animals that come to town. Some of them are only pretending to be a cat, a dog, or a rabbit: an extra eye, the wrong coat color, a smile that's a little too human, a shadow that shouldn't be there, a voice that's subtly wrong. Your job is to tell a real patient from an anomaly using nothing but a photo and their paperwork. Let your own kind in and heal them; keep the others off the threshold. Every animal you admit has to be led to a ward and treated through mini-games — and in between, you'll need to run the generator, check the cages, and keep an eye on the security cameras. All of it without losing your mind, and without looking where you shouldn't. Every shift gets darker, the anomalies grow more numerous, and something that was only pretending to be a patient begins to roam the clinic's corridors. Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Will you live to see the dawn?
howToPlay: Controls PC: WASD — move, mouse — look, E — interact / admit, R — refuse, F — patient chart, G — records log, Q — flashlight, C — coffee to go, RMB (hold) — zoom in, 1–6 — quick phrases in co-op, Esc — pause. Cameras: walk up to the surveillance tablet and press E. Smartphone: left stick — move, swipe on the right — look, round buttons on the right — flashlight, magnifier, and coffee; decisions and all other actions — tap the buttons and prompts on screen.

title: Obby: Parkour with Ragdoll
description: 🏃 Complete challenging parkour maps, collect rewards, and push opponents into the abyss! 🌋 MAP 1 — LAVA An easy parkour course for beginners, but be careful — one wrong move and you'll fall into the lava! ⚙️ MAP 2 — EXTREME The toughest challenges: 🔄 Rotating obstacles 🟨 Disappearing platforms ⬅️➡️ Moving blocks 😱 Only the best players can reach the finish! ❄️ MAP 3 — ICE WORLD Slippery surfaces, dangerous jumps, and a true ice parkour experience! 💥 GAME FEATURES: 👊 Push other players 💫 Knock out opponents with ragdoll physics 🏆 Earn rewards for knocking players off the map 😂 Create epic falls and hilarious moments 💎 COLLECT RESOURCES: 💎 Crystals 🪙 Coins 🎁 Earn rewards and improve your performance ⭐ INCLUDES: ✔️ Parkour ✔️ Obby ✔️ PvP ✔️ Ragdoll Physics ✔️ Player Pushing ✔️ Knockout Battles ✔️ Lava ✔️ Ice ✔️ Challenging Obstacles ✔️ Moving Platforms ✔️ Disappearing Blocks ✔️ Rotating Obstacles Jump in and see for yourself!

title: Black Friday Dress Up Selfie
description: Shop the best looks in Black Friday Dress Up Selfie! Help your fashionista choose outfits from her wishlist, cozy fall fits, warm winter layers, sparkly holiday glam, and dark-academia vibes. Mix tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, and accessories to create the perfect selfie-ready style. A fun, fast way to solve every “What should I wear?” moment!
howToPlay: Use your mouse to play the game on a desktop, tap to play on mobile devices. Browse through the category options, click or tap the clothing pieces and accessories you like the most, and see them pop on your character.

title: Dream Home
description: A cozy 3D builder where you design and furnish your very own house from scratch. Raise walls and floors, paint them any color, hang wallpaper, lay flooring, arrange furniture, and decorate the yard: from flower beds and a campfire to a pool and a fountain. Finished a room? Step inside! First-person walk mode lets you stroll through your house, climb the stairs, and see the result with your own eyes, by day and by night. Want more than a sandbox? Fill client orders: build to the brief, get graded on your work, earn experience, and level up. A special challenge order is available every day. As you level up, new plots unlock — so you can work on several houses at once.
howToPlay: Controls on computer: mouse — building and camera (right button — rotate, wheel — zoom), WASD/arrows — move camera, R — rotate item, Delete — sell, Esc — exit walk mode. Controls on phone: tap — build and select, two fingers — rotate and zoom camera, joystick — walking in walk mode.

description: Do you like simple and challenging puzzles with cars and trains? Do you love mobile bestsellers like “Traffic Escape” and “Parking Escape”? title: Brainrot Courier

The further you go, the more unique and valuable Brainrots you can find. From popular characters to ultra—rare legends, each find brings you closer to becoming the best Brainroot collector. Features * Dynamic platform gameplay on a skateboard * Collect dozens of unique and fun Brainrots * Jump over chasms and overcome difficult obstacles * Smooth and responsive skateboard controls * Unlock rare and legendary Brainrots * Collect the greatest collection of Brainrots * Fast and addictive gaming sessions * Suitable for players of all ages

title: Agent Sniper City

Stay focused—the fate of the city rests in your hands!

title: Rings Untie
description: Rings Untie is a simple but addictive Ring puzzle game. Do you want to train your brain? Do you love colorful games with easy gameplay with fun rotate the circle puzzle games? Both kids and adults can enjoy Rotate the Rings - a game in which you use your finger to rotate the circle to dissolve the puzzle. Save the lovely moments with your beloved people while playing this game! This puzzle game includes various types of colorful rings: D rings, S rings, C lock rings, Ring lock... and different obstacles. A lot of exciting puzzle levels in the game are there for you to explore. If you like mini-games like Rescue the Dog, Rescue the woman and Save the Girl... this is another fun game for you.
howToPlay: • Players need to rotate the circle by touching the screen to align it perfectly with the gap • The circle will display various colors or patterns that need to be aligned with the center target within a given time • Each successful match increases the score and unlocks the next, more challenging level • Different rings bring you different challenges, plan your next move to save the time • C lock rings is easy to rotate, D ring limit the range, S ring is flexible,... and more Ring locks to explore • Pay attention to the time limit, try to complete the matches within the designated time, and avoid incorrect moves • Like other rescue the dog game, you must be careful and have a good strategy to win the game

title: Obby: Extreme Cart Ride
description: 🚀 Jumps, speed, and nonstop forward momentum — there’s no time to slow down! Get ready for a wild ride across challenging tracks where every section demands precision and quick reactions. Accelerate, overcome dangerous segments, dodge traps, and try not to fly off the track. Every mistake can cost you the victory — and that’s exactly what makes each run so exciting. As you progress, the tracks become more difficult and the obstacles more unpredictable. Test your control skills, learn to feel the speed, and prove that you can reach the finish line even in the most extreme conditions. What awaits you: • Unique tracks with unexpected turns • A constant sense of speed and risk • Spectacular falls and fun physics • New ways to complete each level • Bright emotions in every run Easy to learn, challenging to master. Do you have what it takes to overcome every challenge and reach the end?

title: Slither Snake 2048
description: Players begin their journey as small snakes and eat colorful dots to grow. However, the bigger you get, the more challenges you face. You will have to avoid colliding with other snakes while you try to eat them. Your strategy and snake control will be key factors in your survival. Be careful, because if your head touches another snake, you will explode and the game will end. But don't worry, you can always start over and try to beat your previous record. Slither Snake 2048 is a game that tests your skills, reactions and strategic thinking. Are you ready to become the biggest snake? Try it now!
howToPlay: Hold the left mouse button and move the cursor so that the snake crawls in the direction of your cursor! Have A Good Game!

title: Find The Dog

Each dog is playfully tucked away in different settings — from cozy parks to bustling streets — just waiting to be spotted. There's no rush, just relax and enjoy the search!

Have fun, and see if you can find them all!

title: Ball Bounce: Try It

title: Nut Sort: Build the City
description: Dive into the captivating world of «Nut Sort: Build the City» — a thrilling puzzle game where your task is to bring order to the chaos of nuts and bolts! This isn’t just your classic color-sorting game. Every completed level brings you closer to building the city of your dreams. Solve puzzles, earn nuts, and watch houses and parks rise before your eyes. 🏙️ **BUILD CITIES**: Complete levels, earn resources, and construct 14 unique cities. 🧩 **ENGAGING LEVELS**: Thousands of puzzles with varying difficulty will keep you entertained. 🎁 **BONUSES**: Unlock special bonus levels after every 5 regular ones. 💡 **HINTS**: View a level solution or get an extra bolt if you're stuck. 🧠 **ENJOYABLE EXPERIENCE**: Relaxing gameplay that also trains your brain. «Nut Sort: Build the City» is the perfect blend of soothing sorting and engaging strategy. Sharpen your mind and become the ultimate mayor in the world of puzzles!
howToPlay: 🎯 Your goal is to organize all the nuts by color. A level is considered complete when each bolt holds nuts of only one color. 📜 Simple rules: To move a nut, first tap the bolt you want to take it from, then tap the bolt you want to place it on. You can only move the topmost nut from a bolt. A nut can be placed only on top of another nut of the same color or on any empty bolt. 🏗️ Victory and building: For each successfully completed level, you earn valuable nuts as a reward. Use them to construct buildings and develop your city! 💡 In-game help: If you’re stuck, use a hint or add an extra bolt to the field to make things easier. Good luck!

Use your drawing skills wisely to create the perfect defense and keep the stickman safe. As you progress, puzzles become more challenging, requiring smarter strategies and more creative solutions.

Pinch or scroll to zoom in/out. Use the Hint button (lightbulb) to reveal the best move (3 per game, watch a short ad). Access Settings (gear icon) to change difficulty, toggle move hints, or mute audio. FAQ's: 1: How do I play against a friend in 3D Chess - Arcane Edition? Tap "Play a Friend" on the landing screen to create a private room, then share the room code. The other person can open the link and play as the other colour. 2: Do I need an account to play? No. There's no login and no database — just pick a name, play, and close the tab when you're done. Multiplayer rooms are temporary: once everyone leaves, the game and its history are gone for good. 3: How strong is the computer opponent? 3D Chess - Arcane Chess runs Stockfish, one of the strongest chess engines in the world, directly in your browser. title: Fruit Fusion
description: Welcome to Fruit Fusion, the ultimate fruit-merging puzzle experience! Drop and combine cherries, lemons, oranges, tomatoes, melons, coconuts, pumpkins, and watermelons to create bigger, juicier fruits. Keep merging to unlock massive combos and earn record-breaking points!
howToPlay: Drop fruits into the board. When two identical fruits touch, they merge into a bigger fruit. Keep merging to unlock all fruit types. Plan your drops to avoid running out of space. Score as many points as possible before the board fills up!

title: Diamond Painting by Number
description: Diamond Painting by Number is a coloring game in which you can draw, color and create diamonds by numbers. Diamond painting includes many of gorgeous diamond drawings by numbers in coloring books.
howToPlay: On desktop: left mouse click. On a mobile device: touch on game elements on the touch screen. Simple controls for everyone. Enjoy!

title: Cube Trap
description: The room looks simple. Five steps to the door you want, level floor, no enemies. You start walking — and the floor drops out from under you. A 3D platformer that lies to your face. The platform slides away at the exact instant you jump. The ceiling comes down the moment you stand still. The controls flip to mirror mode halfway down a corridor. Gravity turns over, and the sky becomes the floor. And the door you were heading for sidesteps two paces and slams shut. Nothing here is random: every dirty trick fires the same way every single time. The first time it kills you; the second time it doesn't. Death is instant and costs you nothing — the little cube guy bursts into parts and half a second later he's standing at the start again. Losing is impossible. The only thing you can do is fail to catch on.
howToPlay: The goal is simple: reach the green door. The hard part is that the level will fight you. PC: WASD or arrow keys — move Space — jump (hold longer to jump higher) Hold mouse button and drag — rotate camera R — restart level Esc — pause Mobile: Touch the left half of the screen — a joystick appears; drag your finger in the direction you want to go Button on the right — jump (hold = higher) Swipe anywhere on the free part of the screen — rotate camera

title: Box Magician
description: Box Magician is a charming Halloween-themed physics puzzle game where you help a young witch collect her magical treasure. Tap to remove crates, shift the structure, and guide the treasure chest safely into her hands. Each object reacts differently — some explode, some roll, and others change the balance — making every level a fun challenge of timing, logic, and strategy. With cute Halloween visuals, smooth animations, and progressively smarter puzzles, Box Magician delivers a delightful and engaging gameplay experience for all puzzle lovers.
howToPlay: Tap on crates to remove or break them. Use physics to shift the structure and guide the treasure chest toward the witch. Watch out for explosive or moving objects — use them wisely to solve the puzzle. Complete the level by safely delivering the treasure to the witch. Think ahead! Each tap changes the balance of the whole structure.

title: Wednesday Addams Merge Drop Puzzle
description: Wednesday Addams Merge Drop Puzzle – The Creepy & Addictive Wednesday Game Online! Step into the spooky world of Wednesday Addams with Wednesday Ad Merge Drop Puzzle – the ultimate merge-and-drop puzzle challenge inspired by the viral fruit drop trend! Merge creepy items, unlock mysterious evolutions, and see what dark surprises await. How to play? Drop and merge two identical spooky items to evolve them into bigger and scarier ones. Keep combining until you unlock the final giant mystery object – can you guess what Wednesday’s darkest creation will be? Wednesday Ad Merge Drop Puzzle isn’t just fun – it’s creepy-cool and highly addictive. With gothic visuals, smooth animations, and the eerie vibe of Wednesday Addams’ world, it’s the perfect game for fans of puzzles, spooky aesthetics, and the Wednesday universe. 🔹 Free to play online – no download required 🔹 Works on any device (PC & mobile) 🔹 Creepy new items and evolutions coming soon 🔹 Perfect for quick plays or long spooky sessions Start merging now and see if you can master the darkness in Wednesday Addams Merge Drop Puzzle
howToPlay: HOW TO PLAY: SLIDE / SWIPE on the screen or with mouse and tap to throw funny Wednesday characters to merge them.

title: Bubble Shooter Mega
description: Bubble Shooter Mega is an exhilarating bubble-popping arcade puzzle game featuring vibrant clusters of red, yellow, and blue bubbles in a sleek dark interface, where players aim and shoot from dual next-bubble previews (16 shots remaining) to match 3+ colors for explosive chain reactions, clearing encroaching walls to meet trophy score goals (1100), collect gems and stars (1/3), and unleash powerful boosters in addictive, high-stakes levels.
howToPlay: Blast the Bubbles Away! Step into the sleek dark arena as a bubble-popping master and aim your shooter using dual next-bubble previews (16 shots left) to match 3+ colors—reds, yellows, blues—for explosive chain reactions that clear encroaching walls, hit trophy score goals like 1100, collect gems and stars (1/3), and activate boosters to conquer addictive high-stakes levels! Desktop Controls: Mouse: Drag to aim (follow the trajectory line), click or release to shoot. Mobile Controls: Touch: Drag to aim, tap or release to shoot.

title: Draw Bridge: Puzzle Challenge
description: Draw Bridge: Puzzle Challenge - solve puzzles, draw bridges, connect paths and test your logic with stickman in a fun game with creativity! Game Features: 🎮 Simple and addictive gameplay; 🎯 Ragdoll physics; 🎨 Creative freedom; 🧩 Diverse levels; 🚀 Accuracy Challenges. Can your designs stand up to the pressure and lead to victory? Let's paint!
howToPlay: - Swipe your finger across the screen to create a path and guide your motorcycle to your destination; - To draw a bridge, you need to draw a line across the open areas and your vehicle will drive over them; - You can only draw the line once; - Absolutely, you have to touch the flag to win; - Draw strong and balanced bridges. 🌈Show your creativity and pass all levels!

title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
description: In this intense survival game you find yourself trapped in a haunted environment where you must endure five days and five nights against relentless monster encounters. Each night brings bloodthirsty creatures that stalk the shadows, turning every step into a heart?pounding horror challenge. To succeed you must complete mission objectives quickly, perform precise actions, and stay one step ahead of the terrifying foes. Master fast?paced gameplay by learning how to hide, escape, and use the environment to avoid detection while conserving your stamina. Follow proven strategies and tips for night survival to outsmart the monsters and emerge victorious.
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow/W): Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow/S): Move downward. ← (Left Arrow/A): Move left. → (Right Arrow/D): Move right. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick.

title: Color Sorting: Rooms
description: Color Sorting: Rooms is a relaxing and engaging puzzle game where you sort colorful liquids into the correct flasks. Each level tests your logic and attention to detail as you try to arrange all the colors without mixing them incorrectly. Start with simple puzzles and gradually progress to more challenging levels with the addition of colors and increasing difficulty. The game is easy to learn but becomes increasingly addictive as you progress. Complete color-based challenges across multiple levels and earn rewards. Use them to unlock and decorate unique rooms, creating your own cozy space as you play. Customize your gameplay with various flask skins and visual styles. Plan your moves carefully, use helpful power-ups when needed, and enjoy smooth and relaxing gameplay.
howToPlay: Tap on a flask to pick up the top color, then tap another flask to pour the liquid. You can only pour if the colors match or if the target flask is empty. The goal is to sort all colors so that each flask contains only one color. Plan your moves carefully, as space is limited and mistakes can make levels harder to solve. As you progress, more colors and complex layouts will appear, requiring better strategy and thinking ahead. Complete quests by collecting specific colors across multiple levels. Finishing quests rewards you with points that can be used to unlock room decorations. Use helpful bonuses if you get stuck, such as adding an extra flask, undoing a move, or removing a color. Relax, think, and enjoy the satisfying process of organizing colors!

title: Screw Puzzle
description: Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Wood Screw Puzzle, the ultimate wood nuts and bolts puzzle game that will challenge your mind and delight your senses. This isn't just another screw sort game; it's an immersive experience where you'll unravel intricate arrangements of wood screws, nuts and bolts, and other fascinating fasteners, proving your screw master skills along the way. Unscrew, Unwind, and Unleash Your Inner Puzzle Master: Each level of Wood Screw Puzzle presents a unique challenge, a mesmerizing tapestry of wood screws and nuts and bolts intertwined in a complex dance. Your task is to carefully analyze the arrangement, strategize your moves, and skillfully manipulate the screw pins and fasteners to screw out each piece and free them from their wooden embrace. It's a test of your logic, spatial reasoning, and dexterity, all wrapped up in a visually stunning and tactilely satisfying wood nuts and bolts puzzle game.
howToPlay: Solve the Wooden Puzzle: Conquer the challenge of the wooden stack, untangle bolts and nuts, and unlock the secrets hidden deep within the wood. Master the Mechanic Puzzle: Arm yourself with a screwdriver and outsmart wood wasps, overcome the plumer crack obstacles, and avoid the whimsical squirrel nuts. Explore the Woods: Venture into the heart of the woods game, where each level brings a new conundrum. Are you ready to delve into the mind-blowing world of Screws & Fasteners?

title: Car Sales Empire Simulator
description: Step into the dynamic realm of Car Sales Empire Simulator, where you can build a successful automotive business. Master car trading and repairs, hone your strategy, and enjoy smooth gameplay on any device while fostering your enterprise and enjoying thrilling negotiations. Controls: Desktop: WASD, arrow keys, click mouse to select an option, C to crouch. Mobile: built-in joystick, tap to select an option. Game Modes: • Graphics: Low: A less resource-intensive mode for the device, with fewer details, nuances, and volume in light-shadow rendering. • Graphics: High: A deeper contrast of light and shadow, more details, and greater load on the device. Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the goal of the game? A: Buy cars and upgrade them to sell later. The higher the sales, the more opportunities arise. It's a great chance to showcase creativity by choosing designs and tuning, improve your online driving skills by maneuvering cars through the city without accidents, and develop the best sales strategy to expand your dealership. Q: What grabs your attention in the first few minutes? A: The atmosphere of the city, the ability to not just move between locations but to weave through the hustle…
howToPlay: Buy cars at markets, bargain and resell cars to earn more money and develop better! WASD - control the car and the character C - change camera Tab - pause Spacebar - handbrake F - get in the car Enter - get out of the car

description: Nubiks build a defense vs zombies - This is a game for two players, or for playing solo and competing against other players. A whole world awaits! 15+ different modes within a single game, dozens of skins and blocks. Team up with a friend or play alone. There are both co-op and single-player modes. Play in survival mode or sandbox. Do whatever you want in this game!

title: Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in madness and fun as a mischievous cat who decided to turn grandma's cozy house into a field of chaos! 🐱 Break pots, steal fish from the aquarium, throw things and scratch everything that comes under your paw. And all this is in the form of a first-person simulator with elements of humor and mayhem. Explore rooms stuffed with interactive objects and watch as grandma's patience melts with each of your pranks. How far will you go before she explodes with anger? 🐾 Game features: 🐟 Destructible objects and interactive environment 😂 Funny and unpredictable reactions of grandma 😼 Endless opportunities for mischief 🎮 Easy to learn, but addictive gameplay
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to complete all the tasks, while annoying Granny. PC controls: WASD - move; Shift - run; Space - jump; E - put/take; F - interact; LMB - throw/shoot. Mobile device controls: Right swipe - camera movement; Left joystick - player movement.

title: Sumo Fury
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Sumo Fury, where you can acquire powerful wrestlers with superior stats and challenge rivals globally. Show your mastery in combat, earn in-game currency through victories, and unlock stronger fighters to dominate the arena. Achieve glory and wealth with each victory, the excitement of Sumo Fury is sure to captivate you!
howToPlay: Keyboard Controls: Movement: Arrow keys (← ↑ → ↓) Punch: Z Kick: X Defend: C Jump: Spacebar Mobile Controls: Movement: Virtual Joystick [Joystick Image] Actions: Tap corresponding buttons

title: Schoolboy: Escape from Parents!
description: Welcome to “Schoolboy: Escape from Parents!” — an exciting stealth quest where you must escape the house without being seen by your parents! Explore rooms, collect items, and use them wisely to discover new paths to freedom and solve puzzles. The game features 10 unique endings, each unlocked through clever thinking, observation, and strategic planning. Track your progress and compete with friends on the leaderboard to see who can unlock the most endings. Combine items, distract your parents, hide, and plan every move — from an ordinary light bulb to a simple stool — every little thing can help you make your escape. The game blends stealth, puzzles, and strategy, making each playthrough unique and exciting. See how far you can go and prove that you can outsmart even the most watchful parents! Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do? A: It's a stealth quest where the player needs to escape from home without getting caught by their parents. Q: Is there a storyline in the game? A: There is no storyline, but the objective is clear: escape from home without disturbing the parents, using various items to distract them. Q: What is the unique feature of the…

title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
description: Geometry Vibes X-Ball is ready to give you a completely different gaming experience! After the first game of the series, interactive new levels, challenge section and completely new store are waiting for you in X-Ball mode. Start your new adventure now in Geometry Vibes X-Ball game where you will find yourself avoiding obstacles, traps and gears in each level! What are Geometry Vibes X-Ball Game Modes? Classic Mode: Try to reach the portals at the end of a total of 10 levels that get harder as the levels pass. The last 3 levels are quite challenging! Endless Mode: Try to go as far as you can without hitting obstacles and traps. Challenge Mode: Challenging stages designed for master players are located in this section. Prove how good a Geometry Vibe X-Ball player you are with 5 different challenge levels. Race Mode: You can compete with your friends locally by playing levels with 2-3-4 player. Is Geometry Vibes X-Ball a Difficult Game? Geometry Vibes X-Ball is definitely not a difficult game and you can complete 10 levels in the classic section if you practice enough. Can Geometry Vibes X-Ball be played on mobile devices? Yes, you can play the game smoothly on your mobile devices s…
howToPlay: The aim of the game is to reach the portal at the end without hitting anything. Click "MOUSE LEFT-CLICK" or "SPACE" to accelerate upwards. Release the button to go down. In 2,3,4 Player Modes, other players are controlled with "H", "L" and "UP ARROW KEY". You can use touch controls on mobile devices such as tablets and phones.

title: Fruit Chopper
description: Grand fruit slasher is out! Gameplay is zero hassle. Time your throws carefully and try to slash multiple fruits at once to get bonus score! Be nimble and accurate - DO NOT MISS! You'll get one cocktail per every level completed. After you get 4 cocktails, you will get free spin of fortune wheel! RARE COCKTAILS = BETTER REWARDS! Can you reach level 100?
howToPlay: You try to slash / cut fruits as they come or are thrown — particularly trying to hit multiple fruits with one throw/slash to get bonus points. The aim is to keep going without missing. You tap or swipe (depending on the moment) to time your throw/slash. Time it carefully so you can hit as many fruits in one go as possible. Important: Do NOT miss — if you fail to hit fruits properly, it affects your progress.

title: Alchemy Elixir of Life
description: Alchemy: Elixir of Life is an exciting puzzle game in which you can feel like a real creator. Create and find all the elements to save your beloved! Find the elixir of life right now! Start with four simple elements — fire, water, earth and air — and create everything that exists in the world. Connect the elements, discover new combinations and watch as order is born out of chaos. Each discovery brings joy, and each new combination brings you closer to solving all the mysteries of the universe. Use logic, imagination and intuition, because there is no single path in alchemy, only your own.
howToPlay: At the beginning, several basic elements are available to you: Water, Land and Air. Choose the first element (for example, Water). Select the second element that you want to add to it (for example, Earth). If there is a combination in the game, then a new element will appear (for example, Water + Earth = Mud). A new item is added to the list, and you can combine it further. Some combinations are obvious (Fire + Water = Steam), while others will require experimentation and logic. Each open element counts, and you gain a certain level in alchemy, as well as getting closer to victory! Sometimes the same result can be obtained in different ways — it all depends on your thinking. Gradually, you will create entire worlds: plants, animals, technology, and even life. The goal of the game is to discover all the combinations, save your beloved and create the elixir of life!

title: Ammo Rush Master
description: Get ready to run, multiply, and blast your way to victory in Ammo Rush Master! Dodge obstacles, choose the right gates, and build the biggest Ammo army of bullets. Then, grab your blaster and unleash a storm of foam darts to smash through targets, enemies, and bosses! ? Features Addictive hyper-casual gameplay – easy to play, hard to master. Fun math gates that boost or reduce your army. Colorful worlds: beach, city, rainbow skies, desert, and more. Huge variety of Ammo-style blasters to unlock and upgrade. Exciting boss battles at the end of each world. Smooth controls and satisfying shooting effects. ⚡ Can you become the ultimate Ammo Rush Master and blast your way to the top? Download now and find out!
howToPlay: ? How to Play Run through the track and pass through gates (+, -, ×, ÷) to increase your firepower. Collect stickman allies and multiply your shooting strength. Avoid traps and tricky gates that can reduce your numbers. At the end, aim your Ammo blaster and fire away to break through walls and bosses!

title: Dogfight
description: Dogfight is a thrilling air combat game where you control a battle plane in intense aerial battles. Perform maneuvers like looping, rolling, and turning as you engage in dynamic dogfights. Experience the rush of real air battles and showcase your piloting skills.
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: W = speed up S = slow down A = left turn D = right turn Q = sharp left turn E = sharp right turn J = fire K = sub-weapon Space = pull up Shift = roll R = reload Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick. Fire Button: Tap to shoot. Pitch Button: Pull up. Roll Button: Let the airplane roll.

title: Ball Attack
description: Blast through endless waves of bouncing balls, dodge incoming obstacles, and upgrade your powerful cannon to survive longer in this intense, fast-paced arcade shooter filled with nonstop action and explosive fun!
howToPlay: Drag to Move: Slide your finger (or mouse) left and right to control the cannon. Shoot Automatically: Your cannon fires continuously—focus on aiming and dodging! Destroy Balls: Each ball has a number—shoot to reduce it to zero and blast it apart. Dodge Everything: Avoid touching balls or it’s game over! Collect Coins: Use coins to upgrade your firepower, speed, and special abilities. Survive Waves: The longer you last, the tougher (and more rewarding) it gets!

title: Solitaire Stars
description: Do you love playing Solitaire? Get ready for Solitaire: Yukon Play Cards, a fun and free card game! This is a special type of Solitaire game called Yukon Solitaire. It’s super relaxing, easy to learn, and fun to play. Play this Solitaire game anytime and anywhere for free.
howToPlay: The goal of Yukon Solitaire is to move all cards to the foundation piles, sorted by suit (hearts, spades, diamonds, and clubs) in order from Ace to King. In this Yukon Solitaire game, you can move a group of cards, even if they’re not in order. Just make sure the first card of the group follows the rules. Stack the cards in descending order (King to Ace) and alternate colors. For example, a red card like a Queen can only follow a black card like a King. Unlike classic Solitaire, all the cards in Yukon Solitaire are dealt face-up, so you can see them all from the start!

title: Constructor Bricks
description: An exciting building game awaits you, where you can immerse yourself in the world of creative design. The game offers many levels with a variety of models, from simple objects to complex architectural masterpieces. Each project includes step-by-step instructions, making it easy for players to follow and assemble unique structures. This is a great way to develop spatial thinking skills, attentiveness, and patience. During the assembly process, you will not only have fun but also learn about different design approaches and architectural styles. Participate in exciting challenges, compete with friends, and share your successes. Join the community and discover an amazing world where your imagination becomes reality, even if you follow clear instructions!

title: Boxing Stars
