howToPlay: Win matches by knocking out your opponent. Use various attacks, blocking and movement to create your own strategy and form your own story. Train your abilities to compete in better tournaments.

title: Race On Cars in Moscow
description: Race On Cars in Moscow — Racing, Tuning and Records! Description: Immerse yourself in a crazy race where the strategy of checkers meets the adrenaline of speed! Drive your car in the traffic, avoid collisions and break through to new records. 💥 🌟 What awaits you: Checkers Racing: think through every maneuver, just like in the classic game! Deep tuning: lower the body, change the wheels, repaint the car or turn the "dorestyling" into a top sports car! Competitive mode: fight with players in multiplayer races and take a place in the TOP league! Earn and upgrade: unlock powerful cars, upgrade them and dominate the roads! Endless Drive: A survival mode where your goal is to drive as far as possible in the chaos of city traffic! Become the king of asphalt — download the game and prove that your driving style is invincible! 🚗💨
howToPlay: The goal of the race is to get as far along the highway as possible. Try not to crash into cars, so you can drive on. Also complete missions on the open map in parking mode and earn money. Spend the money you earn on improving your car and buying new cars. PC control: WASD/arrows - machine control Z - emergency QE- turn signals C - camera change Phone controls: On-screen buttons / on-screen steering wheel. The mode is switched in the game settings.

title: Ant Colony Idle
description: Ant Colony Idle is a relaxing incremental clicker game where you grow a tiny ant nest into a thriving underground colony. Tap the soil to find food, send workers to gather resources, and expand important chambers to boost your colony's income over time. Unlock new food slots, upgrade rooms like the Food Storage, Nursery, and Queen Chamber, and keep improving your colony with powerful upgrades, cosmetic skins, achievements, and prestige bonuses. Whether you play actively or let your ants keep working in the background, progress never stops. Start small, manage your nest wisely, and build the strongest ant colony possible.
howToPlay: Become the ruler of a growing ant colony! Tap the soil to discover food, then use that food to buy upgrades, unlock more workers, and expand your underground nest. As your colony grows, you can improve chambers, earn achievements, collect cosmetic skins, and use prestige to restart with strong bonuses for even faster progress. Desktop Controls: Mouse Left Click: Tap the soil to find food and interact with buttons. Mouse Left Click on upgrade cards: Buy upgrades. Mouse Left Click on tabs: Open Upgrades, Prestige, Skins, Achievements, and Settings. Mouse Wheel / Click and Drag: Scroll through the sidebar lists and menus. Mobile Controls: Tap the soil: Find food and interact with game buttons. Tap upgrade cards: Buy upgrades. Tap tabs: Open Upgrades, Prestige, Skins, Achievements, and Settings. Swipe the sidebar: Browse lists and menus.

title: Squid Game Tower Defense
description: Squid Game Tower Defense battle against Squid Game characters in the towers. Complete challenges, defeat enemies, and become the victor in this thrilling fight! Welcome to Squid Game Tower Defense — a unique and thrilling game where you will battle against characters from the famous Squid Game show. Unlike traditional Tower Defense games, your task here is not to defend towers but to attack and fight enemies that reside within them. Each tower is not just a structure; it's a place where dangerous characters are waiting for battle. You'll engage in a series of exciting fights, defeating enemies at every level and overcoming various challenges. The game features characters well-known to all fans of the show, each with its own unique abilities and characteristics. Complete levels, improve your combat skills, gather valuable resources, and unlock new opportunities for your battles. Make sure that your strategic abilities help you defeat even the toughest enemies standing in your way. Enjoy fast-paced combat, challenging missions, and an atmosphere that immerses you into the world of Squid Game.
howToPlay: Fight with the squid characters in the towers. Use your skills and strategy to defeat the enemies in each level. Overcome the challenges and become a winner! Drag and drop your character onto the desired enemy platform.

title: Block Bloom
description: Block Bloom is a colorful puzzle-shooter about smart timing and sharper planning. A conveyor belt carries a stream of colored blocks across the board. Below it sits your grid of shooters — each one loaded with a color and a limited number of shots. Tap a shooter to send it into a firing slot, and it will automatically blast every matching block that rolls past. The catch: you only have a handful of slots. Send in the wrong shooter and it sits there, clogging a slot with nothing to shoot. Fill every slot with dead weight and the board jams — game over. Clear the whole conveyor and the level is yours.
howToPlay: Watch the conveyor. Colored blocks ride the belt across the top of the board. Tap a shooter in the grid below. A shooter is only tappable when nothing is blocking it. It slides into a free slot and starts firing automatically at every block on the belt that matches its color. Mind your shot counter. Each shooter has limited ammo. When it runs dry, it disappears and frees its slot. Keep your slots healthy. Slots are limited — a shooter whose color isn't on the belt just sits there taking up space. Clear every block on the conveyor to win the level.

title: Tornado: Fury of the elements
description: In this game you take on the role of a tornado lord, who must wreak havoc and destruction in the city. Your task is to create powerful whirlwinds, destroy buildings and infrastructure, and avoid collisions with defenses and other obstacles. You will be able to improve your tornado control skills and destructive power to wreak havoc more effectively. “Tornado: Fury of the Element” is an exciting game that will make you feel like a real master of the elements. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games and simulators.

title: Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number , where the art of coloring meets the intrigue of puzzles. This free online game offers a delightful escape, combining the therapeutic joys of adult coloring with the challenge of matching stickers to solve intricate puzzles. Unleash your creativity and witness your imaginations come to life as you craft stunning masterpieces, one sticker at a time, on both your phone and computer .

The game offers a calming and relaxing atmosphere of colorful arts with sticker puzzle challenges. 🧘🌅 Compared to traditional coloring books, in the Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number, you will be provided with numerous gorgeous, intricate and cute stickers to complete the overall picture. Adult coloring has never been so much fun. Match the numbers of these adorable stickers and complete the whole coloring book. 🕵 This sticker book puzzle isn't just an ordinary coloring game. It contains brain-teasing puzzles, which you will need to solve to see a final result – a completed coloring book. 👁🔍 Click on the sticker picture at the bottom of the screen and drag it to the appropriate area of the picture to eventually see a complete picture. 🔰🖍 So what are you waiting for? Enjoy an exciting sticker book puzzle game. 🧩

title: Aquarium of Surprises
description: Aquarium of Surprises is a calm idle game about a small tank. Fish swim on their own and earn coins while you decide what to add next: 10 kinds of fish, 7 plants, 7 decorations and 11 upgrades, each with a clear effect. Events arrive quietly — coin bubbles, a drifting chest, glass to clean, or one of 6 rare visitors that joins a collection of 16 creatures. Pearls unlock special decorations and 4 aquarium themes. No timers, no pressure, no forced ads. All graphics are vector, the sound is synthesised in the browser, and the whole game is under 150 KB.
howToPlay: Watch the tank: every fish earns coins by itself, there is nothing to click. The top bar shows your coins, income per second, pearls and aquarium level. Open the Shop to spend coins. Tabs: Fish, Plants, Decor, Upgrades, Themes. Each extra fish of the same kind costs a little more; plants and decorations are bought once. Upgrades raise income, extend the offline reserve and make events more frequent — every card shows the current effect and the next level. Catch events when they appear: tap coin bubbles, spots on the glass and the drifting chest. A rare visitor must be touched before it swims away to join your collection. Tasks give three calm goals at a time and pay coins, sometimes a pearl. Controls: mouse or touch, no keyboard needed. Tapping the water nudges nearby fish aside, Esc closes dialogs. Survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score! 🎮 Controls: • MOUSE/TAP: Aim and shoot arrows • CLICK/TAP: Select upgrades in the shop • AUTOMATIC: Archers auto-attack nearby enemies 🏆 How to Win: 1. Eliminate all enemies in each wave 2. Earn gold from defeated monsters 3. Upgrade your archer's damage, speed, and abilities 4. Survive endless waves - the longer you last, the higher your score! Perfect for both casual players and tower defense fans!

title: Twisted Rope 3D
description: Rope Tangle Puzzle is a captivating mobile game for Android that challenges players to untangle ropes arranged in intricate configurations. This free-to-play puzzle game requires strategic thinking as players manipulate ropes without creating new knots. Using simple touch controls, players can select and move ropes to solve increasingly complex puzzles, all set against vibrant visuals and a user-friendly interface. Each level offers a fresh challenge, demanding critical thinking and quick problem-solving to untie the knots. Success relies on careful planning and precise rope arrangement, making the game a delightful mix of fun and mental exercise. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, Rope Tangle Puzzle delivers an engaging experience that puts your skills to the test.
howToPlay: Jump into Twisted wonderland and become a Tangle master with Twisted Rope 3D! 🪢 🎀Challenge yourself with this immersive tangle rope 3D puzzle game where untangle knots becomes an art. Twisted Rope 3D is designed to test your mental sharpness as you work through increasingly complex twisted tangle puzzles. Use precision and strategy to untie the most challenging knots 3D and become a true Tangle master.

title: Bottle Flip
description: Can you flip bottle and put it flat on the bottom? And on the neck? And if you need to throw it on a tiny platform? Test your skills, show precision and dexterity to toss the bottle and gently land it on the platform. Every movement matters: you have to control your hands, balance and calculate the trajectory so that the bottle fits perfectly on its target. Collect points for successful landings and unlock new levels full of exciting obstacles and unexpected turns. Luck and skill go hand in hand in this exciting precision game, where each level brings a new challenge and the opportunity to become a real bottle master!
howToPlay: Grab bottles and throw them on special platforms, completing challenges and gaining points. At each level there is a zone marked as "Win", when a bottle hits it, the level will be passed and access to a new one will open. Management: For the computer: Arrows - hand control Space bar - hold down the space bar and the character grabs the bottle, throws it when released. For a smartphone Arrow buttons - hand control A button with a hand - when pressed, the character grabs the bottle, when released, throws it

title: Hot Rods Arena Stars
description: Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive! Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents. Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast. Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind! Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory. Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!
howToPlay: Desktop: W, A, S, D — drive your car Mobile: Movement — use the left stick (up, down, left, right) Goal: Collect stars to outscore your rivals. Use your weapons wisely — blow up enemies, trap them, and don’t give them a chance to strike back. One mistake, and your car becomes scrap metal!

title: SCP-173: Foundation Escape
description: Step into the role of SCP-173 and break free from the Foundation’s control in a tense stealth experience built around a deadly rule: you can MOVE only when no one is LOOKING at you. Hide in the shadows, avoid patrols, and choose the perfect moment to dash through dark corridors where every mistake leads to capture. Plan your route carefully, use cover and darkness to your advantage, and upgrade stealth abilities to gain the upper hand over security forces. Every second matters: one glance freezes you in place, one wrong move triggers a relentless chase.
howToPlay: Controls: 🎮 Arrow keys — move your character around the game world 📱 Touch controls — tap anywhere on screen to move

title: World Flags Quiz
description: World Flags Quiz is a fast-paced, fun, and educational mobile game that challenges players to match countries with their correct flags. Designed with simplicity and clarity in mind, the game offers a single, highly addictive game mode that tests your geographical knowledge one country at a time. In each round, players are presented with the name of a country — such as France, Brazil, Japan, or Nigeria — and must choose the correct flag from a set of four options. Only one is right, and the other three are cleverly selected to test your attention to detail and flag recognition skills. Enjoy playing this flag quiz game here
howToPlay: use mouse to choose any answer! World Flags Quiz is a fast-paced, fun, and educational mobile game that challenges players to match countries with their correct flags. Designed with simplicity and clarity in mind, the game offers a single, highly addictive game mode that tests your geographical knowledge one country at a time. In each round, players are presented with the name of a country — such as France, Brazil, Japan, or Nigeria — and must choose the correct flag from a set of four options. Only one is right, and the other three are cleverly selected to test your attention to detail and flag recognition skills. Enjoy playing this flag quiz game here

title: Billiards 3D: Russian Pyramid
description: Play a realistic online billiards game against virtual opponents of varying difficulty. Customize AI skill levels to match your ability and improve your game. Enjoy lifelike tables of different sizes and refine your strategy in this immersive billiards experience!
howToPlay: - For aiming click anywhere on the table and rotate the cue - For precise aiming, turn the precision aim wheel on the right side of the screen, or aim the cue while holding down the Shift button if you play on PC - To hit, click on the cue on the left side of the screen and pull towards the desired force of the blow, then release - For screws, click on the ball icon with a dot in the upper right part of the screen, move the impact point and confirm the installation of the point by clicking on the green button. If you're playing on a PC, you can hold down the X button on your keyboard while aiming to move the point of impact - To change the inclination of the cue, click on the cue ball icon at the top of the screen. In this mode, tap anywhere on the screen and raise the cue to the desired angle, then confirm the change by pressing the green button. If you play on a computer, you can hold down the Z button while aiming, this will also change the tilt of the cue.

title: Puzzle Parents: Baby's Path Home
description: «Puzzle Parents: Baby's Path Home» is a fun puzzle game with unique characters (nubik, haggy waggie, kisi misi, rainbow friends) who will help you win. Draw smart to find the fastest way home with your little one! At each level, players will face a unique puzzle filled with winding paths, obstacles and rewards. The main goal is to ensure that the child returns home safely using logic, problem-solving skills and a little creativity. However, it is not as easy as it seems! 👶 Game Features: 🌈 Bright and whimsical graphics; 🐣 Very cute and interesting characters; 🍃 Refreshing sensations; 🧠 The perfect way to refresh your mind after a day’s work. Optional mode: In the additional mode, you have to find and give your favorite toy to the baby!
howToPlay: 1. Click on the character to start drawing lines; 2. Draw a line to the kid, but avoid obstacles 3. Make sure all Sims get to their babies safely and back home with them.

title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
description: Dudes, this is a very short strategic card battle game that blends tactical gameplay with quirky humor and vibrant creativity. Build powerful armies, summon creatures, cast spells, and construct buildings across unique terrains in epic turn-based battles. What sets this game apart is its dynamic terrain system—each battlefield zone corresponds to specific card types, favoring attackers, healers, defenders, or versatile "special units" that can be placed anywhere! With customizable decks and deep strategic options, players must outwit their opponents to claim victory. Unlock new cards, upgrade your favorites heroes, and dominate the battlefield in this thrilling clash of wits and strategy. Let's go. In and out. After all, this is Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure!
howToPlay: • Deck Building: Before starting a match, create your deck using cards you’ve collected. Customize your deck based on strategy—focus on attack-heavy units, healing abilities, or powerful spells. • Terrain Zones: At the start of the game, choose which terrains to place on your side of the board. Each terrain type allows only certain creatures to be summoned there, except Rainbow Creatures, which are flexible. Terrain types: - Cornfields: Strong attackers. - Sandlands: Defensive powerhouses. - Blue Plains: Balanced but unpredictable. - Candy Kingdom: Weak but great at healing allies. - Useless Swamp: Special ability users or direct-damage dealers. • Turn-Based Mechanics: On your turn, draw cards, spend resources (Magic Points), and deploy creatures, buildings, or spells onto the field. Attack enemy creatures or target their towers directly when possible. • Winning Conditions: Outlast your opponent by maintaining stronger forces, controlling key areas, and dealing consistent damage.

title: Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines
description: Discover the exciting world of Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines, where online arcade fun meets thrilling challenges. Engage in various mini-games, collect tickets for rare pets, and unlock new machines. Spin the Wheel of Fortune for prizes and explore unique machines for exclusive rewards. Start your gaming adventure now!
howToPlay: In this game, you’ll explore various arcade machines, each offering mini-games and challenges. Complete the challenges to earn tickets, which can be exchanged for rare pets or to unlock new machines. Spin the Wheel of Fortune for extra rewards and search for hidden secret machines to discover exclusive prizes. PC Controls: Movement: W/A/S/D Jump: Space Camera Rotation: Mouse Toggle Mouse Control: Tab (hide/show cursor) Mobile Controls: Movement: Virtual joystick (bottom left) Jump: Button (bottom right)

title: Big Wild Bucks: Voxel Buck Hunter
description: A fast first-person voxel hunting game. Raise your rifle, line up the shot, and take down trophy bucks across changing treks — from pine valleys to ember woods, murky hollows, and frozen basins. Shoot a doe and you’re busted, so aim true. Upgrade rifles and ammo, collect rare coats, fill your trophy room, and chase higher scores with combos, critter bonuses, and bird rounds. Scope in, hold steady, and bring home the bucks.
howToPlay: How to Play Bag is a first-person hunt against the clock. Bag enough bucks to clear each trek — if you shoot a doe, you’re busted. Desktop Move mouse to aim (cursor locks in-game) Left click / Space — shoot Right click / Shift — hold to scope R — reload Esc / P — pause · M — mute Mobile Drag to aim · tap to shoot Hold scope button to zoom · reload button to chamber shells Tips Bucks score cash and trophies; does end the run Combos, distant shots, and big racks pay more Critters are bonus points (no penalty) Spend cash in the shop on better rifles and ammo Clear treks to unlock new biomes and rare coats

title: Puppetman: Ragdoll Puzzle
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Puppetman: Ragdoll Puzzle, an engaging game that tests your cleverness and quick reactions. Navigate Poly through challenging levels with clever tactics to avoid crashes. With 15 progressively difficult stages, it offers an exciting challenge, whether on mobile or desktop.
howToPlay: Keyboard: Control is carried out by pressing keys A, S, D . Mobile: Control is carried out by pressing buttons on the screen.

title: Eating Simulator The Italian Animals Brainrot
description: Eating Simulator The Italian Animals Brainrot A fun physics puzzle game: feed hungry animals from Italian memes by using gravity, logic, and creativity! Is a one-of-a-kind physics puzzle game where your mission is to feed adorable and funny animals inspired by Italian memes. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity: manipulate objects, control gravity, and build action chains to deliver food straight into the paws or beaks of quirky creatures. The game offers dozens of levels with increasing difficulty, hilarious scenarios, surprising solutions, and signature humor. Attention to detail and precision will be the key to success, while your reward will be the grateful looks of happy, well-fed animals. Dive into a world of carefree fun, where physics is your main tool for playful experiments, and every completed level brings fresh emotions. Test your skills and prove that you can feed every Brainrot animal!
howToPlay: Drag, tap, and build paths! Use blocks and physics to guide food to the animals. Watch out for traps, experiment, and find creative solutions. The goal is simple: make the creatures happy!

title: JUICE TYCOON
description: A relaxing and addictive arcade-idle game where you build your own juice empire! Harvest fresh fruits, blend them into delicious drinks, and serve thirsty customers. Hire staff, upgrade your machines, and expand your business until you become the ultimate Juice Tycoon!
howToPlay: Objective: Harvest fruits, process them into juice, and sell them to earn money. Reinvest your profits to unlock new fruit types, faster machines, and helpful staff! Controls: • On Desktop: Use WASD, Arrow Keys, or click and drag the mouse to move. • On Mobile: Touch and drag anywhere on the screen to use the virtual joystick. • To interact with objects (harvesting, blending, cashing out), simply walk into their glowing green areas!

title: Camel Destroyer
description: A camel has appeared in the city and is looking for adventures! In the game, you will have to help the camel find animals, chat with people, and explore the city. Look for hidden machines, guns, cannons, and grenades to destroy buildings and create chaos. Drive cars, operate a helicopter, and even saddle a turtle or a cow for unforgettable adventures. Ready for crazy antics and unpredictable situations? Then join the camel on its exciting journey around the city!
howToPlay: Desktop Move: WASD Jump: Space bar Attack: F Shoot a weapon: F Acceleration: Shift Pick up an item: E Mobile Joystick + pop-up buttons

title: Club Guard
description: Club Guard is a simulation game where you take on the role of a nightclub security guard. Your task is to check visitors at the entrance, find prohibited items (weapons, alcohol and other contraband items) and decide who to allow to enter and who to deny entry. The game is characterized by unusual humor, absurd situations and freedom of action: you can search people, take away their belongings, use force or even beat them if you decide that they violate the rules. Game Features: Interactive gameplay : Check pockets, bags and clothes of visitors to find hidden items. Absurd humor : Each visitor is unique, with unusual dialogues and behaviors. Freedom of action : You can be strict, fair or even ruthless - it's all up to you. Variety of situations : From fights to strange requests, every day at the club is unpredictable. Simple graphics : Minimalistic style and intuitive controls make the game accessible to everyone.
howToPlay: Imagine that you find yourself in the role of a nightclub security guard. Your task is to keep order, check visitors at the entrance and maintain the atmosphere of fun, without forgetting your power and responsibility. You have complete freedom of action: you decide who to let in, who to expel, and who to warn. You can also use a huge arsenal of weapons!

title: Crazy Flying Car
description: Control a car with wings, make dangerous flights over the abyss and overtake your rivals! You need to get to the finish line first. To do this, you can simply drive along the track, pushing your opponents, or take a risk and fly off the track, going into flight in the hope of shortening the path by air. To take a risk or to rely on maneuvers - it's up to you! Play and fly right now!
howToPlay: On PC: A/D and tapes on keyboard - installation of the machine in/out On phones: Application of the mobile phone in/out to the screen Goal: To finish

title: Guardians of Tower
description: Guardians of Tower Defend your castle in a fast-paced strategy battle! Deploy brave soldiers, powerful towers, and devastating weapons to stop waves of enemies. Earn coins from every victory, upgrade your army and defenses, and keep sending reinforcements until the enemy fortress falls. Every upgrade makes your forces stronger, so choose your strategy wisely and claim victory!
howToPlay: Controls 🖱️ Mouse Only Left Click – Deploy soldiers, build or upgrade towers, and use abilities. Interact with the on-screen buttons to manage your army and defeat the enemy.

title: Onet Animals
description: Onet Animals is a charming puzzle game that involves matching similar animal tiles. Completing pairs allows you to finish levels. With its engaging challenge and adorable visuals, this game is fun for players of every age.
howToPlay: Onet Animals is a charming puzzle game that involves matching similar animal tiles. Completing pairs allows you to finish levels. With its engaging challenge and adorable visuals, this game is fun for players of every age.

title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
description: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is an action-packed arcade game where players take on the role of a skilled ninja on a stealth mission through treacherous bamboo forests. As the Bamboo Assassin, you must navigate through challenging levels filled with enemies, obstacles, and traps. Employ your stealth, agility, and precision to outmaneuver adversaries and eliminate targets silently. The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, strategic planning, and quick reflexes, offering an immersive experience that tests both your skills and timing. With its sleek design and captivating gameplay, Ninja: Bamboo Assassin delivers a thrilling adventure for fans of ninja-themed games.
howToPlay: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is an action-packed arcade game where players take on the role of a skilled ninja on a stealth mission through treacherous bamboo forests. As the Bamboo Assassin, you must navigate through challenging levels filled with enemies, obstacles, and traps. Employ your stealth, agility, and precision to outmaneuver adversaries and eliminate targets silently. The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, strategic planning, and quick reflexes, offering an immersive experience that tests both your skills and timing. With its sleek design and captivating gameplay, Ninja: Bamboo Assassin delivers a thrilling adventure for fans of ninja-themed games.

title: Fruit Madness
description: A delightful fruit puzzle where adorable kawaii fruits merge in the chase for juicy high scores! 🍉 The rules are simple and familiar: when two identical fruits touch, they combine into a new, even tastier one! 🍋🍇 Use unique boosters — level up your fruits, shrink them down, or clear whole clusters from the board! Don’t save your boosters for later: at the start of each round, you get 4 unique ones, plus another random booster for every 500 points you earn. The longer you play, the more fun and fruity combos await! 🍊
howToPlay: 1. Aim your fruit — with your finger or mouse! 🍎 2. Got your target? Perfect! 3. Release — and let the fruit drop right into the party! 🎉 If things get tricky, don’t hesitate to use a booster — it’s always there to help! 🍉

title: Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!
description: ⚔️ Welcome to "Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!" - a fun 3D physics arena where ragdoll opponents fight in funny fights! Push, throw and knock enemies off the platform to be the only one left standing. This battle royale is a real epic action with falls, collisions and pushes! 🔥 Inspired by the popular hits "Epic Sword Fight! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!" and "Balance Duel: Physics Action", this game combines simple mechanics, playground dynamics, and a lot of fun! ♥️ Don't forget to leave a review and share your impressions to help us improve the game! Game features: - Beautiful and pleasant 3D graphics - Simple one-finger control - Fun short levels in the style of shorts and reels - Funny ragdoll physics - Online leaderboard - The game is available online for free on PC and mobile devices 🎯 Become a legend of the ragdoll arena - throw off all enemies and become a winner!
howToPlay: 🕹️Controls: - 💻 On PC: Move the mouse while holding the left button to move the character. - 📱 On mobile devices: Use the virtual joystick - just move your finger across the screen to move. 🎯Game Objective: Push all the ragdoll opponents off the arena and be the last fighter standing in this fun battle royale! 🔥 Tip: Stay away from the edges and always keep an eye on your opponent to avoid being thrown into the abyss.

title: Rune Reactor
description: Rune Reactor is a spell-building auto-battler where every rune changes your magic. Draft elemental and modifier runes, combine them into powerful spells, and survive increasingly dangerous enemy waves. Collect gold and Arcane Dust, discover rare combinations, defeat bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades for future runs.
howToPlay: - Select runes to build and improve your spells. - Your wizard automatically attacks nearby enemies. - Click dropped gold and Arcane Dust before they disappear. - Use gold between waves to buy health, runes, and upgrades. - Combine elemental runes with modifiers to discover new spells. - Defeat bosses and survive as many waves as possible. - Spend Arcane Dust on permanent upgrades after a run. - Use the bonus wheel when it becomes available.

title: Zombie Merge
description: A top-down survival duel. You’re pinned at the center of the arena while a horde of zombies pours in from the edges. Your rival survivor is doing the same on their side of the match — you’re racing to outscore them before the 90-second clock runs out. The twist is the merge mechanic: killing a zombie doesn’t always remove it from the field. Below max tier, it fuses into another zombie of the same type, upgrading it into something bigger, slower, tankier, and worth more points. Only the top-tier Colossus (Lv 5) dies for good. The better you play, the more dangerous the horde becomes — but also the more points you can farm.
howToPlay: How to Play Goal Score more points than your rival before time runs out. If your health hits zero, you’re eaten — the rival keeps scoring until the clock ends, and ties go to them. Controls You stay fixed in the center — you don’t move around the map. Your gun auto-fires at zombies inside its forward fire cone (~94° arc). Click/touch and drag anywhere on screen to swing the gun and aim manually. Release to return to auto-aim. Zombies behind you are outside your gun’s cone — they won’t get shot unless you turn toward them, but they can still bite you.

title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
description: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action game where you take to the skies on a broom, engaging in battles against hordes of enemies! Collect experience points from defeated foes – experience that will help you level up and grow stronger. Explore new spells and evolve the ones you've unlocked to defeat enemies even faster. Face a variety of different enemy types and challenging bosses attempting to halt your progress. Accumulate coins to unlock new, faster, and more agile brooms. Don't forget to upgrade your brooms to achieve maximum power. Combine different magical spells, each associated with its own element, and find your winning strategy! Two distinct game modes are at your disposal: a leveled game mode where you can train, explore new enemies, and, most importantly, conquer bosses; and an endless mode for those seeking to challenge themselves against wave after wave of monsters. Either way, good luck in battle – you'll need it!
howToPlay: PC Controls WASD or Arrows = movement Space = broom leap / rush Z = choose to take the first spell X = choose to take the second spell C = choose to take the third spell Mobile Controls Joystick = movement Rush Button = leap/ rush

title: Survival Island
description: Survival Island is an exciting survival simulator set on a tropical island! Explore the island, gather resources, collect wood and stone, build shelters, and upgrade your character. Your survival depends entirely on your skills! Craft tools, unlock new opportunities, expand your territory, and turn the wild island into your own base. But be careful — resources are limited, and you must constantly improve to survive. Game Features: * Resource gathering * Building and crafting * Character upgrades * Island exploration * Survival adventure atmosphere * Simple and fun controls Can you survive on the island and build your own paradise?
howToPlay: How to Play * Use the controls to move around the island * Collect wood, stone, and other resources * Build structures and craft useful items * Upgrade your tools and character abilities * Explore new areas and expand your base * Manage your resources and keep surviving!

title: Trial Xtreme
description: Trial Xtreme is a thrilling motorcycle racing game that puts your balance, precision, and endurance to the test. Ride through challenging obstacle-filled tracks packed with ramps, pipes, rocks, and tricky barriers where every move can lead to victory or a crash. This is not just a race to the finish — it is a skill-based challenge where speed and control matter equally. Complete tracks, improve your time, and collect stars to unlock new levels.
howToPlay: Ride your motorcycle from start to finish while overcoming difficult obstacles along the track. Use the controls to accelerate, brake, and balance your bike carefully to avoid falling. Try to finish each level as fast as possible and collect as many stars as you can during the run. The more stars you earn, the more new tracks you unlock. To win, you need both quick reflexes and strong control skills.

title: Fix The Hoof
description: Dive into the calming experience of Fix The Hoof, a free online game where you care for the hooves of different animals like horses and goats. Enjoy a captivating 3D environment while earning money to improve your farm. Accessible on both mobile and desktop, it's perfect for relaxation.
howToPlay: Who doesn't like the ASMR feel in cleaning and fixing hoof of a horse, cow, goat etc. This is the most satisfying ASMR 3d game for cleaning, polishing and painting hooves. You've seen it in the ASMR videos and now you get to do it yourself in this oddly satisfying game!

title: The long way home
description: Your ship is gone. You are a very long way from Earth, with a suit, a tank of fuel, and the air in your lungs. The Long Way Home is a game about thrust being precious and drift being free. Every burn spends fuel you may never replace, so the fastest route is rarely the straight one. Swing past a planet and let its gravity throw you onward for nothing, and keep the fuel for the moment you actually need it. Between you and home: abandoned supply stations, each holding one decisive resupply. Sealed containers you can crack open if you have the patience. Debris fields that will shred you at speed and let you pass at a crawl. VESTA, the assistance unit strapped to your chest, talks you through it. She is a machine and says so, and she will tell you when your heading is wrong. Get to Earth before the oxygen runs out. Then do it again, carrying cargo.
howToPlay: Everything is also an on-screen button, so it plays with a mouse, a keyboard or a touchscreen. DRAG anywhere to look around and aim. ENGINE or SPACE burns the main thruster — short taps, fuel is finite. STOP or X flips you around and burns retrograde; it is the only way to slow down out here. DRIFT or Z lays you flat along your heading, which streamlines you and lets you sidestep rock. ION DRIVE or V is a weak electric thrust that runs on battery instead of fuel. SCAN or F lights up nearby supplies and charts debris fields onto your map. REPAIR or T patches the suit. TAB, or a tap on the small map, opens the planning map — pick a destination there and your scanner becomes a compass. The AIM ONLY / HOLD = THRUST switch changes whether dragging also fires the engine.

title: Zombies ate my Castle
description: Zombies Ate My Castle is a tower defense game where you command an army of zombies to protect your fortress. Strategically deploy your undead allies, summon zombie carriers to revive fallen foes, and unleash powerful spells to turn the tide in battle. Collect coins from victories to upgrade your skills and boost your army. Can you save the zombie princess?
howToPlay: Recruit zombies, collect fallen enemies for resources, and defend your castle from every wave of attackers. Controls: Use the mouse or touchscreen to select units and press buttons.

title: Passenger City Taxi Game
description: Welcome to the city taxi driver simulator game, the ultimate driving experience where you become the most reliable and skilled taxi driver in the city. Navigate busy streets, pick up passengers and drop them off safely at their destinations. Every ride is a new challenge that will test your driving skills and city navigation abilities. Get powerful taxis and complete exciting missions and earn rewards for exceptional service.
howToPlay: W / Arrow Up → Move Front S / Arrow Down → Move Back A / Arrow Left → Move Left D / Arrow Right → Move Right - To click any button use mouse

title: Fun fishing
description: Welcome to Fun Fishing — a fun and addictive fishing game about catching fish, upgrading your gear, and selling your catch! Catch rare fish, sell your haul, upgrade your fishing rods, and explore different locations. 🌊 What awaits you: 🎣 Simple and enjoyable fishing 🐟 Many types of fish — from common to rare 💵 Sell fish and earn money 🚤 Boats and new areas to explore ⬆️ Gear upgrades and progression 😄 Relaxing yet addictive atmosphere
howToPlay: PC: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, Left Mouse Button (LMB) to interact, and E to interact with objects. Mobile: Use the left side of the screen to move with the joystick, and the right side of the screen to rotate the camera

title: Toco Teens Halloween Party
description: Step into the spooky fun world of Toca Teens Halloween Party, a fashionable Halloween dress-up game made just for style lovers! 🎃 Join the Toca teens as they get ready for the most glamorous Halloween event of the year. Choose from eerie yet elegant outfits, haunting accessories, and bold makeup looks to create the perfect spooky-chic style. Mix and match trendy costumes, experiment with hairstyles, and make each teen stand out on the dance floor. Whether you want a gothic witch, a cute pumpkin fairy, or a vampire diva — the possibilities are endless!
howToPlay: Desktop: Left Mouse Button Click to select the outifts and accessories Mobile: Tap to select the outifts and accessories

title: Build a Road
description: Build your Obby! How big can you make it? 🏗️🔥 • Buy blocks, walls, ramps, lava, and more to BUILD your obby! 🧱✨ • Play your obby to EARN money! 💰🎮 • Upgrade your plot to build EVEN BIGGER obbies! 📈🏢
howToPlay: Just move with WASD or use the joystick on your phone 🎮 And use your mouse or tap the button to interact with objects on the map! 🗺️✨

title: Block Blast Mania
description: In Block Blast Mania , your mission is simple: try to place colorful blocks of various shapes on the game board in such a way that complete rows are formed. A fully filled row or column without any gaps will disappear from the board, making room for new blocks. The more rows you destroy at once, the more points you'll earn. There are two game modes. In the classic mode, the game will continue until there’s no space left on the board to place one of the three shapes. In the level-based mode, you need to complete objectives such as collecting pigs. Boosters help you get through the levels.
howToPlay: Drag the block from the bottom to the grid to place it. You can't rotate the blocks, but you can place them in any place or order that you want. Fill the colums or rows to destroy them and get points

title: Blocks and Car
description: Blocks and Car is a fun and casual puzzle game that combines Tetris-style block mechanics with passenger matching gameplay. Different shaped blocks appear on the board, and you clear them just like in classic Tetris. Once blocks are removed, passengers of matching colors are generated and move to the waiting area. Your goal is to guide them to the correct
howToPlay: Tap or swipe to place and move blocks Clear blocks in a Tetris-style system Match passengers with the correct buses Plan your moves to avoid overcrowding

title: Parkour World
description: Welcome to Parkour World, an exhilarating Minecraft-inspired parkour game with thrilling challenges and delightful gameplay. -Each level in this game boasts its own distinct and features, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play. -While the initial levels may seem relatively simple, as you progress through the game. By the time you conquer the first ten levels, you'll find yourself facing increasingly demanding obstacles. -Get ready to run, and conquer in Parkour World!

Clue Examples 0: None of the neighboring cells are blue. 6: All six neighboring cells are blue. 3: Exactly three neighboring cells are blue.
