Bring a weapon to level 5 and pick the right tome — and you'll unlock a powerful evolution! Smash pots and chests for loot, activate shrines for temporary buffs. Defeat mini-bosses and the final boss before time runs out — otherwise the Final Storm begins! Earn silver and upgrade your heroes in the shop between runs. Complete quests and challenges for unique rewards.

title: Knock and Run. 100 Doors Escape
description: Become the fastest and most daring stickman in this fun arcade game! Your goal is to race through the corridors of the hotel, ring the doors, knock and slam them, arranging epic pranks. The main thing is not to get caught! Residents' reactions are unpredictable, and danger can lurk around every corner. - Dynamic gameplay — run, prank and avoid capture! - Different doors and reactions — someone will get scared, someone will get angry! - Fun challenges — show agility and speed! - Bright minimalistic style is a classic stickman action game! - Simple controls — addictive gameplay in a couple of clicks!
howToPlay: Control your character through touch, cursor or WASD to move and always run! Run to the end of the level to win this game!

title: Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker
description: Join Sigma Boy in a beat-driven journey through diverse landscapes from deserts to space in this free online clicker game. Each tap earns points for upgrades, enhancing his skills as you tackle various challenges across devices. Embrace the rhythm and guide Sigma Boy to success!
howToPlay: To get started with Fennec The Fox: Clicker Adventure, simply tap on Fennec the Fox to earn points. Use these points to purchase upgrades that boost Fennec’s abilities. As Fennec evolves, he will move from the desert to new, more advanced environments, eventually embarking on a cosmic journey. Each level presents unique challenges, so keep clicking, upgrading, and evolving to help Fennec conquer them all.

title: Roots and Wheels
description: This exciting simulator presents you with an ambitious task: get behind the wheel of a powerful truck and transport as many crates as possible through dangerous and unpredictable locations to your destination. Success depends on your skill—your ability to feel the vehicle and react to road conditions—and your wits—your ability to find the best solutions in difficult situations, whether it's mud, steep climbs, or destroyed bridges. Every box delivered brings you closer to your reward. By earning money for completed trips, you get the opportunity to upgrade your truck – from the engine to the suspension to the wheels – and better equip it for the challenges of the terrain. You can also buy new vehicle models, expanding your options and gaining access to new types of missions and cargo. Show what a real driver can do! Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
howToPlay: Get behind the wheel of the powerful military Ural in this exciting simulation game! The driver of the military Ural challenges you not just to drive, but to deliver valuable cargo skillfully. Your task is to drive through complex tracks and bring to the finish line as many boxes as possible, using your agility to maneuver and wit to find the best solutions in difficult situations off-road. The controls are intuitive, whether you're playing on your phone or computer. On mobile devices you control the movement with touch pedals: right - forward, left - backward. On the computer you use the keys: D for forward and A for backward. Earn money. Invest it in improvements for your machines. Or save up to buy new cars - each with its own unique capabilities, ready for the most extreme tests. Expand your fleet, improve your skills and become the best off-road driver!

title: Bubble Boom
description: A classic bubble shooter where you’ll need to show your skills! Aim, shoot, and pop bubbles through colorful levels filled with fun challenges and relaxing gameplay.
howToPlay: To pop the bubbles, shoot groups of 3 or more bubbles of the same color. But you should hurry up! The level gradually descends and if it reaches the bottom line, then you will lose. IGB by Playgama

title: Girl Hair Salon & Dress Up
description: In the game Hair and Beauty, you can experiment with the latest trends in hairdressing and fashion: 💇‍♀️ **Create stunning looks** Offer your clients a variety of hairstyles, from trendy cuts to elegant updos. 🎨 **Express yourself with makeup** Choose from a wide range of makeup products and styles to complete your clients' looks. 👗 **Dress to impress** Select from hundreds of outfits and accessories to help your clients look their best. 💎 **Unlock new possibilities** Earn rewards as you progress through the game and expand your salon's offerings. 📸 **Capture the moment** Take photos of your clients before and after their transformations to share with your friends and the world!
howToPlay: Girl Hair Salon & Dress Up is a game where you can: - Use your creativity in hairstyling – offer your clients a variety of options, from trendy cuts to vibrant colors and elegant updos; - Experiment with makeup and choose fabulous outfits – turn your clients into real fashion icons; - Get rewards like stickers for your progress – unlock new opportunities for your hair salon and improve your skills as a stylist; - Take photos of your best works – share your masterpieces with friends and other players.

title: Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon
description: Embark on a journey to build your own empire in Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon, an engaging online economic simulator that combines elements of resource crafting, empire development, and clicker gameplay. As the ruler of a thriving island, your mission is to explore every corner, uncover precious resources, and craft them into valuable goods. By hiring managers and traders, you can automate tasks and maximize profits, ensuring your empire's success both on the phone and on the computer. Upgrade your factories, fulfill production orders, and let your empire shine in this captivating free game.
howToPlay: Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon is an economic simulator, time-killer, combining elements of empire development, resource crafting, and clicker gameplay. You play as a ruler tasked to explore the island, sending expeditions to discover new resources and crafting them. Hire managers and traders to handle the daily tasks and bring additional profits to your empire. Upgrade factories with resources and maintain a balance of production for finished goods. Fulfill production orders and earn valuable rewards. Explore the island and uncover all the resources needed to make your empire so great that everyone in this fantastic world will know about it! • Go through the introductory training, which will explain how the production of goods works, how new regions of the island are opened, and how the process of exploring and discovering new resources works. • To earn money, produce resources at factories. After production is completed, the finished product can be sold. Improve factories, produce more goods, and earn more profit. • You need to equip and send expeditions (invest the necessary resources and goods) to open up new regions of the island. • To discover new resources, go to the research…

title: Froggy Hop
description: Froggy Hop is a fun and addictive arcade platformer where you launch your frog into the sky! Bounce off lily pads, spring pads, turtles, whales, dodge tricky traps, and collect coins and gems as you go. Upgrade your frog’s abilities to jump higher, bounce farther, and unlock cool new skins. How far can you hop?
howToPlay: Click at the right time to bounce over lily pads, turtles, spring pads and dodge obstacles by bouncing over them. Desktop Controls: Use the left mouse button to launch the frog. Mobile Controls: Tap on the screen to launch and bounce the frog.

title: Racing: Destruction and Chase
description: Dive into a world where every crash is a masterpiece! - Realistic Destruction: Flying doors, hoods, wheels, and sparks under your feet. - Freedom of Action: Race, evade the police, or explore the open world at your own pace. - Unlimited Tuning: Customize paint jobs, wheel sizes, suspension height, and create your unique style. - Destruction Tools: Use presses, hammers, ramps to test vehicle durability. Key Features: - Dynamic police chases with realistic physics. - AI-driven bots that populate the game world. - Instant car repair for non-stop action. Each collision tells a new story. Every ride is your choice!
howToPlay: Controls: WASD - movement Space - handbrake Shift - acceleration (nitro) C - camera angle R - flip the car K - repair B - slow motion Tab - pause On the phone, using the buttons on the screen.

title: Water Sort Master: Color Puzzle
description: Dive into a vibrant world of colorful liquids and brain-teasing puzzles! Pour, sort, and match colors across hundreds of challenging levels designed to test your logic and strategy. Every move counts as you untangle mixed liquids, unlock new challenges, and sharpen your problem-solving skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Water Sort Master delivers a relaxing yet addictive puzzle experience for players of all ages. Can you sort every bottle and become the ultimate Water Sort Master?
howToPlay: Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the water. You can only pour water onto the same color or into an empty bottle. Keep sorting until each bottle contains only one color. Plan your moves carefully and solve every puzzle!

title: Ancient Dragons Princess
description: Enter the magical realm of the Dragon Princess, Rennie, where elegance is paramount. Adorn her in lavish outfits, from velvet gowns to outfits suited for dragon riding. Customize a unique dragon for her, style her hair, add exquisite jewelry, and join Rennie on an extraordinary journey.
howToPlay: Choose outfits for the characters by tapping on them and save the photos to your device!jewelry will also impress you. Go on an adventure with the Dragon Princess!

title: DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater
description: Get ready to deck the halls with festive creativity in DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater! Join three BFFs as they design their unique ugly Christmas sweaters for an epic holiday party. Choose sweater colors and decorate them with Christmas trees, reindeer, snowmen, globes, lights, bows, and more! Complete their holiday looks with new hairstyles and festive accessories. Show off your holiday spirit and create the ultimate cozy, ugly sweater masterpiece in this fun and festive game!
howToPlay: 1. Click or tap to select sweater colors for each girl 2. Choose from a variety of Christmas decorations and place them on the sweaters 3. Mix and match patterns, icons, and details for a truly ugly look 4. Style each BFF with festive hairstyles and accessories 5. Enjoy your finished sweaters and admire your holiday creations Simple controls make it easy to play on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Ultimate Brainrot Battle
description: Chaotic fights, insane upgrades, pure Italian Brainrot. Enter the madness of Ultimate Brainrot Battle, where Italian brainrot characters throw hands in explosive, fast-paced combat. Play as Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, or Cappuccino Assassino, each bringing their own chaotic playstyle and uniqe abilities. Fight. Upgrade. Repeat. Become the strongest brainrot ever!
howToPlay: Fight your way through four powerful bosses to become the ultimate Brainrot. After each battle, you earn gold based on your performance. Spend your gold to upgrade your character’s skills and abilities and grow stronger with every fight. Unlock new characters as you progress through the game, each bringing unique abilities and playstyles to master. Desktop: Hotkeys for the skills are 1 2 3 4 5 6 by default but you can change it to Q W E R T Y or A Z E R T Y in the settings.

title: Masterpiece Unharmed
description: Masterpiece Unharmed a game about the restoration of paintings. Match the colors, finish the damage and inspector to the end of the timer and save the museum! A night out, a closed museum, and a collection of famous paintings that someone managed to ruin right before the inspector arrived. In the game "Masterpiece Unharmed" you have to hide the traces of the most ridiculous incidents and convince the inspector that everything is fine with the art. Examine the damage, select the appropriate color with a pipette or palette, adjust the thickness of the brush and carefully restore the lost fragment. If you make a mistake, use an eraser or cancel the stroke. Scale and move the canvas to get to the small details, but keep an eye on the timer: the inspector is already on his way. Before each painting you will find a new funny story, and after work — a comparison with the original, highlighting errors and the caustic verdict of the inspector. With each level, the gaps become more difficult, there is less time, and the accident plots become more absurd.
howToPlay: Inspect the damaged area and select a brush. Change its size with the slider, select the color with a pipette or through the palette and fill in the gap area. The eraser removes unsuccessful strokes. The mouse wheel or side slider changes the scale, and dragging moves the canvas. Have time to click "Check" before the timer ends.

title: Survival Sandbox for 99 Nights
description: Four children have gone missing in the forest. You have 99 nights to find them before the woods claim them forever. 🔦 Life-Risking Search: Explore a vast, living forest that changes with every sunset. The children are scattered across different, most dangerous zones of the forest. You must find and lead each one to safety. ⚔️ Survival and Defense: Gather weapons, avoid traps, and seek shelter. Fend off packs of hungry wolves, rogue bears, and other dangers. Manage your basic needs: health and hunger. 🦌 The Main Antagonist — The Deer: The Deer guards the forest's secrets and considers the children its property. It cannot be killed with ordinary weapons. You can only drive it away, deceive it, or temporarily restrain it. 🌙 The Day-Night Cycle — Key to Survival: Day: A relatively safe time for exploration, gathering resources, and crafting. Night: Time of the hunt. Darkness awakens the forest's horrors. It is at night that you will encounter the Deer.
howToPlay: ✅ How to Play: ✅ ❗️ For Computer ➡️ Movement - WASD or arrow keys. ➡️ Jump - Spacebar. ➡️ Sprint - Shift. ➡️ Use abilities - I and U. ❗️ For Phone ➡️ Movement – move your finger on the left joystick. ➡️ Camera rotation – drag your finger on the screen. ➡️ Jump – tap the button with the person icon. ➡️ Use abilities – tap the two buttons to the right of the jump button.

title: Color Hole
description: Color Hole is a fun casual game where you control a hole that sucks in objects. Your task is to guide the hole to eat all the white objects while avoiding the colorful ones. As you progress through the levels, the game gets more challenging with more complex obstacles to avoid. Use your strategy and quick reflexes to become the ultimate Color Hole master!
howToPlay: Move the hole by swiping across the screen. Eat all the white objects, avoiding objects of other colors!

title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
description: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat is a fun meme game where you need to break bricks, collect power-ups for more fun breaking bricks, and watch Chipy Chipy Chipa Cat and El Primo Bara Bere dancing. Go through interesting and exciting levels in the fun game about Chippy Chippy Chippy Chappa Chappa Cat and El Primo. Pass levels of different difficulty and set a personal record. Play the Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat game at now and have fun.
howToPlay: Control the bottom area and hit the balls into the green blocks. Once all the green blocks are destroyed, the level will be completed. Collect falling bonuses in order to increase the number of balls and gain extra life.

title: Music Note
description: Play as a music note jumping across platforms. Spread color with each bounce and bring life to a black-and-white world.
howToPlay: Click on the screen or press Space to jump, and reach the end part (Piano) to win. Press R to restart

title: Dancing Road
description: Dancing Road is a fast-paced rhythm runner where you guide a glowing ball along a neon track and match balls of the same color to the beat. Dodge mismatched colors, react to color-changing gates, collect rewards, and master multiple music tracks. Simple one-touch controls, vivid cosmic roads, and music-synced challenges make every run easy to start and hard to perfect.
howToPlay: Hold the left mouse button and drag left or right on desktop, or touch and drag on mobile. Guide your ball into balls of the same color and avoid balls of other colors. Color gates change your ball, so look ahead and move to the matching lane. Reach the end of the track, collect rewards, and improve your score to unlock more balls, roads, and songs. Primary controls: left mouse button and horizontal mouse drag on desktop; touch and horizontal drag on mobile. No keyboard controls are required.

title: A deadly car crash
description: Try this deadly descent—only 1% of people have ever made it. Immerse yourself in a thrilling world of destruction and speed! This game lets you control cars that crash with stunning realism. Doors, hoods, and wheels can fly off with a powerful impact! Create unique cars by changing the body color, parts, and adjusting the size and placement of the wheels. Meet other cars racing along the roads and compete in spectacular crashes. Enjoy crazy jumps, collisions, and complete freedom of action! Realistic car destruction Customization: color, wheels, and style Vast open world Unique crash test areas Destroy, build, and race—create your own chaos on the road!
howToPlay: Controls: WASD - steer the car Space - brake hard Shift - enable nitro C - switch camera N - change car R - put car back in service K - repair car B - slow down time Tab - open pause On mobile: use the buttons on the screen. Goal: drive, crash, tune - do whatever you want!

title: Pixel Differences
description: Compare the two images. Each of them contains items that look different from those in the other. Your task is to find them. At the top, you can see how many items you need to find.
howToPlay: Click or tap

title: Buggy Simulator Sandbox 3D
description: This is a buggy physics simulator, ride on various maps and observe the behavior of cars and their wheels. There are several cars to choose from - you can switch between them at any time and control any one. Explore the map with the city and the bridge, jump over the hills, drive off the bridge. On the test zone, you can destroy the pyramids, evaluate the work of the suspension and more.
howToPlay: Controls: "WASD" - driving/steering "SPACE" - handbrake "C" - change camera "Shift" - nitro "R" - reset car "N" - next car "Tab" - menu The rest is through the game interface. For mobile devices, use the game interface. The goal of the game: just ride as you like

title: Jumping Bottle 3D
description: 📦Welcome to Jumping Bottle 3D - a game where every bottle throw is fun! 🚀 -🎮Easy and addictive gameplay: once you try it, you won't want to stop! -🧘‍♂️Relax and unwind with one of the best stress relief games. -🔄Interact with surrounding objects to complete levels. -🎯Go through more than 200 levels, each of which will be a real challenge! -🎨Unlock dozens of stylish skins and collect unique bottles! Milk, Coca-Cola, poison and many others are waiting for you. Can you complete all the levels? Get ready for incredible adventures with Jumping Bottle 3D!
howToPlay: 🚀 In "Jumping Bottle 3D" your task is to complete all levels by throwing the bottle over obstacles. The main rule is not to touch the floor with the bottle! 📱 The controls are very simple: 1. Tap the screen to make the bottle jump and turn over. 2. Double tap the screen to make the bottle taller and spin faster. 💰 Collect as many gold caps as you can to unlock amazing new bottle skins! Milk, Coca-Cola, poison and other bottles are waiting for you. 🏆 Complete exciting levels and get cool rewards! Can you complete all the missions on the first try?"

title: Trash Sort
description: You play as a trash sort every bottle, can, paper scrap, or food waste you sort correctly helps nature recover. As you recycle more, the scenes slowly change from polluted and gray to clean, colorful, and full of happy animals again. It feels simple to play, but very satisfying to watch the environment heal because of your actions.
howToPlay: tap and drag items into the matching bin. Each bin has a symbol or color that matches a type of waste (for example, a bottle for glass, leaf for organic).

title: Battleships Pirates
description: Battleships Pirates is a classic guessing turn based game, where each team has a grid on which they secretly mark out a number of 'ships'. Place your ships according your logic, how will be hardest hitting, or choose the cube to replace it random. Try to be the first player to sink all of the opposing players' ships wins the game. Brilliant game for encouraging logical thinking!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click to select and apply choices TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Obby Swing for Brainrots Steal
description: Welcome to Obby Swing for Brainrots Steal A fast-paced action game that blends grappling traversal, skill-based movement, and idle tycoon progression into one addictive experience. Swing, aim, and launch your harpoon to reach Brainrots, collect them, and build your empire. This is more than just a runner. Brainrot Hook Obby is a dynamic movement game with long-term progression, competitive mechanics, and satisfying upgrades. 🪝 Traverse with Your Harpoon Master movement using a harpoon system. Aim, hook, and fly across the map. 🪝 Grapple from point to point across the level 🏃 Fast-paced movement with jumps and swings ⚡️ Skill-based traversal and timing
howToPlay: How to play: - Swing across the map! - Steal Brainrots! - Upgrade your base! - Build the ultimate Brainrot empire!

title: Amaze!
description: Get ready to be amazed! In this game, pop and move the ball to paint your way through challenging maze puzzles. Color every square to unlock new levels, but be strategic—AMAZE gets tougher as you progress. Each level is a canvas, and you must fill every square completely to conquer the maze. Don’t miss a spot, or you’ll be stuck forever! Are you ready for an extraordinary paint puzzle adventure? Let’s pop the maze with color and crossy road challenges!
howToPlay: You will have to color the puzzle mazes. To pass the puzzle, fill each square with a color. The game gets harder as you play, color the maze and pass the puzzles! Each level is a canvas, color it with marbles! Coloring the maze seems simple, but you need to choose the right path and strategy to color the maze and fill each square. If you don't fill at least one square with marbles, you will be stuck in the maze forever! Game Objective: Fill each square with a color to complete the level. PC Controls: You can use mouse, keyboard arrows or w,a,s,d buttons to control the ball. Control on mobile device: Control the ball with your finger.

title: LumberJack Simulator 3D
description: Lumberjack Simulator 3D is a relaxing economic game where you build a logging operation from the ground up. Start with nothing but an axe and grow your humble camp into a thriving wooden empire. Chop trees, collect logs and haul them to the warehouse. Spend your coins on upgrades, unlock a tablet to manage incoming orders, and hire helpers — lumberjacks who chop for you and collectors who gather logs automatically. Build houses for your workers and expand your base by placing buildings wherever you like. Accept deals from buyers, negotiate with business partners, and keep your warehouse stocked — the more logs you deliver, the more you earn. A dynamic day-night cycle, a living world and full control over your progress make every session feel fresh. Adjust music, controls and language to your liking and get to work.
howToPlay: Controls are simple and easy to pick up in seconds. Walk up to a tree and hold the action button — your character will start chopping. Once the tree falls, chop the trunk into logs and carry them to the warehouse. Each delivery earns you coins. Spend those coins on upgrades: increase how many logs you can carry, chop faster, and expand warehouse capacity. Purchase a tablet to unlock the orders system — buyers will send time-limited deals offering coins in exchange for log deliveries. Hire lumberjacks and collectors to automate your operation. Lumberjacks chop trees on their own while collectors pick up loose logs — but each lumberjack needs a house first. Build one through the buildings menu and place it anywhere on the map. Keep an eye on your orders tablet and sell logs before deals expire. Unlock new trade partners for bigger and more profitable contracts. Develop your base, grow your team and see how far your lumber empire can go.

title: Money Empire
description: Money Empire is an exciting strategy game 🧠 with clicker 👆 and board game 🎲 elements, where you build your path to wealth 💸 step by step. Move around the game board, unlock new businesses 🏪, invest in passive income 🏦, upgrade your enterprises 🚀, and compete with other players 🏆 to become the most successful entrepreneur! Casinos 🎰, stock markets 📉📈, banks 🏛️, luxury real estate 🏡, and company shares 📊 — use every tool to grow your fortune. Watch out for global news 📰 that may impact your income, and plan your moves wisely — your success 💎 depends on your strategy!
howToPlay: 1️⃣ Roll the dice 🎲 and move across the board. 2️⃣ Land on business tiles 🏪 to earn money and upgrade them 🔧. 3️⃣ Use special tiles like the bank 🏦, casino 🎰, stock exchange 📉, or HQ 🏢 to boost your empire 📊. 4️⃣ Buy luxury items 💎 and climb the leaderboard 🏅! 5️⃣ Manage your finances wisely 🧠, and beware of taxes 🧾 and random events ⚠️. Build a powerful empire — from a humble startup 🚀 to a global financial machine 🏗️💼!

title: Tile Match Camp
description: Tile Match Camp is a relaxing and addictive triple-match puzzle game set in a beautiful camping world. Explore nature, match colorful items, and clear challenging levels as you journey through forests, campsites, and outdoor adventures. Match three identical tiles to remove them from the board and uncover new challenges. Plan your moves carefully, keep your tray from filling up, and complete each level to advance further into the adventure. With charming visuals, smooth gameplay, and hundreds of satisfying puzzles, Camp Match Adventure is perfect for players who enjoy casual brain-training games and relaxing puzzle experiences. Can you master every level and become the ultimate camping puzzle explorer?
howToPlay: Tap a Tile Select a tile to move it to the collection tray. Match Three Identical Tiles Collect 3 matching tiles to remove them. Clear the Board Match all tiles to complete the level. Think Ahead The tray has limited space, so choose tiles carefully. Complete Levels Solve puzzles and unlock new challenges.

title: Coloring book
description: 🎨 An exciting coloring game for adults and children! Color animals, flowers, mandalas. Anti-stress, creativity and relaxation all in one place !
howToPlay: Choose the desired mode, then choose the coloring book you like, let your imagination run wild and start creating!✨

title: About a Frog
description: A puzzle game about a frog in which you need to pass various obstacles to activate the sail on a small raft to advance further.
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow) / W: Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow) / S: Move downward. ← (Left Arrow) / A: Move left. → (Right Arrow) / D: Move right. R: Restart. Q: To Menu. M: Mute. Mobile Controls: On-screen Buttons *Gamepad supported

title: Snake Out
description: Embark on a colorful puzzle adventure in Snake Out! Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, Snake Out offers a captivating experience that's fun, challenging, and endlessly rewarding. Can you master the art of Snake Out and escape every level?
howToPlay: Control Snakes of different colors and lengths, and guide them to their holes before time runs out. With intuitive drag and move mechanic, each level offers a unique challenge to test your strategic thinking.

title: SnakeWar.io
description: Enter the battlefield in SnakeWarz.IO, a fast-paced multiplayer snake game where survival belongs to the smartest and fastest players. Your mission is simple: grow the longest snake in the arena by eating fruits, defeating rivals, and dominating the leaderboard. Collect delicious fruits scattered across the map to increase your size and score. The bigger you become, the more dangerous you are. Outsmart enemy snakes, trap them into crashing into your body, and consume the massive fruit drops they leave behind after elimination
howToPlay: Grow the longest snake in the arena by eating fruits scattered across the map. Defeat other players by forcing them to crash into your body. When enemies die, they drop huge amounts of fruits. Collect them quickly and keep growing. Movement & Boost PC: Move your mouse to control the snake. Need speed? PC: Hold Left Click Boosting makes you faster but reduces your snake’s length. Use it carefully to escape danger or trap enemies. Growth & Kills Eat fruits for steady growth. Eliminate rival snakes for massive rewards. If another snake’s head touches your body, they are eliminated instantly and explode into fruits. Collect the dropped fruits before other players steal them. Arena Strategy Stay near the center for more fruits. Trap smaller snakes by circling them. Avoid giant snakes until you grow bigger. Use boost wisely — too much boosting makes you smaller and vulnerable. Watch the leaderboard and target distracted players. Key Features Multiplayer Arena Combat: Real-time battles. Compete against global players in nonstop sessions. Customizable Skins: Pumpkin heads. Pirate themes. Pig designs. Tailor your snake's appearance before each match. Speed Boost Mechanic: Burn length for t…

title: Pet Card Sort
description: Pet Card Sort is an adorable matching puzzle game where you organize cute animal cards across a double-sided game board! Match three identical pet cards to clear them from the board and collect dozens of charming pets including owls, bunnies, rainbow sloths, and more. With its satisfying card-sorting mechanics and colorful cast of collectible creatures, Pet Card Sort offers relaxing puzzle gameplay that's easy to learn but challenging to master. Can you sort all the pets and clear every level?
howToPlay: Tap cards at the bottom of the screen to select them Tap empty slots on the game board to place your selected cards Match 3 identical pet cards anywhere on the board to clear them Clear all cards from both sides of the board to complete the level Plan your moves carefully - limited slots mean strategy matters!

title: Sorting Ball Puzzle
description: As the most relaxing and addictive color sorting game, this ball puzzle is designed to entertain and sharpen your mind at the same time. While sorting the colored balls to fill each bottle with the same color, the relaxation it brings will relieve stress and distract you from your daily worries. This classic color sorting game is pretty simple to play, but hard to master. Just tap to take a colored ball from one bottle and stack it into another bottle, until all balls of the same color are in the same bottle. However, there are thousands of puzzles of varying difficulty. The more challenging the puzzles you play, the more careful you need to be with each move. Each move cannot be taken lightly, or you may get stuck! This Ball Sort game is definitely the best puzzle game for you to exercise your brain and train your logical thinking.
howToPlay: Tap any bottle to pick up the top ball, then tap another bottle to move the ball into it. You can only stack the ball into a bottle with the same color ball on top and enough space. When balls of the same color are sorted into a single bottle, you win! Each bottle can only be placed with 4 balls. Use "Undo" to go back to previous steps. Add an extra bottle if you get stuck. You can restart the current level at any time.

title: Coin Color Sort
description: Get ready to relax and enjoy with this unique color-matching puzzle game! Perfect for chilling out, Color Coin Puzzle offers you a soothing way to pass your time. With lots of levels, this game is all about relaxing your mind. If you liked playing classic sorting games like Coin Sort or Ball Sort, you'll love Color Coin Puzzle! It's not just fun but also a good brain exercise. Dive into the colorful world and sort colorful coins to get a satisfying experience.
howToPlay: - Tap and drag to move coins. You can only move coins of the same color. - Only one color coin can be moved at one time. - You can place a coin on top of another only if both are of the same color. - Try to stack all coins of the same color together. - Use your color matching skills to solve these fun logic puzzles. - Enjoy thousands of levels for endless fun!

title: Word Chef
description: Word Chef is a classic word search puzzle game. This free word game makes learning new words fun. It comes with 6 difficulties ranging from Beginner to Expert and there are more than 500 levels in total. Simply swipe letters from the word scramble to create a word. Connect the letters, find the words, and sharpen your word skills as you go.
howToPlay: Drag / swipe your cursor (or mouse) across letters in sequence to form a word. (Click + drag with left mouse button). If the word you formed is valid, it will be accepted and added to your list / score. Your goal is to find all the valid words hidden in the scramble to complete the level. As you progress, higher difficulties will have harder or longer words to find.

title: Cosmic Dash
description: Cosmic Dash is an endless space runner where you pilot your way across the solar system, dodging space junk, collecting tokens, and smashing asteroids. The core loop is simple—travel as far as you can while managing jumps, shrinks, and speed boosts—but what makes it stand out is its layered mechanics: shrinking lets you slip through debris, boosts let you destroy asteroids, and big tokens chain into massive rewards. The mix of fast reflex gameplay, mission objectives, and planetary backdrops gives it a fresh twist on the classic runner genre.
howToPlay: 🎮 How to Play Cosmic Dash Your mission is to dash through space, travel as far as possible, and collect tokens while avoiding or destroying obstacles. Controls (Keyboard): Jump – Press UP arrow Shrink – Press DOWN arrow to squeeze through tight gaps and space junk Move – Use LEFT / RIGHT arrows to change position Boost – Press SPACE to speed up and smash through asteroids Controls (Touch / Mobile): Jump – Swipe UP Shrink – Swipe DOWN Move – Swipe LEFT / RIGHT Boost – Tap the screen 🪐 Tips & Mechanics: Collect small tokens to increase your score. Grab BIG TOKENS to automatically pull in smaller ones. Use SHRINK to slip past dangerous space junk. Use BOOST to destroy glowing asteroids and clear the way. The further you travel, the more challenging and rewarding the journey becomes.

title: Millionaire Factory
description: Millionaire Factory 🔩🏭 is a fun and addictive 🎉 clicker game where players collect Metal to grow their fortune. By tapping the giant Metal button 👆, players gather Metals, convert them into Money 💰, and invest in upgrades to build their own factory empire. The game offers a growth journey that starts with a small piece of Metal 🔩 and expands into a massive factory and investment fortune 📈📉.
howToPlay: Metal Production 🔩: At the heart of the game lies a massive Metal (Gear) button. Each tap 👆 earns you Metal, which serves as your primary source of income. Metals → Money 💵: You can convert collected Metals into Money 💸 to keep your economy running. For example: ➡️ 1 Metal = 0.1 Money ➡️ 10 Metals = 1 Money Income and Robot Program Upgrades 🤖🏭: With the money you earn 💵, you can: Purchase upgrades that increase the amount of Metal gained per tap 💪. Invest in automation systems such as the Basic Auto Robot 3️🔨, Regional Robot Program ⚒️, and National Automatic Robot Fleet. These systems generate passive income every 5 seconds. Factories 🏭: At the start of the game, you begin with a single factory, which you can upgrade 🔧. You can also purchase up to three additional factories 🏭, each of which can be further developed. Every factory has a progress bar 📊 representing its Metal production. Once the bar fills, the factory automatically sells the produced Metal, adds the profit 💵 to your balance, and the cycle restarts. Fast Investments⚡: 📊 In the investment section, carefully observe the **candlestick movements** left by the dynamic system. ⏱️ Within about **15 seconds**…

title: Flag Coloring Puzzle
description: A fun and educational flag coloring puzzle game. Test your memory and geography knowledge to correctly color hundreds of national flags in a clean, vibrant cartoon-style interface.
howToPlay: Look at the country name displayed at the top. Select the correct colors from the palette below and tap the blank areas of the flag to fill them in. Complete it accurately to level up.

title: Airplane Factory - Tycoon
description: Build and expand your own aviation empire in Airplane Factory - Tycoon ! Start small by producing lightweight planes, and gradually scale up to manufacturing giant airliners and advanced fighter jets. Manage production lines, upgrade your factory facilities, enhance your manager’s skills, and unlock new types of aircraft to boost your profits. Strategically grow your business to become the ultimate aircraft manufacturer!
howToPlay: Controls on Desktop: - WASD or Left Mouse Click (LMB) : Move your character around the map. Controls on Mobile Devices: - Swipe : Simply swipe across the screen to move your character in any direction.

title: Ladder Master
description: Run and collect ladder parts in order to grow your ladder with goal to reach the moon! 🏆 Welcome to Ladder Master Runner! 🏆 Are you ready to take on the ultimate climbing challenge? Ladder Master Runner is an addictive and fun arcade game where you climb ladders to reach new heights. Dodge obstacles, collect power-ups, and compete against friends to see who can climb the highest! 🎮 **Key Features**: - **Exciting Levels**: Hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty. - **Smooth Controls**: Easy to learn, hard to master controls. - **Stunning Graphics**: Vibrant and colorful 3D graphics. - **Power-Ups**: Collect awesome power-ups to boost your performance. - **Leaderboards**: Compete with players worldwide for the top spot. - **Customization**: Unlock new characters and skins as you progress. 🌟 **Why You'll Love Ladder Master Runner**: - Endless fun and challenges. - Perfect for all ages. - Regular updates with new levels and features.
howToPlay: 🔝 **How to Play**: - Swipe left or right to move your character. - Avoid obstacles and enemies. - Collect coins and power-ups. - Reach the top of the ladder to advance to the next level. - Keyboard A also you can use arrow controls left or right

title: Zombie Monster Survivors
description: In a world ravaged by a zombie virus, you are one of the last survivors. Each playthrough features randomly generated maps and enemies. Collect various weapons and items, upgrade your character's abilities, and survive as long as possible against waves of zombies.
howToPlay: Slide on the screen to control the character's movement, avoid monsters to gain experience and level up to pass levels

title: One Man Army: Battle Game
description: One Man Army: A casual single player Battle Game that will test your warrior skills and battle reflexes. With challenging levels and intense battles, you must use your tactical skills to survive and defend against arrows, canon, and even dragon flames.
howToPlay: Are you ready for the fun challenge in this defensive battle strategy game? One Man Army: Battle Game puts you in the shoes of an unstoppable warrior defending yourself and testing your reflexes against enemy attacks. With a variety of skills and upgrades at your disposal, you can upgrade your armory and become an unstoppable force. As a One Man Army, you must use your battle tactics to defend and survive enemy attacks. The game tests your reflexes and strategic skills as you face wave after wave of enemy soldier's attacks. You must be quick on your feet, using the right tactics to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious. With each battle won you earn points to rank up, upgrade your armory and enhance your battle skills. Armory upgrades include everything from new weapons and armor to protective gear and shields. By climbing up the ranks you claim them all to be a champion battle warrior. One Man Army: Battle Game will test your warrior skills and battle reflexes. With challenging levels and intense battles, you must use your tactical skills to survive and defend against arrows, canon, and even dragon flames. The game features easy Battle game mechanics and realistic sound e…

title: Color Roll 3D
description: Experience one of the most addictive, color-filled puzzle game — Color Roll 3D! Think you've got a keen eye for details? Ready to challenge your brain? Then this color game is just for you! It's all about color, creativity, and some serious agility! In Color Roll 3D, you'll need to copy the exact image you're shown, down to the last detail! How? Just by unrolling and arranging the vibrantly colored rolls the puzzle game give you for each level. Sounds easy, right? But wait, there's a catch! You've got to ensure the colors overlap in just the right way to perfectly match the image. Got the image in your head? Great! Now get to work and let those colorful rolls fly! Just tap each roll and watch as it smoothly moves across your screen, bringing the image to life. But remember, it's all about getting those colors to line up just right!
howToPlay: You are given several colored rolls. Each roll is like a ribbon or band that you can tap to start unrolling. When you tap, the roll moves/unrolls and overlays onto the puzzle area. The goal is that the overlapping colours and their positions match the sample image you’re trying to replicate. The challenge comes from getting the direction and position of each roll correct. If you unroll a roll the wrong way, or overlay in the wrong spot, the final image will look different from the target.

title: Gods Mixer
description: Gods Mixer is a fun and experimental game where you combine different heads, bodies, and weapons to create unique characters. After assembling them, you can pit them against each other in battles to see which creation reigns supreme. The game encourages creativity through mixing and matching parts for unexpected results. ? Mix & Match Creativity Combine heads, bodies, and more to create your own unique god-like characters. Each combination produces a different look and potential battle outcome. ⚔️ Auto-Battle Arena Watch your creations automatically fight against others to prove their supremacy. Sit back and enjoy the chaos, or refine your mix for a stronger build. ? Endless Combinations Thousands of possible combos. Let your imagination run wild—create funny, powerful, or bizarre beings.
howToPlay: Drag and drop with a mouse is when you: Move the cursor over an item. Press and hold the left mouse button (don’t release yet). Move the mouse to drag the item to a new position. Release the button to drop it in place.

title: Microgic 89
description: MICROGIC 89 is a retro tile puzzle set inside a 1980s microchip. You play BYTE, a courier who has to collect every data chip on the board, unlock the socket they open, and reach the exit before the timer runs out. 22 hand-built levels, each one testing a different machine: sliding ice floors, force belts, teleport pads, cloning machines, trap doors, live bombs and patrolling bugs. Nothing on the board is decoration - if a gadget is there, you have to use it. Every level you clear and every second left on the clock feeds your score, and the global leaderboard remembers who runs the chip best. Play it flat in the classic top-down view or flip to 3D at any time. A full level editor is built in, so you can draw your own maps and play the ones other players have published. Fully localized in 8 languages: English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish, German, French and Japanese.
howToPlay: GOAL: collect every data chip on the board, step onto the socket to open it, then reach the exit before TIME reaches zero. CONTROLS - Desktop: arrow keys or WASD. You can also click and drag toward where you want to go. - Mobile: swipe or drag in the direction you want to move. Pinch to zoom. - P pauses, R restarts the level, and any key clears the level card. WATCH OUT - Water and fire are fatal unless you are carrying the matching boots. - Ice slides you until you hit a wall. Force floors push you along their arrows. - Push a block into water to build a bridge over it. - Coloured doors need the matching key. Bombs destroy whatever steps on them. - Monsters walk fixed patrol routes - wait for the gap, then cross. SCORING - Each cleared level is worth its number x 500, plus 10 points for every second left on the clock. Beat your best time to raise your total on the leaderboard.

title: Cat Block Puzzle
description: Cat Block Puzzle is a fun and relaxing block slide puzzle game with a cute cat theme. In this game, you slide blocks across the board and arrange them to match the target picture. Every level gives you a new puzzle to solve, and each move matters. It is simple to start, but it becomes more challenging as the puzzles get harder.
howToPlay: Slide the blocks on the board to build the target cat picture. Each level gives you a grid filled with blocks of different shapes and sizes. Move the blocks in straight lines whenever there is empty space. Your goal is to place every block in the correct position so the final layout matches the preview picture or silhouette. Think carefully before every move. Because space on the board is limited, one wrong slide can block another piece. You need to open paths, create space, and move the blocks in the right order to finish the puzzle. Some levels are easy to understand, while later stages need more planning and smart logic.

title: Cosplay Gamer Girls
description: Two BFF are going to a summer cosplay festival. They love computer games. Help the girls choose costumes for their favorite video game heroes and princesses. It is very important for a cosplayer to create a complete look: from makeup and hair to dress. Lots of original and gorgeous outfits are waiting for you!
howToPlay: Help the girls create a cosplay based on a computer game. Apply bright makeup. Choose the appropriate items of clothing, shoes, accessories and jewelry that match the theme of this cosplay. A very important point is the choice of hairstyle or wig. The result can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

title: Petdoku: Cozy Puzzle Games
description: Get ready for an exciting challenge with a thrilling twist on two classic games! Dive into a captivating puzzle that merges the strategic thinking of Minesweeper with the number-crunching fun of Sudoku, all while uncovering the hidden map of your dog's favorite territory. Can you solve it and reveal where your furry friend's adventures lie?
howToPlay: Tap – Mark a cell with an X. Double Tap – Place a dog in a cell. Drag – Mark multiple cells quickly. Swipe – Move across cells to mark them. Undo – Reverse your last move. Hint – Get help with the next move.

title: Impossible Parkour 3D
description: Are you ready for the impossible challenges and levels in this Impossible Parkour game? Every level has its unique experience and at every level you will experience new things with 25 levels of the game. You can play it all the day but never finish the game. Let's see if you can?
howToPlay: PC Controls: [ WASD or Arrow Keys ] to move. [ Space ] - Jump. Mobile Controls: Use Joystick and buttons + in-game Toturial.

title: Food Sort 3D
description: In this game, you manage your own food court, sorting various food items into their respective categories. You'll encounter different eateries, from fast-food joints to upscale restaurants, each requiring you to sort items like burgers, sushi, hotdog, fries, pizza and desserts. The game features colorful graphics and quick, satisfying levels that keep you engaged as you expand your food
howToPlay: Drag and drop with a mouse is when you: Move the cursor over an item. Press and hold the left mouse button (don’t release yet). Move the mouse to drag the item to a new position. Release the button to drop it in place.

title: Gun Baron
description: Become the boss of the arms business! You're a red panda building an empire in a world ruled by raccoon bandits. Set up production: install machines, craft pistols, assault rifles, and dynamite, sell to customers, and save up for your dream. But the road to riches is dangerous. Hostile raccoons regularly raid your base. Buy tougher weapons, upgrade your stats, and keep your paw on the trigger to protect your conveyor belts and warehouse. Key features: • Engaging production system • Dynamic real-time shootouts • Living economy: satisfy customers and defend them from raccoons • Vibrant world with signature humor • Clear goal: accumulate capital, build a rocket, and blast off! • Upgrade your skills and buy better gear Every gun sold brings you closer to that dream rocket. Every raid is a test, every dollar a step toward the sky. Run your factory, repel attacks, and become a legend. Launch Gun Baron now — your journey to the stars starts here! 🚀
howToPlay: 🏭 1. Build & Optimize Place machines, keep shelves stocked. Shorter queues = bigger profits. 💰 2. Craft & Sell Make pistols, rifles, dynamite. Customers come automatically: track demand, adjust stock, grow your capital. 🔫 3. Defend Against Raids Raccoon bandits attack regularly. Buy weapons, upgrade your panda skills, defend in real-time. 🚀 4. Save for the Rocket Every dollar brings launch closer. Escape this cruel planet. 💡 Tip: Balance production and defense. Invest in character upgrades, guard your warehouse, and maintain customer reputation.

title: Escape from School 3D
description: 🏃‍♂️ Welcome to Escape from School 3D – the ultimate blox-style school escape game full of chaos, action, and fun! Trapped in a crazy high school, you must fight your way through evil teachers, bullies, principals, and headmasters to break free. 💥 Armed with anything you can find—baseball bats, bricks, slingshots, and more—it's up to you to survive the madness and make your daring escape! 🎮 Game Features: • Action-packed school escape gameplay with hilarious chaos • Dodge and fight angry teachers, bullies, and bosses • Use funny and destructive weapons: bricks, bats, and more! • Cartoony, blox-style graphics and smooth controls • Explore multiple school zones: classrooms, hallways, gyms, and rooftops! • Fast-paced and addictive gameplay with survival elements • Easy to pick up, hard to put down – perfect for all ages!
howToPlay: On PC: Use the WASD keys on keyboard to control the character, and the left mouse button for the weapon. On mobile: Use the virtual joystick to control the character. Look for the elevator on the level to go through it. Collect money to buy new escape heroes.

title: Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja
description: Experience the thrill of battle in "Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja," a 2D fighting game enriched with RPG elements. Conquer over 120 levels, facing tough bosses, customize your character, and unlock legendary gear. Play this engaging game for free online on your phone or computer.
howToPlay: Controls for PC/Keyboard: 1. arrow keys "left" and "right" for movement; 2. arrow key "up" - jump; 3. key "V" - normal attack; 4. key "B" - Special skill, allowing a 30% increase in attack and defense for 15 seconds; 5. key "F" - Summon dragon; 6. keys "Z," "X," "C" - skill buttons providing powerful attacks (effect depends on the skill branches chosen). Controls for mobile devices/touchscreen: 1. slider in the bottom left corner - for movement "left" and "right"; 2. other control buttons are displayed on the screen.

title: Cat Rescue
description: The newest save cat game is here! Rescue the poor kitty from all the obstacles in his way. Draw a simple line to protect the cat from the evil bees that will try everything to sting him. Cat Rescue is the best way to train your brain. Draws a line, a circle, a star, anything you like, the sky is the limit. Each level will require a different solution. It takes the sharpest of minds to complete every challenge and protect the kitty and his nap.
howToPlay: - Touch and drag to draw. - Protect the cat with your drawing. - Beware! The larger the drawing, the fewer stars you get. - Try to get 3-stars on every level.

title: Matching Tiles 3D
description: Match, tap, and clear your way to victory in Matching Tiles 3D. Train your brain and sharpen your memory in this fun and relaxing 3D puzzle game. Your goal is simple: find and select two tiles with the same image to clear them from the board. Keep matching until all tiles are gone and claim your win. With beautifully designed 3D objects and satisfying gameplay, Matching Tiles 3D offers the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Whether you want to unwind or test your focus, this game is made for you. Features: • Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay • Stunning 3D tile designs • Smooth and satisfying matching mechanics • Increasing difficulty to keep you challenged • Perfect for all ages Can you clear all the tiles and become a true matching master? Start playing now and find out.
howToPlay: Mobile: Touch to select tiles, drag to rotate the cubes PC: Click to select tiles, drag with the mouse to rotate the cubes

title: TCG Shop: Maps, Toys and Comics
description: Open your own store in the new trading simulator! Sell TCG cards, figures, comics, food, collectibles, toys - everything geeks and fans love. Serve customers, restock shelves, manage the cash register, deliver orders and expand your business. Upgrade your store, unlock new items, hire employees and build a shopping empire! This game about store combines elements of simulator, clicker and business game, will suit fans of economic strategies, management and TCG-cards. Simple controls, bright graphics and the excitement of business development make the game exciting and accessible to everyone. Try to become the best merchant and expand your store to the level of the legendary marketplace! Play online for free right in your browser. Perfect for fans of store simulators, card games, shipping and business pumping.
howToPlay: Welcome to the store simulator! This is where you are in charge! Main Actions: - Click on the goods to put them on the shelves. - Improve the store by opening new departments. - Create your own merch, comics and even food!

title: Hidden Paint 3D
description: Coloring 3D is an exciting game where you can animate objects with the help of color. Just click on various objects and they will instantly turn into bright and beautiful shades. The game is suitable for all ages, offering a simple and relaxing way to show your creativity.
howToPlay: Task: 1. Find all specified items. 2. Color them by clicking. 3. Move to a new location with a new environment!

title: Breinrot Bog
description: Welcome to a world where the mind is devoured by a mysterious substance — Brainroot. This substance appears in the most dangerous and inaccessible places on the map. Your main goal is to collect it to survive and strengthen your character. The main threat is the awakening swamp. The water level is constantly rising, flooding the land. If the swamp catches up with you, the character will die, but will immediately be reborn at his base. However, death is not the end, but part of the strategy. Return to flooded areas for new resources and watch as familiar trails become impassable. Spend the collected Brainrots on leveling shelters and improving stats: increase your movement speed to escape from the water, boost your jump power to jump on high ground to escape the flood, or invest points in income to passively receive resources even in idle time.
howToPlay: The game is controlled simply. Use the WASD keys to move around the map in search of glowing clusters of Brainrots. To overcome obstacles and climb to high points, press the Space bar (jump). When you find the Brainroot (or want to install the collected sample on the base), go close to it.

title: The Pirate Sea. The Smuggler's Way
description: In the game you have to take on the role of a smuggler. Search for treasures, complete various tasks, destroy enemy ships, capture islands, upgrade your ship, beware of sea monsters and become the most famous smuggler.
howToPlay: PC Management: Up arrow - Straight movement Down arrow - Backward movement Right Arrow - Move to the right Left Arrow - Move to the left Key "D" - Shooting from the right side. Key "A" - Shooting from the left side. Left Shift - Acceleration Management for Mobile devices: Up arrow button - Straight movement The down arrow button is a backward movement. Left arrow button - Move to the left Right arrow button - Move to the right A button with a burning shell on the left - Shooting from the left side A button with a burning shell on the right - Shooting from the starboard side Red-and-white arrow button - Acceleration For accelerated swimming, you need food, it is spent while swimming in the sea. To set the course, open the map and click on the compass icon near the desired location. The leaderboard shows the amount of your gold.

title: Gun Blast
description: Fast-paced arcade shooter where every tap fires your weapon and flips it through the air, turning recoil into movement. Master ricochets, chain precise shots, and stay in control as you bounce around the screen in chaotic, skill-based action. Switch between different weapons like SMGs and shotguns, each with unique feel and strategy, and adapt on the fly to survive longer. Grab powerful upgrades such as rockets for explosive shots and shields for protection, adding depth to every run. Simple to learn but hard to master, the game delivers nonstop action, satisfying mechanics, and endless replayability.
howToPlay: PC - use "SPACE" to FIRE Mobile - Tap screen to FIRE You exist in an arena with other guns! shoot them down to win, last man standing takes the win. Each shot taken add recoil to your gun which allows you to move around the space. Get ready, take aim and enjoy

title: Merge Royal 2048
description: Merge Royale – The Ultimate 2048 Card Puzzle Adventure! Welcome to Merge Royale, the most addictive fusion of Solitaire strategy and 2048 merging fun! Test your logic, speed, and focus as you combine matching cards to reach the highest numbers and Levels. If you enjoy relaxing yet challenging merge puzzle games, this one’s for you. Match cards with the same numbers, merge them to create higher values, and keep progressing to unlock stunning visuals and satisfying combos.
howToPlay: Hit the Target Score to Level Up! Your main objective in this game is to rack up enough points to reach the required target score for each level. You do this by combining matching cards on the board. Drag and drop two identical items together to merge them into a single, higher-level card, which earns you points! Keep merging strategically to clear the board, hit your target score, and advance to the next challenging level. Desktop Controls: Left Mouse Button: Click and hold on a card or item. Mouse Movement: Drag the held item across the board. Drop (Release Click): Release the mouse button over an identical item to merge them. Mobile Controls: Touch & Hold: Tap and hold an item with your finger. Swipe/Drag: Drag your finger across the screen to move the item. Release: Lift your finger to drop the item onto a matching one to merge them.

title: Planet Destroy Idle
description: Planet Destroy Idle - Smash planets to pieces! Craft powerful tools like pickaxes, swords, axes, and arrows to strike and destroy planets while collecting valuable resources. Complete quests, unlock achievements, and upgrade your tools to maximize destruction. Use the prestige system with unique perks to come back stronger and smash even bigger planets. Every hit brings progress, and every new planet opens up new opportunities for chaos. Become the ultimate destroyer and show the planets who’s in charge!
howToPlay: Use the left mouse button to interact with UI elements throughout the game — buy and craft new weapons, upgrade your existing weapons, complete quests, activate prestige, and unlock new perks and upgrades in the menus.

title: Obby Royal races in flight
description: Obby: Royal Races in Flight is an exciting online racing game where players can unlock fast cars and navigate challenging courses. Available on multiple platforms, it features stunning 3D graphics, opportunities for car upgrades, and fun for all ages, including exclusive options for premium members.
howToPlay: Addictive and addictive lava racing simulator where you can pump up your Obby character for hours, buy cool cars and pass difficult parkours! Lots of cases and boxes and cool cars for tracks will help you have a great time! Collect stars, charge a slingshot, dynamite or even an entire rocket with energy. Hatch pets from cases and eggs to get more energy. Earn money and pump up your hero with ranks and ranks. PC controls: AWSD - run; Space - jump; Escape - hide/show cursor; Mouse - turn. On smartphones: Joystick movement - run; Up arrow - jump.

title: City Tuk Tuk Simulator: Racing Game 3D
description: Race through city streets in your Tuk Tuk! Drive, drift & deliver in 3D fun. Experience the thrill of city driving in City Tuk Tuk Simulator 3D – Racing Game, the ultimate auto-rickshaw adventure . Take the driver’s seat of a colorful Tuk Tuk, race through busy streets, pick up passengers, and master the art of high-speed three-wheel driving. Explore realistic city environments, dodge traffic, and test your reflexes as you drift through tight corners. Upgrade your Tuk Tuk, earn rewards, and unlock new levels filled with fun challenges and stunts.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys to ride and control your tuk-tuk smoothly. Press the left arrow to move left, right arrow to move right, up arrow to drive forward, and down arrow to reverse. Master these controls to navigate obstacles and complete challenging routes!

title: Mine Block Party: World of Minigames
description: In this game you will plunge into the exciting world of mini-games! - Competitive spirit: for every victory you receive cups and coins, which you can spend on buying new skins or improving your character. Fight for the championship and become the most skilled player! - Variety of skins: the ability to choose any skin, which includes characters from popular games, cartoons, as well as famous YouTubers. Let your character look the way you want! - Variety of modes: the possibility to choose one of three modes, in one of which you will have to try your luck and choose the right path, and in the other you will have to show your dexterity and wit! - Character upgrade: upgrade your character’s skills, making him faster and more agile in battles. Each victory brings not only pleasure, but also the opportunity to improve your hero. Can you become the best in this game? Embark on an exciting adventure with your favorite characters! Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done? A: Mini-games with block-style gameplay similar to Minecraft. Q: What is the game's unique feature? How can it hook players? A: The game offers a variety of games, unique skins, character pro…
howToPlay: Controls for PC: W, A, S, D or ↑, ←, ↓, → - move. Spacebar - jump. Mouse movement - camera control. Controls for mobile devices: Joystick on the left - move. Button on the right - jump. Swipe on the right side of the screen - camera control.

title: Slow Time Ninja
description: Master time and precision in this stealth ninja game! Swipe to throw your weapon, freeze time to plan, and strike with deadly accuracy. Outsmart enemies, use your surroundings, and defeat all foes with true ninja elegance.
howToPlay: Swipe to throw your weapon at enemies, showcasing incredible ninja mastery. While the weapon is in your possession, time moves slowly, giving you the chance to carefully plan each move. But as soon as you throw the weapon, time returns to its normal speed. Therefore, every action you take must be deliberate and precise to find the perfect moment for an attack. The mission will end when all enemies on the battlefield are defeated. However, don’t forget to stay aware of your surroundings—some opponents may be faster, stronger, or craftier than they initially appear. Stay stealthy, use the environment, and take advantage of the time-slowing mechanic to secure victory. Your task is not just to attack, but to do so with cold calculation and the elegance of a true master.

title: Car Stunts Driving
description: Drive a realistic car, drive along tracks with obstacles. Lots of different tracks for car stunts. You have to drive the car along the tracks in the sky, overcome interesting obstacles and try not to fall off the track into the abyss! The game has many different levels and realistic car physics.
howToPlay: Controls for PC (desktop): W - forward S - back A/D - left/right Space - stop Controls for mobile: controls by corresponding screen buttons

title: SnowTail Peaks: 3D bubble pop adventure
description: Classic bubble shooter but in a glossy 3D world. Drag to aim, bounce shots off the side rails, and match colorful bubbles to clear the board before you run out of shots. Line up clusters, use bank shots to reach tricky spots, and watch unmatched bubbles fall away after each pop. Power-ups like Bomb, Rainbow, and Lift help you dig out of tight spots as stages get tougher. Clear every bubble to win — run out of shots and the level ends.
howToPlay: How to Play Drag to aim — The glowing line shows where your bubble will go, including bounces off the lane rails. Release to shoot — Match 3 or more same-color bubbles to pop them. Use bank shots — Bounce off the side rails to reach bubbles behind obstacles or in hard-to-hit corners. Clear falling bubbles — Bubbles that aren’t connected to the top fall away after a match. Clear the whole board to win the stage. Watch your shots — You only have a limited number of shots. Run out before the board is clear and you lose. Swap bubbles — Tap the launcher area to swap your current bubble with the next one. Power-ups (unlock as you progress): Bomb — Arms an explosive next shot that blasts nearby bubbles. Rainbow — Arms a shot that clears one color from the board. Lift — Pushes the bubble stack away from you, buying you more time.

title: Rocketcar Cup
description: Rocketcar Cup is a fast-paced 2D arcade soccer game where rocket-powered cars battle for victory. Boost, jump, flip, and master aerial moves to score incredible goals in exciting one-on-one or team matches. Use skill, timing, and strategy to outplay your opponents, defend your goal, and become the ultimate champion. Easy to learn, challenging to master, and packed with non-stop action for players of all ages.
howToPlay: Use the virtual joystick to drive your car. Press the blue button to activate Boost. Press the yellow button to perform a Hard Hit. Use W, A, S, and D to drive your car. Press Shift to use Boost. Press Q to perform a Hard Hit. Use the Arrow Keys to drive

title: Parking Boom
description: Parking Boom is a fun and addictive physics-based game where your goal is to launch your car straight into the parking spot! Adjust the power and angle, smash through other vehicles along the way, and try to land as accurately as possible. Each level offers unique obstacles and creative challenges that make your ride exciting and unpredictable. Sharpen your parking skills, beat level after level, and aim for perfection in this fast-paced and explosive adventure. Spacebar to jump. Hold down during jumps to perform tricks (backflip, Superman, etc.). Mobile – Tap left/right side of screen to lean. Swipe up to jump. Tap and hold mid-air for tricks. description: Pocket Tyrant is a charming one-joystick action-strategy conquest game where you lead a tiny goblin warlord and his growing horde across seven islands. Enter a settlement to fight automatically; compare your warband number with the garrison number before attacking. If the enemy is too strong, retreat, gather more resources, and return—permanent progress is never lost. Conquer all 27 kingdoms across seven islands, then defeat the Black Citadel to complete the campaign. After the first victory, the Citadel returns for repeat battles that increase your Infamy leaderboard score.

After slapping, you need to escape avoid obstacles or enemies, and don’t get caught. As you proceed, likely the challenge is to maintain speed, evade pursuers, and possibly manage hazards or other impeding features.
