Features 🎹 Build and customize your ASMR keyboard 💰 Upgrade typing speed and earnings 👷 Hire workers for automatic income 🏆 Compete on the global leaderboard ✨ Relaxing ASMR atmosphere with satisfying visuals 🚀 Become the ultimate keyboard tycoon!
howToPlay: 🖥️ PC 🚶 WASD / Arrow Keys — Move 🦘 Space — Jump 🖱️ Hold Right Mouse Button — Rotate the camera 📱 Mobile 🕹️ Virtual Joystick — Move 👆 Swipe — Rotate the camera

title: Obby: Ragdoll Boxing
description: Immerse yourself in Ragdoll boxing chaos and fun with Obby! This is a unique simulator that combines ragdoll physics and crazy fights! Here you control not just a fighter, but a real rag doll, who will have to go through trials in the arena, in training and in improvised fights. Funny animation, unpredictable behavior and collision physics turn every fight into an exciting spectacle. Create your own character, explore locations and prove who is the best boxer among Obby fighters. Control punches, dodge and hit with precise calculation - or just enjoy the chaotic fun, watching your characters fly around the arena. 🔑 Key features of the game: 🥊 Ragdoll physics - every hit is unpredictable 🎮 Simple controls with deep gameplay 🧍 Character customization 🧠 Elements of strategy and reaction 😂 Fun and unexpected situations in every fight 🌍 Various locations and arenas for battles
howToPlay: The goal of the game: Win battles, controlling a ragdoll fighter with ragdoll physics, pass tests in arenas, improve skills and become the strongest Obby boxer.

title: Funny Rescue Gardener
description: Samantha is a great gardener, but even the best will get accidents sometimes. Let's play and rescue Samantha from the horrible accident! Help her recover from the wounds and have fun!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Potion Kitchen
description: Potion Kitchen is a cosy crafting puzzle about running a potion shop at the edge of the market. Guests arrive with orders — one needs a potion of warmth, another a good night's sleep, and some speak in riddles and expect you to work it out. Mix ingredients in the cauldron, brew, and serve before your guest gives up. The recipe book starts empty: all 19 recipes are unlocked by brewing alone, and every one of them can be reasoned out rather than guessed, because the ingredients of a potion share one element.
howToPlay: Serve every guest before their patience runs out. 1. Press "Start shift" — the first guest walks up to the counter. 2. Read the order. A direct request names the potion, a riddle describes its effect; the hints below the order narrow it down. 3. Tap an ingredient on the shelf or drag it into the cauldron. It holds two ingredients, or three once upgraded. 4. Press "Brew" and see what came out. An exact match is "Perfect", but any real potion still sells. 5. Press "Serve": the guest pays in coins and reputation, and a new recipe goes straight into the book. 6. Between shifts, spend coins in the shop on kitchen upgrades. Mouse, touch or keyboard — Space or Enter to brew and serve, C to empty the cauldron, H for a hint, B for the recipe book, P or Esc to pause, M for sound.

title: Clickdom
description: Welcome to Clickdom — a charming clicker where every tap brings your kingdom one step closer to glory! Wander through your realm, tap busy villagers to collect coins and scratch exciting lottery tickets for a chance to win magical scrolls and powerful buildings. Spend scrolls on kingdom upgrades and place new structures — a villager-collecting Tower, a resident-attracting Bell Tower and a coin-producing Laboratory — to automate your empire. Keep clicking, keep scratching and keep expanding until every upgrade is unlocked and your kingdom reaches its full potential. Can you build the ultimate Clickdom?
howToPlay: Tap wandering villagers to earn coins. Visit the shop to buy lottery tickets, then scratch each ticket to reveal prizes — magical scrolls or even brand-new buildings. Use scrolls in the upgrade menu to strengthen your kingdom and unlock new perks. Place buildings on your realm to automate progress: the Tower collects villagers for you, the Bell Tower attracts more residents to tap and the Laboratory generates coins over time. Keep tapping, buy more tickets and reinvest your rewards wisely. Your goal is to unlock every upgrade and expand the kingdom to its maximum size — so click, scratch and build your way to the ultimate Clickdom!

title: Frontline Commando Shooting: Gun Games
description: Welcome to the world of gun shooting games. Get ready to step into the world of intense gun battles, thrilling missions, and heart-pounding survival challenges in the most complete first-person shooter game. Choose from an enormous collection of authentic, modern firearms and futuristic experimental guns. Pistols, assault rifles, SMGs, sniper rifles, shotguns, heavy machine guns every weapon feels unique and powerful.
howToPlay: W / Arrow Up → Move Front S / Arrow Down → Move Back A / Arrow Left → Move Left D / Arrow Right → Move Right - To click any button use mouse

title: Stickman: Jailbreak Story
description: Dive into the exciting world of "Stickman: Jailbreak Story," where cleverness and agility lead to liberation. Play as an innocent stickman trapped in a jail, solving complex puzzles and avoiding clever guards and tricky obstacles. Enjoy an engaging gameplay experience on both mobile and desktop that tests your strategy and quick thinking.
howToPlay: Use your mouse or tap the screen to select items, interact with objects, and solve puzzles. Make quick decisions and choose the correct options to outsmart guards and navigate your way to freedom!

title: Shape Transform
description: 🌀 Shape Transform – Race 3D Game 🚀🏁 Shift. Race. Conquer. Get ready for the ultimate shape-shifting race where speed, timing, and smart decisions decide the winner! 🏎️💨 Can you transform fast enough to master land, sea, and sky? 🌊🏔️☁️ 💥 Game Features: 🎮 Super-easy one-touch gameplay — anyone can play! 🔄 Transform into cars, boats, and planes instantly! 🧠 Fast reflexes & smart timing win the race! 🌈 Dynamic tracks that change every time you play! 🕹️ Perfect for quick fun or long racing marathons! 🏆 Addictive “just one more race” excitement! 🌟 Why You’ll Love It: ⚙️ Simple controls, endless fun! 🔥 Fast, fluid gameplay that trains your reflexes! 🌍 Beautiful 3D visuals that make every race thrilling! 🧩 A smart mix of action and timing — easy to play, hard to master! Ready to transform and dominate every race? 🏁 👉 Download Shape Transform – Race 3D Game now and show the world how fast you can shift! ⚡✈️🚤
howToPlay: 🎮 How to Play: 👆 Tap to switch your shape (car, boat, or plane)! ⚡ Match the right vehicle to the terrain — land, water, or air! 🚧 Avoid obstacles and outsmart your rivals! 🥇 Finish first to unlock new tracks and challenges!

title: The Depth of the Limbo
description: The game is about a girl in limbo who has to complete all the levels to wake up. Top view: The character must overcome 13 levels. Each level is a one—minute test cycle, but the camera rotates around the hero, changing the orientation of the space. Due to the moving camera, you can get confused about right, left, up and down, which turns simple routes into a puzzle. The lines of the path seem familiar until they turn around your head, forcing you to rethink each goal. The goal is simple and touching: to complete the route from beginning to end, overcome the inner noise of fear, and wake up refreshed and free.
howToPlay: On the computer: To make the character move to the right, left, up or down, press the D, A, W, S keys or the arrows to the right, left, up or down, respectively. On a smartphone or tablet: To make the character move to the right, left, up or down, press the arrow buttons to the right, left, up or down, respectively.

title: Catch the Snowmen!
description: 🎅🌨️ Touch the winter magic in the game "Catch the Snowmen!" 🎁🎅You can feel like a real Santa Claus, creating nice and cute snowmen. Have fun creating a huge crowd of cute snowmen 🌲🎄Meet New Year's toys at each level that can be hung on a magical Christmas tree! 💪🔥 Each completed level allows you to improve the abilities of your brave snowmen and acquire new heroes in your team. Who are you - Santa Claus or the Grinch? 🎅👊Collect magical items and unlock unique abilities to face the real challenge of the game - the Giant and Evil Santa as the boss ✨🎉The more snowmen you have, the higher your place in the player ranking. Be the first! ❄️
howToPlay: Recruit new snowmen by collecting gifts. Enemies below your level can be attacked. If the enemy is higher than you, run away! At the end of the level you can get a New Year's toy. Decorate the Christmas tree! Computer control: WASD or arrow keys. Phone controls: Tap the screen and a virtual joystick will appear.

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description: 🌸 Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy 🧊 and fly through levels full of danger: fire 🔥, ice ❄️, lasers ⚡, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control 👆, but surviving takes focus and reflexes. 💰 Collect coins, open chests 🎁, find eggs 🥚, and hatch new Fluffies in the incubator! Every hero is a unique fluffy cube with personality. Build your collection — from common to rare and hilarious! 😍 🚁 A friendly drone awaits you in the main menu — it guards your incubator and reacts to your actions. Customize it 🎨 to make it truly yours! 🎵 Fun music, colorful 3D visuals, and tons of fluffy joy await! Happy Fluffy Cubes is perfect for kids and anyone who loves cheerful and casual games! 🐾✨
howToPlay: Controls are super simple — hold the screen and move your finger up or down to guide your Fluffy 🧊. Avoid fire 🔥, ice ❄️, lasers ⚡, and spinning saws. Don’t crash and don’t lift your finger! Collect coins 💰 while flying — use them to buy chests 🎁. Chests may contain eggs 🥚 that hatch into new Fluffies! Each one is a fluffy cube with its own style and charm. Some are rarer than others — build your full collection! You can also upgrade the incubator 🔧 — higher levels hatch Fluffies faster, helping you unlock new heroes even quicker. Your drone companion 🚁 floats in the main menu, protects the incubator, and can be recolored 🎨 to match your style. Let’s fly! 🐾✨

title: Brainrot Hide and Seek Classic
description: Everyone has played hide-and-seek at least once. With each level, changing locations will keep you busy. In the game, you have to move quickly and skillfully before you get caught. Each level becomes more difficult, requiring you to have faster reaction speed, agility, and the ability to plan your movements.
howToPlay: Your task is to move around the location so that the Seeker, who has a certain viewing radius, does not find you. Remember that the Seeker's movements are chaotic, so always try to keep your distance.

title: Fishtopia
description: Dive into the magical world of Fishtopia Adventure! 🐠✨ Embark on an underwater journey filled with colorful fish, charming pets, and exciting puzzles. Unlock and decorate your own aquariums, complete thrilling levels, and discover hidden treasures beneath the waves! Enjoy daily events, challenges, and bonuses that make every dive a new adventure. Perfect for puzzle lovers and casual gamers alike!
howToPlay: How to Play: Objective: Match and collect items to complete each level, save adorable fish, and unlock new aquariums. Controls: Use your mouse or touch screen to swap, click, and match items. Tips: Plan your moves carefully, use power-ups wisely, and aim for high scores to earn rewards! Why You’ll Love It: Hundreds of unique levels with increasing difficulty. Adorable fish and pets to collect and care for. Fun events and challenges every day to keep you hooked. Easy to play, hard to put down!

title: Your Obby Labyrinth
description: Join an exciting multiplayer maze adventure! Team up with friends to explore tricky mazes full of secrets, funny messages, cool prizes, and hidden paths! Pick awesome character skins and cute pets to join you! Dodge silly AI monsters and funny NPCs that make your journey fun! Easy controls let you use doors, levers, buttons, and keys to escape! Each maze has colorful places, sneaky traps and puzzles. Jump into magical portals and discover new maze adventures! Chat, laugh, and escape in your-styled universe !
howToPlay: The goal: get to the end. Control: WASD - movement. Space bar - jump. TAB - pause. E - Interact. Shift - cursor. Mouse wheel - zoom in/out. On the phone: Use the game interface.

title: Obby: Battle Arena
description: Exciting third-person shooter with beautiful graphics, where exciting battles, cool guns, and a real battle arena await you!
howToPlay: In the game, you can choose the game mode and maps on which you will play. There are many skins and additional accessories for the character. Controls in the game on PC: WASD - movement 1, 2, 3, 4 - change weapons Shift - fast run (weapon is hidden) R - reload F - hide weapon (increases movement speed) LMB - shoot RMB - aim Esc - game menu Tab - leaderboard

title: Car Runner
description: Car Runner is an exhilarating low-poly arcade racing game with puzzle-platformer elements set in surreal, gravity-defying environments. Players navigate a compact delivery van through twisted, winding pipes and looping checkerboard tunnels, dodging hazardous obstacles like spinning giant red windmills, wooden barriers, and scattered boulders. The core unique selling point is the combination of momentum-based tunnel racing with high-stakes physics, where mastering the curves of the track is just as important as maintaining high speed to scoop up valuable gold coins.
howToPlay: Main Objectives & How to Win Collect the Wealth: Drive along the curving walls of the tunnel to collect as many glowing gold coins as possible. Survive the Obstacles: Avoid or maneuver around hazardous blockades, including giant red spinning blades, rocks, and barricades. Reach the Light: Successfully navigate the twists and turns of the loop to reach the blinding light exit at the end of the tunnel to complete the level. Primary Controls * A: Steer Left * D: Steer Right

title: Obby: Sword Hero Adventure
description: Obby: Sword Hero Adventure is an exciting game where you’ll master your sword skills. Increase your attack power, obtain and use rarer swords. Build a collection of the best companions, defeat enemies, fight bosses, and explore all the game worlds in search of adventure! • Increase your attack power • Collect rare swords! • Earn trophies and skill points! • Recruit companions! • Upgrade your hero’s abilities! • Unlock all game worlds!
howToPlay: PC Controls: WASD - Move your character Space - Jump Right Mouse Button - Camera control Left Mouse Button - Attack Mobile Controls: Joystick - Move your character Hold your finger on the screen - Camera control Tap the screen - Attack

title: Sins and Desires
description: “Sins and Desires” is a captivating visual novel in the detective genre with romance elements. As detective Felicia, you travel to the village of West-Alben to uncover the mystery of aristocrat William’s disappearance. Experience an interactive story with branching choices, a relationship system that affects the ending, and romance routes with Albert, Felix, and Victor. The atmosphere of a dark mansion, a foggy lake, and a village full of secrets keeps you intrigued. Every choice matters - will you uncover the truth or fall into the shadows of West-Alben’s sins and desires?
howToPlay: In “Sins and Desires” you play as detective Felicia, investigating the disappearance of an aristocrat in the village of West-Alben. This is a visual novel with a mystery story, romance, and branching choices. How to play: - Read the story and dialogues. - Make choices that affect endings. - Gather clues and question villagers. - Unlock romance paths. - Replay to discover all story branches. Every choice matters. Explore different paths, uncover secrets, and experience the full mystery of West-Alben.

title: Tap Gallery
description: Tap Gallery is the ultimate puzzle game where you test your brain and tap away blocks to uncover hidden images. This iq game challenges your logical thinking and provides satisfying puzzle-solving experiences that relieve anxiety. Each tap puzzle is a unique brain teaser designed to engage and entertain, making it one of the most addicting games in the puzzle genre.
howToPlay: – Tap Block to Solve Puzzle: Tap on the blocks with arrows to move them – Strategize Your Moves: Plan your taps carefully to clear the blocks in the most efficient way possible. The more you play, the more you improve your puzzle-solving skills – Use Boosters: When stuck, tap it away with the help of boosters to remove multiple blocks at once – Master the Tapping Game: Become a tap master by completing increasingly difficult tap puzzles and unlocking new levels of brain-teasing challenges

title: Brainrots Merge
description: An engaging merge-clicker autobattler. Combine characters to get a new one, periodically battle other players, and unlock all brainrots!
howToPlay: - Click on characters to earn currency - Drag identical characters onto each other to unlock a new one - When you're attacked, select the characters you want to send into battle

title: Click Kitty Idle
description: Click Kitty Idle– Fast-Paced Cat Clicker Challenge! Click Kitty Idle is a fun and competitive idle clicker game where speed, timing, and strategy matter! Tap to feed your kitty, level up, and dominate the leaderboard in this addictively cute cat-clicking game! Why You’ll Love It: If you enjoy fast-paced clicker games with a twist, It’s not just about clicking—it's about clicking smart and fast. Play now and prove you’ve got the fastest paws in town! •Cute & competitive gameplay with pressure-based challenges! •Buy fun food like tuna, milk, cheese & more! •Unlock cute cat characters like Miss Pawlina and Captain Purrbeard! •Boosters: Auto Click, Time Extension, and Massive Click Power! •Compete for high scores and unlock achievements!
howToPlay: Use the left mouse button to interact with in-game UI How to Play: •You have 32 seconds to earn coins by clicking. •Use coins to buy cat food before time runs out! •Each time you buy food, the price increases (ex: 100 → 860 → more!) •Upgrade your Click Value to +1, +2... and increase your speed!

title: Tangram Triangle
description: Tangram Triangle is a captivating mobile puzzle game that reimagines the classic tangram tradition with triangular blocks, challenging players to drag and rotate colorful pieces—blue, yellow, red, and orange—to perfectly fill irregular silhouettes on a grid. Its core idea revolves around spatial reasoning and problem-solving, blending accessibility for all ages with progressively tougher levels and a time-attack mode for high-score chases, making it uniquely addictive through clean visuals, hundreds of puzzles, and family-friendly brain-teasing fun.
howToPlay: Master the Tangram Challenge! Dive into Tangram Triangle, the ultimate mobile puzzle where you drag and rotate colorful triangular pieces—blue, yellow, red, and orange—to perfectly fill irregular silhouettes on the grid. Your goal is to complete each level by fitting all available pieces without overlaps or gaps, unlocking progressively tougher puzzles, stars for perfection (like 3/3), gifts, and high scores in time-attack mode! Mobile Controls: Drag: Select and move any piece to the grid. Two-Finger Rotate: Pinch or rotate to adjust piece orientation. Tap: Select a piece; double-tap or use rotate button (if available) for quick spins.

title: Cup Quest
description: Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey: A Feline Hero’s Adventure Begins! Join a brave cat on an epic quest in Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey, a fresh twist on the classic balls-and-cups game. This isn't just about tossing balls into cups—it's a full-blown adventure packed with clever puzzles, physics-based challenges, and one courageous kitty determined to save the day. Your Cat, the Hero Meet your furry champion—a quick-thinking, nimble cat with a heart of gold. As danger looms and traps lie in wait, it’s up to this whiskered warrior to take on wild levels filled with spinning platforms, explosives, and tricky obstacles. Precision Meets Puzzle Each level is a test of aim and timing. Launch the ball just right, bounce it off the environment, and land it perfectly in the cup. It’s not just about power—success requires strategy, finesse, and a little creative thinking. What Awaits You - Over 200 unique levels, ranging from simple to seriously tricky - Skill-based gameplay that mixes timing, puzzle-solving, and action - Hero upgrades: unlock new feline champions and grow stronger as you progress - Satisfying animations and smooth physics that make every throw feel great - Enemies and traps: it's no…
howToPlay: Use the mouse to guide the balls dropping from the cup, and mouse is also used for interacting with UI elements (buttons, powerups, etc.)

title: Scale the wheels
description: The game where size matters! Your mission is to change the size of the wheels, transitioning from small to large and vice versa, to overcome a variety of obstacles and progress through levels. But that's not all! The size of the wheels also affects the speed of your car, adding excitement to the gameplay. With over 30 different tracks to conquer, you'll face unique challenges. Additionally, you can upgrading your acceleration, enabling you to jump farther and collect more coins at the end of each level. So, resize your wheels, and embark on the exhilarating journey to earn the highest score and become a true champion!
howToPlay: Your goal is to reach the finish line. To do this, use the slider in the game to change the size of the wheels. Small wheels allow you to accelerate. Large wheels allow you to drive into high obstacles, but because of them the car becomes slow. Also, the larger the wheels, the more the car turns into the standard position if it is not standing on all wheels at the moment. If you get stuck, try to drastically change the size of the wheels, so the car can bounce. In some levels, it is important to gain speed in order to hit an obstacle. If you realize that the car is stuck, stopped and does not move even when you change the size of the wheels, then use the restart button of the level and try to pass it again. Pump up the acceleration level so that at the end of the level the car can jump as far as possible and earn as many coins as possible. Control on all platforms using the game interface.

title: 12 minutes to survive
description: Step into the shoes of a powerful mage in 12 Minutes to Survive, an intense survival game where every second counts! Battle against relentless waves of enemies for 12 action-packed minutes. Level up your character mid-battle to unlock powerful skills and abilities, and collect souls from defeated foes to upgrade your mage’s power. With each passing moment, the challenge escalates—will your strategic choices and magical prowess be enough to conquer the chaos? Prove your mastery of the arcane and survive the onslaught!
howToPlay: Desktop -> Move with the arrow keyboard keys Mobile -> Use the touch virtual button on screen to move

title: Screw Out Jam Puzzle

Unlock rewards, harness boosters, and keep your winning streak alive in this thrilling free online puzzle experience!
howToPlay: The navigation in this game is very simple. Just use mouse on desktop or your finger tap on mobile devices.

title: HoleMart
description: HoleMart is a fun and addictive casual game where you control a growing hole inside a busy market. Move around the area, swallow objects, and expand your size as you consume more items. Start small by absorbing tiny goods, shelves, and carts. As your hole grows bigger, you’ll be able to swallow larger objects and clear the market faster. The more you consume, the stronger and bigger your hole becomes. Simple controls, satisfying growth, and smooth gameplay make HoleMart perfect for quick play sessions and endless fun.
howToPlay: Move the Hole Drag your finger to move the hole around the market. Consume Objects Absorb smaller objects to increase your size. Grow Bigger The more items you swallow, the larger your hole becomes. Unlock Larger Items As you grow, you can consume bigger shelves, carts, and objects. Clear the Market Keep swallowing until the market is completely cleared.

title: Badlands Hero
description: Embark on an epic journey in the game "Badlands Hero", where danger lurks around every corner and adventure awaits at every step. As you play, you will: - Complete levels - Earn experience points to unlock new characters - Collect gold to upgrade your characters and weapons - Unlock new types of weapons - Defeat bosses
howToPlay: Controls for PC/Keyboard: - Movement: Use the W, A, S, D keys or left mouse click to move your character . Controls for Mobile Devices/Touchscreen: - Movement: Tap and drag on the screen to move your character.

title: Kings Defense: Roguelike
description: Kings Defense: Roguelike — Defend the Kingdom! The kingdom is under threat! Enemies are advancing, and only your cannon can stop their onslaught. Kings Defense is a dynamic blend of classic block-breaker and roguelike, where every shot counts. How to Play? Your goal is to destroy monsters by launching chains of balls. They ricochet off walls and enemies, dealing damage. But be careful: opponents move toward the castle walls and strike back. Survive all 20 waves and defeat the final boss! Features: Unique Builds: Break open chests and choose skills — from lightning to splitting balls. Each run offers a new set of abilities. Combo System: Hitting enemies with balls fills the combo meter, granting bonuses to damage and healing. Tower Upgrades: Spend coins in the main menu to increase damage, add more balls, and boost HP. Varied Enemies: Fight ghosts, "dodging" monsters, and cunning bosses. Level up, combine skills, and become a legendary defender. Your kingdom awaits!
howToPlay: Aiming: Move the mouse cursor (on PC) or your finger across the screen (on mobile devices) left or right to set the trajectory of the balls. Shooting: Release the mouse button or lift your finger to launch a volley of balls from the cannon in the chosen direction.

title: Build Your Dream Car
description: Build your dream car, upgrade engines and nitro, win intense drag races, and dominate the streets with perfect shifting skills.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys and mouse on PC to control your car, shift at the right moment, and win drag races. On mobile, simply hold your finger on the screen and slide left or right to control the car. The controls are very simple and intuitive, so you can focus on building, upgrading, and racing your dream car.

title: Fantasy Fish World Mahjong
description: Fantasy Fish World Mahjong is a delightful Mahjong Solitaire puzzle game immersed in a vibrant underwater fantasy realm. Its core concept revolves around matching and removing identical fish-themed tiles—featuring colorful clownfish, angelfish, and other sea creatures—to clear intricate layouts against a pirate shipwreck backdrop with corals and seaweed. Unique elements include adorable aquatic tile designs, intuitive UI with hints, shuffles, and color swaps, plus timed levels for relaxed yet engaging play.
howToPlay: **Dive into the Depths!** **Plunge into the magical underwater world of Fantasy Fish World Mahjong and become the ultimate tile-matching master by clearing every last fish from the board!** **In this captivating Mahjong Solitaire puzzle game, you’ll match pairs of identical colorful sea creatures—like clownfish, angelfish, and more—to dismantle intricate layouts amid pirate shipwrecks, corals, and seaweed. Conquer over 4,000 levels, earn up to 3 stars per level (1 for completing, +1 for no hints, +1 for finishing in time), and unlock endless adventures!** **Desktop Controls:** **Mouse Left Click:** Select a free tile (unblocked on at least one side), then click its identical match to remove the pair. **? Button:** Get a hint for available matches. **💡 Button:** Shuffle tiles to rearrange the board. **🎨 Button:** Activate magic color swap for new tile visuals. **↺ Button:** Restart the level. **|| Button:** Pause/Resume gameplay. **Mobile Controls:** **Tap Tiles:** Tap a free tile, then tap its identical match to remove them. **On-Screen Buttons:** Tap for hint (?), shuffle (💡), magic (🎨), restart (↺), or pause (||).

title: Sorting Nuts and Bolts by Color: Home Repair
description: Ready for some fun sorting? 🧩 The free puzzle game "Nut Sorter" invites you to relax and exercise your mind! Your task is to sort colorful nuts into bolts, creating perfect color chains. Over 15,000 levels with no time limit await you! 🎨 Soothing gameplay mechanics with tactile feedback and pleasant sounds. ⚡ Use bonuses: extra bolts, undo, and restart. ❓ Uncover the secret colors of the nuts under the question marks. 🏡 Build your dream home, earning rewards for completing levels. 😌 Comfortable Effects Soothing ASMR-inspired sounds combined with haptic feedback provide an exceptional nut sorting experience! Simply tap the bolts to move the nuts. Sort colors, plan your moves, and enjoy endless puzzles! Perfect for relaxing and developing your attention span. Download and immerse yourself in the world of color logic! 😍 🔩 FREE • 15,000 levels • No timers • For all ages
howToPlay: Select a Nut: Click on the bolt you want to take the nut from. Move it: Click on another bolt to move the selected nut there. Sort by Color: Match nuts of the same color on one bolt. Make sure there's enough room on the bolt! Use Tools: Use bonuses if you need to add a bolt, cancel a move, or restart the level. The goal is to clear the board by sorting all the nuts by color.

title: Tile Pop : Block Blast
description: Tile Pop is a relaxing yet strategic block puzzle game that challenges your thinking with satisfying gameplay, colorful themes, and endless replayability. Drag and place beautifully designed block pieces onto the board to complete rows and columns, clear space, and achieve your highest score. Every move matters, so plan carefully and build massive combos to keep the board alive. Whether you're looking for a calm puzzle experience or a tougher strategic challenge, Tile Pop offers multiple ways to play. 🎮 Game Modes 🧩 Classic Mode Endless block puzzle gameplay. Beat your personal best score. Relaxing, easy to learn, difficult to master. ⚔️ Adventure Mode A unique endless challenge where random obstacles appear throughout the game. Face Frozen Ice, Vines, Spider Webs, Stone Blocks, Chains, Slime, Crystals, and Corrupted Tiles. Every obstacle has its own mechanics, requiring different strategies to overcome. Dynamic challenge events ensure that every run feels fresh and unpredictable. ✨ Features Beautiful high-quality block themes. Smooth, satisfying animations and sound effects. Simple one-finger controls. No time limits—play at your own pace. Strategic gameplay that rewards planni…
howToPlay: 🖥️ Desktop (Mouse) Select & Drag: Click and hold Left Mouse Button on any of the 3 available blocks at the bottom of the screen, then drag it onto the grid. Place Block: Release the mouse button over valid highlighted grid cells to drop the block. 📱 Mobile (Touch Screen) Select & Drag: Touch and hold your finger on any block shape at the bottom, then slide your finger to position it on the grid. Place Block: Lift your finger when the block aligns over open grid cells.

title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
description: Money Factory - Earn a Billion is an engaging online strategy and puzzle game where you manage a money-making factory. Strategically enhance your operations, overcome challenges, and unlock new levels while boosting your earnings. Play on any device and enjoy a thrilling experience as you build wealth and demonstrate your skills.
howToPlay: 1. Making money is easy at first, but you'll need creativity and luck to keep growing your factory. 2. Buy boosters, fill the field, and multiply your earnings. 3. Hold your finger or mouse button to move boosters, release to place or combine two identical ones. 4. Aim to become a billionaire!

title: Air Assault: Ship Defense
description: Man a twin AA gun on a WW2 destroyer and shoot down waves of diving planes before they sink your ship. Air Assault puts you in the splinter tub of a wartime destroyer — twin barrels, open ocean, and enemy aircraft diving straight at your deck. Aim with the crosshair, manage gun heat, and cut down fighters before they reach the hull. Stages ramp up fast: denser swarms, faster dives, bombers and armored blimps on high flyovers, and kamikazes that don’t turn away. Planes shoot back. Bombs fall. One bad miss and the ship goes down. Upgrade your mount between runs, climb the stages, and hold the line as the sky fills with incoming fire. Simple controls, sharp 3D action — pure anti-aircraft mayhem in the middle of the Pacific.

Desktop Move the mouse to aim (center reticle is your aim point) Hold left mouse button or Space to fire Mobile Drag to aim The gun auto-fires when the reticle is on a target Tips Watch the heat gauge — overheating locks the gun until it cools Protect hull HP; repair a bit between stages Fighters dive first; later stages bring bombers, blimps, and kamikazes Spend coins in the shop between runs to upgrade damage, cooling, and hull Pause anytime from the top-left button

title: Gothic New Era

But before the trip, the gothic princess needs to update her wardrobe while staying true to style. Only dark, gloomy shades, gothic dresses and school uniforms. To any question you’ll hear: “I doubt it”, “50/50”, “unlikely”, “partially”, “hard to say” — and dozens of other evasive replies. Click, collect feathers, and upgrade your flock of doubtful birds. Unlock new ones and complete the full collection of the most uncertain creatures in the world. 🔹 Feathers — used for regular upgrades and faster progression 🌾 Grain — a rare currency for unique improvements and special bonuses 📈 Many upgrades with unexpected effects 🏆 Leaderboards — compete to become the most doubtful keeper of grain 💬 Chat — talk with other players who are just as uncertain You don’t need to be right here. You just need to doubt. Become a legend of hesitation. Or… maybe not.

Build structures, markets, workshops, and storage facilities to support your exploration efforts. title: Domino Legend
description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Domino Legend. Ideal for both veterans and nostalgic players, this online game offers an exciting challenge. Enjoy the beloved Block and Draw formats, and experience the joy of a fast-paced match on your device.

At the beginning the players receive 7 tiles and the one with higher double begins the game. If neither player got a double, then the player with the highest tile begins. The player who earns 100 points first wins.

title: Relaxing Games: 30 in 1
description: This collection of games is perfect for those who are looking for a relaxing and fun way to unwind. These mini-games are designed to bring a sense of peace and entertainment during short breaks or long journeys. Enjoy a variety of calming and fun games that will help you escape from the daily grind and find harmony. A great way to relax and have fun anywhere and anytime. No ratings or points, just addictive mini-games.
howToPlay: After loading. Choose one of 30 games to start the game with. Simple rules of the game do not require training. If there are difficulties at the level or it seems uninteresting, you can simply skip it.

title: Road Fury - Racing
description: Dive into dynamic 3D racing where your main goal is to reach the finish line first. The track is full of rivals, dangerous obstacles, traps, ramps, and sharp turns that will test your reaction speed and driving skills. Every collision damages your car: the body breaks, wheels can fly off, and handling becomes harder. Use nitro, avoid hazards, upgrade your vehicle, and buy new cars to become the race leader. - Dynamic 3D racing with rivals - Lots of obstacles, traps, and ramps - Realistic car damage - Nitro for powerful speed boosts - Car upgrades and new vehicles - Goal — finish first
howToPlay: Goal: Reach the finish line first while overtaking rivals, avoiding obstacles, and escaping traps. Avoid collisions, use turbo, and upgrade your car to win the race. Controls: - Mobile devices: use touch and swipes to control the car. - PC: WASD — control the car, double-tap W — turbo.

title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
description: Block Puzzle Tropical Story is a vibrant puzzle game that blends relaxing gameplay with a sense of island adventure. You’ll connect blocks, solve clever challenges, and unlock stunning tropical locations. As you explore lush jungles and serene beaches, each level rewards you with stars and new areas, turning every puzzle into a step deeper into paradise. The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a tropical paradise with beautiful graphics, relaxing music, and fascinating gameplay! Each successfully completed challenge brings you closer to discovering new horizons, and accumulated stars become the key to the next chapters of this exciting journey. A relaxing puzzle game where you connect blocks while traveling through picturesque tropical islands. Collect stars, unlock new locations, and immerse yourself in the resort atmosphere!
howToPlay: Complete tasks in levels and open new locations. Hold and drag the left mouse button to drag and drop the blocks.

title: Match them up!
description: Match Them Up! is a relaxing 3D matching puzzle where you search for pairs of identical objects scattered around the room. Tap to match, clear the space, and beat your best time! With smooth controls and colorful toon visuals, every round feels satisfying and fun.
howToPlay: Your goal is to find and match pairs of identical objects scattered around the room. Select an item with the right mouse button. Move the camera by dragging with the right mouse button, rotate it by dragging with the left mouse button, and zoom using the mouse wheel. Match all pairs to clear the level and beat your best time!

title: Star Wing
description: Earth's last hope is in your hands, take control of the lone spaceship and protect Earth from alien swarms. Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies. In this space shooting game, you will be facing an increasingly large number of enemies in hazardous environments. As the game progresses, you will earn the right to upgrade your spacecraft to unleash its full lethal capacity.
howToPlay: Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies and collect items to upgrade or change your weapons.

title: Cooking Letters - Word Search
description: - Start Your Culinary Adventure. When you enter the kitchen you will see a variety of tasty letters scattered across the game board. Each letter is an ingredient for creating words. - Find All the Hidden Words. Your goal is to find all the words from the list hidden on the game board. The faster you complete the task the more points you earn. - Unlock New Levels. As you progress you will unlock new levels where the words get longer and the challenges become more exciting. Cook up increasingly complex dishes made of letters. - Earn Rewards. For every word you find you earn points. Use them to unlock additional bonuses or new kitchen themes. - Train Your Brain. This game is not only fun but also helps improve focus vocabulary and quick thinking.
howToPlay: - Collect Words. Swipe your finger or use your cursor to connect the letters and form words. You can connect letters in any direction horizontally vertically diagonally or even zigzag.

title: Police Drift Escape
description: Police Drift Escape is a fast, simple, and addictive top-down drift survival game. You are the getaway driver. Police cars are coming from every direction. Drift, dodge, collect cash, and make the police crash into each other before they catch you. There is no road. No traffic. No complicated rules. Just pure arcade chasing on a clean open surface. Drift to Survive Your car keeps moving. Use smooth control to turn, slide, and escape at the last second. The police cars are faster, but they cannot turn as sharply as you. Use that advantage to make them miss. A perfect drift can save you. A wrong move can end the chase. Make Police Crash You do not need weapons. Your best weapon is your driving skill. Bait police cars into following you, turn at the right moment, and watch them crash into each other. Every police crash gives you more score and makes the escape more satisfying. Grab the Cash Cash bundles appear during the chase. Collect them for extra rewards, but be careful. Some cash is placed in risky spots, and chasing it too greedily can get you caught. Normal cash gives quick rewards. Golden cash gives bigger rewards. But survival always comes first.
howToPlay: Control your car, avoid police, collect cash, and survive as long as possible. The longer you survive, the more intense the chase becomes. Police cars keep coming, the screen gets more dangerous, and every second matters.

title: Merge Mushroom

title: Cannon Ball 3D : Big Boom Obby
description: A satisfying physics puzzle shooter packed with 100 handcrafted stages. Take control of a powerful cannon, line up the perfect shot, and launch heavy cannonballs into towers, stacks, and tricky block formations. Your goal is simple: knock every block off the golden base plate before your shots run out. Each stage challenges you to think carefully about angle, force, timing, and momentum. Some levels can be cleared with brute force, while others require smart ricochets, chain reactions, and precise hits on weak points. As the stages progress, the layouts become more complex, with tougher structures, awkward angles, and fewer chances to make mistakes. With easy-to-learn controls, satisfying destruction, and clever physics-based puzzles, every shot matters. Aim well, make the blocks tumble, and clear all 100 stages to prove you are the ultimate cannon master.
howToPlay: How to play Tap anywhere on screen to fire at that spot. Each shot launches a heavy cannon ball with real physics. Knock every block off the base plate to clear the stage. Use fewer shots to earn more stars. Beat all 100 stages!

Everyone has their own design, rarity, and Easter eggs. Collect them all to add to the album. • Upgrade your hero: Improve your running speed and jump height. • Stylish skins: Buy and unlock unique looks for your character. • Base development: Invest your earnings in your own shelter.

title: Mahjong Pirate Plunder Quest
description: Mahjong Pirate Plunder Quest is a tile-matching puzzle game based on classic Mahjong solitaire. Players remove pairs of identical free tiles featuring pirate-themed icons—such as treasure chests, gold coins, parrots, cannons, ships, anchors, and skulls—to clear the board. The core concept revolves around a pirate treasure hunt, where progressing through levels represents a "plunder quest." Its distinctive feature is the immersive pirate theme that replaces traditional Mahjong symbols with vibrant, adventure-inspired graphics, creating a fun and thematic twist on the familiar matching gameplay.
howToPlay: Embark on a Pirate Treasure Quest! Set sail as a fearless pirate captain and plunder hidden riches across the Caribbean seas in this addictive Mahjong solitaire adventure. Match pairs of identical free tiles featuring vibrant pirate icons—like treasure chests, gold coins, parrots, cannons, ships, anchors, and skulls—to clear the board and claim your bounty! Your main goal is to remove all tiles from the board by finding and matching open pairs, earning up to 3 stars per level: 1 for completion, a second for finishing without hints, and a third for beating the time limit. Progress through over 4,000 levels, unlock new backgrounds, and tackle daily challenges to become the ultimate mahjong pirate! Desktop Controls: Left Mouse Click: Select a free tile to match with an identical one. Mobile Controls: Tap on Screen: Touch a free tile to select and match it with an identical one. If successful, the tile becomes yours. A soldier defeats another soldier if its level is higher; a level 4 soldier can attack any soldier. A house is destroyed immediately by any soldier. Economy — income: +1 per income tile (in a chain connected to a house) and +2 per house. If you lack gold for upkeep, soldiers die starting with the most expensive.

title: Bubble Smash

Aim and launch bubbles into the playfield, merge matching ones to pop them in satisfying chains, and clear each level's goals before you run out of moves. Chain pops together to trigger explosive combos, unleash power-ups when you're stuck, and work your way across a colorful level map. Easy to pick up, tricky to master — one more pop is never enough.

The parking lot is completely gridlocked, and it’s up to you to clear the mess! Use your logic and strategy to slide the cars, unblock the path, and guide everyone safely to the exit. It looks simple, but the puzzles get trickier as you go. Can you untangle the chaos and become the ultimate parking master? 🌟 Key Features: - Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn, incredibly hard to put down. - Vibrant 3D Graphics: Bright, smooth, and deeply satisfying visuals. - Endless Levels: Hundreds of brain-teasing parking lots to clear. - Stress-Free: No timers or penalties. Just relax and solve at your own pace!

howToPlay: Roll the dice, buy properties, and collect rent to build your business empire.

title: Max: The secret of Grandpa's letter
description: A treasure hunt quest. Meet Max, a young wolf who dreams of adventure. One day, Max receives a letter from his late grandfather, who, like any good grandfather, always loved to play riddles with his grandson. Even after he passed away. With the letter, Max receives a treasure map and mysterious clues from his grandfather's old notebook. This means it's time to pack a backpack and embark on a journey! Embarking on an exciting journey, our friendly wolf cub will face simple yet fun challenges. Max's path leads to the mysterious Island of Lost Ships, where the routes of sailors end and the adventures of true treasure hunters begin! With enthusiasm and a wagging tail, Max sets out to find his grandfather's treasure. Are you ready to unravel mysteries and become true adventurers alongside him? Let's embark on a new journey of discovery!

Perfect for those who love customization and creativity. Game features include: buying cars, spray painting, gluing films and stickers, and selling your masterpieces at auction. You can discover new colors, films and stickers in the store for even more variety.

You are an elevator guard who must not allow emerging monsters to penetrate from floor to floor. - Clear the floors - Save people - Earn money - Unlock new weapons Key game features: - simple controls - large selection of weapons - various levels - stylized zombie shooting gallery

Experience adrenaline-pumping action without downloads or registration across multiple platforms.

title: Mix & Paint 3D
description: Mix & Paint 3D is a relaxing color-mixing and 3D painting puzzle. Choose pigments, blend the target shade on your palette, then paint each object and see how closely your result matches. Every level combines hands-on mixing, satisfying painting, and an accuracy challenge.

Click or tap a pigment to load the brush, then hold and drag across the palette to mix colors. During painting, hold and drag to move the brush or spray across the object. Use Clear, Hint, and Done by clicking or tapping their buttons. The game uses a mouse or touchscreen; no keyboard keys are required.

title: Capybara-HexaSort
description: Capybara Hexa Sort is a relaxing color-sorting puzzle game with a cheerful capybara theme. Place stacks of colorful hexagonal tiles on the board and watch matching top colors merge automatically. Plan every move, complete increasingly challenging level goals, collect rewards, and enjoy a satisfying blend of strategy and cozy visuals.
howToPlay: Place a hex tile stack from the bottom tray onto an empty cell on the board. Stacks with matching top colors that touch each other will automatically sort and merge. Keep combining colors to clear tiles and reach the level goal before the board runs out of free cells. Complete the goal to win; if there is no room for another stack, the level is lost. Mobile: Tap or drag a stack, then release it over an empty board cell. Desktop: Click and drag with the left mouse button, then release over an empty board cell. Use the in-game buttons for boosters, pause/settings, sound, music, and haptics.

title: 2048 checkers

title: Obby Upgrade Your Speed!

title: Tall Grass
description: Every blade of tall grass hides something: a shard, a heart or a monster. Trample it and find out. Cleared tiles reveal how many monsters lurk in the eight tiles around them, so every step is a read as much as a gamble. The gate opens before the field is cleared: leave with what you have or push deeper for the shards and upgrades you'll need when the Pumpking wakes. No two days play the same. The weather turns over each morning — rain slows the waking, mist shortens what you can read, frost slows the whole field, dusk cuts the light — and something is hiding in every field that only a careful eye will find. One thumb, one verb, fully turn-based: nothing happens until you move, so there are no reflexes to fail.
howToPlay: Tap or swipe to step one tile, or use the arrow keys / WASD, or click. Tall grass hides shards, hearts and monsters. Stepping on it cuts it down. A number on a cleared tile counts the hidden monsters in the eight tiles around it. Step into a woken monster to strike it. It strikes back if it survives. Every 4 shards, choose a boon. Shards light the rail along the top of the field. When the rail fills the gate opens — then decide whether to leave or keep going. Today's weather changes how the field behaves. Something is hiding in plain sight in every field; find it and see what has been visiting. Find one each day to build a streak.

title: A Long Way Home
description: A Long Way Home is a chilling survival horror game that plunges you into the role of a lost wanderer, desperately trying to find their way back home. Stranded in an eerie, ever-changing landscape, you must navigate through shadowy corridors and odd places while being relentlessly pursued by strange, otherworldly creatures. As reality begins to unravel, you'll encounter haunting visions and unsettling experiences that blur the line between fear and madness. Will you uncover the truth behind your nightmarish journey or succumb to the horrors lurking in the dark? Prepare for a gripping tale of survival, mystery, and terror in A Long Way Home.
howToPlay: You're a lost wanderer. Explore the haunted world using Arrows or WASD. Use your mouse to control the camera Find hidden notes that expand the universe. Collect all the hidden Foxes.

title: Abandoned Mansion
description: Abandoned Mansion is a first-person horror game set in an abandoned mansion, where a distress call leads you to investigate. Upon arrival, you realize it’s too late. The game features item interaction, challenging puzzles, and terrifying monsters. Features: Optimized 3D graphics and realistic sound effects Immersive and thrilling music Multiple levels to test your skills Variety of enemy types Boss fights Puzzles to solve Exploration of the abandoned building Hidden rooms and items "Abandoned Mansion" will test your courage and survival skills. Can you unravel the mansion's mystery and face its monstrous inhabitants? Play now to find out.
howToPlay: W, A, S, D - Move E - Interact R - Reload C - Crouch Tab - Open inventory Space - Jump Left mouse button - Attack/Shoot

title: Clash of Skulls
description: Clash of Skulls is a tower defense game where you try to prevent enemies from destroying your base by deploying various types of units. Face a dangerous horde of evil creatures that intend to invade your lands. Combine and level up your units to have the upper hand and increase your damage output. Once you've taken care of the defense part, you can start planning your attacks to take over your enemy's territory. Hire skeleton warriors with blades, spears, scythes, explosives, battering rams, and much more... Go ahead and try it. Clash of Skulls rules! This side-scrolling strategy game features a lane-based tug-of-war mechanic where players deploy diverse skeleton units to destroy the opponent's fortified tower. The gameplay loop centers on managing a regenerating mana resource to summon units from a card-based hand, including melee warriors, archers, and heavy-hitting bosses like the hog rider. Each unit automatically marches right toward the enemy base, engaging in combat upon contact. Victory is achieved by depleting the enemy tower's health bar displayed at the top of the screen. The visual style is a clean 2D cartoon aesthetic with flat vector graphics against a bright, tranqu…
howToPlay: Destroy the opponent tower base by deploying the skull warriors. Desktop: Use mouse click on cards to deploy units on the battlefield. Mobile : Use screen touch on cards to deploy units on the battlefield.

title: Dronner 3D
description: Dronner 3D - Immerse yourself in dynamic racing in a unique car that can turn into a quadcopter and overcome exciting tracks.
howToPlay: Dronner 3D - Immerse yourself in dynamic racing in a unique car that can turn into a quadcopter and overcome exciting tracks. Collect points and battery charges, avoid collisions that are especially dangerous in quadcopter mode, and monitor damage status and battery charge levels. As you progress through levels, upgrade your car by increasing battery capacity and repairing damage. At the end of each level you will find a table with statistics where you can evaluate your achievements. Desktop Controls: 1. Movement on the ground: ↑ (Up Arrow) or W : Move forward. ↓ (Down Arrow) or W : Move back. ← (Left Arrow) or A : Move left. → (Right Arrow) or D : Move right. 2. Switching modes: Spacebar: Transform the machine into a quadcopter and back. 3. Air control: ↑ (Up Arrow) or W : Move forward. ↓ (Down Arrow) or W : Move back. ← (Left Arrow) or A : Move left. → (Right Arrow) or D : Move right. Q: Move upward. E: Move downward.

title: Rolling Balancer Ball
description: Rolling Balance Ball 3D is a simple but challenging balance game where your main goal is to guide a rolling ball across narrow wooden bridges surrounded by water. You must keep the ball steady, avoid traps, and safely reach the boat at the end of each level. The gameplay feels physics-based, so small moves matter one wrong swipe and the ball can fall into the water.
howToPlay: Swipe left / right → move the ball left or right. Drag forward → roll the ball forward (you can go faster or slower depending on how you drag). When traps come, slow down and align the ball straight before crossing. Keep balancing until you reach the end. Reach the boat to finish the level.

title: Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City

title: Sugar Blast: Snowy Pop
description: Sugar Blast: Welcome to Snowy Pop! 🍫💥 Join 125 thrilling levels filled with colorful candies, plan your moves, and put your skills to the test. 🎯🧩 But be careful! ⚠️🍬 Some candies hide bombs that can cost you your life. Every move counts! ⏳❤️ Level up your abilities: boost your tapping power, increase your starting lives, and unleash powerful candy bombs to clear the screen in a single strike! 🍭🚀 Each level gets tougher, keeping the fun fresh and intense. 🏆🔥 Unlock 9 mysterious achievements, grow stronger, and prove your mastery! 🎖️🔮 With support for 8 languages (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese), you can share the same excitement with players from all around the world. 🌍🗣️

title: Zombie Raid

The city has been overrun by monsters, and only you can clear the streets and stop the growing threat. Unlock new characters, buy and upgrade weapons, earn resources, and find the best playstyle for each challenge. You will have access to a wide range of equipment, from bats and crossbows to lightsabers and blasters. Each new mission becomes harder, and the enemies become more dangerous. Survive, upgrade your loadout, and prove that you can stop the zombie onslaught. Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do? A: The game is about survival, where you need to fend off waves of zombies. Q: Is there a storyline in the game? Buy new equipment, unlock characters, and improve your chances of survival. Choose the right weapon for each mission and do not let the enemies surround you. title: Slinger

Who knows, maybe it's up to you to find the antidote to the virus and save humanity... - The world of the zombie apocalypse. - An exciting storyline. - Hordes of zombies from the simplest to the mutated. - A variety of weapons from the real world. - Various weapon modules and a leveling system.

title: Dragon Block Blast
description: Hatch your dragon. Clear the grid. Rise through 100 levels. Deep in an enchanted forest, a golden dragon egg waits on a stone altar. Your block puzzle skills are the magic that brings it to life. In Dragon Egg Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — each one a score challenge on an 8×8 grid. Clear rows and columns, chain combos, and hit the target before you run out of moves. Every 10 levels, your egg evolves: cracks spread, a hatchling emerges, wings unfurl, and by the end a mighty dragon stands at your side. Beat Level 25 to unlock Head to Head duels. Complete all 100 levels for the full dragon evolution finale.
howToPlay: How to Play — Dragon Egg Quest Enter the quest — Tap Dragon Egg Quest from the home screen. Pick your level on the forest map (new levels unlock as you clear the one before). Place blocks — Drag pieces from the tray onto the 8×8 grid. You always have 3 pieces; when they’re all used, a fresh set appears. Clear lines for points — Fill a full row or column to blast it away and earn bonus points. Chain multiple clears for combo multipliers. Hit the score goal — Each level has a score target that climbs as you advance. Reach it to clear the level — there’s no clock in solo mode, but the grid can fill up. Watch your dragon grow — Every 10 levels triggers an egg milestone: your dragon evolves on the campaign map, with new backdrops and story beats as you progress. Earn rewards — Clearing levels earns coins for hints and cosmetics. Stuck with no valid moves? Watch a short ad to get fresh blocks and keep going. Unlock the full game — Reach Level 25 to unlock Head to Head rival duels. Push to Level 100 to complete the quest and see your dragon’s final form.

title: Axe Run

Download now and start rolling through the clouds!
howToPlay: ⬅️ ➡️ Move Left / Right ⬆️ Jump ⬇️ Slow Down / Brake 💰 Collect Coins ⚠️ Avoid Obstacles 🏁 Reach the Finish Line 🌀 Use Boost Pads to Speed Up

title: STORMHAWK
description: STORMHAWK is a vertical arcade shooter — a shmup — built to be played with one hand. Fly 32 hand-built missions over the Pacific, dodge with a barrel roll, and chain kills to multiply your score. What makes it different from other plane shooters: everything you earn goes somewhere. Land after a mission and spend it in the hangar, unlock twelve planes that each fly differently, and pick roguelite cards mid-run so no two campaigns stack the same way. Six modes, including a Daily mission everyone plays identically and a Boss Rush against all 32 bosses back to back.
howToPlay: Goal: survive each mission, beat its boss, and land to bank what you collected. Chain kills without missing to raise the multiplier — the score is what puts you on the leaderboard. Touch: drag anywhere to fly; the plane follows your finger. Firing is automatic. Tap with a second finger to barrel roll — you are invincible for a moment and nearby bullets turn into points. Hold that second finger to slow down and tighten your shot. Keyboard: arrows or WASD to fly, Z to fire, X to barrel roll, C for the special attack, P or Esc to pause. All keys can be remapped in Settings.

title: Stick Box - Ragdoll Slowmo
description: Immerse yourself in a frantic action game starring a flexible blue ragdoll! Pull his body, help him overcome obstacles, and engage in dynamic battles against hordes of red stickmen. Each level is a new challenge, where not only dexterity but also strategy are essential. Unlock new weapons: boxing gloves, knives, bats, pistols, and even unexpected objects that transform into powerful weapons. ⚔️ Key Features: 💥 Realistic ragdoll physics – funny and spectacular! 🔫 Huge arsenal: from gloves to firearms. 👊 Levels with enemies and powerful bosses. 🎮 Simple controls: pull, hit, win!
howToPlay: 🎯 Game Objective: Defeat all enemies and bosses, completing levels one after another. Use agility and strength to control your ragdoll character, collect weapons, and survive the most chaotic battles. 🎮 Controls: Click and drag your character's body to move around the level. Drag their arms to attack enemies. Pick up weapons by touching them. Use items to inflict more damage on enemies.

title: Block Puzzle Magic
description: Block Puzzle Magic is a simple yet addictive puzzle game that challenges players to arrange blocks on a grid to clear full rows and columns. It blends relaxing gameplay with a bit of strategy: you can play in a few seconds to refresh your mind, but thinking ahead helps you last longer.
howToPlay: You’re given a fixed grid (often 10×10) into which you must place (drag) blocks of various shapes. You drag block pieces from a preview area and drop them onto the grid. You have to find space where the block fits. When you completely fill an entire horizontal row or vertical column with blocks, that entire row/column clears out (is removed), and you score points. You cannot rotate the block pieces — they must be used in the shape presented. Because the blocks come in various shapes, you need to plan placements intelligently so you don’t block yourself from placing future pieces. The game ends when there is no more space to place any of the current block pieces. When none of the available block pieces can fit anywhere on the grid, the game ends. Your final score depends on how many rows/columns (and combos) you cleared

title: Grow a Garden 3D

howToPlay: Desktop Controls: [ WASD ] - Move Hold Right/Left Mouse Button and Rotate the Mouse to look Arround [ LMB (Left Mouse Button) ] - Plant Seed [ Space ] - Jump [ E ] - Intreact [Buy/Sell/Collect] [ Tab ] - Inventory Mobile Controls: JoyStick to Move around and Drag On the Right side to look arround Buttons for Picking up item and Planting also for Other such as Jumping Thre game has an In-game Tutorial which Guide the player.

title: Ragdoll Fury

Wield an arsenal of 15 blades and guns across five classes — from Knife and Katana to Sawn-off, Machine Gun and Grenade Launcher — with a premium Laser Blade and Minigun to unlock with gems. Many pack their own special move: ground slam, spin, dash, blade throw. Each wave hits harder: armored robots, kamikaze bombers, shield bots and towering bosses, while special waves throw hordes and gold rushes at you. After every wave pick one of three roguelite upgrades — damage, crit, burn, freeze, chain explosions, knockback and dozens more. Chain the elements into combos (shatter, wildfire, detonation), and at wave 10 trigger your weapon's EVOLUTION. Ring out enemies, keep your combo alive and climb the leaderboard.
howToPlay: • Melee: drag the weapon with your finger (or mouse) — the faster you swing, the harder you hit and the farther enemies fly. • Ranged: move to aim at enemies — it fires automatically, or tap FIRE. • Special: tap the glowing button when charged (ground slam, spin, dash, blade throw and more). • After each wave pick 1 of 3 upgrades and shape your build. • Between waves spend run coins to reroll, heal or banish a card. • Combine effects into elemental combos (shatter, burn, detonation), and from wave 10 trigger your weapon's EVOLUTION.

You can also get cool knives, swords, and daggers from the shop. The goal of this game is to hit all the targets and become the greatest knife-throwing maniac. Collect the loot in your backpack and stack it in a mesmerizing Tetris-style puzzle. Get ready for a game that combines strategic excavation and exciting loot stacking! 🗺️ Focus on the map 💎 Dig deeper into the fascinating landscapes to find precious items 🎒 Collect the loot in your backpack ⚡️ Stack them in a mesmerizing Tetris-style puzzle 🧩 Stack gems, coins, and more to maximize your treasure profit 🛠️ Upgrade your tools and unlock new maps as you delve deeper into the adventure 🌟 Test your skill, strategy, and luck in this addictive game!

title: Nexus Override

Face increasingly dangerous enemies across 6 unique sectors, each with its own difficulty and boss. Can you outlast the system? Easy to learn - hard to master! ✨ Game Features: 🔥 Fun and addictive food sorting gameplay 🥩 Match 3 grilled foods to clear the board 🌽 Juicy BBQ visuals and a relaxing atmosphere 🍤 Hundreds of satisfying puzzle levels ⚡ Easy controls and smooth gameplay 🏆 Perfect for fans of cozy sorting & puzzle games 🍖 New foods, new challenges in every level 🍔 Can you become the ultimate Grill Master and sort every dish to perfection? Fire up the grill, sharpen your senses, and start matching now!

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! title: 4 Clues 1 Word
description: Think you’re a master of language? Put your lateral thinking to the test with 4 Clues 1 Word, the word puzzle game that goes beyond the surface. Most games ask you to find a simple object; we ask you to find the hidden connection between worlds. Whether it’s the Stock in a financial market, a pot of Stock on a stove, or the Stock in a warehouse—your job is to find the one word that rules them all. Featuring stunning, high-definition photography and curated levels ranging from "Casual" to "Mind-Bending," 4 Clues 1 Word is designed for the curious, the clever, and the linguistically brave. It’s not just a game; it’s a workout for your synapses. Can you see the pattern?
howToPlay: Observe the Imagery: Each level presents you with three or four distinct images. Look closely—one might be a physical object, another an abstract concept, and the third an action. Find the Common Thread: Identify the single word that applies to all images. Remember: we love polysemy (words with multiple meanings). A "Draft" could be a cold breeze or a rough sketch of a masterpiece. Type Your Answer: Use the provided letter tiles to spell out the word.sss Use Your Intuition (and Hints): Stuck on a particularly "Hard" level? Expose a Letter: Reveal a single correct letter in the word. Remove Tiles: Get rid of letters that aren't part of the solution. Climb the Ranks: Progress through hundreds of levels. The further you go, the more abstract the connections become. Pro Tip: If you're stuck, try saying the names of the objects out loud. Sometimes the ear catches what the eye misses!
