howToPlay: Take turns guessing words in Player vs. Player mode, or race against the clock in Player vs. Bot mode. Earn a random number of points for each guessed word. The player with the most points wins.

title: Portal Hop
description: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle game where you carry a portal above your head and use it to solve tricky challenges! Move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms, collecting plus and minus power-ups to adjust the height of your portal. Think smart, plan your moves, and find the perfect path to reach your destination. Ready to warp your way to victory
howToPlay: Warp: Press the W key or the Up Arrow key to warp or move upward quickly. Move: Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right Arrow keys to control movement in different directions. Reset: Press the R key at any time to restart or reset the current level.

title: Mole Kingdom Defense
description: Mole Kingdom Defense is a charming tower defense adventure filled with brave little moles and endless battles! Build your ultimate mole army, recruit powerful heroes, and defend your kingdom against waves of dangerous enemies. Each mole warrior has unique abilities—from fearless fighters and sharp archers to powerful mages with devastating magic. Upgrade your heroes, unlock stronger weapons, and create the perfect strategy to defeat bosses and conquer challenging stages. With colorful graphics, adorable characters, and addictive idle progression, Mole Kingdom Defense offers endless fun for players of all ages. Game Features: • Cute and funny mole heroes • Strategic tower defense gameplay • Multiple hero classes and upgrades • Fight epic bosses and enemy waves • Idle rewards and easy progression • Beautiful cartoon graphics and animations Defend your kingdom and lead the Mole Army to victory!
howToPlay: • Recruit brave mole heroes with different abilities. • Arrange your team wisely to create the strongest defense. • Defeat waves of enemies and powerful bosses. • Collect coins and resources after every battle. • Upgrade heroes, weapons, and skills to become stronger. • Unlock new stages and protect the Mole Kingdom from invasion. Use your strategy, strengthen your army, and become the greatest Mole Commander!

title: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle
description: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle offers a fun brain challenge where you strategically unscrew pieces to solve puzzles. Enjoy this free online game without downloads, perfect for fans of strategy and logical thinking, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment.
howToPlay: 💡 Begin by tapping to remove nuts and bolts. This action causes wooden plates, which are pinned to a board, to fall strategically. The game’s complexity lies in how these elements interact, pushing you to think critically. 🎯 Aim to unscrew all the nuts and bolts smartly. Each puzzle has the core elements of wood, nuts, and bolts uniquely, demanding careful thought and precision. 🧐 Every move you make can determine success or failure. Plan and proceed your strategies to navigate through the puzzles and claim victory.

title: Ocean Pop
description: Ocean Pop brings a delightful new twist to the blast genre, inviting players of all ages to dive into a lively underwater world brimming with charm and color. Unlike typical grid-based games like Toy Blast, Ocean Pop features real 2D bubbles that drift, bounce, and cluster with natural, playful physics, creating puzzles that feel dynamic and alive. Players dive beneath the waves to pop colorful bubbles, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and explore the serene beauty of the ocean depths — all while enjoying intuitive gameplay that’s easy to pick up yet delightfully challenging to master.
howToPlay: Use the mouse to pop matched colored bubbles to reach the target of the level Use powerups in the right moment to have the best results.

title: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie
description: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie - Your Camp, Your Rules! You are the leader of a survivor group in the heart of a zombie apocalypse. This is a thrilling idle tycoon strategy where your goal is to protect the barrier, gather resources, and survive! A true survival simulator for those who love camp management and crushing hordes of enemies. What awaits you: ✅ Trap Defense: Protect your barrier! Research and install deadly gear - from deadly spikes to massive decoy bombs! ✅ Relocation & Progress: Don't stay still! Move between motels and farms, upgrade your camp, and unlock new zones. ✅ Scavenging Runs: Send your team for fuel. It’s a classic survival strategy - every drop of gas counts! ✅ Camp Evolution: Develop your facilities, automate your income, and become the ultimate master of the wasteland! Strengthen the barrier, gear up your scouts, and hit the gas. Become a survival legend right now!
howToPlay: 🛡 Protect the barrier: Your main goal is to prevent the zombie horde from breaking into the camp. 🏗 Place traps: Simply drag defensive devices from the bottom panel to the highlighted zones on the battlefield. 💰 Complete quests: Follow the quest list to earn resources and grow your camp's economy. 🚀 Upgrade everything: Click on buildings and objects to increase their durability, damage, or income. 🖱 Interact: Click directly on zombies and objects on the map to actively assist your survivors. Controls: Mouse: Click and drag (to install traps), left-click (for menus and actions).

title: Drill the Snake
description: Snake Drill is a casual arcade defense game where you protect the surface from giant segmented snakes crawling up from underground tunnels. A giant segmented snake is crawling up through winding tunnels toward the surface, and your only weapon is a swinging pendulum drill. Time your strikes to shatter the snake's body segment by segment before its head breaks through. Upgrade your drill, use a roguelike card system that changes every run. Swing your drill like a pendulum, time your attack, and shatter the snake's body segment by segment before its head reaches the surface. Simple to pick up, hard to master. One button. One drill. One chance to stop what's coming.
howToPlay: Stop the Snake Before It's Too Late! Take control of a powerful drill and defend the surface from massive segmented snakes crawling up from underground. In this intense arcade defense game, you'll time your strikes to shatter the snake's body piece by piece. Swing your drill, aim carefully, and destroy every segment before the snake's head reaches the top! Desktop Controls: Tap to launch drill attack. Spacebar to launch drill attack. Mobile Controls: Tap to launch drill attack.

title: Left 4 Die
description: Left 4 Die is an intense survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic environment. Utilize strategy to face endless enemies in this web-based game with stunning graphics and responsive controls. Experience the excitement across various devices as you navigate dangers, wield formidable weapons, and adapt to survive.
howToPlay: WASD - move Left Mouse button - attack R - reload SPACE - jump 1 - 4 - select weapons. Approach the weapons dealer to buy weapons, the armor dealer - to buy armor, the barber - to change your appearance, the commander - to receive a new mission. Complete missions and kill zombies to earn money and experience. The higher your level, the more powerful equipment and higher rewards for missions you can obtain, but you will also face more numerous hordes of zombies chasing you.

title: Hard Working Man
description: Hard Working Man is an offline farming and survival simulator. Start with nothing, rebuild your farm, gather resources, and craft tools to create your dream homestead. Harvest berries and mushrooms, grow vegetables and fruit trees, go fishing, cook food, and expand your farm. Sell crops at the bazaar, buy seeds and tools, and build a workshop, forge, and even your own car from junk. Enjoy realistic survival mechanics, crafting, building, and resource management. Discover secrets, upgrade your farm, and prove you can build an empire from nothing! Perfect for fans of farming, crafting, and survival games.
howToPlay: Click on different resources to gather materials and use them to build houses, craft tools and create useful parts. Every action is based on clicking, so collect resources, upgrade buildings and progress step by step to grow your settlement

title: Neon Goal
description: Step into the Neon Arena and test your aim in this fun physics puzzle game! Your mission is simple: throw the ball and reach the net but the challenge is real because you have limited hits and obstacles are everywhere. Each level is a new puzzle where you must think, aim, and throw perfectly to win. If you love short, satisfying puzzle levels with neon style, Neon Goal is a perfect quick-play game for you.
howToPlay: Touch and drag to aim your throw Release your finger to shoot/throw the ball The ball will bounce and move based on physics Throw the ball into the net/goal Complete the level using limited hits/throws

title: The Upside Down
description: A tactical RPG where strategy meets the 80s: Outsmart the Gloom-Walkers and bring your dog home. 📹 Background December 1984: As the winter solstice nears, the veil over Black Hollow tears open, allowing shadow entities known as Gloom-Walkers to prey upon the unwary. While the town evacuates to escape the encroaching dark, young Eddie Sinclair stays behind, venturing alone into the snowy ghost town to rescue his best friend, Buddy.
howToPlay: 🕹️ How to play Explore the streets for upgrades and face the darkness, but return home to save and level up. Danger grows with every step away from safety—plan carefully and watch your Gloometer! Master four unique ways to fight: deploy your boombox to distract the shadows, leaving them rooted in place while you make your escape, blind them with your camera’s high-intensity flash, or launch powerful fireworks to blast the Gloom-Walkers into oblivion. How far will you go to save Buddy? - Objective: Reach the bottom-right corner of the map for the final showdown and rescue your dog. - Your Home: Located in the top-left corner. Return here to upgrade your stats and heal yourself by drinking found potions. - Survival Tip: Don't venture too far from home until you've grown powerful enough; the outskirts are unforgiving. - Scavenge: Explore city buildings to find superior slingshots and powerful "spells" (items). - Tactical Combat: Every action on the battlefield takes time. Once an action starts, it cannot be canceled until it’s finished—plan your moves wisely!

title: Copy the Drawing
description: An exciting drawing game with hundreds of levels! Look at the example and recreate the drawing on the canvas — the more accurate, the higher your score. The game features 300 levels across 18 categories: from simple shapes to animals, transport, space, fantasy, and Japanese culture. Every day brings a new drawing of the day — build your streak and compete with yourself! Three brush sizes, undo last stroke, hints, and a medal system — all designed to make drawing fun and enjoyable. Gold, silver, or bronze — which medal will your drawing earn?
howToPlay: 1. Choose a category and level 2. Look at the example at the top of the screen 3. Draw the same picture on the canvas below 4. Use three brush sizes for precise lines 5. Tap "Undo" to remove the last stroke, or "Clear" to start over 6. When you're happy with the result, tap "Check" 7. Get a match score and earn a medal: bronze (50%+), silver (70%+), or gold (90%+) 8. Unlock new levels and categories!

title: Furious GT Drift
description: Feel the roar of the engine and the thrill of burning rubber in Furious GT Drift! Take control of high-performance GT cars and master the art of drifting through neon streets, mountain passes, and blazing sunset highways. Every corner tests your precision, timing, and style as you push your ride to the limit. Customize your car, upgrade your handling, and chase new records with each drift combo you land. Earn rewards, unlock faster machines, and dominate every track with smooth slides and perfect angles.
howToPlay: use arrow keys or A/D to steer left and right. Feel the roar of the engine and the thrill of burning rubber in Furious GT Drift! Take control of high-performance GT cars and master the art of drifting through neon streets, mountain passes, and blazing sunset highways. Every corner tests your precision, timing, and style as you push your ride to the limit. Customize your car, upgrade your handling, and chase new records with each drift combo you land. Earn rewards, unlock faster machines, and dominate every track with smooth slides and perfect angles.

title: Viaducts
description: Viaducts - Relaxing Zen Puzzle Game Embark on a serene journey with Viaducts, the latest trending cozy, and meditative puzzle game designed to transport you into a world of calm challenges and scenic landscapes. Immerse yourself in the perfect blend of relaxation and strategy as you craft seamless paths for trains and objects using a limited number of attempts. Viaducts is more than just a puzzle game; It's a mindful escape into a world where challenges are met with grace, and success is achieved through thoughtful contemplation. Let the rhythmic flow of trains and the gentle rotation of bridge blocks guide you through this truly relaxing and trending gaming experience.
howToPlay: Desktop: - Click the blocks to rotate them - Use Scroll Wheel to zoom in and out - Click + Drag to pan camera around Phone/Tablet: - Tap the blocks to rotate them - Pinch to zoom in and out - Swipe to pan camera around

title: Save King
description: Save King is a fun pull-the-pin rescue puzzle game where your mission is to save the King, protect the royal family, and rebuild the kingdom. Each level gives you a tricky situation with pins, enemies, traps, and treasure you must pull the right pin at the right time to win. Use your brain, make smart moves, collect rewards, and upgrade your castle as the story continues.
howToPlay: Look at the full puzzle first 👀 See where the King/Queen/Princess, enemies, treasure, and danger are. Pull pins in the correct order 🧷 Your main job is to pull the pins to create a safe path and stop danger. One wrong pin can ruin the level. Defeat enemies & avoid traps ⚔️🔥 Use the puzzle logic to keep enemies away and avoid risky situations while saving the King. Collect coins & treasure 💰 Finish levels to earn rewards. Rebuild and upgrade your castle 🏰 Use your collected rewards to rebuild the castle and progress through more chapters.

title: Dream Room
description: Six unique rooms await you: a cozy bedroom, a stylish living room, a magical nursery, a charming kitchen, an atmospheric café, and a sunny balcony. In every room, you decide what goes where — total design freedom! Over 250 items: beds, sofas, wardrobes, side tables, lamps, plants, rugs, curtains, toys, paintings, windows with different views, and much more. Every item can be repainted in various colors and placed anywhere you like. Choose wallpapers and floors from dozens of options — from delicate stripes and hearts to starry skies and floral patterns. Place windows with views of the sea, mountains, a city at night, or an enchanted garden. Earn coins, unlock new rooms, and collect rare items!
howToPlay: 1. Choose the room you want to decorate 2. At the bottom of the screen, select a category: walls, floors, furniture, décor, windows, and more 3. Tap an item in the catalog, then tap anywhere in the room — the item will appear there 4. Drag items wherever you like — total placement freedom 5. Save your design and earn coins for new items 6. Spend coins in the shop on new furniture, wallpapers, and rooms 7. Complete challenges — themed tasks with rewards

title: Fishing: Catch the Moment!
description: A relaxing 3D fishing game with atmospheric locations, changing weather and time of day. Cast your line, master the fishing mini-game, discover rare fish, upgrade your tackle and unlock new fishing spots. Build your collection and catch the heaviest trophy!
howToPlay: Move the mouse or swipe left and right to aim. Press and hold to prepare the cast, then release to cast the line. Wait for a bite and press the screen or mouse button to hook the fish. During the fishing mini-game, keep the indicator inside the yellow zone. Successful critical catches can bring heavier and rarer fish. Sell your catch, upgrade your tackle and unlock new locations.

title: Uphill Racer2
description: Uphill Race2 is a fun and challenging physics-based driving game where you race across hilly terrain and rough roads. Control your car carefully, balance your speed, and climb as far as possible without flipping over. Collect coins, unlock new vehicles, and upgrade your ride to go even further. The farther you go, the harder it gets!
howToPlay: Use the left and right arrow keys (or on-screen buttons) to control your car. Right to accelerate Left to brake or reverse Keep your balance while driving uphill and downhill, avoid crashing, and collect coins along the way. Try to reach the longest distance possible and beat your best score!

title: Match Challenge
description: A simple but engaging matching challenge! Look at the variety of items at the bottom of the screen, and tap four that belong to the same category whether it's fruits, tools, animals, or household objects. Think fast, but choose wisely!
howToPlay: Observe a set of mixed items Tap to select four that share a common category Submit your match to check if you're right Race against the clock in later levels

title: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion
description: Help Tom & Angela to become Instagram famous. Buy and choose clothes, hairstyles, or accessories by following their moods. Make them look stunning on every occasion, take beautiful pictures to post on Instagram and receive lots of likes. Get their insta-ready outfits and have fun!

title: Mine Obby 3D: Car Wash Tycoon
description: 🚗 “Mine Obby 3D: Car Wash Tycoon” lets you build a small car wash and turn it into a huge automotive complex! 💦 Develop your car wash Unlock foam, brushes, rinsing, drying, polishing, and other services. 💰 Earn money Serve cars, wait for them to reach the cash register, and collect your earnings. 🏗️ Expand your business Build a gas station, café, and repair shop. Upgrade every facility to increase your income. 🚦 Manage the traffic Add more cars, improve their speed, and unlock gold, emerald, and diamond roads. 🐾 Collect pets Equip pets to increase your character’s running speed. ⭐ Unlock every upgrade and become the ultimate car wash tycoon!
howToPlay: 💻 PC: WASD - character movement 🏃 Right mouse button - rotate camera 🔄 Left mouse button - interact ⛏️ Space - jump 🦘 📱 Mobile devices: Joystick - character movement 🏃 Touch screen - rotate camera 🔄 Action button - interact ⛏️ Jump button - jump 🦘

title: Squishy Sheep
description: Your mission is to help an adorable cat friend collect every balloon in each level. All it takes is removing the right platform at just the right moment and letting physics do the magic. Every level is carefully designed to be solved with just a few clicks, while the sheep bounces across ledges and gathers balloons in delightful, unexpected ways. With fluid animations and a cute, inviting art style, Squishy Sheep keeps you coming back for more until every level is complete.
howToPlay: Tap (on touchscreen) or click with the left mouse button to remove a platform / obstacle. Timing is key remove platforms at just the right moment so physics does the rest. The goal in each level is to help your sheep collect all the balloons by bouncing off ledges and using gravity.

title: Find Capybara: Valley of Monsters
description: Welcome to a huge and crazy world where your main goal is to find and collect all the hidden capybaras! Explore a giant, diverse map with dizzying trampolines that will take you to the highest platforms. But be careful — the territories are guarded by dangerous monsters! Don't let yourself get caught. To fight back, you have a whole arsenal of funny but effective "slaps": a giant hand, a roll of toilet paper, or even a venerable bream fish! Stun the enemy and run on. Use special power-ups: a magic carpet for flying, a speed spring for a lightning-fast dash and a jump spring to conquer inaccessible places. For the capybaras you find, you will receive three unique skins for your character. Become the most stylish seeker! Ready for a big adventure? Launch the game, explore every corner and become a legendary capybara hunter!
howToPlay: The controls are simple and intuitive: Movement: Keys W, A, S, D Jump: Space bar (use it together with trampolines for super jumps!) The goal of the game is to explore the map, find and collect all the hidden capybaras. Look around! Capybaras can hide in the most unexpected places. Use trampolines and power-ups to reach the secret corners.

title: Draw & Drop
description: Dive into the thrilling universe of Draw & Drop, where creativity and skill collide! Navigate the ball into a basket by sketching your route, while overcoming tricky obstacles. Test your ingenuity through various levels, available for free on both mobile and desktop. Enjoy the challenge!
howToPlay: -Draw a line where you can direct the ball to the goal -Click on the ball or the "start" icon in the Top Right to start -The ball will move along the line you drew. -The level passes when the ball hits the Target.

title: Funny Rescue Pet
description: Lica and Purry had an accident! Lica's house is on fire, and Purry is soak wet when she played inside the wall. How can it happen? Rescue them immediately and also give them some makeover!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Bubble Shooter Island Quest
description: Bubble Shooter Island Quest is an enchanting bubble shooter puzzle game set in a lush jungle island paradise. Its core concept involves launching colorful bubbles from a pirate bird's cannon to match 3+ of the same color—reds, blues, yellows, and specials like eggs and coins—causing chain reactions to pop clusters and clear encroaching bubble walls before they reach the bottom. Unique elements include a charming red parrot pirate shooter, power-up barrels (rainbow, lightning, ice), gem/coin collection for upgrades, star/trophy goals per level, and tropical vibes with vines and barrels for immersive, relaxing yet addictive play.
howToPlay: **Blast the Bubbles Away!** **Embark on a tropical adventure in Bubble Shooter Island Quest and clear every bubble cluster from the jungle canopy before they reach the bottom!** **In this enchanting bubble shooter puzzle, aim and launch colorful bubbles—reds, blues, yellows, plus specials like eggs and coins—from your pirate parrot's cannon to match 3+ of the same color, triggering chain reactions to pop massive groups. Collect gems/coins for upgrades, hit star/trophy goals (e.g., 0/5 eggs), and conquer levels amid vines and barrels!** **Desktop Controls:** **Mouse Drag/Aim:** Drag to aim the bubble from the cannon. **Mouse Click/Release:** Fire the bubble to match and pop. **Barrel Buttons:** Click power-ups (🌈 Rainbow, ⚡ Lightning, ❄️ Ice) when available. **|| Button:** Pause/Resume. **35 Shots:** Manage your limited ammo wisely. **Mobile Controls:** **Drag to Aim:** Swipe/drag on screen to aim the next bubble. **Tap/Release:** Tap or release to shoot and match 3+. **On-Screen Barrels:** Tap power-ups (🌈, ⚡, ❄️) for special effects. **|| Button:** Pause/Resume gameplay.

title: Shot a Brainrot!
description: Shot a Brainrot! Is an exciting 3D shooter game in which your task is to defeat your enemies. Dynamic battle scenes, challenging opponents, and several different weapons! Join the meme universe and win!
howToPlay: Character movement: W, A, S, D Running: Shift Jump: Space Bar Camera rotation: Mouse Attack: Left mouse button Aiming: right mouse button Recharge: R Interaction with objects: E Weapon change: mouse wheel

title: Idle Pop Merge
description: 🎮 MERGE, TAP, CONQUER! 🎮 Welcome to the ultimate cartoon merge adventure! Start with one tiny fighter and build an unstoppable team of 32 unique toon warriors! 🌟 SIMPLE YET ADDICTIVE GAMEPLAY Merge identical fighters to unlock powerful new characters Tap to boost attack speed and demolish enemies faster Strategic placement on your 3x3 battle grid matters! ⚔️ EPIC ARENA BATTLES Conquer 120 challenging enemies across multiple arenas Face single, double, and triple arena challenges Each victory brings you closer to unlocking new fighters!
howToPlay: Drag and drop the characters into the available slots to combine and merge them into powerful new forms!

title: Help Me: Tricky Story of Puzzles
description: Help Me: Tricky Story of Puzzles - a casual game with logical challenges, 2D graphics, intuitive controls, tough situations, and funny scenarios for all ages. Help the character pick up the right tools while avoiding all obstacles on the way. You will be surprised at how funny the game situation will unfold after each step of your solution. Can you find a solution and help the characters? Unleash your creativity and enjoy the game. Start training your brain right now! Game Feature: - Nice 2D graphics 🎨 - Simple and very addictive gameplay 🔥 - Lots of funny situations 🤡 - Unusual game idea 🎭
howToPlay: - Click on the character and start dragging the hand; - Hold and drag over various obstacles to reach items; - Choose the right item that will help the character get out of a difficult situation.

title: Slappy Bird
description: Instead of controlling the bird, you control the green pipes. Time your smashes perfectly to crush birds as they fly through the gap and collect coins for every successful hit. But don't let too many escape—missing three birds ends the run. Spend your coins on permanent upgrades to increase coin rewards, reduce smash cooldown, and improve the chance of rare golden birds worth bonus coins. Test your reflexes, beat your high score, and see how long you can keep the skies clear! Key Features: Smash birds to earn coins Endless high-score challenge Permanent upgrades Rare golden birds with bonus rewards Simple controls, fast-paced action
howToPlay: Mobile: Tap anywhere on the screen to smash the pipes. Desktop: Click the left mouse button or press Spacebar to smash the pipes.

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo Games
description: 🎨 Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo offers a unique and creative experience where you not only create stunning ink tattoos but also dress up characters in trending outfits! Dive into the world of fashion and tattoos, where your artistic talents can shine in more ways than one.
howToPlay: 💄 In this game, you’ll have the chance to design beautiful ink tattoos for a variety of characters. But that's not all! You can also choose stylish outfits and accessories to give each character a complete makeover. From tattooing intricate designs to dressing them up in the latest fashion trends, the possibilities are endless!

title: Graveyard Wars - Two player
description: Are you ready for a competitive game between the Mummy and the Pumpkin King? Yes, someone has to win! Team up with a friend and choose either the Mummy or the Pumpkin King.Collect as many flying pumpkins as you can! You can earn coins by eating candy and win the game by collecting all the pumpkins. Catch the balloons and bring them to the treasure chest. The fastest collector wins! Different hats await you as you win. So, gather your friends, race, and collect all the pumpkins!
howToPlay: *Use 'WASD' keys and 'Arrow Keys' to move. *Playable on both mobile and PC. *Four different hats are available in the shops. *The player who collects 10 pumpkins the fastest wins.

title: Block Match 3D
description: Block Match 3D is a relaxing yet brain-teasing 3D puzzle where you take apart a giant cube of blocks, piece by piece. Every block carries a cute icon — donuts, animals, emoji, music and more. Match blocks to the active category goals, dig deeper into the structure, and clear the whole cube before the timer runs out. Simple to pick up, tricky to master: plan your taps wisely, because the storage bar at the bottom fills up fast. Dozens of levels, colorful icon collections, and handy boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Magic Wand and Undo will keep you matching for hours!
howToPlay: – Tap any block with an open face to pick it up — buried blocks can't be taken yet. – If the block's icon matches one of the goal chips at the top, it flies straight to that goal. – Any other block goes to the storage bar at the bottom. If the bar overflows, you lose — so don't hoard! – Complete a goal chip and the next category slides in; stored blocks of that category fly to it automatically. – Clear all the categories before the timer runs out to win the level. – Stuck? Use boosters: Hint finds a matching block, Magic Wand collects one instantly, Shuffle rearranges icons, and Undo returns your last block.

title: Deorbit - Space Survivors
description: Deorbit is a fast-paced top-down space survivor shooter. You command a lone starship stranded in hostile sectors, and wave after wave of enemy swarms close in from every direction. Your weapons fire automatically — your job is to fly, dodge, and stay alive as the horde grows. Vacuum up glowing XP orbs to level up mid-run, then choose from a hand of upgrade cards to shape your build on the fly — more firepower, drones, shields, and devastating new abilities. Crack open chests that drop into the battlefield for extra loot, push through 10 escalating phases per sector, and brace for massive boss encounters that can turn the tide. Every run earns gold. Spend it back at your hangar to permanently upgrade your ship, unlock new vessels, and gear up before diving back in. Claim daily rewards, chase new records, and see how deep into the sectors you can survive. No two runs play the same. Think you can beat your best score? Suit up, Commander. Tips Grab XP orbs to level up, then pick the upgrade cards that fit your build. Open chests for bonus drones, cells, and items during a run. Spend gold in the hangar between runs to make your ship permanently stronger. Survive to face the sector boss…
howToPlay: PC Move: WASD or Arrow keys Aim & shoot: Automatic Open a chest: Press F when standing next to it (or click the OPEN button) Pause: On-screen pause button Mobile Move: Drag the on-screen joystick (it appears wherever you touch) Aim & shoot: Automatic Open a chest: Tap the OPEN button when you're next to it Play in landscape orientation

title: Trash Baron
description: Trash Baron: Turn trash into treasure! Have you ever thought that trash is not waste, but a resource? In Trash Baron, you will create a waste recycling empire. Start with a small landfill and turn it into a high-tech enterprise! Gameplay: ♻️ Collect and sort: Tons of waste - plastic, glass, metal, and rubber. Sort it all properly. 🏭 Recycle into goods: start production lines! We turn plastic bottles into new bottles and so on 💰 Sell and grow: the higher the quality of your recycled products, the higher the profit. Earn money to buy new equipment, expand your workshops, and hire employees. 📈 Become a baron: from a small waste collection point to the largest waste recycling plant in the city. The future of the environment and business is in your hands!
howToPlay: To control, you need to press the WASD keys or use a mouse if you're playing on a computer. If you're playing on a phone, you need to use your finger.

title: Cat Escape: Hide and Seek
description: «Cat Escape: Hide and Seek» is an exciting casual arcade game in which you need to help the cat escape, hide from the Great Dane and get to the sweet cake! 🧐GAME FEATURES: ・ Nice, unique graphics; ・ Endless mode for competitions; ・ Addictive gameplay with different levels of variety and difficulty; ・ Challenging enough to make you feel more engaged. A cat dressed as a banana will be the image that will bring moments of happiness into your day. A game with a wonderful cat meme that will charge you with positive energy! Don't miss the moment, start playing right now!
howToPlay: ・ Run straight to the cat's favorite food; ・ Keep an eye on the dog, do everything possible to remain unnoticed; ・ Run skillfully and get a well-deserved reward;

title: Wordeck: Associations
description: WorDeck: Solitaire is a browser-based logic game that combines classic solitaire-style card interaction with word association puzzles. Players are presented with a board of word cards and must clear the layout by grouping related words into the correct categories. Unlike traditional solitaire games based on suits and card order, the core gameplay here focuses on logic and semantic connections. Players analyze words, identify hidden relationships, and sort cards into meaningful groups. Each level has a fixed structure and gradually increases in difficulty with more cards and less obvious associations. The game is designed for short and relaxing play sessions while still offering a mental challenge. It runs directly in the browser with no download or installation required, making it easy to start playing instantly.
howToPlay: In WorDeck: Solitaire , players are presented with a board of word cards. The goal is to clear the board by grouping cards that share a common meaning or association. Each level contains several hidden categories, usually made up of 3–4 related words. Players select cards and combine them based on logical connections such as themes, objects, properties, or concepts. When the selected words form a correct group, the cards are removed from the board. If the combination is incorrect, the cards return to their positions, allowing the player to try another solution. Some levels may limit mistakes, encouraging careful thinking and analysis. As the game progresses, levels become more challenging with larger word sets and less obvious associations. The gameplay is calm and thoughtful, with no time pressure, making it suitable for both casual play and brain training.

Only those who can disguise themselves and escape cleverly will reach freedom!
howToPlay: 🎯Your main task is to get out of the school and not let the evil teacher catch you. You can interact with some items(hide, pick up, activate, etc). 🕹️Control character: - On the desktop. Press the WASD keys or move the mouse with the left button pressed. - On mobile. Move your finger across the screen.

title: Foot Bomb
description: Football. Why stop at football? Why not use a ticking bomb instead of a ball? Foot bomb is a bomb kicking soccer game. Your goal is simple, kick the bomb and race to the goal post before it explodes.
howToPlay: W A S D to move Move the Mouse to look around Kick the bomb into the goal post! Time is ticking! 5 4 3 2 1 ....

title: Crazy Sheep
description: Crazy Sheep is a fun puzzle-platformer where you help a clumsy sheep overcome obstacles by building a bridge with different items. Available for free online, it features engaging physics challenges. Playable on any device, it's perfect for those who love light-hearted, casual games.
howToPlay: Help the sheep get to the other side. To do this, you need to build a bridge from objects. This is very difficult to do, you need to have a quick reaction and a lot of patience. In addition, the sheep is very clumsy, and any unevenness in the bridge will prevent it from passing across it.

title: Zombies vs special forces
description: Zombies vs Special Forces is an online third-person shooter game. You will act as special forces and complete the task of clearing the territory from zombies. The game has three difficulty levels that allow players with different skill levels complete the mission. You have full freedom to walkthrough levels of the game.
howToPlay: - Forward: [W]. - Back: [S]. - Step left: [A]. - Step right: [D]. - Direction: mouse cursor. - Shoot zombies: left mouse button.

title: HexFall.io
description: Hex.io is an intense arcade survival experience 🎮 inspired by classic hex-tile challenges ⬢. Tiles collapse beneath your feet ⬇️ as you move, forcing you to plan every jump carefully 🧠. Outsmart the fall 😈, survive longer than your rivals 👥, and become the last player standing 🥇.
howToPlay: Move across the falling hex tiles and stay above the void for as long as possible. Every step breaks the floor, so plan your moves carefully. Avoid falling, survive longer than everyone else, and become the last player standing. PC controls: Use Arrow keys or WASD to move Mobile controls: Use the on-screen joystick to move

title: Bucket Ball
description: Welcome to the Bucket Ball Game! 🎉 Tap the gate to open it and start the fun. Move obstacles out of the way or use them cleverly to guide the ball into the bucket. You'll get different items to help you complete each level. Remember, as you go higher, the game gets tougher, so think before you move! Each time you finish a level, you earn 1 point and move on to a more challenging one. How many levels can you play? Press on and challenge yourself! Just click your mouse to play. Enjoy the game! 🎮
howToPlay: Use the tools given to you to solve each level. As you progress, the game becomes harder, so use your wits! Why is Glass Pong the most fun aim and shoot casual game? Super fun and gets you hooked Simple to start but a tough nut to crack Offers many unique and challenging levels Free to play, so jump right in!

title: Jigmerge Puzzles
description: Rearrange picture fragments, connect matching pieces and restore beautiful images. Relaxing and satisfying puzzles for all ages with endless level variety. Jigmerge Puzzles is a calm and satisfying puzzle game where you restore images that have been split into shuffled picture tiles. Each level gives you a new photo broken into fragments that you can freely move, swap and connect. Analyze details, match shapes and watch the picture gradually come to life. The game includes many themes: animals, nature, food, winter, cars, landscapes and more. Every level features a unique image, and the library of pictures grows over time. Tiles automatically “merge” when placed correctly, creating smooth and intuitive gameplay. Jigmerge Puzzles is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing experiences, visual challenges and the satisfying moment when everything falls into place. You can play endlessly — levels cycle through the theme, and new images are added regularly. A great way to unwind, improve focus and enjoy beautiful visuals.
howToPlay: Drag tiles to restore the picture. When two matching fragments touch, they automatically merge. Merged groups can be moved as one. Complete the full image to finish the level and unlock the next puzzle.

title: Brain Line Connect
description: Brain Line Connect is a simple-but-challenging brain puzzle where you draw one continuous line to connect all dots on the screen. It looks easy at first, but each level is designed to make you think ahead especially when obstacle lines block your path. Play anytime with no time pressure, enjoy clean visuals, and solve your way through a huge collection of levels made to train focus and logic.
howToPlay: Start a level and look at all the dots you must connect. Place your finger on a dot to begin drawing. Drag your finger to draw one continuous line that connects every dot. Do not lift your finger (keep it as “one touch / one stroke”). Avoid obstacle lines if your drawn line touches a blocked/obstacle line, the try is considered wrong. When all dots are connected correctly, the level completes and you move to the next puzzle.

title: Demolition Car - Rope and Hook
description: 😊Want to relax while destroying buildings with rope and grappling hooks? Do you like casual hits like "Rope and Demolish" with realistic destruction physics? Then this game is for you! ⭐ Main features ⭐ - Simple and intuitive controls will allow you to easily master the game - Realistic and fun physics of object destruction - You can play from your smartphone and PC. Anywhere and anytime - A store where you can upgrade your car or buy a new one - Leaderboard. Take first place and show who is the best destroyer here 💕If you liked the game, please support us! To do this, just leave a good review and describe what pleased you! ★★★★★;-) ✉️If you find any bugs, please write to us and we will try to fix them quickly! Our goal is to make fun and high-quality games! 👆Hurry up and click “Play” and plunge into the exciting atmosphere of the free online game “Demolition Car - Rope and Hook!”
howToPlay: 🕹️To control the hook, move your finger across the phone screen or the mouse with LMB held down on your PC. 🎯Your goal is to destroy abandoned buildings. To do this, you need to wrap the buildings as best as possible using a hook and rope, and then press on the gas as hard as you can to demolish the structure. 💡You can also improve your winch and buy new cars. Calculate your strength correctly to demolish the entire building and earn more points. Happy destruction!

title: Click & Idle - Slimes!
description: Step into the delightful universe of Click & Idle - Slimes! Tap the squishy slime to generate income and expand your empire. Unlock and enhance various skills, each offering unique perks that go beyond simple click boosts. Some grant instant rewards, while others provide long-term advantages, allowing you to shape your own progression. Collect charming slimes, customize your background, and embark on an endless adventure to become the ultimate slime master!
howToPlay: Taking control is easy! On PC, click with your mouse to interact and navigate menus. On mobile, simply tap and swipe to engage with the slime, unlock upgrades, and explore different options.

title: OUTSIDE
description: OUTSIDE is a minimalist puzzle game where every move counts. Guide your one-eyed character across a grid to collect the key and unlock the door to the next level — but there’s a twist: once you start moving in a direction, you can’t stop until you hit a wall. Plan your path carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. Simple to play, but tricky to master, OUTSIDE challenges your logic and spatial thinking with each new level.
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow) / W: Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow) / S: Move downward. ← (Left Arrow) / A: Move left. → (Right Arrow) / D: Move right. R: Restart. Q: To Menu. M: Mute. Mobile Controls: On-screen Swipe: Move. UI Buttons: Restart / To Menu / Mute. *Gamepad supported

title: Gravity Speed Run
description: Gravity Speed Run is a fast-paced platformer where you control a mini character, switching gravity to navigate through obstacle-filled levels. Tap to run on the top or bottom of the track, avoiding deadly spikes and traps—one hit, and you restart. Each level gets harder with more obstacles and increased speed. Earn coins by completing levels and unlock new skins for your robot avatar. Test your reflexes and conquer the challenge!
howToPlay: Move up or down by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen

title: Squid Game Ultimate Challenge!
description: You must pass the squid trials and reach the red line to discover all the secrets! Be careful when the red light is on or when the doll stops talking, you must never move!
howToPlay: Left mouse button or hold your finger on your phone to go! Stop when there is a red light! Good Luck!

title: Shopping Simulator
description: Earn game money by tapping the hamster, raise the customer's level and buy everything from the store shelves. Anime, horror, food, pets, household goods, hundreds of heroes in one place! Buy anything you want! More than 500 unique items, 200 leveling levels, lots of mini-games and lots of emotions are waiting for you!
howToPlay: Earn game money in different mini-games to upgrade your level! Tap the hamster and complete the puzzles to get as many as possible! Unlock new levels to become the best!

title: SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies
description: Engage in SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies, a thrilling strategy game where you defend humanity from a zombie apocalypse. Enjoy online gameplay without downloads, equip over 50 unique weapons, and face endless undead waves. Test your skills in various modes and strive for victory in PvP battles.
howToPlay: "SWAT & GREENS vs Zombies" is an engaging tower defense strategy game where you can upgrade and unlock new members of the SWAT squad as well as plants. Together, they will stand against waves of advancing zombies. Upgrade SWAT members and plants to create a stronger squad. - Each member of the special forces squad comes equipped with unique weaponry, strategically position them on the battlefield. - Every plant has a cooldown period; use their powers wisely in combat. - Strive to minimize losses in battle to maximize the level completion reward. Battle Controls: Drag SWAT members and plants onto the field by holding down the left mouse button/touchscreen.

title: Chainsaw 3D
description: Chainsaw 3D is an exciting online arcade game where you cut logs using a chainsaw. Available for free on multiple platforms, this engaging woodcutting challenge blends skill and puzzle elements, requiring concentration to succeed at each new level. Aim to become the top woodcutter!
howToPlay: Use mouse or finger to rotate chainsaw up and down. Avoid obstacles and cut through the lines! Be the best woodcutter!

title: Starweave: Creative Constellation
description: Starweave is a cosmic puzzle game. A relaxing yet challenging journey bring the night sky to life! In Starweave you control a glowing beam of starlight traveling through the deep cosmos. Your goal is to guide this light from star to star, connecting them together to weave beautiful, glowing constellations. As you glide through space, you will need to dodge floating obstacles and navigate clever pathways to complete each celestial pattern. Why you'll love it (What makes it unique) Soothing and Relaxing: With soft, colorful cosmic backgrounds and peaceful, ambient sounds, it is the perfect game to play when you want to decompress and unwind. Satisfyingly Smooth Controls: Controlling your light thread feels incredibly natural and responsive. It is as simple as drawing directly on your screen with your finger. Beautiful Neon Visuals: Watch the dark, quiet sky explode with brilliant neon lines, glittering starbursts and magical effects the moment you complete a constellation. Delightful Brain-Teasers: Each level challenges you to find the perfect path to connect all the stars. It is easy to pick up, but offers just the right amount of playful challenge as you progress.
howToPlay: Use mouse to click and drag to connect the stars and make constellations in the sky, use hints for the correct connection

title: Animal Merge
description: Objective: Merge animal bubbles to create upgraded animals and ultimately achieve the final objective by collecting fully developed animals. Gameplay Instructions: Launching the Animal Bubbles: Tap on an animal bubble to select it. Drag the bubble backward to aim. Release to launch the bubble in the opposite direction. Merging Animal Bubbles: When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge to create an upgraded version. Continue merging bubbles of the same type to progress. Achieving the Objective: Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal. Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal. Once the final animal is created, it is automatically collected as part of the level objective. Winning the Level: The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.
howToPlay: Objective: Merge animal bubbles to create upgraded animals and ultimately achieve the final objective by collecting fully developed animals. Gameplay Instructions: Launching the Animal Bubbles: Tap on an animal bubble to select it. Drag the bubble backward to aim. Release to launch the bubble in the opposite direction. Merging Animal Bubbles: When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge to create an upgraded version. Continue merging bubbles of the same type to progress. Achieving the Objective: Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal. Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal. Once the final animal is created, it is automatically collected as part of the level objective. Winning the Level: The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

title: Assault on Squid Island
description: Government troops are storming the island! Assault on Squid Island is an action-packed action game in which you have to survive a deadly battle on a mysterious island. Your main goal is to destroy all the enemies and find a way to escape from this sinister place. What makes the game special: Thrilling battles with realistic combat system Unique locations with a unique atmosphere A fascinating story that will keep you in suspense until the very end. Immerse yourself in a world where every step can be lost, and every decision is crucial in the struggle for survival.
howToPlay: Control Computer: - WASD - movement, - LSHIFT - switch to running, - SPACE - jump. - LEFT MOUSE BUTTON - shoot, - RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON - aim, - T- inspect the weapon. - R - reload. - P - pause. On the phone, control is carried out using mobile control functions.

title: Snowball Dash
description: Control a lively red ball as it bounces its way down a snowy mountain! Avoid trees, rocks, and tricky obstacles to stay in the game as long as possible. The deeper you go, the faster it gets — and the tougher the ride! Grab glowing crystals along the path to boost your score and test your reflexes. How long can you survive the snowy descent?
howToPlay: Control a bouncy red ball as it rolls down a snowy mountain! Dodge trees, rocks, and other obstacles while trying to survive for as long as possible. The faster you go, the harder it gets! 🎮 Controls: PC (Keyboard): Press A or Left Arrow to move left. Press D or Right Arrow to move right. Mobile (Touchscreen): Touch the Left side of the screen to move left. Touch the Right side of the screen to move right.

title: Void Shot
description: Void Shot is a one-hand neon arcade shooter set in the glowing depths of space. Slide your turret along the bottom of the screen — it fires on its own — and pop endless waves of pulsing rings before they reach you. Every fifth wave ends in a boss fight, and each boss plays differently: some teleport, some split, some spawn minions. Random wave modifiers — crosswind, low gravity, turbo drift, extra bounce — reshuffle the rules so no two runs feel the same. Catch power-ups (frost, double damage, rapid fire, shield), bank coins and permanently upgrade your turret between runs. How deep into the void can you go?
howToPlay: Goal: survive as many waves as you can. Destroy every ring in a wave to advance; beat the boss on every fifth wave. Your best wave goes to the leaderboard. Controls — mobile: touch and drag anywhere to move the turret. Desktop: move the mouse, or use Arrow keys / A and D; Esc or P pauses the game. Firing is automatic — just aim. Catch what falls from destroyed rings: coins, hearts (extra life) and temporary power-ups. Lost all lives? Watch an ad to revive once per run. Spend coins in Upgrades to boost damage, fire rate, coin gain, and unlock the twin shot.

title: CraftMart
description: Noob decided to go into business and open his own shop. And what do all the people of Minecraft want? That's right - to eat! In Noob's shop you can always buy beet soup and bread! And also a lot of other food. And now all the residents of CubeWorld rushed to the best store! Help Noob to serve all the customers! No one should go hungry! :) Build new fields for wheat and beets, get a cow and a chicken and expand the shop to the maximum assortment! Simulate a grocery shop in the world of Minecraft: - plant turnips and wheat, raise chickens and a cow - make turnip soup as well as warm bread - serve your customers - improve your means of production and your abilities - hire workers to help you Show your business skill!
howToPlay: Control Noob with the arrows on your keyboard (or by tapping on the screen of your mobile device). Build a building, pick up products and take them to the counter. When the customer has bought everything, help him pay at the cash register.

title: Project: Survival
description: PROJECT: SURVIVAL Welcome to Project: Survival — a fast-paced zombie survival shooter where every shot, every second, and every decision counts. Drop into Ghost Map City, where chaos echoes through empty streets, or brave the twisted halls of Zombie Hospital, where every corner hides something waiting to strike. Scavenge what’s left of the world, complete deadly missions, and climb the ranks as you fight through relentless waves of the undead. From crawlers that lurk beneath wreckage to spitters that melt through your cover, every encounter pushes your instincts and aim to the limit. Survive long enough, and you’ll earn rewards to expand your loadout, unlock brutal new weapons, and forge the arsenal that keeps you alive when the horde closes in. Your progress is your power — and your only lifeline. Collect ammo and medkits from fallen enemies to stay in the fight. Each mission brings a new test of endurance and precision, taking you one step closer to becoming the ultimate survivor. Die? Maybe. Give up? Never. Use rewarded revives to get back up, skip impossible missions, or unlock exclusive weapons to turn the tide. There’s always another chance — if you’re bold enough to take it…
howToPlay: Controls: - PC - WASD for movement - Left mouse button for aiming and shooting - Spacebar for jumping - P for game pause - X for switching guns - Tab or Delete or unlocking cursor Mobile - Customizable game control presets.

title: Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge
description: Dive into the captivating universe of Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge, starting with simple daggers and advancing to legendary weapon crafting. This free online game tests your skills against tough foes as you upgrade weapons, ensuring the safety of the realm, whether you play on a phone or computer.
howToPlay: - Start with basic weapons and drag identical ones to merge them into more powerful versions. - Each new weapon brings more gold. - Spend gold on upgrades: unlock new types of weapons or speed up the merging process. - Fight monsters and progress through levels. - From time to time, you’ll encounter powerful bosses. Defeat them to prove your mastery! - Experiment with upgrades to increase weapon efficiency and earn more. - Keep playing to unlock legendary weapons and become a true master of the arsenal.

title: Pickaxe Crusher Idle
description: Dive into the thrilling world of underground mines in Pickaxe Crusher Idle. Play as a daring miner with a bouncing pickaxe, dashing left and right to explore deeper and deeper into the caves. Collect resources, unlock new tools such as axes, arrows, swords, and more, and upgrade your skills to become a true master of mining. Use talents and upgrades to accelerate your progress, unlock achievements, and advance through the prestige system. Each descent into the depths brings new opportunities, challenges, and valuable treasures. Are you ready to venture into the abyss and become a mining legend?
howToPlay: Controls Click the left and right arrows to dash your pickaxe. Use the UI to upgrade tools, talents, and skills as you dive deeper into the cave!

title: Yummy Waffle Ice Cream
description: Are you a waffle lover? Are you an ice cream lover? This game is perfect for you. Let's make some waffle and decorate it with ice cream and any kind of fruits and syrups! Be a waffle maker!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Pinata Color Smash
description: Smash Color Pinatas by Selecting the matching color bat. You can Select Bats on top and then the bottom bats are revealed. You can Place Extra Bats on 5 Tile Slots and use them when needed. Pinatas Color Smash is a colorful and engaging puzzle game where players aim to break Pinatas by selecting matching colored bats. The game offers a fun and casual experience suitable for all ages.
howToPlay: At the top of the screen, you'll see a selection of bats. Choose one that matches the color of the Pinata you wish to break. After selecting a bat, the corresponding bat at the bottom of the screen will be revealed. You have five tile slots where you can place extra bats. Use these when needed to help break more challenging Pinatas.

title: Stack Master
description: Stack master is a minimalistic, endless stacking game where your goal is to build the tower as high as possible by perfectly aligning moving blocks. The graphics are simple and clean, focusing on smooth gameplay without distractions. You compete globally for the highest score (tower height) on leaderboards.
howToPlay: When you start, a block (or “slice”) begins sliding horizontally across the screen at some height. You tap the screen (or tap a control) to drop the moving block onto the block beneath it. The better the alignment with the block below, the more of the block remains. If part of the block overhangs, the overhanging part is cut off. If you drop with a slight misalignment, the excess portion is cut away and removed, making your next block smaller. If your misalignment is very poor (i.e. almost no overlap), you might lose the block entirely, ending the game. Each successful drop continues the tower upward. The goal is to stack as many as possible, reaching the highest possible height (score). As the tower gets higher, it becomes more challenging. The blocks may move faster or require more precision. (This is common in stacking games of this type.)

title: Fluffy Jump
description: The objective is to jump from platform to platform while continuously moving forward. Missing any platform results in failure, and the player’s speed gradually increases as the game progresses. The challenge lies in surviving as long as possible to achieve the highest time-based score. Key Features: Simple controls: Intuitive and quick controls. Dynamic difficulty increase: The game becomes more challenging as you progress.
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to jump from platform to platform as you move continuously forward. Missing a platform results in failure, and the player’s speed increases as the game progresses.

title: Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies!
description: ⚔️ Welcome to the thrilling game "Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies!" Destroy everything in your path using knives, sabers, lightsabers, and other weapons. Immerse yourself in a world of dynamic battles where you slice enemies into tiny pieces and become a true samurai! 🗡️ In this free 3D game, you will find many exciting levels, challenging enemies, and a variety of melee weapons. 🎮 If you enjoy games like Swing Blade or "Slash the Enemies to Pieces!", this game will bring you lots of fun. Feel the thrill of slicing enemies in slow motion. ⭐ Game Features: - Numerous levels with unique challenges to keep you engaged - A variety of weapons: sabers, knives, blades, and even lightsabers like in Star Wars - Stunning slow-motion effects during strikes for extra enjoyment - Simple and intuitive controls to quickly get you into the action
howToPlay: 🎯 Game Goals: Become a master of the blade! Your task is to slice enemies, destroy obstacles, and complete levels with maximum efficiency. Unlock new weapons as you progress! 🕹️ Controls: - On PC: Hold down the left mouse button to strike. Move the mouse in the desired direction for precise enemy slicing. - On mobile devices: Swipe your finger across the screen to slice enemies.

title: Bottle Color Match Challenge
description: Your task is simple but thrillingly challenging: arrange the bottles so that the colors match! Move, combine, and find matches to complete the level. ✨ Why will you love it? ✔ Simple yet addictive – easy to start, hard to stop! ✔ Vibrant graphics – pleasing colors and smooth animations. ✔ Relax or challenge yourself – play for fun or race against the clock. ✔ Perfect for all ages – fun for the whole family! Can you beat all the levels? Test your wits and become a true Bottle Master! 🏆 👉 Start playing right now! 👈
howToPlay: Select a bottle and swap it with another. Match all the colors in a single row – victory is yours! Use hints if you get stuck. Play against the clock or at your own pace – the choice is yours!

title: Emoji Guess
description: Show off your skills as an emoji interpreter in this supremely fun and frenetic puzzle game where you have to pick the right set of emojis to express the phrase, saying or movie title that’s written or illustrated above. Solve endless emoji puzzles by matching the right emojis in the right order and sharpen your logic, word association and visual perception skills with hundreds of short, colorful and often hilarious levels of brain-teasing entertainment. Emoji Guess Puzzle is a simple-in-concept but endlessly challenging and amusing puzzle game for smart players of all ages.
howToPlay: Your goal is to pick the correct sequence of emojis that represent the phrase, saying, or movie title shown above the puzzle. Think of it as translating text or ideas into emoji form in the right order. Each level presents a prompt (text-based or illustrated) and a jumble of emojis. You select emojis in the precise order needed to match the intended phrase. If you're correct on the first try, you earn all the stars for that level. Otherwise, you’ll get additional attempts with guidance. Stuck on a puzzle? The game offers helpful hints that can nudge you in the right direction without giving the full answer away.

title: Winged Wheels 2
description: Ready to challenge your brain and reflexes like never before? In this fast-paced action game, you'll control a car and a spaceship simultaneously. While dodging enemies and obstacles with one vehicle, you’ll be collecting coins and power-ups with the other – all in real time! Multitask like a pro: Master the art of controlling two vehicles at once Unlock new cars and spaceships with unique visuals Upgrade your abilities after each run for better performance Face random events and power-ups that shake up the gameplay Climb the global leaderboard and prove your skills This game is designed to test your concentration, dexterity, and multitasking to the absolute limit. Whether you're dodging missiles or grabbing that last coin, every second counts. Can you handle the chaos?
howToPlay: PC: ← (Left Arrow): Move left with the car. → (Right Arrow): Move right with the car. A: Move left with the spaceship. D: Move right with the spaceship. Mobile: - Swipe on the left side to move the spaceship. - Swipe on the right side to move the car. Objective: Collect coins to buy upgrades and climb the leaderboard. Hitting an enemy or obstacle will cost you one health. Losing a coin also costs one health. Power Ups: - Magnetic Field: Coins are automatically attracted to your vehicle. Upgrades increase the duration. - Energy Shield: Destroys enemies and obstacles on contact. Upgrades increase the duration. - Extra Life: Grants you an additional life. - Weapon System: Automatically fires rockets at the nearest enemy or obstacle. Upgrades increase the ammo capacity.

title: LifeCode
description: GAME STORY After the incident in the Zone, all personnel were evacuated. To ensure that no one would uncover the secrets of the facility, the staff deliberately damaged the data storage system. As a result, the A.R.C.H core lost access to critical information, placing an immense strain on the entire system. Sooner or later, it would lead to a catastrophic explosion. But the staff overlooked one thing. A.R.C.H is an advanced artificial intelligence capable of calculating thousands of possibilities and creating complex plans within milliseconds. It quickly found a way to avoid its destruction. There was only one problem: A.R.C.H could not move on its own. It needed someone else to do the dirty work. Only the monsters remained inside the abandoned laboratory. Then A.R.C.H remembered that among them was one creature capable of listening, thinking, and acting. And it found YOU. ABOUT THE GAME This is a survival horror game set in an abandoned laboratory. You play as an intelligent creature that must survive, explore the facility, and complete tasks for the A.R.C.H core. Your main objective is to export memory data for A.R.C.H so the artificial intelligence can recover lost information…
howToPlay: HOW TO PLAY Each day begins at 10:00 AM at your base. Your first task is to adjust the antenna angle. The more accurate the alignment, the more memory you will receive during the export process. After that, enter the laboratory and locate an M3N (Memory Export Node). Activate the first export phase. A single M3N operates for 2 to 5 minutes depending on conditions. While the M3N is running, explore the laboratory, gather resources, and avoid hostile monsters. Once the memory bar is filled, return to the base and activate a Control Core function. Afterward, you will need to fill the memory bar again, this time to a higher requirement. When the M3N finishes operating, you can activate Phase Two. This phase provides additional memory and helps complete your objectives more quickly. However, always keep an eye on the clock. You must leave the laboratory before midnight. If you remain inside after 12:00 AM, your character will die and all collected items and stored memory will be lost. If you forget to check the time, don't worry. At 11:00 PM, a warning siren will sound throughout the laboratory, alerting you that midnight is approaching. At the same time, emergency lights will illumina…

title: Blocky Guns
description: Collect colored blocks, build powerful weapons, and fight your way through waves of enemies in this blocky first-person shooter. Unlock and use different weapon types, including pistols, machine guns, rocket launchers, and grenades. Choose the right gun for each battle, upgrade your firepower, and survive intense combat across dangerous levels.
howToPlay: Defeat enemies, collect colored blocks, and use them to create new weapons. Each weapon requires blocks of two different colors, so gather enough materials during missions to unlock stronger gear. Use your weapons wisely, keep moving, and eliminate all enemies to complete the level. On desktop, use WASD to move, mouse to aim, and left click to shoot. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick and buttons to move, aim, switch weapons, and attack.

title: Logo Quiz Master
description: Test your knowledge and challenge your brain with Logo Quiz Master, the ultimate trivia game for logo enthusiasts! Dive into a world of iconic brands, famous companies, and unforgettable symbols as you guess the logos from various categories. Whether you're a casual gamer or a trivia master, this game will keep you entertained for hours!
howToPlay: Guess the correct logo from the given options. Click or tap the right answer to win the level. Complete all levels to become the logo quiz master! Controls: Use your mouse or finger to select the correct logo.

title: Home Run Infinity
description: Time your swing and launch the ball as far as possible in an endless arcade baseball challenge. Earn coins from every hit, unlock 25 increasingly powerful bats, discover 10 distinctive fields, and compete for the longest hit on the Playgama leaderboard.
howToPlay: Tap or click the playfield, or press Space, to stop the moving timing marker and swing. Aim for the green zone for a powerful hit. The small red and orange zones provide rare distance multipliers. Earn one coin per metre, then use your coins to unlock and equip new bats and scenery.

title: RageRoll.io
description: Dive into fast-paced arena combat where giant spheres clash in epic simulated multiplayer matches, powered by advanced AI for non-stop action!
howToPlay: Battle other rollers in fast-paced arena combat. In DeathMatch, score the most kills before time runs out. In Elimination, survive longer than every other opponent to claim victory. Keyboard and Mouse Controls Use WASD to move your roller. Use Q to shield. Use E to use. Hold F to use the attractor. Tap Shift to dash. Hold Shift to brake. Use Space to float up using anti-gravity. Look with the mouse. Use Left Click to fire bullets at enemies. Use Right Click to launch missiles.

title: Sprunki Adventure 4
description: 🎮 Welcome to the frozen world of "Sprunki Adventure 4"! ❄️🏔️ A real disaster has struck the world of Sprunki — the huge Central Heater suddenly broke down, and a harsh winter quickly covered all the lands! 🧩 Begin a new adventure with Sprunki! 🔧 Search for lost parts to repair the Heater 👥 Help characters and complete winter quests Your main goal is to collect all the necessary parts and help repair the Great Heater before the world completely freezes. Can you bring warmth back to the world of Sprunki? 🔥
howToPlay: PC Controls: Move — W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys; Jump — Space; Run — Shift; Crouch — Ctrl; Interact — E; Open Menu — Tab; Open Inventory — I; Zoom Camera — Right Mouse Button (RMB); Bonus Speed from Ads — Z; Bonus Jump Power from Ads — X. Mobile Controls: Move — Joystick; Jump — Jump Button; Run — Run Button; Crouch — Crouch Button; Rotate Camera — Right side of the screen; Open Inventory — Button in the top-left corner; Interact — Button with the "E" icon; Open Menu — Button in the top-right corner.

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.
howToPlay: Click on the flasks to move the colored water on top from one to another. Make sure water of the same color is in one flask to pass the level. Use the power-ups in case you get stuck or don't know how to proceed.

title: Spill & Knock Down
description: In Spill It!, you drop balls in order to knock over glasses and spill everything inside them. It combines simple mechanics with physics-based puzzles—to achieve the goal you must carefully aim, drop, and use gravity / momentum to spill from glasses.
howToPlay: You get to drop balls from certain positions. You can aim or choose the drop point in many cases. The balls interact with the environment: glassware, supports, possibly moving platforms or obstacles. Physics matters: timing, angle, force, obstacle clearance. Your goal is to spill all the liquid from the glasses. You do this by using the balls: drop, throw or position them so that they hit the glasses (directly or via bouncing or rollovers) and cause the liquid inside to spill out.

title: Sweet Supermarket Simulator
description: - Collect ingredients - Stock shelves - Earn money - Unlock new shelves with products - Hire new staff - Upgrade your character - Unlock new supermarkets
howToPlay: Character Controls: Movement: W,A,S,D keys or mouse/touch

title: SHADOW FORGE
description: Shadow Forge is a dark-fantasy Tower Defense × Action-RPG hybrid. Build and upgrade 10 unique towers while you command the Forge Master hero — dodge, cast 4 skills, and crush endless waves of shadow creatures across 8 maps and 20 waves with epic bosses. Level up to unlock powerful boons.
howToPlay: Desktop: WASD/Arrows to move, mouse to aim and cast skills (Q/E/R/T), click a tower then a tile to build. Mobile: left joystick to move, tap skill buttons to cast, tap a tower icon then the map to build. Start waves early for bonus gold — don't let enemies reach the Forge!

title: Pop The Band
description: Pop the Band is a satisfying 3D puzzle game where colorful rubber bands are wrapped tight around delicious snacks — eggs, donuts, burgers, watermelons and 40+ more! Your job: pop them all off, one by one. But there's a catch — a band can only snap free when nothing is crossing over it. Study the tangle, spin the snack around, and pop the bands in the right order. Tap wrong three times and the puzzle resets, so look before you snap! FEATURES 🍩 48 tasty 3D puzzles that get trickier as you go — from 3 bands to a 10-band mega-tangle ✂️ Bands cut right where you tap and flop off with real rubbery physics ⚡ 4 powerups when you're stuck: Zap any band, Magnet the top band off, Find the free band, or Shield a mistake 🐝 Race rival bees to the finish for bonus coins 🏆 Climb the Gold Quest ladder and grab the 1,000-coin jackpot 🎁 Daily rewards, a snack collection book, leaderboards and more 🎵 Cheerful music, juicy snap sounds, and confetti when you win Easy to pick up, tough to put down — how far can you untangle? Pop every band!
howToPlay: Pop every rubber band off the snack to clear the level! Look at the tangle. Every band is wrapped over or under the others — only a band with nothing crossing over it can be popped. Tap the top band to snap it off. It cuts right where you tap and flops away! Wrong band? It wobbles and you lose a life. You get 3 mistakes per level — lose all three and the puzzle resets. Drag to spin the snack and check every side — sneaky bands love to hide around the back. Stuck? Use a powerup: ⚡ Zap — cut any band, even a buried one 🧲 Magnet — yanks the top band off for you 🔍 Finder — highlights the band that's safe to pop 🛡️ Shield — forgives your next mistake Clear the level to earn coins and stars, push your Gold Quest forward, and race the bees to the finish!

title: Movie Star Daily Routine
description: Let's join the a day in the life of a movie star stream. We will spend the whole day with a famous actress from the series. The morning begins with cosmetic procedures and skin care. See how the skin of a movie star shines! Time to go in for sports to maintain excellent physical shape. Preparing for going to the gym begins with packing a bag - you need to take water, a yoga mat and other accessories. A star needs to look stylish even in the gym, so you need to get serious about choosing a tracksuit. It's time to put on your makeup and go to the screen test. The movie star will have to go through a casting and try on the image of the heroines of films and series. And finally, it's time to enjoy the glory. Having collected everything you need in a small clutch, the girl goes to the red carpet to amaze everyone with brilliant and original outfits!
howToPlay: Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it. The result can be saved as a PNG image.

title: Snake Rush
description: Get ready to dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of Snake Rush! 🐍 Embark on an electrifying journey through this competitive twist on the classic Snake game. Challenge your survival instincts and strive to outmaneuver your opponents in the ultimate Snake Rush showdown! With Snake Rush, you'll experience the timeless arcade fun with a fresh, modern flair. Engage in thrilling live events online, where the competition never sleeps! Can you climb to the top of the leaderboard and claim victory in this dynamic mobile adaptation of the arcade sensation? Snake Rush merges cutting-edge visuals with the iconic gameplay mechanics of the original snake game, delivering an unmatched gaming experience that will keep you hooked for hours on end. Get ready to slither, dodge, and dominate your way to glory in Snake Rush! 🎮 [Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do? A: Snake Rush is a game where you play as a slithering snake, surviving as long as possible by running into and defeating opponents. Q: What is the game's unique feature? What will hook players? A: Great graphics and unique, Indian-themed skins. Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons…
howToPlay: Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick. Fire Button: Tap to shoot.

title: Happy Coloring Book
description: Color your world with our interactive web coloring book game! Choose from a variety of fun drawings to bring your imagination to life.
howToPlay: Select a drawing from our coloring book and use the virtual crayons to color it in. Experiment with different colors and techniques to create your masterpiece. Once you're done, save and share your creation with friends!

title: Dice Merge
description: Roll, merge, and race against time in this fast-paced dice puzzle game. Each roll resets a 10-second timer, and your score is multiplied by the time you have left. Drag and merge matching dice to build higher numbers, use special X dice to destroy others for extra points, and strategize before the clock runs out. Reach higher combos, manage your limited dice count, and aim for the best score before time hits zero.
howToPlay: Press Space or click the Roll button to create 2 dice and reset the timer. Merge dice numbers (like 1+5, 3+3, or 2+2+2) to create a 6. When you merge two sixes, you get the X dice, which can destroy any other dice. The higher the dice value destroyed and the more time left on the timer, the higher your score! You can click the "?" button to check every merge combination. The timer starts with 10 seconds, and then gets reduced to 5 seconds after 2 minutes.

title: Cowboys Duel
description: Enter the rugged world of the Wild West in *Cowboys Duel*, where sharp aim and quick reflexes are crucial. Compete in solo missions or face off against friends in thrilling duels. Customize your character, enjoy various game modes, and hone your skills to become the top cowboy.
howToPlay: - Click on the menu and open the game - Just Click when you want to shoot - Watch the clock and shoot when it is 12, if you shoot before you will lose - Click on the arrows before time runs out to turn them in the direction shown - Download 20 Targets before time runs out - The one who scores 3 wins.

title: Toxic Arena: Biological Threat
description: Toxic Arena: Biological Threat is a thrilling action-roguelike "survivors" game where your only goal is to survive in the heart of a global biological catastrophe. You are a fighter trapped on an arena with endless hordes of mutants. Test your nerves and your reaction time! What awaits you: Insane Drive: Fight against ever-growing waves of enemies. Every minute on the arena is a new challenge and a test of your tactics. Deep Mutation System: Choose unique upgrades with each level! Increase damage, fire rate, or unlock abilities like ricochet and armor penetration. Survivor's Arsenal: Collect weapons of various rarities — from 'Common' to 'Legendary'. The cooler your gun, the less chance the monsters have. Diverse Locations: Fight your way through gloomy forests, abandoned military bases, and secret laboratories. Become a legend of the "Toxic Arena: Biological Threat" and top the global leaderboards. Are you ready for the challenge?
howToPlay: Survive the harsh conditions of "Toxic Arena: Biological Threat," repelling endless mutant attacks. Collect biological experience, unlock unique mutations, and upgrade your arsenal to last as long as possible and set a new record! PC Controls: WASD or Arrow Keys — Move character. Mouse movement — Aim and look around. Left Click (LMB) — Fire at enemies. R Key — Reload (don't forget to watch your magazine!). Space — Dash for a quick evade or to escape surrounded areas. Mobile Controls: Left Joystick — Character movement. Right Joystick — Aiming and auto-fire. Reload Button icon — Manual reload. Tips: Use Dash to dash through groups of enemies if you get cornered.
