Study mutation descriptions: the right combination of skills (synergy) will make you practically invulnerable! Always stay on the move — a standing target is an easy meal for mutants.

title: Skebob Gun
description: Welcome to a frantic open-world shooter where you decide who to be: a hero, a villain, or just have fun! Fight with friends, run, jump, shoot, and explore huge maps full of secrets, weapons, and surprises. Game Features: - Online multiplayer: play against other players in real time - Wide selection of weapons: from blasters to rocket launchers - Open world: explore maps, drive cars, and cause chaos - Various modes: duels, survival, fun minigames - Lots of skins and customization: stand out from the crowd - Physics and tricks: jump, flip, and make the most of the environment
howToPlay: Desktop controls: WASD - move; Space - jump; LMB - shoot; R - reload; G - grenade C - change camera Mobile controls: touch/swipe.

title: Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft
description: Become a dungeon keeper, control stickmen, mine ore, develop a Cult and hold power in this exciting 3D simulator! Develop the Cult, manage resources and expand the boundaries of your underground Universe! ⛏ Resource extraction - send followers for ore and minerals. 🏛 Cult development - maintain loyalty at a high level. 👀 Captivating 3D graphics - fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of darkness. ⚒ Dungeon upgrade - build, improve and strengthen your base. 💰 Economic strategy – distribute the spoils and increase wealth.
howToPlay: Desktop: WASD / arrow keys / drag left mouse button = move Left mouse button / E = select upgrade Mobile: In-game joystick = move tap = select upgrade

title: Bouncy Ball
description: Bouncy Ball is a fun and addictive arcade platformer where timing is everything ⚡️ Guide a happy bouncing ball across floating platforms, avoid deadly spikes, and survive tricky jumps that get harder every level 😱 Each bounce matters 🟠✨ Tap at the right moment to control the ball’s movement, master precision jumps, and keep your ball alive as long as possible. Simple controls, smooth animations, and vibrant neon visuals make every run exciting and satisfying 🎨🔥 Can you keep bouncing and beat your high score? 🚀🏆
howToPlay: Tap the screen to move the ball downward and control its bounce, Your goal is to survive as long as possible, avoid falling down, and collect combo chains to earn more rewards and higher scores, Timing is the key, one wrong move and the game is over.

title: Tile Stack
description: This game is perfect for players who enjoy puzzle and strategy games. Its simple mechanics and increasing difficulty levels make it both accessible and addictive. You will not realize how time passes by playing fun levels by putting tiles together
howToPlay: Tiles fall from the top of the screen. Click or tap on a tile to select it. Move the selected tile to another tile based on the arrow that shows directions to stack them together. When tiles are stacked, they disappear, earning you points.

title: Raven Estate
description: Raven Estate is a fast-paced shoot-'em-up where you become a fearless crow reclaiming a haunted estate. Blast through waves of monsters with strategically placed weapons that lock in the direction you pick them up. Every choice matters as you dodge, weave, and unleash chaos in this intense bullet-hell adventure. Can you reclaim your home?
howToPlay: Controls - Use arrow keys or WASD to move and navigate the menus - Hold Space to confirm options in the menus

title: Box Tap Sort
description: A head-to-head 3D color-sort puzzle. Dismantle candy-colored cube stacks by tapping cubes that match your active color orders. Wrong taps fill a limited holding bin — overflow resets the puzzle. Clear more structures than your rival before time runs out.
howToPlay: How to play Tap exposed cubes that match one of the three color orders at the bottom. Each order shows how many cubes of that color you still need. Clear the whole structure to finish the puzzle. Wrong colors go to your holding bin. Fill all 7 slots and the current puzzle resets. Drag to rotate the stack. Pinch or scroll to zoom in and out. Clear more puzzles than your rival before the 90-second timer ends.

title: Cube shooter
description: Cube shooter - 3D battle shooter game! Loot weapons, eliminate enemies. Be the last player standing in fast-paced PvP matches!
howToPlay: Shoot & Survive: Eliminate enemies. WASD to move, LMB to shoot

title: Path Control
description: Pave the ball way into the target in this robust physics based puzzle game. Control each platform simultaneously and lead the ball into the basket to complete each level. Watch out for the ball's bounce and keep in mind that this is a frictionless environment so the ball will keep rolling it might just take an extra second.
howToPlay: Click or tap on the screen to rotate platforms and reach the target. There are many barriers so be careful to clear the level.

title: Merge Rush Attack
description: Merge Rush Attack is a fast tap-and-merge runner: spawn a crowd, fuse units into stronger tiers, and smash through boss walls before overheating. A portrait clicker with escalating walls, paid merge chains, and risk–reward tap pressure that turns every sprint into a short, tense power race.
howToPlay: Build a strong enough crowd to break the wall at the end of each run. If your squad’s power is equal to or higher than the wall’s HP, you win the level and earn coins. If not, the run fails and you can retry (or watch an ad for a soft boost). The crowd runs forward automatically. Tap/click the screen to spawn more units. Merge 3 identical units into 1 stronger tier (unlock merge and upgrades in the Shop with coins). Reach the wall and compare your power vs its HP. Spend coins between runs to unlock higher merges, auto-merge, and power upgrades. From level 5, manage overheat — tapping too fast fills the heat bar and can weaken your squad. Controls: Tap / Left click — spawn units Merge button — merge 3 matching units (when available) Shop button — open upgrades Overheat Shop — buy heat defenses or claim crystal rewards No keyboard movement — the squad runs on its own; the game is designed for touch and mouse click

title: Cryptograms: Secret Text
description: Cryptograms: Secret Text - is a puzzle game where you decipher encrypted phrases, gradually uncovering letters and piecing together the full meaning. Choose a theme to match your mood: love and relationships, wisdom and philosophy, movies and TV shows, motivation and literature – and progress through levels one by one. Progress and Rewards: Earn coins for completing levels, which can be used to access hints.
howToPlay: In each puzzle, some letters are hidden, while others must be guessed to restore the phrase. Keep track of your mistakes and reveal letters carefully. If you get stuck – use hints (e.g., lightbulb/search) and continue solving.

title: Kitty Cat Merge
description: It’s raining cats! 🐾 Tap, drop, and merge adorable kitties to create bigger, fluffier breeds in this addictive merge game. Simple to play, impossible to put down, and packed with nonstop kitty chaos! 😺🎉
howToPlay: Tap and drag to aim where your cat will land, then release to drop it. Merge matching cats to create bigger, fluffier kitties and earn points. Keep merging, manage your space, and aim for the highest score possible!

title: Sausage Life
description: Avoid obstacles and become the last sausage standing. A parkour and survival game where you, as a sausage, must compete for survival. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock various unique skins. Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do? A: The game is a mix of parkour and survival for a sausage. Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in? A: The game offers fun gameplay, unique skins referencing movies and games, like Harley Quinn. Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)? A: Yes, the game has currency - money, which can be spent on skins and rebirth. Q: What is the progression system like? What needs to be done to level up faster? A: Progress by surviving levels in the role of a sausage. Mechanics & Progression Q: What are the engaging elements of content (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)? A: The game offers many skins with references to movies and games, like Harley Quinn. Economy & Customization Q: Is there customization in the game? Can players adjust the appearance of the hero, location editor,…
howToPlay: Drag your mouse to move. Use your mouse to navigate. Overcome various obstacles on different stages to be the winner! Unlock customizations, accesories, and skins through playing!

title: Car And Truck Parking Game
description: Welcome to the world of car and truck parking games. Get ready to experience the best of both worlds with a car and truck parking game. Realistic and addictive parking simulator where you can test your skills driving both cars and massive trucks. This game brings you a full driving experience in one powerful package. Precision, patience, and control are the keys to success. Park your vehicle perfectly, avoid obstacles, and complete dozens of increasingly difficult levels.
howToPlay: W / Arrow Up → Move Front S / Arrow Down → Move Back A / Arrow Left → Move Left D / Arrow Right → Move Right - To click any button use mouse

title: Dicey Chickens
description: A dice-vs-monsters castle defense game. Your chicken heroes stand at the bottom of the battlefield and roll six-sided dice automatically — whatever face lands fires that attack upward at monsters marching down from the top. Each hero’s die is built from two attack types (and sometimes shield, heal, or speed faces), so every roll matters. Kill enemies to gain XP, level up, and pick spells that upgrade die faces or add effects like bleed, poison, freeze, and knockback. Survive five waves per stage — recruiting up to three heroes along the way — with the final wave being a boss fight. Win by clearing all waves; lose if your castle HP hits zero. Between runs you earn coins, crystals, and weapon shards to permanently upgrade heroes, rank up spells, and push through 100 stages across ten worlds in the Chicken Coop Run campaign.
howToPlay: Pick a hero to defend the castle at the start of each run (and recruit more heroes between waves as you progress). Your heroes roll on their own — you don’t choose attacks manually, but you can tap a hero’s die anytime to force an instant reroll when you need a clutch hit. Enemies walk straight toward the castle and chip away at its HP when they reach the wall, so keep them off the lane with your dice attacks. Every kill earns XP; when you level up, choose one of three spell upgrades to grow die faces, copy your strongest side, roll faster, or unlock hero-specific combos. Clear all five waves to win the stage and earn rewards; use those rewards in the Hero Upgrades and Spell Book menus to get stronger before your next run.

title: Merge Furry Monsters
description: The game 'Merge Monsters - Fluffy Frenzy' is an entertaining game with incredibly cute and charismatic little monsters. Each monster is not just a cute colorful furball, but also an incredibly charismatic personality, with its own name, emotions, and feelings. Who knows, maybe behind each monster's emotion lies a story - happy or sad. Maybe someday we will find out...
howToPlay: It's simple to play: drop the monsters down, and they will merge with their own kind. When the monsters merge, they transform into a new monster, also fluffy and very cute. But in doing so, they lose a piece of their souls. Don't let them disappear. Collect them, and perhaps you will become the main Guardian of fluffy souls!

title: Unstack Tower
description: Unstack Tower is an addictive puzzle game available on Android that challenges players to dismantle a tower of colored cubes in a specific sequence. This game combines the mechanics of a traditional board game with modern gameplay, providing hours of fun. Players must carefully unstack the cubes without causing the tower to collapse, which requires strategy and quick reflexes. The game features various materials, including glass and wood, adding an extra layer of complexity to each level.
howToPlay: Use clicks or taps to place or drop blocks. You may be able to rotate or position pieces for optimal placement. When blocks of the same color group together (usually in clusters of 3 or more), they vanish, freeing up space and earning points. If blocks are placed unevenly or stacked too loosely, the tower may collapse, leading to game over.

title: Moto Traffic Rider
description: Moto Traffic Rider puts you behind the handlebars of a powerful motorcycle and delivers a whole new level of realism while keeping the old-school spirit and simple gameplay. Jump into the saddle, switch to the first-person view, and race through busy highways, weaving between streams of cars. The game features a full career mode, enhanced graphics, detailed environments, and realistic motorcycle sounds recorded from real bikes. Complete missions, earn money, and unlock new motorcycles to become a true highway legend. Moto Traffic Rider combines fast-paced arcade racing with the atmosphere of a real biker adventure. Ride day and night on highways and city streets, pushing your skills to the limit. Features: • First-person camera view for full immersion • 13 unique motorcycles with realistic engine sounds • Detailed roads and dynamic day/night cycle • Full career mode with no fuel or time limits • Motorcycle upgrade and purchase system
howToPlay: Controls in Moto Traffic Rider are simple and intuitive. Hold the throttle button to accelerate and release it to slow down. Lean the motorcycle left or right to steer, avoid traffic, and take corners smoothly. Use the brakes to reduce speed in heavy traffic or before dangerous turns. Activate nitro for sudden bursts of speed and overtake vehicles closely to earn extra points and money. Keep a balance between speed and control — crashes will end your ride.

title: Mahjong Tower: Puzzles
description: Mahjong Tower: Puzzles are a mix of "puzzle" and "three-in-a-row" genres in a mahjong setting. An exciting puzzle game for MAHJONG and THREE-IN-A-ROW fans! More than 60 levels of varying difficulty. SOLVE THEM ALL! Combine mahjong tiles to remove them from the board or create special tiles that will help you clear the board even more effectively. Solve fascinating puzzles in the "Puzzles" game mode. Clear the board from mahjong tiles in the "Board Clearing" game mode. Score as many points as you can in the endless "Arcade" game mode.
howToPlay: Choose one of the three game modes: -"Puzzles" - solving spatial puzzles with a limited number of tiles; - "Board Clearing" - clearing the board from mahjong tiles in limited time; - "Arcade" - is an endless mode with increasing difficulty, where you need to combine mahjong tiles on the board for as long as possible, without allowing them to be too much. COMPUTER INPUTS: - LEFT MOUSE BUTTON - drop the tile on the board; - "R" - restart current level; - "H" - show hint for current puzzle; - "ESC" - open and close the pause menu. MOBILE INPUTS: - All controls are performed by TAPPING and/or MOVING YOUR FINGER across the screen.

title: Survival for 100 dollars
description: Congratulations, you're the owner of a fortune of 100 dollars! Unfortunately, that's all you have. Welcome to a survival simulator set in harsh reality. In this game, you'll: Masterfully manage your budget: is "Doshirak" a delicacy or an everyday staple? Look for work in the urban-type settlement: from unloading train cars to carrying out dubious errands. Monitor your hunger, health, and mood (it's hard to be happy when your pocket is empty). Prove to everyone that you're an economic genius, capable of surviving where others give up. Your empire starts with a hundred-ruble note!
howToPlay: Standard mouse controls: left-click on the desired abilities and make sure the character's health doesn't drop to 0.

title: Space Craft: Ship War
description: Explore deep space, piloting a cubic ship that can be infinitely expanded with modules. Collect new decks, melee and ranged weapons, boosters, and rare upgrades on the map, transforming your ship into a true battle station. Enemies also grow, making every encounter a dynamic battle for survival. Complete levels, upgrade your stats, unlock new skins, and experiment with builds. Vibrant 3D graphics, rich effects, and constant progression make space battles exciting and unpredictable. Features: 🚀 Infinite ship expansion with modules 🔫 A variety of weapons: melee and firearms ⚡ Boosters and boosters for dynamic battles 🛠 Upgrades after each level 🎨 Skin collection and customization 🌌 Colorful 3D graphics and numerous levels
howToPlay: PC: Use WASD keys to move your ship. Mobile devices: Use swipes to control movement. Game Objective: Destroy enemy ships by collecting modules, upgrading your ship, and surviving longer than anyone else.

title: Build My Brainrot
description: Build My Brainrot is a casual puzzle–simulation game where players collect and place colored blocks on a grid to complete quirky “brainrot” characters. Blending light resource management with creative pattern-building, the game’s core idea revolves around filling shapes efficiently while upgrading abilities like speed and inventory. Its charm comes from its simple controls, humorous character designs, and the satisfying progression of turning scattered resources into complete, animated figures.
howToPlay: **Complete the Brainrot!** Step into a quirky creative world where your goal is to build hilarious “brainrot” characters by collecting and placing colored blocks onto a grid. In this casual puzzle–simulation game inspired by *Build My Brainrot*, you gather resources scattered around the map and carefully fill the correct tiles to match the character’s shape. Complete the pattern before running out of space, unlock upgrades, and bring each strange creation to life! **Objective & Win Condition:** Collect enough colored pieces and correctly place them on the grid to fully complete the character. You win by filling all required tiles accurately before your capacity or available pieces runs out. **Desktop Controls:** W / ↑ (Up Arrow): Move upward. S / ↓ (Down Arrow): Move downward. A / ← (Left Arrow): Move left. D / → (Right Arrow): Move right. E / Left Click: Collect or place blocks. Shift: Increase movement speed (if unlocked). **Mobile Controls:** On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions. Tap on Blocks: Collect resources. Tap on Grid: Place blocks in the correct position. Upgrade Buttons: Tap to improve speed or inventory size.

title: Epic Mine Idle
description: ⛏️ Dig at full speed! Break rocks and extract rare resources. But don't let your guard down: keep an eye on your health (HP) to avoid being caught off guard by a cave-in. 🔥 Hot work! Use powerful drills for fast mining. But beware—the equipment can overheat! Optimize your timing and let your tools cool down to keep digging without stopping. 💎 Real treasures. From sparkling sapphires to pure gold—collect a collection of the rarest minerals. The deeper you mine, the more valuable your loot! 👷 Stylish hero. Your miner is a true professional in a fashionable blue suit. Who said mining can't be stylish? ⚡ Leveling and upgrades. Improve your equipment, increase your health, and reduce your drill's cooldown time. Become the most efficient miner in history!
howToPlay: Simple and clear controls, you need to click the left mouse button on the screen and the character will break the wall, but watch out for overheating, because if the character overheats, you will have to let him rest and cool down

title: Liquid Sort Puzzle
description: Liquid Sort Puzzle is a highly relaxing yet mentally stimulating color-sorting puzzle game set in a vibrant jungle environment. The main idea is to sort mixed colored liquids across various test tubes until each tube contains only one uniform color. What makes this game unique is its soothing ASMR-like pouring animations combined with a rewarding "Lucky Spin" system, allowing players to earn 'Undo' and 'Restart' power-ups to conquer increasingly complex levels. It's the perfect blend of casual brain-training and satisfying visual feedback!
howToPlay: Objective: Sort all the mixed colored liquids so that each test tube holds exactly one solid color. Controls: Click or Tap on any tube to lift the top layer of colored liquid. Click or Tap on another tube to pour the liquid into it. Rules: You can only pour water on top of another liquid if they share the exact same color AND if the destination tube has enough empty space. You can always pour any colored liquid into an entirely empty tube. If you get stuck, use the 'Undo' button to reverse your last move, or the 'Restart' button to reset the current level. Earn more of these power-ups by playing the Lucky Spin!

title: 3D Dots
description: 3D Dots is a relaxing connect-the-dots puzzle that happens in real 3D space. Every level starts as a cloud of numbered dots floating in the air — link them with the right lines and a hidden object comes to life. The number on each dot tells you how many lines it needs, so there is no guessing, only clean logic. Unlike flat dot-to-dot games, the puzzle has depth: orbit the camera to look at the figure from any side and find connections you could not see before.
howToPlay: Tap a dot and drag a line to another dot to connect them. The number inside a dot shows how many lines must meet there — when it is satisfied, the dot turns green. A wrong link turns red: tap the red line to remove it and try another pair. Swipe on empty space to rotate the camera — the puzzle is three-dimensional, and some dots are hidden behind others until you turn the model. Pinch or scroll to zoom. Connect every dot correctly and the model is revealed and added to your gallery; larger models are assembled part by part. Stuck? Use the Hint button to reveal one correct connection. Complete as many models as you can to climb the leaderboard.

title: Knife Smash
description: Do you like throwing stuff? Like knives at random spinning targets? Then this is the ultimate challenge for you! Time your actions, aim carefully and become the knife master! Can you beat all the levels? Very simple one-touch gameplay, but challenging to master! Can you collect all the ridiculous knives?
howToPlay: Do you like throwing stuff? Like knives at random spinning targets? Then this is the ultimate challenge for you!

title: Go Up
description: Welcome to Go Up, the exciting free mobile game that challenges you to protect the balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this amazing balloon game that'll keep you on your toes and your eyes glued to the screen. Picture this. You have a tiny balloon you need to protect. You need to push away all the pointy and heavy things that get in the way of your balloon going up. But it's not that easy. The sky is full of all kinds of strange things like blocks, beams, and triangles. If your balloon even touches one of these, it's all over. Exciting, right? But it gets even better! The higher your balloon goes, the harder the game gets. The obstacles become trickier and more difficult to avoid. You can push everything out of the way, but watch out! If you send blocks flying everywhere, you will find it difficult to protect the balloon.
howToPlay: You have a “shield” or barrier (often a circular protective plane) that you can move around the balloon to push objects aside. You swipe or drag on the screen to reposition your shield around the balloon. (While the store page doesn’t explicitly describe the swipe controls, that’s the common mechanic for this kind of game.) You must time your moves carefully pushing obstacles too late or too aggressively can send them flying in directions that block the balloon again. The higher you get (the further in the level), the more frequent and more complex obstacles appear.

title: Geometry Vibes Monster
description: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks. Geometry Vibes Monster Features: 8 Unique Monsters: Each with their own unique attack patterns, adding variety and depth to the game. Learning these attacks is the key to mastery. Dynamic Gameplay: Fast paced courses and increasing difficulty levels invite you to challenge at any time. Multiplayer Fun: Enjoy the competition by competing with your friends on the same device. Mobile Compatibility: Playable on phones and tablets with touch controls. Visual and Sound Design: Vivid graphics and impressive music enhance the atmosphere of the game.
howToPlay: Keep your spaceship on course and avoid hitting obstacles. Stay alert for the specific attack patterns of each monster. Click and hold the "MOUSE" or press and hold the "SPACEBAR" to ascend. Release the button to dive downward. In 2,3,4 Player race mode, "UP ARROW", "SPACEBAR" "H" and "L" are used to control.

title: Tiny Delivery
description: Tiny Delivery is an game, created by combining the ideas of food delivery and hill climbing. Customize your car and wheels in the store, and complete each level with your favorite vehicle. Before starting the game, you can activate the truck rack to keep the food from falling out, making it easier to finish the level.
howToPlay: Use the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard (on PC) or the left and right touch buttons on your screen (on mobile) to move the vehicle forward and backward and deliver the food to the customer. Be careful not to drop the food! If the food falls on the ground, you will lose your level.

title: Golf Invaders
description: Welcome to Golf Invaders, the ultimate arcade golf shooter! Your golf course has been invaded by punks, bums, and other troublemakers. Your goal? Aim, shoot, and eliminate all invaders using precision golf shots!
howToPlay: Welcome to Golf Invaders, the ultimate arcade golf shooter! Your golf course has been invaded by punks, bums, and other troublemakers. Your goal? Aim, shoot, and eliminate all invaders using precision golf shots! 🎯 Aim & Shoot – Drag to aim your shot and release to fire the golf ball. Be strategic—each level has limited golf balls, so make every shot count! 💥 Use Power Shots – Unlock explosive golf balls to deal massive damage and clear multiple invaders at once! 🌦 Adapt to Weather – Wind impact ball physics, making each shot more challenging! 👾 Defeat Unique Invaders – Face off against different enemies, each with their own behaviors. Play Golf Invaders now and experience the most action-packed golf battle ever! ⛳🔥

title: Cavern of Gears
description: Cavern of Gears is a 2D action-adventure set in a steampunk underworld. Fight through gear-driven caverns with a growing arsenal of weapons, uncover the fate of the workers who vanished below, and face down the powers that took their place.
howToPlay: Fight your way through caverns, defeating enemies and collecting weapons and power-ups as you travel deeper. Clear all the stages and the bosses to discover the century-old secret that they are hiding. WASD to move, SHIFT to dash, J/K to attack, R to switch weapon, L to use power-up

title: Yeti Run
description: Yeti Run is an endless skiing game where the mountain never runs out but your luck does. You carve down the slope with one finger, ski between gates to build combos, and dodge trees, rocks, and lift pylons at increasingly stupid speeds. There is also a yeti. He will not end your run, but if he catches you he shoves you into the deep snow and wrecks your combo, which honestly feels worse. Collect snowmen as you go and spend them on skins in the shop. Every run ends the same way, but the flag marking your best distance is always sitting there, daring you to pass it.
howToPlay: Drag your finger (or mouse) left and right to steer. That is the entire control scheme. The game handles your speed, you handle the carving. Ski between the paired gates to score points and grow your combo. Missing a gate resets the combo. Hitting a tree, rock, or pylon ends the run. Tap once to instantly go again. Stay ahead of the yeti. If he catches you, you get knocked off the trail into slow deep snow and lose your combo. Grab snowmen for currency, knock out missions for bonus snowmen, and unlock skins in the shop. The real objective is simple: ski past the flag from your last best run and plant it a little further down the mountain.

title: Mushroom Runners
description: Run endlessly in Mushroom Runners! Dodge obstacles, crush enemies, and collect mushrooms to grow HUGE! Ride the Happy Flying Cloud in this fun, fast-paced endless runner with a unique platforming twist.
howToPlay: Mobile: touch the screen to jump, swipe down to stomp the ground. Desktop: press up key to jump, press down key to stomp the ground.

title: PC Cafe Simulator 3D
description: 🎮 Welcome to "PC Cafe Simulator 3D" — become the owner of the gaming club of your dreams! 💻 Assemble gaming PCs from components: powerful processors, top-tier graphics cards, and cool accessories for the ultimate gaming experience. 🕹️ Host gamer clients, including popular characters, and earn money from their love of gaming! 🔧 Repair equipment and keep your club running smoothly, ensuring everyone enjoys their favorite games. 📈 Climb the leaderboard of the best club owners, expand your business, and add more gaming stations. 🌅 Day and night cycles bring your club to life: lively during the day, planning and upgrading at night. 🔥 Build a club that becomes legendary among gamers! Play "PC Cafe Simulator 3D" today!
howToPlay: How to play: PC: WASD - Move E - Interact Space - Jump Mobile Devices: On-screen joystick - Movement On-screen buttons - Interaction

title: Stickman in space
description: Join Stickman in Space for a thrilling journey as a lost astronaut on the moon. Overcome space obstacles and discover your route back to Earth. Enjoy free gameplay on mobile and desktop, tackling aliens, evading meteorites, and solving puzzles along the way for an exciting escape.
howToPlay: Find two successful ways to escape from the moon. Use a computer mouse to control the game. If you have a mobile device, use a stylus or a finger.

title: Drawing Online
description: A fast, funny drawing party game for up to 4 players. Get a word, draw it with your finger, and let the game guess what it is. The faster it guesses, the more points you earn. Play with friends or bots, complete 5 drawing challenges in 3 minutes, climb the podium, and unlock cute new animal avatars. Simple controls, hand-drawn style visuals, quick matchmaking, smooth touch drawing, cheerful sounds, and no losing state: you always gain points and experience, but only one player takes first place.
howToPlay: Draw the picture the game suggests. Look at what other players are drawing if you're having trouble. If you can't draw it, click "Skip."

title: Inner City Drive
description: Weave through neon traffic at 390 km/h, one mistake and it's over! Inner City Drive drops you into a rain-soaked neon city at night, behind the wheel of a car built for one thing: surviving the storm at impossible speed. Dense oncoming and same-direction traffic floods every lane — thread the gaps, launch off ramps over gridlock, and blast through tunnels while lightning cracks across wet, reflective streets. The hook is the near-miss combo: shave past traffic as close as you dare and your combo climbs, stacking speed and score multipliers the longer you hold your nerve. Play it safe and the combo bleeds away, every run is a gamble between going faster and staying alive. Every day brings a brand-new procedurally-generated drive, the same route for every player worldwide, reset at UTC midnight, so you're racing the whole planet on a level playing field on the daily global leaderboard. Grind XP and coins to unlock all 14 cars, each with its own speed and grip feel, knock out daily missions, and build your day streak. Instantly playable on desktop or mobile.
howToPlay: Steer: A/D, Arrow Keys, mouse drag, or touch-and-drag. Start: Space or tap. Pause: on-screen pause button. Speed is automatic, focus on weaving through traffic and timing near-misses. Plays with keyboard, mouse, or touch.

title: We Are In A Simulation Simulator
description: SIMON SAYS , COMPLY OR DIE! A brain wrecking, monkey see , monkey do game. Your only chance of survival is to follow the crowd. Any unwanted action will be punished.
howToPlay: Someone is pulling our strings. The key to survival is copying exactly what the others are doing, and not questioning anything. W-A-S-D for movement C for crouching Space for jumping P to pause Are you ready to obey?

title: Stack the Blocks
description: Dive into the captivating world of Stack the Blocks , a strategic online puzzle game on a 10x10 grid. Challenge your logic by placing blocks to clear lines and earn points. Accessible yet complex, it guarantees addictive entertainment on both mobile and desktop platforms.
howToPlay: The 10×10 game board is your canvas for creativity and strategy. Place the offered blocks to form solid horizontal or vertical lines. Once a line is complete, it disappears, making room for new pieces.

title: Stick Roll Arena
description: Challenge your skills in Stick Roll Arena ! Roll the dice to summon your stickman army and push the enemy team off the platform. Use strategy and timing to defeat your opponents in exciting 1v1 battles. Features: - Unique colorful stickmans - Satisfying push mechanics and physics - Simple one-touch controls - Addictive gameplay with increasing difficulty - Beatiful vibrant graphics Can you become the ultimate arena champion? Roll the dice and find out !
howToPlay: - Tap / Click anywhere on the screen to roll the dice - Your stickmen will automatically push the enemy team - Time your rolls correctly to summon more warriors - Push all red opponents off the arena to win! Simple one-tap controls. Easy to learn, fun to play!

title: Push The Box
description: Welcome to Push The Box, a fun and engaging game where you solve puzzles by just pushing buttons and sliding pieces. Complete different stage missions and try out harder levels as you improve! Game Features: - Use handy features like reset and undo to make your gameplay smooth. - Watch replays of your successful stages to see how you solved them. - Enjoy clean and stylish graphics that make the game a delight to play. - Earn achievements and compare your scores with others on the leaderboard. - Perfectly designed for smart pads and tablets for gaming on the go. So, if you’re looking for a game that’s easy to understand but also challenges your brain, Push Maze Puzzle is perfect for you! Slide into the puzzle fun and start solving today!
howToPlay: Push each colored box onto a square marked with a star of the same color. Success means matching all stars with their respective boxes Desktop: Click on a box to push it one square in the direction indicated by an arrow on the box. Touch devices: Tap a box to move it in the arrow’s direction Arrow indicators: Boxes display arrows pointing the direction they'll move. Color-changing tiles: Passing over a colored dot (paint tile) changes a box's color (except black boxes) Black boxes: These remain their original color and cannot change; they cannot complete a star color requirement

title: Shawarma Kiosk Anomaly Game
description: Welcome to the scariest fast-food job in the city. In Night Shift Zombie Shawarma, you’re not just a cook — you’re a survivor running a small kiosk in the dead of night. When the clock strikes midnight, your shop turns into a hotspot for zombies, and every order could be your last. Game Features: Serve the Undead Run your night-shift kiosk and prepare Burgers, Shawarmas, and Drinks for impatient zombie customers. Serve fast — zombies don’t like to wait, and mistakes can be deadly. Smart Inventory Management Handle food deliveries, organize racks, and keep your kiosk running smoothly. A messy kitchen during the night shift can cost you your life.
howToPlay: Press W for Forward Press S for Backward Press D For Right Movement Press A for Left Movement E for Interaction Mouse for Camera movement

title: Hair Salon 3D
description: Hair Salon 3D — a vibrant 3D hair salon simulator! Clients come to you with all kinds of requests: bob cuts, mohawks, undercuts, long layers, and much more. Pick up scissors, clippers, a razor, and a color brush — cut, style, and dye hair, trying to recreate the requested hairstyle as accurately as possible. The better the result — the more stars and tips you earn! Collect in-game currency, buy new tools and dyes, unlock complex haircuts, and serve VIP clients. 23 unique hairstyles, 5 tools, a rating system, and daily challenges — you'll never get bored!
howToPlay: - Check what hairstyle the client wants — tap the card on the right for a 3D preview - Choose your tool: scissors for precise cutting, clippers for even trimming, a razor for detailing - Swipe across the head to cut hair — pinch and rotate the camera with two fingers - If coloring is needed — select the brush and pick a color - Tap "Done" when the hairstyle is complete and receive your rating - Earn in-game currency and purchase new tools and dyes in the shop

title: JUMPER
description: JUMPER Прыгай к новым высотам побивая Рекорды, подбирая Уникальные бонусы и уворачиваясь от Эпичных ловушек с Улучшенной графикой!🌟 Коллекционируй очаровательные Скины👔, получая Достижения🏆
howToPlay: расслабься, неспешно прыгая с платформы на платформу, достигая немыслимых высот! на компьютере: A, ⇦ (стрелка влево), нажатие на левую половину экрана: движение влево D, ⇨ (стрелка вправо), нажатие на правую половину экрана: движение вправо на смартфоне: нажатие на левую половину экрана: движение влево нажатие на правую половину экрана: движение вправо

title: Dead Lands Driver Open World
description: The world has fallen. Civilization has collapsed. Only empty roads, abandoned military bases, and endless hordes of zombies remain. Now you are one of the survivors. It no longer matters who you were or where you came from — you must survive in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. Explore a vast open world filled with deserted cities, military facilities, dark forests, and dangerous places better left unexplored. Choose your vehicle, find weapons, gather resources, and fight to stay alive. The world will never be the same again. Now you are part of the zombie apocalypse.
howToPlay: There are markers in the remnants of the world. They represent missions (delivery/zombie cleanup), as well as other interactions (leaving/entering car, entering garage, accessing shop etc.) Simply enter them (inside car) and/or press interaction key (outside car) to start mission or do something else. You'll see further instructions in-game. Controls: WASD or arrow keys to move Left mouse button to attack/shoot (outside car) Drag mouse while holding LMB to rotate camera (inside car), or without holding (outside car) E to interact (while being inside marker) U to use item in middle slot (outside car) I to open/close invertory (outside car) ESC to pause/unpause game

title: Change part in Love Story
description: What is the code for the safe? What is she hiding? A couple in love goes on an exciting journey where funny situations become their lives. Turn on your brain and find solutions to their problems! Complete tasks and puzzles, make up a couple!
howToPlay: - Read the assignment - Select an element from the suggested ones at the bottom and move it to a certain place on the picture Complete all the levels and help the couple get out of funny situations!

title: Magic Story of Solitaire
description: Welcome to the amazing and magical world of solitaire. Here you can feel at home, comfortably playing solitaire on a tavern table in the light of a fireplace or in the shade of an oak tree to the sound of a majestic waterfall. Magic Story of Solitaire is the classic solitaire you love in an exciting new world. The card game's simple rules will help first-timers get the hang of things fast, and different challenges in the adventure ahead will keep seasoned players on their toes. But don't worry, your fairy helper will show you which magical powers to use to get out of even the toughest pinch. What makes this game so great? - Hundreds of fun layouts - Beautiful and mysterious places in a magic world - Different game challenges - A warm, fun adventure game atmosphere - Offline Cards Adventure This beloved card game is perfect for everyone. We hope you enjoy your time in Magic Story of Solitaire!
howToPlay: Select cards that are one higher or one lower in value than your drawn card to remove it from the playing field. To complete a level, you need to remove all cards from the playing field without running out of cards from your supply.

title: Fix Pizza: Food Sorting
description: Enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle packed with pizza ingredients. Each pizza is covered with different food items: find the extra ingredients, collect them on matching plates, and restore the correct recipe. Look carefully, because the number of mistakes is limited. Complete increasingly busy levels, discover new recipes, and sort pizzas filled with unusual ingredient combinations. As you progress, more items appear and the object search becomes more challenging. Use Highlight, clear mistakes, or Shuffle whenever you need help. This is a relaxing game about sorting, observation, and finding objects, featuring juicy cartoon graphics, short levels, and simple controls. It works equally well for a quick break or a longer puzzle session at your own pace.
howToPlay: Study the recipe sheet and inspect all ingredients on the pizza. The recipe shows the food items that must remain. Every other ingredient needs to be removed. Tap extra ingredients and collect them on the matching plates. Each plate shows which item you need and how many pieces are required. After filling a plate, the next sorting task will appear. Do not tap ingredients included in the recipe. A wrong choice fills one mistake marker. If all available markers are used, you will need to restart the level. Helpful abilities: • Highlight reveals suitable ingredients. • Mistakes clears filled mistake markers. • Shuffle rearranges the items on the pizza. Fill every plate and leave only the recipe ingredients on the pizza to complete the level.

title: Sea Legends - Match 3
description: Dive into the captivating world of Sea Legends - Match 3, a thrilling puzzle game where you explore ocean mysteries and uncover shipwreck secrets. Featuring beautiful graphics and captivating gameplay, it guarantees endless fun, whether on mobile or desktop.
howToPlay: 🔹 Complete level objectives: clear blocks from the board and collect marine creatures. 🔹 The bigger the underwater block combination, the more powerful the boosters! Activate them to complete level goals faster. 🔹 Combine boosters to maximize efficiency and overcome challenging levels more easily. 🔹 Explore new stages, uncover the secrets of ocean treasures, and dive into a world of adventure!

title: Dot and Dot
description: Dot and Dot is a vibrant puzzle game where players connect matching dots without crossing paths.Challenge yourself across three exciting game modes: Normal Mode: 5000 classic puzzles to master Loops Mode: 1500 puzzles to connect dots back to their starting point Bridges Mode: 1500 puzzles to cross paths strategically on special bridge tiles Features designed to enhance your experience: Daily Login Rewards: Earn hints for consecutive daily logins Smart Auto-Complete: Double-tap to automatically complete the last remaining connection U-Turn Detection: Visual warnings prevent invalid patterns Colorblind Support: Toggle color labels (A-Z) for better accessibility Hint System: Get help when you're stuck Quick Reset: Restart any stage instantly Test your logic and spatial skills with intuitive controls, right-click line removal, and progressively challenging puzzles!
howToPlay: Use your mouse or touchscreen to drag and connect dots of the same colour. There should be no empty spaces on the map.

title: Planet 404. Episode 1
description: In this exciting puzzle platformer players embark on an amazing journey with Alice, a brave and curious explorer who finds herself stranded on a mysterious planet filled with secrets. Surrounded by enigmatic landscapes, this world is filled with puzzles that must be solved to uncover its mysteries. Each solution and obstacle overcome not only propels the player forward, but also reveals new chapters of Alice's adventure. The game's graphics are designed in a vibrant and colorful style, and the musical accompaniment creates an atmosphere of magic and mystery, immersing the player in an exciting world full of wonders and surprises.
howToPlay: On a computer: To make the character run to the right, press the D button (or the right arrow) on the keyboard. To make the character run to the left, press the A button (or the left arrow). To jump, press the space bar (or the up arrow). On a smartphone or tablet: To make the character run to the right, tap the right arrow at the bottom of the screen. To make the character run to the left, tap the left arrow. To jump, tap the up arrow. To fire a shot (which becomes available at a certain level), press the fire icon button.

title: Good Knight Story
description: What happened last night!? Join our unlikely hero as he awakens in a dungeon with a sore head and no memory of how he got there. Solve puzzles, battle monsters and survive bad jokes as you piece together events from the night before. FEATURES: * Rich and entertaining story * Over 100+ levels of puzzle solving action * Dynamic character upgrade system * Daily gifts to help with your quest * Epic Boss battles * Special Boosts to unlock * Upgradeable weapons * Custom themed soundtrack * Over 1000+ handsome tavern owners
howToPlay: In the game, you need to find combinations of identical elements and connect them. To complete the level, you need to complete the task that is indicated in the upper right corner.

title: Shape Jam
description: Get ready to jam with shapes in this playful physics puzzle game! In Shape Jam, your goal is simple: collect 3 matching shapes to clear the board. But every move counts the pick zone is limited, the shapes tumble with physics, and the order you choose decides your success.
howToPlay: Clear the board by collecting 3 matching shapes. When you make a set of 3 same shapes, they get cleared. Tap a shape to pick it. The picked shape goes into your pick/holding slots at the top (the small empty circles). Make a triple: If you collect 3 of the same shape in your slots, they clear automatically. Don’t fill the slots: Your pick area/slots are limited, so the order you pick shapes matters.

title: Newbie’s Escape from Blogger Prison
description: 🔓 Escape from Prison is an exciting platforming adventure where you must overcome dangerous challenges and find your way to freedom! Explore the prison, complete challenging levels, avoid traps, and outsmart the guards who will do anything to stop your escape. 🎮 Game features: — 🚨 Alert guards patrolling the prison — ⚠️ Laser traps, surveillance cameras, and dangerous obstacles — 🗺️ Many challenging levels on the road to freedom — 🔑 Hidden paths and unexpected challenges — 🌟 Famous blogger inmates you’ll meet along the way — 🏃 Dynamic platforming and an exciting escape adventure Will you be able to overcome every obstacle and escape from prison? Embark on an unforgettable adventure with your favorite characters and prove that nothing can stand between you and freedom!
howToPlay: 🖥️ PC Controls: W, A, S, D or ↑, ←, ↓, → — Move Spacebar — Jump Move the mouse — Control the camera 📱 Mobile Controls: Joystick on the left — Move Button on the right — Jump Swipe on the right side of the screen — Control the camera

title: DreamBlox
description: Join a multiplayer game where you can earn coins, buy accessories and cute pets, and train them in various tricks at a special school.
howToPlay: Collect coins and explore the world! Use your earned coins to purchase pets and various accessories in the shops. Take your pets to a special school to teach them different tricks. Explore all locations and discover new entertainment opportunities.

title: Crusher Block
description: Crusher Block is an idle game where you smash blocks, earn money, and upgrade your tools to create the most powerful crushing machine! Can you build the ultimate resource-crushing machine?
howToPlay: Use the left mouse button to interact with objects and UI elements Hold the mouse over the pickaxe and move the cursor

title: Stickman Gun Rush
description: Build the ultimate stickman weapon and blast your way to victory in Stickman Gun Rush! Run through exciting tracks, collect stickmen, and assemble them into massive, powerful guns. Merge your growing weapon, avoid dangerous obstacles, collect cash, and upgrade your firepower as you race toward the finish line. Every level brings new challenges, stronger enemies, and bigger rewards. Can you build the biggest gun and defeat the final boss? Features 🔫 Build gigantic weapons from stickmen 🏃 Fast-paced runner gameplay 💰 Collect cash and unlock upgrades 🚀 Merge parts to create stronger guns 🎯 Face challenging enemies and bosses 🌆 Bright, colorful 3D environments 🎮 Easy controls, satisfying gameplay
howToPlay: Swipe left and right to move your character. Collect stickmen and gun parts to build a bigger weapon. Pick up cash bundles to earn more coins. Avoid obstacles that reduce your weapon's size or power. Reach the finish line with the strongest gun possible. Defeat the final enemy to complete the level and earn rewards. Upgrade your damage, fire rate, and income to become unstoppable.

title: Madness Online
description: Madness Online is a brutal 2D top-down multiplayer survival shooter set in a procedurally generated infinite world. Players must navigate a hostile, apocalyptic environment by fighting off relentless waves of zombies and enemy entities. The game blends intense, fast-paced gunplay with deep survival mechanics, allowing players to gather resources, craft essential gear, and construct fortified bases. Featuring dynamic combat with dodge mechanics and an expansive inventory system, players can team up with friends to build and survive together, or face the unforgiving world solo.
howToPlay: WASD — Move Mouse — Aim and Shoot Spacebar — Dodge E — Interact B — Open Inventory R — Reload Q — Switch Weapon Enter — Chat

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Game
description: jigsaw puzzle game is a classic jigsaw puzzle game designed for players who enjoy calm and thoughtful gameplay. This brain puzzle Game helps improve concentration, memory, and logical thinking through relaxing challenges. Enjoy a collection of offline puzzle games that you can play anytime without an internet connection. The game offers smooth controls and clean visuals, making it a perfect casual puzzle experience for daily play.
howToPlay: - To click any button use mouse

title: Merge Builders
description: Open. Merge. Build! Dive into a bright and cheerful merge arcade where your goal is simple: assemble the ultimate toolkit and construct beautiful houses step by step. Buy mystery boxes, open them, and merge identical tools—like screwdrivers, paint rollers, and hammers—to upgrade their efficiency. Strategically hand the best tools to your four hardworking builders stationed around the foundation. They’ll work automatically while you focus on optimizing your board. Watch in satisfaction as the house realistically takes shape and grows right before your eyes! Take on increasingly ambitious construction projects, from a Cozy Cottage to a Grand Mansion. Each new building brings escalating requirements that will push your merging tactics to the limit. Grab limited-time gift events, boost your progress with Efficiency x2, and activate Auto-Open to speed up your workflow. Every decision matters as your building empire scales endlessly. Finish projects, earn rewards, and see how far your crew can go in an infinite challenge of fun and strategy. Complete the tutorial, master the coin economy, and prove that your team can construct any dream home!
howToPlay: Tap / Click the Buy button — purchase a box Tap / Click a box — open it (may require multiple taps) Drag & Drop an item — move tools between slots Drag an item onto an identical one — merge and upgrade Drag a tool to one of the 4 builders — they start building the house automatically Tap boost buttons (Efficiency x2, Auto Open) — activate temporary power-ups

title: Geometry Open World
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Geometry Open World, a dynamic 2D action game. Steer your vessel through challenging terrains, face various foes, and confront tough bosses. Utilize upgrades and skills to secure triumph. Ready to dominate this geometrical adventure? Enjoy it for free on your devices!
howToPlay: Controls A or left arrow key = move left D or right arrow key = move right Q = use shield E = use cannons Left mouse button = interact with in-game UI

title: Clash of Tanks
description: Clash of Tanks is real time strategy tank game. Objective is to destroy the opponent base by deploying the tanks. Each tank has its own weakness and strength, selecting the right tanks at appropriate time is best way to win the battle. Good Luck
howToPlay: Your objective is to destroy main defense of the enemy base. Desktop: Use mouse to drag and drop the units on the battlefield Mobile : Use touch to drag and drop the units on the battlefield

title: Monsters' Wheels Special
description: Monsters' Wheels Special is a 2D race game created by Smokoko. In this online game you race with your own monster truck in different stages like the Industrial, Forest, Arctic, Desert and City stage. Ugrade your monster truck so you can stay ahead of the competition and equip it with rockets and other weapons to really crush it. [Core Gameplay & Story] Q: What is the game about and what are the objectives? A: It is a racing platformer where you must navigate obstacles and cross the finish line first, mastering the vehicle's physics to succeed. Q: What is the game's unique hook and what makes it engaging? A: The game features an upgrade system, a cool soundtrack, monster trucks, and diverse environments like forests, cities, winter landscapes, industrial zones, and deserts. It also offers multiple modes, including traditional races and time trials. Q: What are the most engaging content elements? A: The highlight of the game is the collection of awesome monster trucks and several beautifully designed locations.
howToPlay: Desktop: Throttle - up arrow; Brake - down arrow; Lean backwards/forward - left/right arrow Mobile: Automatic acceleration; Tilt buttons to turn left/right; Nitro button - Nitro

title: Playground Ragdoll Sandbox
description: In the game world, you can do everything: ride cars, blow up buildings, fight enemies and complete exciting missions. Use a variety of weapons, build objects with a tulgan and experiment with destruction. The main goal of the game is to destroy the city using a nuclear bomb. How will you achieve this? It's up to you to decide. Move towards your goal through story missions or immerse yourself in a limitless sandbox of possibilities.
howToPlay: Your main goal is to blow up the city with a nuclear bomb. How exactly you will do this is up to you. On a PC, use WASD for movement, LMB for shooting, F to get into a vehicle. It's even easier on touch devices: all the necessary buttons are displayed on the screen, so you definitely won't miss anything!

title: Domino Camp
description: 🀄 Domino Camp is a fun and addictive puzzle game where strategy meets quick thinking! Match domino tiles, clear the board, and complete exciting challenges across a variety of levels. With simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying matches, Domino Camp offers endless entertainment for players of all ages. 🎯 Test your logic, improve your matching skills, and discover new ways to solve each puzzle. Whether you're looking for a relaxing experience or a brain-teasing challenge, Domino Camp is the perfect place to start your domino adventure! ✨ Features: 🀄 Easy-to-learn gameplay 🎮 Challenging puzzle levels ✨ Smooth animations and satisfying effects 🏆 Fun challenges and rewarding progression 🌟 Suitable for all ages Join the camp and become a domino master in Domino Camp! 🚀🀄
howToPlay: Use your mouse or touchscreen to interact with the domino tiles. Tap or click on a tile to select it, then match it with the current target number displayed at the bottom of the screen. Correct matches will help you clear tiles and progress through the game. Plan your moves carefully and try to complete each level using the fewest moves possible to achieve the highest score.

title: Brainrot Tower Defense
description: Single-player browser-based tower defense game with progressive waves, tower upgrades, resource collection, and optional meta-progression features.
howToPlay: Mouse / Touch: - Left Click or Tap: place towers - Click buttons to upgrade, sell, or interact with UI

title: Ants Io
description: Ants Io is a fast-paced and highly competitive multiplayer arena (.io) game. In this microscopic world, you embody a hungry ant striving to grow your colony by collecting food scattered across the map. The core philosophy is "Survive and Expand"—you must evade predators larger than yourself while seeking opportunities to outmaneuver and eliminate smaller rivals. What sets it apart is the fluid colony-following mechanics and dynamic gameplay where every bite brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Ant King.
howToPlay: Dominate the nest and rule the arena! Your primary goal is to consume food to increase your length and the size of your colony. Use clever maneuvers to force opponents to crash their heads into your trail, turning them into a feast of energy. The ultimate objective is to survive and become the largest ant on the leaderboard! PC Controls: Mouse Movement: Control the direction of your ant. Left Click / Spacebar: Consume energy to boost speed and intercept rivals. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Drag the joystick to move in any direction. Boost Button: Tap the designated button for a temporary speed burst.

title: Keepie Uppie Paddle Pong
description: Bounce the ball, collect coins, and unlock achievements. - Every hit = coins. - The more you bounce — the closer your next achievement. - Decorate your paddle with your favorite character and show your style. - Catch the vibe, laugh and complete the collection!
howToPlay: To control the rocket: - On a computer, move the mouse. - On a mobile device, move your finger across the screen.

title: Block Blast
description: Dive into this popular and free puzzle game designed to stretch your brain and entertain you during your free time. Your mission is simple yet thrilling: match and remove as many blocks as possible from the board.
howToPlay: Use your mouse or finger (on touch devices) to move and place the blocks on the board. Arrange them to form complete lines horizontally or vertically. When a line is completed, it will disappear, giving you more space to keep playing. Try to clear as many lines as possible without running out of space. The more lines you remove, the higher your score!

title: Backslash Slash
description: Backslash Slash is a keyboard-first blade clicker that turns simple key presses into satisfying combo chains. Instead of tapping, press /, \, P or K to strike a human-shaped training dummy using knives, daggers, machetes and more. Each key corresponds to different attack timing and combo opportunities — master the rhythm to unlock special multi-hit moves and new weapons as you level up. Key features: Keyboard controls: intuitive use of /, \, P, K for fast-paced slashing. Weapon variety: each blade (knife, dagger, machete) has unique speed and combo patterns. Combo progression: build and maintain combo chains to multiply damage and unlock advanced techniques. Level-based unlocks: reach higher levels to gain access to new combos, weapons and passive upgrades. Upgrade system: improve attack speed, combo window, crit chance and weapon power. Focused, stylized visuals emphasizing skill and progression. Whether you want quick, rhythmic keyboard action or deep upgrade planning, Backslash Slash delivers addictive feedback and meaningful progression. Learn key timings, discover the best combo sequences, and climb the ranks as you unlock ever-more lethal blades
howToPlay: Press /, \, P or K to strike a training dummy with knives, daggers & machetes. Unlock combos & new weapons as you level up

title: Brainrot Merge & Fight
description: Brainrot Merge & Fight is a chaotic strategy brawler where you fuse quirky heroes into stronger versions and send them into battle. Every merge boosts your squad’s power, letting you build crazy combinations to take on tougher enemies. With each fight, your evolving team grows funnier, wilder, and more unstoppable—can you conquer every challenge?
howToPlay: Mouse = interact with the game UI

title: Arklet
description: Welcome to Arklet - a cozy and meditative puzzle game where your talent for organizing turns into the art of creating harmony for the most adorable creatures. In this game, you become the caretaker of a unique ARKlet filled with charming "square" animals, each possessing its own personality, quirks, and little secrets. 🧩 Gameplay: Harmony in Every Block Your task is simple: distribute the arriving animals into cozy rooms. However, each ward is an individual. To complete a level perfectly, you must do more than just fill the space; you must ensure every animal feels completely safe and comfortable. 🐾 Consider Every Detail: Fears and Dislikes: A massive elephant might panic if placed in the same room as a tiny mouse. You will need to plan layouts so the giant doesn't even catch a glimpse of its small neighbor. Friendship and Socializing: Some animals, like meerkats or raccoons, love company, while bears or porcupines might prefer solitude in a far corner. (some of the pets are still WIP) Special Requests: Some dream of a room with a view of the lighthouse, while others need to be close to food supplies. 🌿 Relaxing Experience and Aesthetics The game features a detailed style that…
howToPlay: The main objective is to satisfy as much as possible amount of pets on the floor by pairing them with suitable neighbors. Experiment, use your wits, attention and resourcefulness to figure out how to do it in the most profitable way. The captain is watching you and shall task you with peculiar missions on your campaign. Use mouse/touch drag&drop to sort out animals into cabins

title: Constella - single line puzzle
description: Starlight - Single Line Drawing Puzzles Relax and unwind as you connect the stars to reveal beautiful constellations in this calming, line-complete puzzle experience. Journey through a serene celestial atmosphere where every single-line puzzle you solve brings a new shape to life. Draw your continuous path through the cosmos to discover hidden figures—from a peaceful desert cactus and a crisp apple, to a majestic celestial turtle and a starry crab. Enjoy a tranquil game that gently challenges your mind while soothing your soul.
howToPlay: - Left Click & Drag: Trace lines to connect stars and draw your path. - Left Click: Interact with in-game UI (Undo, Hints, or Skip levels). - Mouse Movement: Navigate the board.

title: Funny Hair Salon
description: George's hair is in a no bueno situation. His scalp is full of mites and pimps. The only way to fix his hair is going to the salon. Let's cure his scalp and plant new hair to his head, so he can show his true outter beauty!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive
description: Experience the excitement of Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive , a dynamic game where you merge items to craft powerful tools and potions. Test your strategy as you navigate dungeons. Play for free online on both mobile and desktop . Embrace your heroic side!
howToPlay: Welcome to our thrilling adventure game! Your journey consists of two main parts: merging items and exploring dungeons. Merging Items In the lower part of the screen, you will find the merging grid. This is where you combine different items to gain various effects: - Weapons: Merge different weapon parts to create powerful weapons that deal damage to enemies. - Potions: Combine potions to restore health and boost your survivability. - Keys: Merge keys to unlock chests scattered throughout the dungeon, which contain valuable loot. - Coin Pouches: Collect and merge coin pouches to purchase new items from the shop and expand your inventory by buying travel bags from the merchant. Dungeon Exploration In the upper part of the screen, your character moves through the dungeon level by level. Use the items you've merged to overcome challenges and defeat enemies as you delve deeper into the dungeon. Embark on this epic journey, combine powerful items, and conquer the depths of the dungeon!

title: Hipsters vs Rockers
description: Gaia, Ero and Ai are best friends forever. They like to try the latest fashion and compare with one another that suits them. This time they tried the style of rockers and hipsters. Wonder which fashion is suitable for them?
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Alpha Balls
description: Alpha Balls is a stimulating word puzzle game that sharpens your mind and vocabulary. Enjoy it online for free on any device. Solve puzzles to earn coins for hints, making it an entertaining and educational challenge for all.
howToPlay: Make words from letters. The hint can show you the first letters of an answer. If you press the bin, the additional letters that mislead you will be removed. Press the ball with a tick to confirm your answer and earn coins. You can spend coins for hints.

title: Fruits into Baskets
description: Just tap on the fruits, watch them fall into place, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything going where it belongs. Your goal is to clear the whole field and sort all the fruits into the right baskets. No timer, no pressure — just you, the fruits, and that satisfying feeling of order after each level. Perfect for short breaks when you need to unwind and breathe. Grab your phone, get comfortable, and sort fruits to your heart's content! 🍊🍋🍇
howToPlay: 🍊 Tap a fruit on the screen and it will fall. 🍊 If a fruit is stuck and can't fall — remove the ones blocking it from below first. 🍊 Collect 3 fruits in a basket and a new basket will open. 🍊 If there's no matching basket for a fruit — no worries, it will wait on a temporary plate. Clear all the fruits from the field — level complete. You're the best!

title: Loopvival
description: Loopvival is an atmospheric survival game with elements of roguelite, built around the mechanics of cycles. You find yourself in a world consumed by Darkness, where the only source of light is a bonfire in the center of the map. Collect resources, boost your fire, unlock new territories, and rebuild ruined ruins to learn the story of a lost world. Each cycle brings the world back to the beginning, but the campfire's progress and key improvements persist, gradually allowing you to move further into the Darkness. The simple action game, meditative gameplay, and gradual opening of the lore make Loopvival a short but seamless gaming experience.
howToPlay: Darkness covered the world. You are his last hope. But for some unknown reason, the loop resets every time. And only one permanent thing in this world is a bonfire. Your task is to break the cycle and overcome the Darkness. - Explore the world - Extract resources - Rebuild the ruins - the only reminder of the past world - Fight against the minions of Darkness. Desctop Controls: W,A,S,D - Movement LMB, Space - Attack E - Interaction Q - Switch the resource that you add to the ruins. Mobile Controls: Left On-Screen Joystick - Movement A-button - Attack E-button - Interaction Q-button - Switch the resource that you add to the ruins.

title: PopCats: Merge the cats!
description: PopCats: Merge the cats! is a fun online puzzle game where you combine matching cats to form bigger, cuter ones. Enjoy the playful feline stories while aiming for the top of the leaderboard. No downloads or sign-ups needed, perfect for all cat enthusiasts on any device!
howToPlay: - Connect identical seals into larger seals by clicking on the screen with your finger or mouse. - To get to know a cat and find out its history, click on its image in the bottom panel. - Make sure that the cats do not reach the top line, otherwise the game will end! - You can change the next cat for watching ads. - Use yarn to remove the interfering cat, and remember - the main thing here is not to miss! - Collect points to take a leading position in the player rankings. - Win by connecting the two biggest cats!

title: Emoji Sort
description: Emoji Sort is a pattern recognition puzzle game where players must fill in empty cells with the correct emojis. Each puzzle presents a grid with missing emojis that follow specific patterns - such as categories, sequences, or associations. Players analyze the existing emojis to identify the pattern (animals, food chains, transportation types, etc.) and select the appropriate emojis to complete the grid. The game features 80 increasingly challenging levels with various pattern types, and includes a hint system to help when players get stuck. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts who enjoy discovering logical connections between visual elements!
howToPlay: Select the appropriate emoji by clicking or touching it. Each puzzle may seem nonsensical, but there is only one correct answer!

title: Obby Maker
description: Create your own levels and play levels made by other players! Build your own obby courses, come up with challenges, and share them with other players! In this editor, you can create unique levels, customize obstacles, add logic, and program object behavior. Use the flexible editor to build simple parkour maps, complex puzzles, mini-games, traps, moving platforms, and levels with custom rules. Customize objects, add events, experiment with mechanics, and turn your ideas into full game worlds. Game features: * Create obby courses and parkour levels * Object, obstacle, and platform editor * Logic and element behavior settings * Programming of in-game events * Levels of different difficulty * Ability to invent your own rules and challenges * Suitable for beginners and experienced creators Build, test, improve, and create obby levels that other players will want to beat!
howToPlay: Use the “?” button in the editor to read the help section. Use the editor to create your own levels. You can also copy and modify levels you like by using the “Remix” button. Once your level is ready, publish it so other players can play it.

title: Dungeon Descent
description: Loot. Survive. Descend deeper. A fast voxel dungeon crawler with deadly rooms, powerful gear, and bosses waiting below.
howToPlay: Dungeon Descent is a fast-paced voxel dungeon crawler. Clear rooms of monsters, crack open chests, and stack weapons, armor, upgrades, and artifacts as you push deeper. Combat is quick and deadly—dodge, swap weapons on the fly, and unleash artifact powers when the fight turns ugly. Each run gets harder, with tougher biomes, brutal bosses, and Ascension modes for players who want more heat. Loot. Survive. Descend deeper.

title: Build the Bridge
description: Build the Bridge is a fun and challenging physics puzzle game where you control both sides of a bridge to help the explorer safely cross dangerous gaps. Use precise timing and smart movements to create the perfect path, overcome obstacles, and complete increasingly difficult levels. Easy to learn but hard to master!
howToPlay: Objective: Guide the explorer safely across each gap by adjusting both sides of the bridge. Build a stable path and reach the finish flag to complete the level. Controls (Keyboard): A – Extend the left side of the bridge. S – Retract the left side of the bridge. K – Retract the right side of the bridge. L – Extend the right side of the bridge. M - Mute, unmute Enter – Start the game / Continue. Space – Continue after completing a level. Goal: Create the perfect bridge, avoid mistakes, and complete every level with precise timing and careful planning.

title: BitBanda
description: BitBanda is your music studio in your pocket! No instrument skills needed: just tap the sound cards, and cheerful musicians take the stage and start playing together. All the sounds are pre-matched in rhythm and key, so playing badly is impossible. From the very first tap, you create a real track! Feel like a true DJ: control the volume of each musician, trigger solos, tweak effects (filter, echo, reverb), build your track from scenes, and arrange your mix. Hunt for secret sound combinations — they unlock bonuses and turn the stage into a real party!
howToPlay: 1. Tap the sound cards at the bottom — musicians will take the stage and play together. Any combination sounds great! 2. Control each musician: adjust the volume with the slider, trigger solo (🎧) or mute (🔉), and remove what you don't need. 3. Tweak the effects — filter, echo, and reverb — to give your track its own sound. 4. Fill the scenes with different sounds, arrange them into a mix, and tap "Track" to hear the whole composition from start to finish. 5. Hunt for 🔮 secret sound combos — they give bonus Notes and launch party mode. 6. Save your track or publish it to the Catalog. Listen to others' work, give likes ❤, and make remixes 🎭. 7. Earn Notes, unlock new musical worlds and accessories, complete the daily challenge, and compete for the title of Champion of the Week!

title: Unfamiliar Object
description: Unfamiliar Object is a first-person office-horror inspection game about finding the one thing that does not belong. Read the rules, explore a silent night-shift corridor, photograph the true anomaly, and submit your evidence by fax before procedure turns hostile. Each shift twists ordinary office objects into something quietly impossible.
howToPlay: Inspect the office corridor and find the object that does not belong. Click to enter mouse look, use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move, and move the mouse to look around. Press Space to raise or lower the inspection camera. While the camera is raised, aim at the outlined object and left-click to take a photo. Bring the evidence to the correct highlighted fax machine and left-click to submit it before time runs out. Do not report the wrong object, do not re-enter a photographed room, and follow the changing rules to survive all shifts.

title: Dress Up Anime Girl
description: Anime DressUp is a fun online game that lets you style a cute anime princess. With a variety of outfits, hairstyles, and makeup, you can unleash your creativity and fashion skills. Enjoy creating unique looks and make your princess a standout fashionista in her realm!
howToPlay: Create your perfect anime character! Make a screenshot and use it as your avatar. Features: 1. Graphics in anime style 2. 10 692 000 combinations of the appearance 3. Many unusual items 4. Cute cats 5. Screenshot button 6. Random button

title: Arkanoid For Painters
description: Arkanoid For Painters is a thrilling online game where players create barriers to control a ball, clearing blocks and foes. It blends classic gameplay with artistic elements, catering to creative strategists. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it guarantees entertaining challenges on the go.
howToPlay: In this game you draw an obstacle for a ball instead of controlling a boring board. Also plenty of interesting upgrades are waiting for you. Draw with left mouse button or your finger.

title: Farmers vs. Aliens
description: Lead the animals to their enclosures, identified by green arrows and matching images. Keep them inside the green zone to prevent alien abductions! As the game progresses, it slows down at a certain point. If you don't gather the animals in time, aliens will arrive to take them. Leaving the green zone—whether it's you or the animals—will trigger a UFO to appear and abduct them. If aliens take more than two animals or capture you, it's game over. Stay fast and remain in the green zone to survive!
howToPlay: PC: Use the mouse to control the character. Clicking the left mouse button will make the player follow the cursor. Mobile: Drag the on-screen joystick in the direction you want the character to move. Gamepad: Move the left stick to make the character run in the direction of the tilt.

title: Amigurumi: Cozy Stitches
description: Welcome to your cozy amigurumi workshop! Craft adorable knitted friends with your own hands — from sweet bears and bunnies to fantastical dragons and dinosaurs. Every toy comes to life in 4 delightful stages: - Knit the parts by tracing spirals with your finger - Stuff them with soft filling to perfect plumpness - Sew on little paws, ears, and tails - Style the face — eyes, nose, smile, and accessories Choose your yarn color and type, fulfill customer orders, display your toys in the shop window, level up your crafter skills, and complete your full collection. New quests and bonuses await you every day!
howToPlay: 1. Choose a toy from the catalog and pick your yarn color 2. Knitting: trace your finger along the spiral, looping each stitch row by row 3. Stuffing: tap the piece to fill it up — watch the gauge to hit the perfect zone 4. Assembly: press and hold each part until it's sewn onto the body 5. Decorating: place the eyes, nose, and mouth on the face, then add blush or a bow 6. Sell your finished toys, fulfill orders, and save up coins for new materials 7. Level up to unlock new categories, colors, and yarn types

title: Luchaball
description: Knock the various masks off the Luchaballs and equip them with green masks! Collect pickups along the way and see how far you can progress in this endless physics game!
howToPlay: Use your mouse to aim and left click to fire! The further your mouse is from the mask, the harder you fire it.

title: Fake Ninjas
description: There are fake ninjas in town who have caused dishonour to your master. You have to find them all and redeem yourself to the master
howToPlay: Click on the ground to move. Tap the screen on touch devices to move. Your goal is to move to all of the enemy fake ninjas to eliminate them. Prove yourself to the master

title: Supermarket Manager
description: Try your hand as a Supermarket Manager! Develop your store by purchasing shelves for products, which you will need to stock yourself at the beginning. Earn profits by serving customers and invest your earnings to hire staff like stockers and cashiers. Boost the prestige of your supermarket by improving the quality of the products you sell.
