Then, invest in more expensive shelves and fill them with a wider variety of goods. Start earning maximum profits from serving each customer and build the supermarket of your dreams!
howToPlay: For PC Controls = Use the left mouse button or the WASD keys to move your character For Smartphone Controls = Hold your finger on the screen and drag it in the direction you want the character to move To purchase a shelf or a cash register, stand on the corresponding areas marked on the game field To stock shelves with products, first load products from the warehouse, then carry them to the appropriate shelf In the warehouse area, you'll find a computer. Approaching it will open the store management menu. Here, you can improve product quality or hire staff

title: Blondie in the Real World
description: Blondie lives in her perfect doll world. She is happy, but one day she realizes that something is wrong with her life. Her life is too artificial and perfect. Blondie decides to go to the real world to feel real. Help the Blonde to embody her image in makeup. Bake a cake for the guests and put things in order with Blondie in her new apartment. Choose an adorable party outfit for her and remember that Blondie's favorite colors are pink, gold and white.
howToPlay: The heroine of the game finally decided to take off her pink glasses and plunge into boring reality. The girl is having a hard time and she needs your help to just clean the room, make a cake for the guests and dress up for the party herself. The result can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

title: Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!
description: 🌟 Welcome to "Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!" — an exciting online game with ragdoll physics, where every descent turns into a real adventure! Roll, tumble, dodge obstacles and prove that you are the best in this crazy race with epic falls and popular meme heroes! If you like such popular games as "Deadly Slide!" or "Ragdoll Crash Test: Throw and Break!", then quickly click "Play" and enjoy the exciting gameplay. 🔥 Game features: - Simple and intuitive controls - Funny ragdoll physics: watch your hero tumble, break and get up again! 🤸 - Cartoon 3D graphics and funny animations make every fall even funnier - Skin shop: play as Hagi Wagi, Stickman, Noob, Obby and other popular heroes - Compete in the leaderboard and show the best result - Online game for any device: smartphone, PC or tablet
howToPlay: 🤪 Control the fall of a ragdoll hero who rolls, tumbles and crashes into everything! Your goal is to roll to the finish line. 📱On mobile, swipe left or right to change the direction of movement. 🖥️ On PC, use arrow keys or mouse.

title: Basketball Tap
description: Basketball Tap is a fast-paced casual sports game. Time your taps perfectly, launch the ball into the air, and score epic slam dunks!
howToPlay: Tap the screen, control the ball, and guide it toward the basket to make your best shots and score points!

title: Carrom Club
description: Super Carrom — the classic tabletop game, reimagined for your browser. Flick your striker to pot coins, sink the queen, and outplay a opponent. Place your bets, build your coin stash, and climb from casual games to high-stakes tables. Smooth physics, satisfying shots, and quick matches you can play anywhere — on desktop or mobile.
howToPlay: Desktop - use mouse to drag the striker on rail left / right and pullback to aim and shoot. Mobile - same controls as desktop use touch.

title: Night Club Security
description: Immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of a security guard simulator inspired by the cult game I'm Security. Check visitors for prohibited items, decide who is worthy of entry and who is not. Your power is absolute, because you are an unlimited security guard! Use your imagination to have fun and unusual "entertainment" with visitors, leaving them without things or even with a couple of bruises. Everything that happens is in your hands. Game features: 🔎 Check people for prohibited items. 🕶 Decide who to allow entry and who to refuse. 🤪 Give free rein to your imagination - everything is allowed! 🤝 Interact with visitors in any way. 🎭 Feel like a real "owner" of the club.
howToPlay: Desktop: WASD or arrow keys = move E = interact or take F = drop Left mouse button = use tools P = pause Try on the role of a nightclub security guard, using visitor screening and complete freedom of action to achieve maximum entertainment and control over the situation.

title: Lost Adventure
description: "Survivors of a mid-air crash find themselves in a mysterious land. The pilot, amidst crafting, mining, and solving puzzles, works tirelessly to save passengers stranded on separate islands in the wild grass. Can they conquer the challenges, reunite, and escape the enigmatic realm before the unknown dangers lurking in the wilderness engulf them all?" Embark on a thrilling adventure after a plane crash strands you in a mysterious, wild land. As the pilot, you must gather resources from wreckage, craft tools, and navigate through the wild grass to rescue scattered passengers on small islands. Explore ancient ruins, solve puzzles, and mine resources to unlock the secrets of this enigmatic realm. Encounter friendly and hostile creatures, and use your crafted weapons to survive. Communicate with other survivors, separated by streams and dense vegetation, through makeshift signals. Your journey is a test of resilience and camaraderie. Each crafted item brings you closer to reuniting with your fellow survivors and discovering the way back home. Will you conquer the challenges of the wild grass and unveil the mysteries hidden within, or succumb to the unknown dangers that lurk in the shad…
howToPlay: Become a True Survivor! Step into the role of a skilled pilot whose plane has crash-landed on an uncharted island—one that doesn’t exist on any Earth map. In this gripping RPG survival adventure, your mission is clear: find and rescue every passenger, brave the unknown, and uncover the island’s secrets. Scavenge for resources, battle mysterious threats, and lead your group to safety. Rebuild what’s broken, forge alliances, and piece together a way off the island. Every choice matters, and survival depends on your courage, cunning, and determination. Can you reunite your crew, outsmart the dangers, and escape the island that time forgot? Desktop Controls: W/↑ (Up Arrow): Move forward. S/↓ (Down Arrow): Move backward. A/← (Left Arrow): Move left. D/→ (Right Arrow): Move right. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick.

title: Mine Mining Islands 2: Skyblock City!
description: Dive into a world of mining adventures and build your own city! — Become the mayor: upgrade buildings, trade with villagers, and grow your city — Explore islands: discover new lands and mine valuable resources — Upgrade your character: improve speed, strength, and luck — Fight and defend: protect the city from monster raids and battle in the arena — Earn wealth: sell resources and become the most successful player Are you ready to become the best mayor and hero of this world?
howToPlay: 🖥 PC: W, A, S, D or ↑ ← ↓ → — movement Button on the right — break blocks / attack 📱 Mobile devices: Joystick on the left — movement Button on the right — break blocks / attack

title: Kitty Grid Puzzle
description: Welcome to Kitty Grid Puzzle, a relaxing logic game where adorable cats are waiting for their perfect space! Each kitty has a number that shows exactly how many grid squares its room must contain. Drag across the board to create correctly sized rectangles, give every cat its own cozy room and fill the entire grid without leaving empty spaces. The puzzles begin simple but gradually become more challenging, encouraging you to think carefully, plan each move and improve your spatial reasoning. Cute cat reactions, satisfying grid-filling gameplay and clever levels make every puzzle enjoyable to solve.
howToPlay: Look at the number shown beside each cat. The number tells you how many grid squares that cat’s room must cover. Touch and drag across the grid to create a rectangular room. Every rectangle must contain exactly one cat. The rectangle’s total number of squares must match the cat’s number. Rooms cannot overlap or extend outside the grid. Fill every square on the board to complete the puzzle.

title: Unboxing Brainrots
description: Open cases, collect Italian animals, upgrade your weapons, and develop your base in the world of the funny Brainrots!
howToPlay: Welcome to Unboxing Brainrots - a vibrant and wildly addictive game where every click brings you closer to new discoveries! 🎁🐾 A whole world of surprises awaits you here: ✨ Open mysterious cases and find rare Italian animals with unique designs. ⚔️ Upgrade and upgrade your weapons to be ready for any challenge. 🐒 Collect and breed pets, create incredible combinations, and unlock new creatures. 🏰 Develop your own base: build, mine resources, and become a true unboxing master. Every case holds a surprise, and every new discovery can be decisive! Will you be able to collect the entire collection of funny animals, unite them into a team, and create your own invincible empire? 🌈 Colorful graphics, frantic action, and a sea of ​​humor await you in this game! 🎮 Become part of the crazy world of Brainrots and prove that you're the best collector! For PC: W A S D - Move Left mouse button - Hit the box Mouse movement - Camera movement For phone: Left side of the screen - Move the joystick Right side of the screen - Control the camera Tap the screen - Hit the box

title: Devil Die
description: Devil Die looks like a simple, cute 2D platformer until the floor suddenly disappears, spikes pop out of nowhere, and the “safe” door turns into a trap. You play as a tiny pixel hero trying to reach the exit door in each stage. The controls are super easy, but the levels are full of hidden tricks: falling platforms, surprise buzzsaws, moving walls, reversed controls, fake safe zones, and more. The game starts simple and then slowly turns into a rage-game where every step can be a trap.
howToPlay: Mobile Controls : Left arrow – Move left Right arrow – Move right Jump button – Jump over gaps and traps PC / Laptop Controls: A key → Move left D key → Move right Space bar → Jump Reach the exit door in every level. Avoid all spikes, pits, saws and hidden traps. If you touch a trap, you die and restart the level.

title: Panda Go!
description: Panda Go: The ultimate test of reflex and rhythm! Tap to soar through glowing rings, chain perfect combos, and dodge mind-bending obstacles. Collect coins, power up with shields and magnets, and unlock unique pandas. Simple to play, impossible to put down—how far can you fly?
howToPlay: How to Play Objective: Guide your panda through an endless stream of rings and achieve the highest score! Controls: Tap (or Left Click) to flap and fly upward. Gameplay: Your panda moves forward automatically. Time your taps carefully to pass cleanly through rings and avoid hitting walls or obstacles. Combos: Chain perfect passes through the center of rings to build combos and skyrocket your score! Power-ups: Collect coins to upgrade and look out for: Shield: Protects you from a single collision. Magnet: Automatically pulls in nearby coins. Revive: Crashed? Use your one chance per run to watch an ad and keep the momentum going! Goal: There is no end—survive as long as possible, collect loot, and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Controls Start/Action/Revive: Tap anywhere on screen or Left Mouse Click. Aim for Perfection: Perfect ring passes are the secret to massive combo multipliers. Power-up Strategy: Save your revive for your best runs—don't waste it when you're just starting…

title: Epicrolla
description: Epicrolla is a one-tap isometric roller. Your ball climbs a diamond grid hopping corner to corner — every tap flips its heading left or right, and it bounces off the edges. Survive the gaps, lava, boxes and spinning portals long enough to hit each stage's tile goal. Snatch item boxes for Invincibility, Coin Magnet, Slow-Mo, Dodge and Push power-ups, bank coins, and spend them on permanent upgrades, ball skins and a repeatable Second Chance. Easy to pick up, hard to master.
howToPlay: click/space/tap change ball roll direction. Roll as far as you can and clear each stage by travelling its required number of tiles without falling into a gap, hitting lava, or crashing into an obstacle.

title: Ninja Survival Simulator
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Hockey Brawl
description: Hockey Brawl is chaos hockey — move your player and let physics do the rest. Body checks send helmets flying, sticks shatter glass, and a random modifier flips the rules every match. Climb three leagues to unlock arenas and cosmetics, or grab a friend for local 2-player mayhem.
howToPlay: Player 1: WASD. Player 2 (local): Arrow Keys. Mobile: drag the touch joystick. Movement is your only input — everything else is emergent physics.

title: Category Match
description: Category Match is a fun, relaxing, and brain-teasing puzzle game where you match cute memoji cards by their correct categories. Look carefully at every card, understand the character style, and place each memoji into the right group. Every level gives you a new matching challenge where smart moves, good observation, and simple logic help you clear the board. The game starts easy, but as you progress, the puzzles become more interesting with more categories, limited space, and tricky card arrangements. You need to think before every move and match the memojis in the best way. With colorful visuals, smooth gameplay, satisfying matches, and easy controls, Category Match is perfect for players who love matching games, sorting games, card puzzles, emoji games, and relaxing brain games. Match the cards, complete the categories, and clear every level with your best strategy!
howToPlay: Look at the memoji cards on the board. Find cards that belong to the same category. Tap and move each card to the correct group. Match all memojis with the right category to clear the level. Use your empty space carefully because some levels have limited space. Think before placing a card, because the wrong move can block your next match. Complete all category groups and win the level.

title: Shadow Stick Ninja
description: Shadowstick Ninja is a physics puzzle game with a dark, minimalist style. In this game, precision is more important than speed. You play as a silent shadow ninja with only a few arrows. In each level, enemy ninjas hide behind obstacles and structures, waiting for you to take them out. Your goal is to eliminate every enemy. The way you do it is up to you! Pull back, aim, and release to shoot arrows with the right trajectory. Pick from different arrow types and solve each level your own way: - Regular arrows for clean, direct hits - Bomb arrows to cause explosive area damage and break through obstacles - Balloon arrows that attach to enemies and lift them into the air, exposing them for easier shots There isn’t just one right answer. You can play smart and efficient, or try out new ideas and experiment as much as you want. Lift an enemy into the air with balloons. Use lots of bombs just to see what happens. Try odd angles, mix up different moves, or come up with wild solutions. Every arrow counts. If you run out of ammo, you’ll need to rethink your strategy and give it another shot. Plan your moves, try bold ideas, and enjoy every physics-based takedown.
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: - Click and drag with your mouse to aim your shot. - Release the mouse button to fire the arrow. - Change how far and at what angle you drag to control the power and direction, similar to using a slingshot. Mobile Controls: - Tap and drag with your finger to aim your shot. - Release your finger to fire the arrow. Arrow Selection: - Choose your arrow type from the icons at the top left of the screen before you shoot. - Each arrow type has limited ammo, so pick carefully. - You can finish levels with any mix of arrows, depending on your strategy. Objective: - Take out all enemy ninjas with the arrows you have. If you run out of arrows before beating the level, try again with a different approach.

As they combine, their value increases. Carefully select cubes with different points, considering their placement to match with others effectively. Be mindful, as cubes may appear individually or in pairs. Merge three or more dice horizontally or vertically to create higher-valued cubes. Utilize the storage space wisely to save cubes for later use. Test your puzzle-solving skills in this engaging dice-merging game!

title: Durak
description: Durak is essentially a shedding card game where each player will try to get rid of the cards in their hand first. Durak is quite an enjoyable game that has over the years made a general impact on millions. The loser in Durak will be the last player with cards in their hand. So, to ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can. Durak is the most popular Russian card game. Durak means fool and it refers to the person who loses the game. A Durak card game is one of the easiest and most fun card games. Players do not need much to get started. You will only need: a poker deck reduced to 36 cards from Ace to 6. However, this game is quite interesting because there will usually be multiple winners. To ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can. Durak might not be a game you are overly familiar with. howToPlay: Durak is played by 2 to 4 players. Total cards used are 36 cards - Only 6 7 8 9 10 J Q K A of all suits are used. The deck is shuffled, and each player is dealt with 6 cards. The bottom card of the stock is turned and placed face up on the table. The rest of the pack is then placed on half over the turn-up and at right angles to it, so that it remains visible. The trump suit is drawn as the last card. The first person to play is the one who holds the lowest trump suit in his hand. The game proceeds in a clockwise direction. The player who started to play acts as an attacker and the player sitting next to him in a clockwise direction acts as a defender. The player who has the lowest trump card will be the first attacker. If the attack succeeds, the defender loses their turn, and the attack passes to the player on the defender's left. If the attack fails, the defender becomes the next attacker. The attacker opens their turn by playing a card face up on the table as an attacking card. Defender responds to the attack with a defending card. A trump card of any rank beats all cards in the other three suits To win Durak, you need to play all your cards quickly. Once you have played your…

Play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, stress-free puzzle experience 😴✨. • Beautiful & Colorful 🎨 Bright hex blocks, smooth animations, and clean visuals make every puzzle satisfying to complete 💎. How to Play 🕹️ • Drag hexagonal blocks ⬡ and place them into the grid. • Blocks cannot be rotated 🔄❌, so plan your moves wisely 🤔. • Fill the available spaces perfectly to complete the puzzle ✅. • Progress through increasingly challenging layouts and obstacles 🚀. Features You’ll Enjoy ⭐ • Simple Yet Addictive Gameplay 🎯 Easy to start, hard to master – perfect for…
howToPlay: Drag hexagonal blocks onto the grid using your mouse or touch controls. Place each block carefully to fill the available spaces. Blocks cannot be rotated, so plan your moves strategically. Complete the grid to solve the puzzle and progress to more challenging levels. Use logic and smart placement to achieve the best results.

title: Sway - Tower Builder
description: Sway is a relaxing one-tap tower builder. It's simple, no need to remember thousands of rules and combinations. Simply stack blocks high, keep them steady and comete with other players!
howToPlay: A block swings from a crane — tap at just the right moment to drop it onto the tower. Line it up for a "Perfect" and the tower grows steadily; miss, and it topples. Three misses and the run is over — so keep it steady and reach for a new best.

title: Monster Merge: Legends Alive
description: Monster Merge: Legends Alive is a fun puzzle game where you combine monsters to score points and advance. Playable online for free, it features engaging gameplay with mythical creatures. Available on both desktops and Android, it offers an enjoyable experience for all ages who love a good challenge.
howToPlay: Press and hold your finger or mouse button within the playing area to select the monster's fall trajectory. Release your finger or mouse button and the monster will fall onto the playing field! It will be easy to connect monsters at first, but with each new one the playing field will fill up. Drop identical monsters on top of each other. When the highest-ranking monster connects, it will disappear and you will get more points.

title: RECOIL
description: 🔫 Recoil A point-and-shoot platformer where every shot pushes you closer to victory… or straight into death. Recoil is a point-and-shoot game built around a simple idea: your weapon is also your movement. Each shot launches you through dangerous, handcrafted levels filled with traps, precision jumps, and brutal timing challenges. Expect unique, fun level designs, instant restarts, and endless deaths as you fight against momentum, physics, and your own reflexes. Frustrating? Absolutely. Satisfying? Even more. Master recoil, embrace failure, and try again.
howToPlay: 🎮 How to Play Move your mouse to rotate the player and aim the gun. Left Mouse Button to shoot. Every shot creates a powerful recoil force. When you shoot, the player is launched in the opposite direction of the bullet. Use recoil momentum to navigate the level, avoid hazards, and reach the goal. Master your aim, control your momentum, and use recoil wisely — one bad shot can send you straight to your death.

title: Mine Obby: +1 Dig Power per Hit
description: 🧱 Blocky Adventure Dive into a blocky world of mines, obby challenges, and upgrades! Break blocks, pass obstacles, and grow stronger with every hit. ⚒️ +1 Dig Power per Hit Every hit increases your digging power. The more you hit, the faster you break stone, ore, and tough layers of the ground. 💎 Resources and Rewards Collect resources, unlock new depths, and earn rewards for your progress. Each stage becomes more exciting and challenging. 🎒 Skins and Pickaxes Change your hero’s look, unlock new skins, choose pickaxes, and create your own style in the blocky world. 🚀 Dig Deeper and Deeper Upgrade your hero, set new records, and see how far you can go!
howToPlay: 💻 PC: WASD - character movement 🏃 Right mouse button - rotate camera 🔄 Left mouse button - interact ⛏️ Space - jump 🦘 📱 Mobile devices: Joystick - character movement 🏃 Touch screen - rotate camera 🔄 Action button - interact ⛏️ Jump button - jump 🦘

title: Sticker Jam: Peel Off & Match
description: Dive into the lively experience of Sticker Jam, a free online puzzle game that merges sticker collecting with engaging challenges. Whether on your phone or computer, it's an enjoyable way to relax and stimulate your mind after a busy day.
howToPlay: Relax and unwind with Sticker Jam, the ultimate matching puzzle game where you peel off vibrant stickers and match colors to solve fun and engaging challenges! This unique blend of relaxation and brain-teasing puzzles will keep you entertained for hours. How to Play: ✨ Peel Off Stickers: Tap to remove stickers from the board. 🎯 Match Colors: Find and match three identical stickers or colors to clear them. 🧩 Solve Puzzles: Complete each level by matching all stickers and unlock new levels with more complex sticker-peeling challenges. Game Features: 🧘 Calming Sticker Gameplay: Peel off and match colorful stickers at your own pace in this relaxing puzzle game. 🧩 Triple Match Color Puzzles: Easy to learn but challenging to master, offering endless sticker-matching fun. 🌈 Vibrant Sticker Designs: Discover beautifully designed stickers in each level, making the game both fun and visually stunning. 🔓 Challenging Puzzle Levels: Progress through increasingly complex levels that introduce new challenges and color-matching puzzles. 🏆 Milestones & Rewards: Earn bonuses, unlock achievements, and reach new goals as you advance through each puzzle. Why You’ll Love Sticker Jam: 🧘‍♂️ Relax…

title: Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami
description: Welcome to Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami! A fast-paced escape game that blends tsunami runner, idle game, and idle tycoon mechanics into one addictive experience. Run, jump, and survive while escaping giant waves, collecting brainrots, and building your Brainrot empire. This is more than just a runner. Escape Brainrots Tsunami Obby is a true survival runner with long-term progression, idle systems, and satisfying upgrades. Escape the Tsunami A massive tsunami is coming and you must escape before it reaches you. Every second matters. 🌊 Classic tsunami obby and tsunami runner gameplay 🏃 Run fast, jump obstacles, and survive dangerous zones ⚡ Reflex-based escape game mechanics Collect Brainrots and Progress Brainrots are the main resource in this game. The more you collect, the faster your empire grows. 🧠 Collect brainrots during runs 💸 Turn brainrots into money 📈 Grow into a powerful idle tycoon
howToPlay: Collect brainrots, craft them, and get the rarest brainrots by building an empire! Computer controls: WASD - to move E - interact with objects G - throw brain rot F - turn on cursor Use the UI to control mobile devices

title: Village of Colors
description: Dive into the lively realm of Village of Colors, where your imagination is key. In this free online game, defend the village by sketching protective barriers. With unique villagers and challenging foes, you can pause time and boost your skills to keep your vibrant home safe.
howToPlay: To protect your villagers from enemies, draw obstacles with your mouse or finger on the screen. Buy abilities in the store on the main menu to make the game easier. All features are described in the Hero's Help.

title: Grand Truck Simulator
description: Get behind the wheel of powerful trucks in this realistic grand truck simulator! Your mission is simple yet challenging — drive to the location of a broken-down car, load it onto your flatbed trailer, and transport it safely to the repair shop. Navigate busy roads, sharp turns, and unexpected obstacles on your route. Precision matters — secure the vehicle properly before hitting the highway! Unlock and choose from a variety of trucks, each with unique handling and performance. Complete delivery jobs, earn rewards, and upgrade your fleet to become the ultimate roadside hero. Feel the thrill of heavy vehicle transport, test your driving skills, and prove you’re the best recovery truck driver in town! Ready to tow, haul, and deliver? Start the engine and roll out!
howToPlay: Use Arrow Keys to control and steer the truck through the city roads. Drive carefully, follow the route to the broken-down vehicle, and load it onto your flatbed. Once secured, transport it safely to the repair shop to complete your delivery mission. Avoid crashing into traffic — each collision costs you a life, so drive smart and stay alert. Complete tasks to earn rewards and unlock more powerful trucks. Keep towing, keep hauling, and become the best truck rescuer on the road

title: DOP Fun: Delete One Part
description: Play the popular logic game DOP Fun: Delete One Part! This game invites you to use logic to tackle engaging and smart puzzles, each erasure unveiling new secrets. Prepare to become a true detective as you explore images and uncover the hidden mysteries behind them. Get ready for each level to surprise you with unexpected plot twists! Simple and clear gameplay makes DOP Fun: Delete One Part the perfect choice for anyone looking for quality entertainment. Simply swipe the eraser across the screen to remove parts of the drawing and discover what is hidden behind it. The game is suitable for both children and adults, enhancing skills in critical thinking and attention to detail. Enjoy the colorful graphics and creative challenges that will keep you entertained. It strengthens mental abilities and provides tons of fun for players of all ages.
howToPlay: 🔍 Swipe the eraser to remove parts of the drawing and reveal hidden objects or scenarios. 🧠 Use logic and attention to detail to solve the puzzle correctly. 💡 If you get stuck, use hints to continue.

title: Mega Ramp Car
description: Get ready for nonstop action in a high-speed driving game built around giant ramps, massive jumps, and extreme stunts. Take control of powerful cars, launch into the air, perform daring tricks, and push your driving skills to the limit across a variety of exciting levels. Enjoy realistic physics and sound effects, a wide selection of vehicles, and plenty of missions designed to keep every run fun and challenging. Unlock new cars, complete events, and prove yourself in bigger and more intense races.
howToPlay: Choose a car, enter stunt-filled levels, and race across giant ramps while performing jumps and tricks. Complete missions, earn rewards, and buy new vehicles to take on even greater challenges. Keep your speed under control, land your jumps, and finish each level as successfully as possible.

title: Soccer Strike
description: Experience casual soccer at its finest with intuitive pull-back and strike controls. Form your striking lineup, aim for the goal, and enjoy Soccer Strike—the perfect mix of fun and competitive play in an instant game tribute to the world's favorite sport.
howToPlay: Drag backward to aim and adjust the shot power. Release to strike the ball toward the goal. Score goals by aiming carefully past defenders and obstacles. Build and customize your striker lineup for better performance.

title: Bubble Gum
description: Blow it up and rise high! 🎈✨ Welcome to an exciting arcade game where lightness is your secret weapon! Inflate balloons, dodge obstacles, and climb as high as you can! The bigger your balloon, the more coins you earn - but watch out for spikes! How big can you grow your balloon?
howToPlay: - Tap the screen to inflate the balloon and control its size. - Watch out for spikes! - Match the number on the lock with your balloons to open it.

title: shrinkzone.io
description: Welcome to Shrinkzone, a lightning-fast, doodle-style battle royale where survival depends on your appetite! Start off as a tiny blob and devour food scattered across the map to grow larger and stronger. But beware — other players are doing the same. Use quick reflexes and clever movement to avoid the giants and hunt down the weak. As the shrinking safe zone forces players closer together, only the smartest and hungriest will survive. Are you ready to dominate the arena and claim the top spot?
howToPlay: Keyboard • Move – WASD Mobile • Move – On-screen joystick

title: Sprunki Adventure 5
description: 🎮 Welcome to the scorching world of "Sprunki Adventure 5"! ☀️🌵 A new disaster has struck the world of Sprunki — extreme global warming has turned the once peaceful lands into a blazing desert! The rivers have dried up, the lakes have disappeared, and everyone is desperately searching for water. 💧 Begin a brand-new adventure with Sprunki! 🥤 Collect 15 bottles of water hidden across the world 👥 Help characters and complete exciting quests Your main goal is to find all 15 bottles of water and fill the giant bathtub before the heat becomes unbearable.
howToPlay: PC Controls: Move — W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys; Jump — Space; Run — Shift; Crouch — C; Interact — E; Open Menu — Tab; Open Inventory — I; Zoom Camera — Right Mouse Button (RMB); Bonus Speed from Ads — Z; Bonus Jump Power from Ads — X. Mobile Controls: Move — Joystick; Jump — Jump Button; Run — Run Button; Crouch — Crouch Button; Rotate Camera — Right side of the screen; Open Inventory — Button in the top-left corner; Interact — Button with the "E" icon; Open Menu — Button in the top-right corner.

title: Obby Pizza Delivery
description: Become a delivery boy in the maze and deliver pizzas to the locals. Rent a scooter to move faster. Pick a bigger bag so you can take more orders at a time and deliver even more pizzas. Complete orders, increase your reputation and open new zones with residents!
howToPlay: 🏃‍♂️ Pick up orders at the pizzeria and deliver them to the residents 🛴 Rent a scooter to move faster 🌟 Upgrade your reputation and open new zones ✅ The game has simple controls

title: 100 Doors Puzzle Box
description: 100 Doors Puzzle Box is an exciting puzzle and escape room game where every level brings a new challenge, mysterious doors, and hidden secrets. Explore rooms, search for hidden objects, combine items, and solve clever puzzles to unlock the next door. Some challenges require logic, attention, and creative thinking. Inspired by classic “100 Doors” and “escape room” games, this version features modern 3D graphics, smooth animations, and fun interactive mechanics. Features: • Dozens of unique levels • Hidden object gameplay • Interactive puzzles • Escape room atmosphere • Modern 3D graphics • Easy controls • Challenging brain teasers Can you open all the doors?
howToPlay: Use your mouse to interact with objects and doors. Controls: • Mouse — interact with objects • A / D — move character Search rooms, find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and unlock doors to progress through the game.

title: Snake Tangle
description: Welcome to Snake Tangle, a thrilling and addictive puzzle game that will put your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to the test! In Tangled Snake, Your mission is to guide a mischievous snake through a tangled mess of obstacles and help it reach its tasty prey. Snake Tangle features multiple levels of increasing difficulty. Each level presents a new maze layout, with more complex obstacles and narrower paths. As you progress, you'll face additional challenges such as moving barriers, time limits, and limited swipes, adding an extra layer of excitement and urgency to the gameplay. Snake Tangle offers an engaging and challenging gameplay experience that will captivate puzzle enthusiasts and snake game lovers alike. So, get ready to twist, turn, and strategize your way through a tangled maze in this thrilling adventure!
howToPlay: To successfully navigate through the tangled maze, you'll need to carefully plan each move and consider the snake's current length and positioning. The snake can only move in a straight line until it hits an obstacle or the maze's boundary, forcing you to plan the path ahead and avoid getting trapped.

title: DEAD FREQUENCY
description: Defend the Signal Tower! A fast-paced tower defense game set in a vibrant red wasteland. Protect your crystal-powered signal tower from waves of enemies using upgradeable stats like damage, speed, bounce, and diamond yield. Level up your defenses, manage resources, and survive as long as you can!
howToPlay: Objective: Defend your crystal-powered signal tower from waves of enemies. Upgrade your stats, collect resources, and survive as long as possible in a hostile red wasteland. Gameplay Overview: Enemies approach your tower in waves. Your goal is to stop them before they destroy it. Use earned currency (₮) to upgrade your character’s Damage, Max Health, Speed, Bounce, and Diamond Yield. The longer you survive, the stronger the enemies become—so keep upgrading!

title: Imposter 3D
description: Imposter 3D offers an exciting arcade adventure where you can choose to be either a "Killer" or a "Hero." Develop strategies to win as you face various challenges. Play for free online on multiple devices without registration, making it accessible for all gamers. Enjoy a thrilling, dynamic experience!

title: Eat Donuts
description: Eat Donuts is a fun and relaxing match-3 puzzle game where you help a cute penguin collect delicious donuts! In a 3x3 grid, drag the glowing donut rings to swap, rotate, and align them for satisfying matches. Reach the target score before time runs out, using power-ups like hammers and rotators for explosive combos. Simple controls, adorable visuals, and addictive gameplay make it the perfect casual brain teaser.
howToPlay: Become a Donut Master! Help the adorable penguin collect sweet donuts in this fun and relaxing match-3 puzzle game. In a 3x3 grid, drag and rotate the glowing donut rings to match them, reach the target score, and clear each level with satisfying combos. Use powerful tools like the hammer and rotator to create explosive matches and boost your score! Desktop Controls: Mouse: Click and drag donut rings to swap or rotate them. Left Click: Select and move pieces. Mobile Controls: Swipe: Drag your finger to move and rotate the glowing donut rings. Tap Power-ups: Tap the hammer or rotator icons to activate special abilities.

title: Idle Cinema Tycoon
description: Idle Cinema Tycoon is a casual business simulation game where you are in charge of your very own movie theater with the aim of slowly managing an empire of theaters. Purchase cinema halls, schedule screenings, and upgrade interiors to boost profits. Curate and collect films of various genres, liaise with guests in VIP rooms, and squeeze out as much profit as you can from ticket sales and more. Strategically expand your theater and complete missions to unlock valuable rewards!
howToPlay: Navigate your cinema empire using the left mouse button to interact with the game's user interface. This control allows you to manage theater operations, make upgrades, and execute strategic decisions effortlessly

title: Sling Chicken
description: You start in a barn and climb upward by attaching to wooden rungs (pegs). From each rung you pull back and release the chicken like a slingshot to fling it to the next peg higher up. The track is endless and gets harder as you climb: Spinning saws guard some rungs Wood boards block half the lane (with a gap you must fly through) Other obstacles appear at higher heights: slanted beams, diamonds, moving pills, stone blocks, spinning wheels Golden eggs float along flight paths as bonus pickups. Your main score is height in meters — how high you’ve climbed. A simulated rival chicken climbs alongside you, gaining meters over time. Each match lasts 90 seconds. Win by ending with more meters than your rival. If you die mid-match, your score freezes at your peak height and the match ends shortly after; you still win if you’re ahead. Outside matches you can earn coins and rank points (RP), unlock cosmetics, and play Quick Match or the Coop Climb ladder (5 rivals in a row).
howToPlay: Core loop Start on a rung in the barn. Drag backward from the chicken to stretch its wings (slingshot tension). Release to launch upward. Land on the next peg to stop and sling again. Repeat to climb higher. Collect golden eggs by flying through them (shown as coin pickups in the HUD). Avoid hazards — especially spinning saws and solid obstacle hits.

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description: Mahjong with history. Puzzle and adventure. Play and win! Connect tiles and collect prizes. The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty! Mahjong Magic Islands features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format. Collecting components for magic spells adds a fun layer to the gameplay, and meeting cute magical creatures to help out gives the varied levels of the game more significant depth. * The mysterious worlds of the Magic Islands await discovery. * Journey through the Mahjong Magic Islands solving fun brain teasers. * Meet mysterious and mythical creatures, and help them on their way! * Hunt down magic ingredients and make magic spells. * Search and connect tiles. * Mahjong Solitaire
howToPlay: You have to complete levels with classic mahjong solitaire mechanics. All the action takes place in a fairy-tale world inhabited by magical creatures who need your help!

title: Match Master
description: Get ready for a new, challenging and original matching pairs brain game. You need to match 3D objects on the ground and pop them all! When you clear a level, you will find new objects to pair. Sort and find all pairs, clear the board and win! Start searching for hidden object and matching tile pairs - Match 3D is a perfect way to zen relaxing and at the same time testing your memory and mind skills.
howToPlay: - Pick the 1st 3d object it can be (a shiny 3D object, animal, or an emoji) - Then pick up the 2nd 3d object & move both of them to the circle in the middle of the screen. - Keep doing that until you clear the whole screen & win the level. - Then keep having fun & start a new level

title: Telekinetic Pumpkin
description: Telekinetic Pumpkin is an arcade game where an experiment aimed at creating a magnificent, oversized pumpkin for Halloween takes an unexpected turn, resulting in the creation of a telekinetic pumpkin. You’re a Pumpkin that teleports and moves objects with its mind! Destroy drones by smashing them, and collect power-ups to stay alive. Select your upgrades and try to survive as long as possible.
howToPlay: Double-click on a location to teleport. Click and drag anything to move it with your mind (boxes, enemies, or power-ups). Every 35 seconds, you can select a random upgrade or ability to help you survive longer.

title: Rolling Cube 3D
description: Embark on an exciting journey with the Rolling Cube 3D! Through countless levels and challenging obstacles, your goal is to lead the cube to the finish line. Avoiding traps and reaching the end. Test your agility and reaction time and see how far you can go in this exciting game!
howToPlay: Swipe the cube through the obstacles and reach the finish line. Exciting levels, stunning 3D graphics, endless fun! Click and hold the mouse to make the cube start rolling. Be careful not to fall into traps!

title: Draw and Guess Online
description: Draw and Guess is a fun and fast-paced online multiplayer game where creativity meets quick thinking! Players take turns drawing a given word while others try to guess what it is in real-time. The faster you guess correctly, the more points you earn. Compete with friends or players from around the world and show off your drawing skills!
howToPlay: 1. Join a Room: Enter a public room or create a private one to play with friends. Minimum 3 players are required to start. 2. Take Turns Drawing: When it’s your turn, you will receive a word to draw. Use the drawing tools to illustrate it clearly. 3. Guess the Word: While another player is drawing, type your guesses in the chat. The faster you guess correctly, the more points you earn! 4. Score Points: Points are awarded for correct guesses and for how many players successfully guess your drawing. 5. Rounds & Winner: The game continues for several rounds. At the end, the player with the highest score wins. 6. Use Hints (Optional): Some versions have hints or drawing aids to make guessing easier.

title: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match
description: You are the 3rd son of the great king of a magical land. Your parents send you to a faraway land to establish a new kingdom and prove that you are the most capable of their children! In the game you collect resource hexes. There are 6 resources in total: food, water, stone, wood, diamonds and metal. When you collect enough resources, you can build a new building. Unlock all the buildings, create a beautiful magical kingdom!
howToPlay: Kingdom building screen. - Click on the scaffolding to see how many more resources you need to collect to build a new building; - when there are enough resources, a hammer icon will appear above the building. Click on it to build a new building and move on to building the next building. Resource Gathering Screen. - 3 stacks of hexes appear at the bottom, which you can pick up and place on the field; - take a stack and place it on the field so that the top tiles overlap. The tiles will then flow over each other; - when you collect a stack of 10 or more hexes of the same type, the stack disappears and you collect that resource; - at the top of the game screen you can see the counter of hexes that you need to collect to finish the level.

title: Quizmasters
description: QuizMasters is a colorful trivia quiz-show game where you answer questions, climb the prize ladder, and aim for the grand reward. Choose the correct answer from four options, earn cash and crystals, collect reward stickers, and challenge other players in trivia battles. Each level becomes harder, keeping every round exciting, fast, and rewarding.
howToPlay: Read each question carefully and choose the correct answer from four possible options. Each correct answer moves you higher on the prize ladder and brings you closer to the grand reward. The questions become more difficult as you progress, so stay focused and think quickly. Earn cash, crystals, and collectible reward stickers as you play. Use your rewards to unlock new collections and keep improving your progress. You can also challenge other players in head-to-head trivia battles and prove who knows more.

title: Cars
description: Become a car driver in this thrilling online racing game! Overtake vehicles, avoid crashes, and race to beat your high score. Tap gas or brake to master the road and show your best result. Play now for fast-paced driving fun!
howToPlay: In this game you will become a car driver! Press the gas to overtake cars, and brake to avoid crashing, and so pass as many cars as possible and show your best result in this race!

title: Crystalia
description: A vibrant block puzzle game. Place pieces on the board so that 3 or more blocks of the same color line up next to each other — and watch them vanish in a satisfying explosion. Simple rules, endless depth, and a fierce battle for the top spot on the leaderboard.
howToPlay: Step 1. A block appears in the bottom panel. Rotate it if needed and drag it onto the board. Step 2. Place blocks so that 3 or more of the same color stand next to each other — horizontally or vertically (diagonals don't count). Step 3. Matching blocks disappear with an explosion, and you earn points. The longer the chain, the bigger the bonus. Step 4. Running out of space? Use boosters: 💣 Bomb — blasts 1 block and all its neighbors. ➖ Laser — clears an entire row or column. 🔀 Shuffle — reshuffles the blocks on the board. Step 5. The game ends when there's no room left for new blocks. Your score is automatically sent to the leaderboard — try to break into the top! Pro tip: don't rush to fill the board. Leave "corridors" open for long chains — that's how mega-combos and record-breaking scores are made.

title: Sudoku - Number Games
description: Увлекательная логическая игра-головоломка с числами! Тренируйте внимание, развивайте память и логику, да и просто получайте удовольствие! По мере повышения уровня игра усложняется, но всегда можно вернутся к прошлым уровням и играть на более легком уровне сложности.
howToPlay: Rules of Sudoku - Number Games is simple: Inside the playing field there are 9 squares consisting of 3 x 3 cells. Each horizontal row, vertical column and square (9 cells each) must be filled with numbers from 1 to 9, without repeating any numbers in the row, column or square.

title: Santa Stunt Racer Christmas Delivery
description: Get ready for the ultimate festive adventure in Santa Stunt Racer: Christmas Delivery! Ride through thrilling holiday stunt tracks filled with ramps, obstacles, and challenging paths. Each level brings a new snowy track where you must drive carefully, perform stunts, and collect the Christmas gifts placed along the ramps. Your mission is simple: reach the finish line and deliver the collected gifts to the kids waiting for Santa! The faster and cleaner you complete the track, the better your delivery score. Unlock a variety of custom Santa vehicles as you progress—each with unique speed, handling, and style to help you conquer tougher levels. Master the tracks, dodge obstacles, and perform daring jumps to complete Santa’s delivery run before Christmas ends! Are you ready to race, stunt, and deliver joy? Christmas needs you! 🎅
howToPlay: Drive Santa’s car with WASD/Arrow Keys and conquer ramps, obstacles, and gift tracks. Collect gifts to the kids waiting for Santa at the finish place!

title: Fruite Swipe
description: Get ready for a juicy adventure with Fruit Swipe Match, Swipe and match colorful fruits to solve exciting puzzles and unlock fantastic rewards. With hundreds of challenging levels, stunning graphics, and smooth gameplay, this match-3 game will keep you entertained for hours. Compete with friends, discover hidden treasures, and master fun power-ups. Download Fruit Swipe Match now and experience the ultimate fruit-matching fun. It's time to swipe, match, and win big!
howToPlay: Use LMB "Left Mouse Button" to connect the same fruit and release the button to make a match! same for Mobile but use Finger instead!

title: Even Odd Dice
description: Play Even Odd Dice – a thrilling online game for 1-4 players! Easy rules, fun gambling twist. Great for families, friends, or solo play. Test your luck and prediction skills now in this exciting dice game!
howToPlay: Each player chooses whether their bet is “even” or “odd”. After that, you need to press the dice and see what luck will be like! There is also a special mode where you can try to get the maximum number of wins in a row - just one-on-one with fate. Good luck in the game! The game of Even-Odd on Dice is an exciting pastime for 1-4 players that combines simplicity of rules with gambling elements. Perfect for family evenings, friendly gatherings or even a solitary game. The object of the game is to predict whether the sum of the dice will be the exact number of even or odd numbers. Each turn brings an element of chance and strategy, as players must take into account previous rolls and try to guess when luck will be on their side. Game includes: Easy rules: Suitable for players of all ages, allowing you to learn the mechanics quickly. Instant Results: Each roll of the dice creates tension and anticipation, making gameplay exciting. Flexible Format: You can enjoy the game either in company or alone, taking on the challenge on your own or competing with friends. Join the exciting world of Odd-Even and see who will be the master of prediction!

title: Magic Water Sort
description: Welcome to Magic Water Sort a smooth and satisfying water sort puzzle that blends vibrant colors, intuitive gameplay, and the soothing process of color sorting. Tap the flasks to fill moving glasses with the right color, complete mocktail orders, and finish levels! Sit back, relax, and enjoy colorful pours as the water sort flows without time limits or pressure! Beyond classic liquid sorting puzzles, Magic Water Sort brings a cozy, café-inspired twist. You don't just sort water or colors—you prepare mocktails on a conveyor belt, watching glasses glide by as you decide when and where to pour. The pouring happens automatically, so the water sort puzzle feels smooth and effortless, letting you relax while still enjoying the sorting process.
howToPlay: - The game screen shows a conveyor with empty glasses, a space under the counter with empty cups, and a board of flasks filled with layers of colored liquid. - Tap a flask to start pouring liquid into the glasses on the conveyor. Liquid pours layer by layer, from top to bottom. - If a layer matches the color of a glass on the conveyor above, it flows straight into it. If not, it stays in the cups under the counter. - Glasses of different sizes move along the conveyor, and you can preview which ones are coming next so that you can plan how to sort colors. - After every pour, a new glass appears. Fill glasses correctly before they reach the exit line and complete all required mocktails to win a level in this pouring game.

title: Blasting Marbles
description: Blasting Marbles is a thrilling 2D puzzle adventure game where your objective is to strategically place the required number of marbles into the hole. Explore the game world, collecting crates to boost your marble count and discover marbles with unique abilities. Switch between marbles to split their efforts and coordinate teamwork for successful challenges. Immerse yourself in a captivating gameplay experience that combines puzzle, physics, and skill.
howToPlay: Your goal is to get all the marbles in the level into the hole! The number in the top left of the screen is the amount of marbles that have to get into the hole. To make a marble move, left click near it to create a blast and watch it roll! There will be boxes in the level - these are extra marbles you can unlock! Have your marble collide into the box to obtain them. The amount of balls in the box are displayed on the box. When you have multiple marbles, you can press the arrow keys or A or D to switch between which marble you want to have in focus.

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle

title: Magic Block Sort

description: Safari Merge is a bite-sized merge puzzle: grass sprouts onto the board, and you drag matching creatures together to combine them into the next animal up the chain. Keep the board from filling up, chain merges for combo bonuses, and unlock all 18 creatures. Each new animal comes with a real fact about how it fits into the natural world! - 18 creatures to discover, ordered along a real food chain - A genuine animal fact with every new tier you reach - Combo system that rewards fast, focused merging - Three difficulties, from easy to hard - Earn gems to unlock backgrounds and board tiles - Plays in your browser. Mouse or touch, phone or desktop
howToPlay: Safari Merge is an endless food-chain merge puzzle. Drag two matching animals together to combine them into the next creature up the food chain, starting from simple grass and rabbits, all the way up to elephants and beyond. Each new tier you discover comes with a real animal fact, so you're learning as you play. The board fills up over time as new creatures spawn in. Merge strategically to keep space open. If the board fills completely, the run ends. There's no fixed "win," so the goal is to reach the highest tier and score you can before the board fills up. Watch for combos: chain several higher-tier merges together in quick succession for a multiplied score and reward bonus. Controls: Click and drag (or tap and drag on touch devices) an animal onto a matching one to merge them. No keyboard required — the game is fully playable with mouse or touch.

title: StickerBall
description: Stickerball is a fast-paced game where you collect stickers using a ball with unique abilities! Your goal is to collect 180 colorful stickers across 9 levels by completing challenges and activating triggers that change the game’s rules. Each turn, 10 stickers fly onto the field from a purchased pack, but any uncollected ones disappear—act quickly and precisely! The game shines with 14 dynamic triggers: freeze stickers, double rewards with "x2," turn the ball into a magnet or ghost, activate "disco" mode, or control a dual ball! The more stickers you collect in one turn, the higher your combo and the more coins you earn. Holo-stickers, with their unique designs, grant double the currency! howToPlay: How to play: 1. Aiming: Move your cursor to aim-the arrow on the ball shows the strike direction. 2. Power Charging: Hold LMB to fill the arrow’s power gauge. Release to launch the ball! The more you gather in one turn, the higher your combo and bonuses! 4. Triggers: Collect special icons (magnet, x2, freeze, etc.) to power up the ball or alter sticker behavior. For example, "Ghost" lets the ball pass through triggers, while "Double Move" grants a second strike without new stickers appearing. 5. Buying Packs: Before your first turn, choose a free Level 1 pack. Each pack contains 100 stickers, with 10 appearing per turn. 6. Strategy Tips: Use "Freeze" or "Bonus" to increase the number of stickers on the field. Combine triggers like "Magnet" + "x2" for double rewards. Prioritize Holo-stickers - they grant x2 coins!

howToPlay: Controls are simple: Choose the position where to move the basket and press the corresponding key — Q, A, E, D (or Q, A, P, L) on a computer, or tap the arrow buttons on your phone or tablet. Catch the toys before they fall. The more toys you catch, the more points you earn.

Use hints (optional) — Tap the lightbulb hint for 50 coins. It shows your next roll and updates after each move. Beat your rival — Finish more mazes than your opponent before the 90-second timer runs out.

Fruit Slicer offers simple yet addictive gameplay that will keep you entertained for hours. With cool challenges and the chance to compete against friends, there's never a dull moment. 🎯
