No problem! Play offline. - Impressive Effects: Special power effects for a mesmerizing slicing spree.

title: Color Water Sort 3D
description: Color Water Sort 3D is a fun and challenging 3D casual puzzle game. The core concept revolves around sorting chaotic colors into perfect order, offering players an incredibly satisfying and stress-relieving experience. Set in a vibrant 3D environment, your task is to sort the colored water in the tubes until each tube contains only one single color. With levels ranging from simple to brain-teasing, it perfectly balances strategic thinking with a relaxing atmosphere, making it the ultimate brain trainer and time killer. What makes it unique is its realistic 3D visuals, smooth pouring physics, and the deeply addictive sense of accomplishment with every puzzle solved.
howToPlay: Become a master of color sorting! Your main objective is to sort the colored liquid in the tubes until each tube holds only one color. You win the game when all liquids of the same color are grouped together and every tube is correctly sorted. Use your logic and strategy to untangle this colorful mess! PC Controls: Left Mouse Click: Click on a tube to select it, then click on another tube to pour the water. Mobile Controls: Single-Finger Tap: Tap on a tube to select it, then tap on another tube to complete the pouring action.

title: Emoji Math Quiz
description: Embark on a brain-teasing adventure with Emoji Math, the game that blends math puzzles with emoji fun! Challenge yourself through six equations where each emoji represents a numerical value. Sharpen your skills as you decipher the emoji codes to solve each equation correctly. Dive into Emoji Math and unravel the mystery behind every emoji's value to conquer this exciting mathematical journey!
howToPlay: Click on empty form to input your answer. Use hint if you are stuck. Theme toggle option for dark mode and light mode support. View leaderboards and share your progress with your friends.

title: Number Sums
description: Number Sums is a challenging number puzzle to train your mental math. The goal is to make the sum of numbers in each row, column, and colored region be equal to the clues on the side of the board and inside the colored regions. Practice your math skills and logic with Number Sums! Each row, column, and region has its own solution, but the goal of this math game with numbers is to make them all work at the same time. You have to circle the correct numbers and erase the numbers you don't need. Remember, the sums of the numbers in rows, columns and colored regions should be equal to the numbers on the sides of the board and inside each region. Each level of this numbers game has only one solution, try to find it to solve educational math puzzles! Mental arithmetic is an invaluable math skill for your everyday life. Inside Number Sums you'll find math puzzles of various difficulty. The mechanics of these math riddles sounds simple but requires a lot of thinking. Playing sum number games and solving math problems can improve your arithmetic skills. If you are interested in number puzzles or math games for adults, and in training your addition skills, play this engaging number game for…
howToPlay: - Circle the correct numbers that add up to the values on the sides of the rows, columns and regions. - Use the toggle to switch between circling and erasing modes. It will help you to mark the correct numbers and the extra numbers that you don't need. - Each level of these math puzzles has only one possible solution, so make sure that the rows, columns and colored regions work together at the same time. - Train your math skills with this free number puzzle with various levels of difficulty. Open different types of board from 3x3 to 10x10.

title: Solve the maze
description: The game will appeal to fans of puzzles. There are 100 unique levels in the game. The difficulty of the levels gradually increases. If the level is too difficult for you, you can skip it by watching a video advertisement. For each level you complete, you are given crystals that can be spent on unlocking new items. Collect the entire collection! You will definitely like: - Smooth ball movement - Lots of beautiful and vibrant paint colors - Simple one touch control - Great way to kill time
howToPlay: To complete the level, you need to move the ball using swaps across the screen (when playing from a computer, you can use the arrows on the keyboard), coloring the entire maze. Make sure the puzzle is completely filled in! If you don't fill in at least one square, you'll be stuck in the color maze forever!

title: Catoom! - Bomb Barrel
description: Imagine a game where, instead of the usual movement on your feet (or paws), you roll... a barrel! But simply rolling isn't enough — to gain truly incredible speed, you need to throw bombs and use their explosions for momentum. Every correct move is a combination of timing and tactics. You'll experience: Unusual movement mechanics — roll on a barrel and learn to control the chaos of explosions. Lots of enemies — for classic use of explosions. Destructible environments — explode tiles and carve your way through. This isn't just an arcade game; it's a test of reaction, ingenuity, and the ability to find solutions, where physics itself becomes your ally.
howToPlay: Tap and release the screen to throw a bomb at the tapped location. PC: WASD - movement Touchscreens: Drag the area to reveal a virtual joystick for movement. Explode bombs near your barrel to accelerate it. Roll the barrel yourself to maintain momentum after the explosion.

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Were you one of those children who could spend hours with their puzzles, whiling away a rainy afternoon or cold winter’s day putting together a 500-piece jigsaw of the Eifel Tower or London Bridge? Well, now you can revisit your childhood on your smartphone or tablet from anywhere in the world. Melt away from reality with this captivating puzzle game that challenges you to use your thinking skills to connect virtual pieces in real time and create unique images of increasing complexity. Arrange a variety of items to produce a pretty picture right on your screen, while developing your abilities as you progress through the levels. You’ll never be bored again!
howToPlay: Tap and drag the puzzle pieces to connect or align them correctly. Once pieces are placed properly, the full picture be it a quirky character, delicious dish, or cool object—comes together. Finish the level and either continue to the next or pause and resume anytime perfect for short bursts of play.

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
description: Tap into your creativity with Paint Sponges Puzzle, a captivating online game that requires strategic skills and maze-solving ability. Navigate your colorful sponge across the grid, leaving a vibrant trail. Challenges increase as you advance, providing a fun blend of logic and artistry on both mobile and computer platforms.
howToPlay: The sponge moves with a swipe. To complete the level, you need to paint over all the squares in the maze. Have a nice game!

title: Noob: Big Item Sorting
description: Do you enjoy keeping things tidy? Do you enjoy sorting things? Then this game is for you! Introducing a fun new game all about sorting and cleaning! 😻In this exciting puzzle, you'll find identical objects and match them together. Arrange the objects so that two identical ones end up next to each other and form a double. 🎁Match items in pairs to advance through the levels! Cleaning has never been so enjoyable and exciting! 🎮"Noob: The Big Object Sorting Game" is a light and calming game suitable for anyone who loves order, regardless of age or gender!
howToPlay: Simple and intuitive gameplay - drag and drop items and connect them at the bottom of the screen. - Match two identical items at the bottom of the screen to create a match; - Connect all the items to complete the level; - Unlock new items, avatars, and skins by completing more levels!

title: Electron dash
description: Attract. Repel. Survive. Master the invisible forces of physics in this high speed magnetic arcade game. You do not just run, you glide, slam, and swing using the power of magnetism. Use the polarity slider to instantly switch your charge between Red and Blue. Repel off walls to launch yourself across the map, or attract toward magnetic pillars to drift around tight corners. Key Features: Unique Control System: Master the polarity slider to push and pull your way to victory. Physics Based Movement: Feel the momentum as you squish into walls and rocket through open spaces.
howToPlay: Feel the Pull! Navigate complex mazes using nothing but the power of attraction and repulsion. Adjust your magnetic charge to fly through the air, dodge traps, and collect coins. How to Control: The Slider: This is your steering wheel found at the bottom of the screen. Slide Left: Activates Negative Charge (Blue). Slide Right: Activates Positive Charge (Red). Let Go: Returns to Neutral (Momentum only). Rules of Physics: Opposites Attract: Positive pulls you toward Negative. Likes Repel: Positive pushes you away from Positive. Use this to launch yourself! Your Mission: 1. Collect all Coins. 2. Reach the Finish Zone safely. 3. Do it before the Timer runs out!

title: Heroic knight
description: Heroic Knight is an engaging puzzle adventure game where you guide a valiant knight through treacherous terrains to achieve glory and seize hidden treasures. This free-to-play, browser-based game requires no download or registration, allowing you to dive directly into an epic medieval quest. Strategically maneuver through obstacles, outsmart cunning traps, and vanquish formidable foes on your journey. The game's captivating 2D world is perfect for fans of mind-bending puzzles and adventurous escapades, offering a seamless experience on both desktop and mobile platforms.
howToPlay: In order for the prince to save the princess or to reach the gold, you need to develop your strategy and pull the right sticks in time. Otherwise, the trolls may kill you or you may die in the lava.

title: Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!
description: A fun action-packed sword game where all you need is to chop and slice enemies into pieces! Sharpen your blade, sword master! It's time to embark on a real ninja warrior adventure! Play the exciting "Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!", defeat hordes of sword masters and become the greatest samurai of all time! FEATURES OF THE GAME - Unique mechanics of slicing enemies - Variety of enemies and levels - Epic gaming experience - Action-packed missions - Hordes of ninja assassins If you like cool ninja games or knife throwing games like Hit Master 3D, Clumsy Ninja, Draw Saber, Sword Hunter, Stealth Master, Sword Play and other samurai games, you will definitely enjoy playing "Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!". What are you waiting for? Prove that you are the greatest sword master of all time!
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to defeat all the enemies on the level. The gameplay is very simple. All you need is to swipe your finger on the phone screen, or the mouse cursor on the computer screen to cut the enemy into halves. Enemies can hit you or throw weapons at you, be careful. Slow down time and chop flying bullets. Cut barrels of explosives in half and beat off giant shurikens from your enemies! Do you have enough agility and reaction to repel attacks and cut all enemies into pieces?

title: TetraDice–Merge & Blast Blocks
description: Play TetraDice – Match & Build Blocks, a free puzzle game blending Tetris and dice mechanics! Strategically place dice-based shapes, clear lines, and challenge your logic. Enjoy Normal & Endless Modes, unique levels, and addictive gameplay. Start playing now!
howToPlay: - Your goal is to create combinations using the provided figures. - You get points for successfully collected combinations and perform special tasks. - The more matches - the more points. - In adventure mode, you need to complete levels by completing assigned tasks. - In classic mode, your goal is to score the maximum number of points before the game ends. Controls PC LMB (left mouse button) - selects, rotates and moves figures. Mobile Touch (tap) - rotates the figure. Dragging with your finger - moves the figure on the playing field.

title: Clash of Cars: Arena
description: Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive! Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents. Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast. Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind! Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory. Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!
howToPlay: Controls: Desktop: W, A, S, D — move your car Shift — nitro boost V — jump R — use ability Mobile: Movement: Left stick (up, down, left, right) Ability: Icon in the bottom center of the screen Brake, Jump, Nitro Boost — buttons on the bottom right Goal: Destroy your opponents to take the lead and become the king of the arena! Use your weapons wisely — blow up enemies, trap them, and don’t give them a chance to fight back. One wrong move, and your car turns into a pile of scrap metal!

title: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight!
description: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight! — is a fast-paced voxel multiplayer shooter with fully destructible, physics-driven maps — buildings collapse and debris change the battlefield. Build bases and fortifications, carve tactical paths, and turn the environment into a weapon. Core modes: Sandbox (creative freedom), Capture the Flag (team tactics), and Team Deathmatch (intense PvP). Quick matchmaking, custom rooms, localized UI and optimization for web/mobile platforms. Join the fights — build, destroy, win!
howToPlay: The world is fully destructible with realistic physics: any block that loses its connection to the ground will fall and break apart. Game Modes: • Sandbox: Experiment with building and destruction without limits. • Capture the Flag: Seize the enemy's flag and bring it back to your base. • Team Deathmatch: Eliminate more opponents than the enemy team. Controls (Keyboard & Mouse): • TAB – Pause menu • WASD – Move • LMB (Left Mouse Button) – Shoot / Build • RMB (Right Mouse Button) – Aim down sights / Dig • 1-5 – Select item • SPACE – Jump • C – Crouch • R – Reload • J – Toggle minimap size • M – Open map • T – Open chat

title: Chu Choo Cake
description: If you love cake, then you will want to help Chef Piggo to save his creations from the hungry mice! These mice are greedy, and they will stop at nothing to try and stop the chef. This game combines elements of both Pacman and Donkey Kong and has retro graphics too. Move the chef around the level and try to drop the cakes to the bottom by standing on them. You must save each cake before you can complete the level - make sure you avoid the greedy mice too though!
howToPlay: Desktop Controls Move: WASD Action/Select: SPACE Mobile Controls Use the on-screen touch controls and UI buttons to move, select, and perform actions.

title: Smash & Merge Balls
description: Short Description: A skill-based arcade game with colorful physics. Full Description: In this game, you control a character that starts a fusion chain reaction! Strike the colorful balls to get them moving. The key rule: when two balls of the same color collide, they merge, and you earn points. Create massive chains of mergers to maximize your high score! (lore) (from the Showman): Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! Welcome to the greatest show in the cosmos — the Arena of Fusion! Here is your instrument of chaos — the mighty merger mallet! Don't be shy, give it a swing! Your mission is brilliantly simple: step onto the arena floor and prepare for a rainbow deluge! Smash those colorful spheres, make them crash, and when two of the same color meet — BOOM! — they fuse into a glorious explosion of points!
howToPlay: -Use the "WASD" or the "touchscreen joystick" to move -Use the "Space" or the "touch-screen button" to dash -Use "left mouse button" or "Touch screen button" to Hit -Hit the balls and collide the balls of the same color to score points, when they collide they create another ball of random color.

title: My Little Farm
description: - A casual arcade game with simple and intuitive controls; - Gather resources to build a farm; - Chop trees to get wood; - Chop rocks to get stone; - Dig a well to get water; - Breed animals to collect fertilizer for your plants; - Build a mill; - Harvest wheat and process it into flour; - Bake bread and hire helpers.
howToPlay: - Move using the on-screen joystick; - Approach a tree to cut it down; - Approach water to extract water; - Accumulate resources to construct a building.

title: EVADE
description: A high-speed chase game where you deliver packages across a city while the police hunt you down. Lose them, make the drop, and move on to the next job.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys or WASD to drive, Space to handbrake, and Shift to boost. Drive to each drop point, but shake the cops first — you can't deliver while they're on your tail.

title: FILL THE HEART
howToPlay: Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow) / W: Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow) / S: Move downward. ← (Left Arrow) / A: Move left. → (Right Arrow) / D: Move right. R: Restart. Q: To Menu. M: Mute. Mobile Controls: On-screen Swipe: Move.

title: Ball: Path Through Obstacles
description: Roll through an obstacle course playing as a ball. Avoid traps and collect coins to unlock new skins
howToPlay: The game controls depend on the device you are playing on. On PC: Use the WASD keys to control the ball. W (up) — moving forward. A (left) — turn left. S (down) is a backward movement. D (right) — turn to the right. The space bar is a jump. To use the improvements, click on the improvement icon on the left side of the screen. To buy a skin, click on the store icon in the menu. On a smartphone/tablet: On touch devices, control is performed using a virtual joystick located in the lower left part of the screen. Move your finger across the screen to control the movement of the ball. To jump, click on the button in the lower right part of the screen. To use the improvements, click on the improvement icon on the left side of the screen. To buy a skin, click on the store icon in the menu.

title: Furry Kung Fu
description: Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun! Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons! Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from.
howToPlay: Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun! Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons! Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from Как играть Control on the PC: by arrow buttons, on the smartphone - by swipes and taps on the screen. Swipe: left/right arrow, tap on the screen to the left/right of the player. Combo: repeatedly pressing the button in the direction where you want to apply a combo / multiple tap to the left or right of the player. Sit down: down arrow / swipe down. Jump: arrow up / swipe up. Double jump (if available for a specific skin): double arrow up / two swipe up Uppercut - squat and jump, arrow down and up / swipe down and up; Attack from…

title: Shape Ascent - Roguelite
description: Shape Ascent is a strategic puzzle game inspired by 2048, where you merge geometric shapes on a 5×5 grid to reach the legendary Ascent Crown. Starting with simple Triangles and Squares, you'll combine matching shapes by swiping in four directions — merging them into Pentagons, Hexagons, Stars, Crystals, Essences, and ultimately the Ascent Crown (8128). What makes Shape Ascent unique is its roguelike card system: every few moves, you're offered a choice of Power Cards with Common, Rare, and Epic abilities — from Score Boosts and Merge Bonuses to Emergency Saves and Auto-Cleanse effects that permanently alter your run. Manage your Undo charges, use the Remove Tile tool wisely, and plan every swipe to avoid filling the board. With 13 shape tiers, stackable card effects, milestone celebrations, and a save system that lets you continue where you left off, Shape Ascent blends classic merge puzzle satisfaction with strategic depth and replayability. Available in 6 languages.
howToPlay: Merge Shapes to Reach the Crown! In Shape Ascent, your goal is to merge identical shapes on a 5×5 grid to create higher-tier shapes and chase the ultimate prize — the Ascent Crown (8128). Two matching shapes combine into the next tier when they collide. Plan your moves carefully: when the board fills up with no possible merges, it's game over! Every few moves, you'll be offered a choice of Power Cards with unique abilities. Choose wisely — cards like Score Boost, Star Boost, Spawn Block, and Emergency Save can change the course of your run. Use the Undo button to reverse a mistake, or the Remove Tile tool (unlocked at Triple Star) to clear an unwanted piece from the board. Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow) or W: Move all tiles upward. ↓ (Down Arrow) or S: Move all tiles downward. ← (Left Arrow) or A: Move all tiles left. → (Right Arrow) or D: Move all tiles right. U: Use an Undo charge. Mobile Controls: Swipe Up: Move all tiles upward. Swipe Down: Move all tiles downward. Swipe Left: Move all tiles left. Swipe Right: Move all tiles right. Tap the Undo button (↩) to reverse your last move. Tap the Remove button (✖) to select and remove a tile from the board. Tap the Settings gear (⚙)…

title: Flag Merging Game - Puzzle Game
description: Are you ready to discover the flags of the world? 🌍 With 8 language options (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese), 75 challenging levels await you. Beat the clock by grabbing and dropping the flags that appear 🎮, then merge two identical flags to clear the target ones! 🎯 As each level gets harder, you can unlock 12 mysterious achievements 🕵️‍♂️ and power up with two upgrades: increase your coin rewards 💰 and gain extra starting time ⏳. Show your strategy, speed, and reflexes to become the ultimate flag master! 🏆
howToPlay: New flags will drop from above 🚩. Drag and drop them anywhere with your finger ✋. Merge two identical flags 💡 to clear them and earn coins 💰. Complete the required flag goals 🎯 before time runs out ⏳ to advance to the next level 🔓. Spend your coins wisely on upgrades: get more coins per merge 🪙 or start each level with extra time ⌛. Everything depends on your skills — can you unlock all the mysterious achievements? 🕵️‍♀️✨

title: Happy Obby Land
description: Happy Obbi Land is a bright and engaging game for the youngest players, created based on beloved children’s adventures. Here, every child can feel like a real hero and conquer the highest peaks!
howToPlay: W — Move forward A — Move left S — Move backward D — Move right SHIFT — Toggle mouse lock (lock/unlock camera) ESC — Open settings menu

title: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky
description: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky is a captivating logic puzzle game set in a lush forest meadow, where players connect pairs of numbered construction blocks with precisely the exact count of road segments—no more, no less—to link all cities and clear the board within time limits, earning stars and trophies in increasingly challenging levels tracked by a dynamic timer and handy undo feature.
howToPlay: Save the Jungle Paradise! Step into the role of a pirate parrot shooter and blast colorful bubbles from your cannon to match 3+ of the same color—reds, blues, yellows, and specials—triggering chain reactions to pop clusters and clear encroaching bubble walls before they reach the bottom, collecting gems, coins, and power-ups to hit star and trophy goals in each tropical level! **Desktop Controls:** Mouse: Drag to aim (dotted line shows trajectory), release to shoot. **Mobile Controls:** Touch: Drag to aim, release/tap to shoot; tap barrels for power-ups.

title: Merge Fruit Monster Defense: Tower Defense
description: A bizarre infection has brought huge changes to the world. Ferocious little monsters are getting ready to attack. But Tao is never scared, because all kinds of magical fruit warriors are holding the line firmly! Your goal is to protect Tao and stop monsters from eating her! Game Features Creative mixed gameplay of backpack merging, roguelike and tower defense, featuring funny fruit characters and weird zombie monsters. Simple backpack merging mechanics. You can easily experience character development, inventory sorting, silver coin management and tactical troop arrangement. Fruit crossbreeding. After upgrading fruits to Tier 4 via merging, cross them with other creatures to gain stronger combat power and funny unique looks. Hybrid monster styles. Most in-game monsters are designed with diverse crossbred visual styles. Exclusive endless challenge mode. Start with plenty of silver coins to finish quick backpack merging. Countless monsters keep spawning nonstop for you to take on extreme battles.
howToPlay: Control your character by touch or mouse drag to move around the map. Avoid all chasing monsters and do not get caught. The game will end immediately if a monster touches you. Collect random buff items on the map to help you survive longer: Speed boost: temporarily increase your movement speed Freeze skill: stop all monsters for a short time The game difficulty increases over time. More monsters will spawn and move faster as your survival time grows.

title: Balls: Pixel Art
description: Balls: Pixel Art is a game about knocking out pictures with balloons. More precisely, you have to disassemble the drawn picture into pixels by breaking it up with balloons. This is a very interesting, exciting process. In which you need to show ingenuity, and accurate calculation. The game has to offer: - Exciting gameplay. - Multiple images for you to smash - Nice graphics - Lots of levels to complete Ready to be the Anti-Artist? Cracking the works of art? Then onward to new victories!Balls: Pixel Art
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to break the picture, to pass the level. To do this you have a cannon, which fires a charge of 16 balls. You have a total of 15 attempts to completely eliminate the painting. Good luck!

title: Pop Balloon
description: Pop Balloon is an exhilarating and fast-paced arcade game that combines precision with rapid reflexes. In this game, players are challenged to pop as many balloons as possible using a set of bouncing spikes. The objective is simple yet addictive: aim and launch the spikes in such a way that they hit and burst the balloons scattered across the screen.
howToPlay: aim and launch the spikes in such a way that they hit and burst the balloons scattered across the screen.

title: Dig & Flow - Save Water
description: Dig through the sand and guide flowing elements through level labyrinths to collect all the stars. Use element physics, plan the route carefully, and control the streams to activate mechanisms and open new paths. Simple controls make the game easy to understand from the first seconds, but each level requires more logic and precision. Different elements appear throughout the levels — water, lava, and hot steam. Each behaves differently and opens new ways to solve puzzles.
howToPlay: Goal of the Game: Collect all the stars on the level by digging through the sand and guiding streams of water, lava, and steam along the correct path. Controls: 🖱️ Left Mouse Button — hold and drag the cursor to dig through the sand 📱 Touch / Swipe — drag your finger across the screen to create paths for the elements

title: Legions: Way of War
description: Dive into the exciting world of "Legions: Way of War," a real-time strategy game that tests your tactical skills. Lead your troops to success by expertly positioning them and utilizing your heroes. Enjoy this captivating blend of strategy and competition on any device!
howToPlay: To win, arrange and connect the squads correctly. Develop your army and get new types of troops: archers, cavalry, infantry, artillery and Heroes. To enjoy the game, pass all the tests.

title: Obby, but you're on a motorcycle
description: Have you ever wondered what would happen if you tried to race a track… on a motorcycle? Get ready for total chaos, crazy stunts, and nonstop fun as you speed, crash, and fly your way to the finish line! - A ton of awesome worlds! Conquer one crazy track after another to unlock brand-new maps filled with ramps, loops, and tricky surprises. - Crazy challenges on every level! From slippery roads and slanted ramps to crazy stunts and unexpected turns—no two tracks are alike. - Motorcycle madness! Accelerate to the limit, race through obstacles, and perform fun gravity-defying maneuvers. The faster you go, the more fun it gets! Jump on, hit the gas, and get ready for total chaos in “Obby, but you're on a motorcycle”. It’s fast, fun, and absolutely ridiculous—in the best possible way!
howToPlay: Controls PC: - WASD/Arrow keys - Move - Hold down the right mouse button and drag - Pan the camera - Spacebar - Brake Mobile: - Joystick on the left - Move - Hold and drag across the screen - Pan the camera - Button on the right - Brake

title: Blocks Adventure Jungle Saga
description: In jungle lands where wild vines grow, drag and drop blocks in a vibrant flow. Match them right and hear them click: stack up points and do it quick!
howToPlay: Playing this block puzzle game is simple yet strategic: Drag and place the given shapes onto empty cells on the grid. Complete a full row or column to clear it and earn points. Place all shapes in the current set to unlock a new set. The game ends when no available shape can be placed on the board. Rotate pieces by placing them into the “pocket” to change their orientation. This format makes the game more flexible than traditional falling block games, rewarding smart placement and long-term planning.

title: Escape From The Crypt
description: Escape from the crypt, one room after another, before the necromancers get you! They move faster than you do, but they won't avoid obstacles: trick them into dead ends!
howToPlay: On PC, use the arrow keys to move your character. Backspace to undo a move, and H to get a hint. On mobile, use the on-screen D-pad and the on-screen buttons!

title: Winter Battle
description: The perfect winter season has arrived. Join the battle between Santa Claus and the Grinch under the snow. Collect all the gift boxes falling from the sky, but remember, some gift boxes are very dangerous. As you collect gift boxes, your size increases; naturally, if you collect the wrong box, your size will shrink. Collect the highest score before time runs out to win the game.
howToPlay: *You can move with WASD and Arrow Keys. *Players can push each other using the Down Arrow key or the S key. *The player with the highest score at the end of the duration wins.

title: Circle Car Crash 3D
description: Drive fast, crash hard! Race in endless circles and survive epic 3D collisions. Get ready for the ultimate crash challenge in Circle Car Crash 3D — a high-speed, physics-based racing arena where every turn could be your last! Race around circular tracks, dodge opponents, and cause spectacular slow-motion collisions. Earn points for near misses, perfect drifts, and insane crashes that send cars flying! With realistic crash physics, simple controls, and thrilling 3D visuals, this game delivers nonstop fun for fans of car stunt and destruction games. 🚗 Game Features 💥 Realistic crash physics and metal-bending effects 🔄 Endless circular tracks full of obstacles & chaos ⚙️ Upgrade cars for better speed and handling 🔊 Immersive engine sounds and visual effects Can you survive the loop and become the last car standing? Download Circle Car Crash 3D now and crash your way to victory!
howToPlay: ⬆️ Up Arrow – Accelerate your car ⬇️ Down Arrow – Brake or reverse ⬅️ Left Arrow – Steer left ➡️ Right Arrow – Steer right 💰 Collect Coins – Earn rewards and unlock new cars 💥 Crash Other Cars – Gain bonus points for epic collisions 🎯 Complete Levels – Survive the circle and reach the finish line 🔄 Avoid Obstacles – Stay in control, dodge barriers & rivals 🏆 Upgrade Cars – Improve speed, handling, and crash power

title: Solitaire Picture Puzzles
description: Solitaire Picture Puzzles is a game where you match cards with pictures instead of pieces. Understand the game in seconds and play for hours. Start with simple 3x3 puzzles and play harder levels as your skills improve. If the game seems too easy, you can unlock extra difficult challenges after completing level 9. Match pieces to reveal beautiful image. Each image used in this game is from a professional photographer. There are no AI generated images in this game. From nature to food to architecture, looking at each image is like exploring the world from the comfort of your device.
howToPlay: Use your cursor or finger to press on a card and drag it to another card on the board. This will swap the cards and possibly match if adjacent cards are valid. Once you match cards pay attention because they will stay grouped when you drag. The more moves you make the better your chances are at creating correct matches. You will also start to see the picture as your matching skills improve.

title: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle
description: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle is a charming and addictive one-line puzzle game where players draw a single continuous line to connect and activate all the water pipes on the farm. Set in a vibrant, colorful cartoon farm filled with blooming flowers, cute animals, and relaxing scenery, the core gameplay revolves around clever pipe-connecting logic that challenges your spatial thinking. With its relaxing atmosphere, satisfying one-stroke mechanics, and progressively tricky levels, it brings the joy of farming and puzzle-solving together in one delightful package.
howToPlay: Draw One Line to Save the Farm! Become a pipe-connecting master in Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle! In this charming one-line puzzle game, your only goal is to draw a single continuous line that connects all the water pipes on the farm and makes the water flow. With clever spatial thinking and just one stroke, you’ll solve every level and bring life back to the vibrant cartoon farm filled with blooming flowers, cute animals, and relaxing scenery. Desktop Controls: Mouse: Click and drag to draw one continuous line. Left Mouse Button: Hold to draw, release to finish the line. Mobile Controls: Finger: Tap and drag across the screen to draw one continuous line. No extra buttons — just one smooth stroke to win!

title: Ninja dash: Cozy tactic puzzle
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Ninja Dash: Cozy Tactic Puzzle, a free online game where stealth and strategy unite. As a ninja tactician, eliminate foes with careful planning, using your surroundings to perfect each move, whether on your phone or computer.
howToPlay: Keyboard Rotate player - hold RMB + move mouse Action - LMB Camera rotate & zoom - AD, mouse wheel Mobile Player - screen buttons Camera rotate & zoom - swipe left/right, pinch

title: Parkour World 2
description: Welcome to Parkour World 2, an exhilarating Minecraft-inspired parkour game with thrilling challenges and delightful gameplay. -Each level in this game boasts its own distinct and features, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play. -While the initial levels may seem relatively simple, as you progress through the game. By the time you conquer the first ten levels, you'll find yourself facing increasingly demanding obstacles. -Get ready to run, and conquer in Parkour World!
howToPlay: WASD to Move Shift to Run Space to Jump ESC to Pause/Resume E to Open Chest in-game tutorial included

title: Okay
description: Okay? is a minimalist puzzle game that turns simple shapes into clever challenges. Every level is made of blocks, lines, and objects placed on a clean, abstract screen. Your goal is simple: clear all the objects with just one perfect move. Draw a line with your finger, release it, and watch it bounce around the screen. If your move is right, the line will hit and remove every object until the screen is empty. Sounds easy? As levels go up, the puzzles get smarter, requiring perfect angles, timing, and logic.
howToPlay: Your goal is to clear all the elements (lines, blocks, etc.) from the board. You draw a line (with your finger / touch) starting from somewhere, and that line interacts with the elements on screen. The drawn line will “pop” or hit the elements, making them disappear (“clear all the elements”) if done correctly. There are many levels, increasingly challenging. Some puzzles are simple; others require more precise dragging, angles, and timing.

title: Untangle Threads
description: "Untangle Threads" — a beautiful puzzle game where you drag nodes so that no thread crosses another. 6 unique worlds, each with its own mechanic: - Neon — classic puzzles to warm up - Nature — new threads appear as you solve - Space — some nodes are locked in place - Ocean — nodes drift with the current - Crystals — limited number of moves - Steampunk — linked nodes move as mirror images
howToPlay: 1. Drag the nodes (glowing spheres) with your finger or mouse 2. Position them so that no thread crosses another 3. Red threads = crossing detected, green = all clear 4. Fewer moves = more stars (up to 3)

title: Spider-Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.
howToPlay: *To move from wall to wall, tap and release on mobile, or click and release with the mouse on PC. *Collect all three pumpkins and safely reach the visible portal. *Playable on both mobile and PC.

title: BeastForge Rival
description: BeastForge- Epic PvP Tower Defense Battles! Dive into the ultimate real-time PvP strategy showdown! Command your army of 20 uniquely balanced units in intense Clash Royale-style tower wars. Outsmart global opponents in lightning-fast multiplayer duels or battle god-tier AI bots that train themselves through 1000+ simulated matches for unbeatable tactics. No waiting—seamless matchmaking and instant AI fillers keep the action non-stop! Key Features: Real-Time PvP Multiplayer: Challenge players worldwide, climb global leaderboards, and dominate ranked arenas! Revolutionary AI Training System: Watch your AI opponents evolve in real-time—self-play 1000 matches to master counters, perfect your strategy against pro-level bots anytime. 20 Balanced Units: Rock-paper-scissors meta with archers, tanks, spells, and more—deploy, upgrade, and synergize for victory. Stunning Graphics & Sound: Crisp visuals, explosive effects, immersive audio—feels premium on desktop & mobile. Quick Matches: 3-5 minute battles perfect for "one more game" addiction. Daily Challenges & Rewards: Earn upgrades, unlock skins, and compete in tournaments. Whether you're a strategy master or casual battler, AI Clash Roya…
howToPlay: To play this game, just drag and drop the powerups from the button deck and place them in the arena and watch the fight, of course you have to time your placement and ensure you manage elixir.

title: Prisoners Run
description: A brutal prison where guards show no mercy. You play as a powerful inmate who can smash doors, outsmart guards, and free fellow prisoners while fighting your way to escape.
howToPlay: Game Objective: Find the key and reach the exit elevator to advance to the next level. Rescue and escort fellow prisoners to freedom along the way. Desktop Controls: Arrows or WASD. Mobile Controls: virtual Joystick: Drag to move in all directions.

title: BuildemUp
description: BuildemUp is an entertaining and cool game where you should put various color and shape blocks on a cargo machine in order to deliver them and finish building beautiful houses. You will enjoy the challenge of keeping all these weird blocks on the truck. As you progress in game you will earn coins witch you can buy and unlock other cool looking trucks and activate power up to help you advance more easily in levels. BuildemUp is an ideal game for all ages, providing easy to difficult mind challenges and enhancing puzzle solving skills.
howToPlay: Drag the shapes and drop them onto the truck. You must stack them in a way that when the truck moves, the shapes don’t fall off!

title: STAIR BALL
description: Climb an endless staircase full of danger in Stairs Ball, a fast and minimal arcade game. You control a small ball running up colorful steps. The path looks simple, but each stair is covered with deadly spikes and tricky gaps. One wrong move and your run is over. Collect shiny rubies on your way to unlock new balls and styles. Chain “perfect” moves to build huge combos and smash your high score. The higher you climb, the faster and harder it gets it’s all about timing, reflexes, and focus.
howToPlay: Touch and hold the screen to move the ball left or right across the stairs. Release and press again to quickly switch direction. Your goal is to keep climbing without hitting any spikes. Each stair can have black cone spikes. If the ball touches a spike, the run ends instantly. Read the pattern of spikes and move early, not at the last second.

title: Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle
description: Slide, Solve, and Smile with Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle! Welcome to Slidey, a heartwarming sliding cat puzzle game that brings you cozy vibes, playful challenges, and the fluffiest kittens ever! ? We give you Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle, the ultimate sliding block puzzle game with unique gameplay and endless fun! The Slidey is simple: slide cute cat blocks left or right to create and clear full lines. The Slidey is free to play and easy to learn. With no timers, no stress, and no pressure - just you, charming puzzles, and adorable feline friends - this game is your perfect escape from the daily grind. FEATURES: ● A new type of brain training puzzle, entertain your brain for minutes or hours ● Endless challenge, you can play forever yet you'll still find something undiscovered
howToPlay: ● Slide/move cute cat blocks left or right. ● New rows rise from the bottom with each slide/move. ● Create full lines to make cats disappear. ● Game is over if cat blocks reach the top of the grid.

title: Pixel Conquest
description: Pixel Conquest is a fast-paced, addictive strategy game where you compete against AI opponents to conquer the most territory. Draw trails to enclose land and claim it as your own, all while your city automatically grows within your borders. Use clever tactics to cut off and eliminate your rivals. Grab powerful-ups like Speed, Shields, and Bombs to gain an edge and become the last tracer standing!
howToPlay: Goal: The goal is to conquer the most territory and be the last player remaining on the grid. Controls: Desktop: Use the Arrow Keys to direct your character. How to conquering Territory: Move out from your colored territory to draw a trail. Return to any part of your own territory to complete a loop. The area you've enclosed will be claimed and converted to your color. Elimination: You are eliminated if you run into the outer walls or an opponent's established territory. City Building & Scoring: As your territory grows, buildings like houses and skyscrapers will automatically be built, generating points for you over time. Conquering enemy territory, destroying their buildings, and eliminating opponents will also boost your score. Power-ups: Occasionally, power-ups will appear on the map. Move over them to collect special abilities for a limited time. Speed: Move twice as fast. Shield: Survive one fatal collision. Ghost: Pass through enemy trails without being eliminated. Bomb: Instantly claim a large circular area around you.

title: GeoVex - Daily Geography Challenge
description: The daily map challenge for flag and geography nerds. GeoVex is an engaging daily educational puzzle game that puts your world geography knowledge to the test. In this map-based trivia challenge, you are presented with a series of national flags and must pinpoint their exact location on the globe. Play on Easy mode to see country names and map borders, or test your true expertise on Hard mode, with a completely borderless map! Compete in the 10-round Daily Challenge to build your daily streak and share your score with friends!
howToPlay: Your goal is to identify the flag, find the country on the map, place your pin, and rack up the highest score possible! Controls: • PC: Click and drag to pan the map, use the mouse wheel to zoom, and left-click to drop your flag pin. • Mobile: Swipe to pan the map, pinch to zoom, and tap to drop your flag pin. Once you place your pin, click the "Submit" button to confirm your guess. If your pin lands perfectly inside the correct country, you earn a maximum of 10 points. If you miss, you are awarded partial points based on your distance from the target (5 points within 500km, 3 points within 1000km, and 1 point within 2000km). Complete all rounds to get your final score and share your results with your friends!

title: DashMash.io
description: DashMash.io is a chaotic multiplayer obstacle race where up to 10 players battle it out in real time! Jump, dash, and dodge your way through stages packed with moving platforms, swinging hammers, crumbling blocks, and deadly spikes. Each round cycles to a brand-new map, forcing you to adapt on the fly. Reach the finish line first to claim the top spot on the leaderboard — if the chaos doesn't get you first!
howToPlay: Race to the finish in this frantic multiplayer platformer! Navigate through obstacle-filled stages alongside up to 9 other players in real time. Dodge hazards, ride moving platforms, and unleash your dash to surge ahead of the pack! Desktop Controls: ← / → (Arrow Keys or A/D): Move left and right. ↑ (Up Arrow) / W / Space: Jump — double jump supported! Shift: Dash — burst forward for a speed boost. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Drag to move left and right. J Button: Tap to jump. D Button: Tap to dash forward.

title: Ragdoll Football
description: Ragdoll Football is wild arcade soccer with ZERO gravity! Your goofy yet lovable ragdoll player floats, tumbles and flies across the arena to smash the ball into the opponent's goal. Every match lasts just 60 seconds and bursts with silly physics, flashy special strikes and surprise modifiers — giant ball, bouncy ball, huge goals, currents and more. No boring rounds, ever! Win cups in Tournament mode, climb the ranked ladder in 1v1 Duels, unlock dozens of characters, balls and arenas, complete daily quests and storm the leaderboards. Easy controls, instant fun and endless replayable chaos — drop in for a minute and stay for hours.
howToPlay: • Fly — drag on the screen (WASD or arrows on PC): move in any direction in zero-g. • Dash-Strike — tap the screen (Space or J on PC): a quick dash that kicks the ball and knocks the rival away. • Brake & Trap — hold (Shift or K on PC): stop fast and catch the ball. • Special — when the meter is full, unleash your hero's signature power strike.

title: Space Obby
description: A fun and lighthearted platformer set in outer space. Join other intrepid astronauts as you adventure to the far reaching corners of a destroyed space station, using your trusty jetpack to navigate the floating wreckage. Featuring six unlockable characters and collectable battery cells scattered across four massive levels -- do you have what it takes to reach the end?
howToPlay: Objective: Explore the space station wreckage, collect power cells to open doors to new levels and unlock characters. Mouse and Keyboard Controls: Movement: WASD or arrow keys Jump: Spacebar Jetpack : Hold spacebar midair Camera Rotation: Move mouse Camera Zoom: Scroll wheel Settings Menu: P key Mobile Touch Controls: Movement: Touch and drag the on-screen joystick on the left of the screen Jump: Tap jump button on the right of the screen Jetpack : Hold jump button on the right of the screen Camera Rotation: Swipe anywhere on the screen Camera Zoom: Pinch anywhere on the screen

title: Real Parking Game
description: Real Parking Game puts your driving precision to the test. Start in a garage full of cars and progress through dozens of hand-crafted levels packed with obstacles, narrow lanes, and tricky parking spots. Your goal is simple but challenging: navigate the course, avoid collisions, and reach the designated parking place to complete the level. Features: Large garage with many cars to unlock and collect. Multiple levels. Realistic driving physics and responsive controls for precision parking. Progressive difficulty — beginner-friendly tutorials up to expert parking puzzles. Optimized performance for smooth gameplay on mobile devices. Whether you enjoy relaxed precision driving or intense obstacle runs, Real Parking Game delivers addictive, approachable gameplay that rewards skill and patience. Download now, pick your favorite ride, master the obstacles and park like a pro!
howToPlay: Steering: Arrow keys or WASD (←/→ or A/D) Accelerate: W or ↑ Brake / Reverse: S or ↓ Steering: on-screen joystick Accelerate: on-screen gas button Brake/Reverse: on-screen brake button

title: Samurai Survivor
description: In the land of ancient Japan, a mysterious portal has opened, unleashing hordes of monstrous creatures into the world. As the last line of defense, a group of brave samurai warriors must stand against the onslaught to protect their homeland. Each warrior possesses unique skills and abilities, handed down through generations, to combat the dark forces. Together, they must fight to close the portal and restore peace to the land.
howToPlay: Survive hundreds of enemies while leveling up and upgrading your skills. ↑ (Up Arrow): Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow): Move downward. ← (Left Arrow): Move left. → (Right Arrow): Move right. 🖱️(Left Click): Move in all directions by dragging your mouse while pressing left click. Mobile Controls: Move in all directions by touching the screen.

title: Mine Jump
description: Join the exciting world of Mine Jump, an engaging online experience that merges quick thinking with rapid actions. Explore a captivating realm where each jump reveals hidden treasures. Enhance your character and uncover the mysteries of an alien planet, all while enjoying the thrill on any device!
howToPlay: Jump, jump, jump! A challenging reaction and logic game that won't let you get bored! Collect slugs, pump up your hero and find the edge of this planet! Click on the left or right side of the screen to move diagonally on a cell. If you make a mistake, you can go back. Get as far as you can to find out all the secrets of this mysterious planet!

title: Nubik Courier: An Open World
description: Nubik Courier: An Open World is an exciting delivery game that turns you into a skilled pizza courier racing through lively city streets. Navigate obstacles and switch vehicles as you complete each delivery, all while enjoying free online play. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it's perfect for casual gamers seeking thrills.

title: Luna And The Magic Maze
description: Join Luna in her enchanting quest through a mystical autumn forest in "Luna And The Magic Maze." Solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets. Each stage presents fresh challenges, proving that willpower can be as powerful as magic, whether you play on your phone or computer.
howToPlay: Move using WASD or arrow keys. Have a great journey!

title: Carvivor Ops
description: Carvivor Ops is a car-based action game that challenges you to survive increasingly intense waves of police within a limited time.
howToPlay: Get behind the wheel of a weaponized supercar ! Dodge the cops, fire rockets Upgrade your gear, survive endless chases, and become the ultimate escape artist! Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow, W): Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow, S): Move downward. ← (Left Arrow, A): Move left. → (Right Arrow, D): Move right. Mobile Controls: Control the car using the buttons on the screen!

title: Tiny Archer
description: Nock, Draw, Loose! There is unlimited number of targets in front of you, and it is up to you to find out how many can you hit. Do not give up, try again and your skills will improve with every game.
howToPlay: Release the arrow at the right moment to shoot target directly in the middle and progress. Get as far as you can to unlock different skins. Number of your arrows is limited. You are loosing them every time you miss. Can you beat your own records and became the ultimate archer?

title: Gun Craft and Fight
description: «Gun Craft and Fight» is a dynamic first-person shooter where you fight enemies, collect resources, and craft new weapons to complete combat missions. Upgrade your arsenal, choose the right weapon for each situation, and clear levels where reaction, accuracy, and smart tactics matter. The game combines classic FPS gameplay with crafting and progression elements. Explore locations, defeat enemies, unlock new opportunities, and become stronger with every battle. The further you progress, the more dangerous the enemies become — so it is time to craft more powerful weapons and use them to the fullest. «Gun Craft and Fight» is perfect for fans of shooters, action games, weapons, survival, and upgrade-based gameplay.
howToPlay: Control your character, look around, and fight enemies on the map. Use weapons to defeat opponents, collect useful items and resources, then craft or upgrade your gear. Stay aware of your surroundings: enemies can attack from different directions, so it is important to move, aim, and shoot at the right moment. The more accurately you play, the faster you can complete each level and move forward. Your main goal is to survive, defeat all enemies, and complete the mission. Upgrade your weapons, unlock new options, and use the best arsenal for every battle.

title: Unravel Eggs Puzzle
description: Celebrate Easter weekend in style this year with the sweet new puzzle game, Unravel Eggs Puzzle! Complete each level by untangling eggs such that each line connecting eggs is not intersected by any other line connecting eggs. Warm up with some light puzzles and work your way up to an egg-tangling like you've never seen! Happy Easter!
howToPlay: Grab an egg: Touch and drag an egg to move it around the screen. Reposition to avoid intersections: Adjust positions so that none of the connecting lines between eggs cross each other. All lines must be “untangled.” Change color to green: When the arrangement has no intersecting lines, the eggs and the lines turn green, meaning the level is solved.

title: The Fill
description: Sharpen your mind with a connect-the-block-style one-line brain training puzzle game. A simple but addictive one-line puzzle game that’s completely free to play. Your brain becomes more active the more you play. During your commute, before you sleep… enjoy downtime with brain training. The rules are extremely simple. Just fill in all of the blocks using only one line. Use hints for puzzles that are too hard to solve. Hints are also free, of course.
howToPlay: Swipe or draw one continuous line that passes through every block without lifting your finger or mouse. You must fill every block in one go; backtracking isn’t allowed. If a puzzle feels too complex, tap the hint icon to reveal part of the solution and it’s free. s you complete puzzles, higher difficulty levels unlock more challenging puzzles.

title: Geek Escape: Run for Survival
description: Geek Escape: Run for Survival is an exciting arcade game where players control a nerdy hero racing against bullies. Available for free online on various platforms, it combines action and strategy. Players dodge obstacles and use trash cans as weapons in this thrilling adventure filled with excitement.
howToPlay: Arrow keys to navigate Spacebar to throw trash cans Shift key for speed boost

title: Resize Stickman
description: Resize Stickman: Master Your Size, Conquer the Run! Dive into "Resize Stickman," a thrilling and visually polished 3D runner where your only power is to change your size! The core idea is simple yet deeply engaging: your stickman automatically runs forward, and you must strategically resize him — grow to smash through towering barriers or shrink to slip under low obstacles. This game stands out in the crowded runner genre by blending instant pick-up-and-play simplicity with hybrid-casual depth. It's not just about reflexes; it's about smart, split-second decisions. With a sleek, reactive interface, satisfying animations, and a wealth of content including a vast collection of collectible skins with a progressive gacha-style shop and multi-tiered achievements, "Resize Stickman" offers a premium-quality experience. Fully localized for a global audience, it delivers a captivating and rewarding challenge that will keep you coming back for more.
howToPlay: Objective: Guide your Stickman as far as possible by overcoming a variety of physical obstacles. Your goal is to achieve a high score by completing as many challenging levels as you can, earning coins to unlock awesome new skins and achievements. Core Mechanic: Your Stickman runs automatically. You have one crucial ability: control his size to navigate the environment. Mobile Controls: Swipe Down: Instantly SHRINK your Stickman to a small size. Swipe Up: Instantly GROW your Stickman to a large size. How to Win: Success depends on your timing and strategy. Analyze each obstacle quickly — some require you to be small, others to be big. Master the rhythm of resizing to survive the ever-changing course and set a new personal record!

title: Lane Clash
description: Lane Hold is a casual 3D lane-defense game. Hold your fortress across five parallel lanes: tap a lane shield to spawn warriors, clash power head-on, and stop enemies before they breach the wall. Clear short waves, upgrade lanes and the base between rounds, and use Shield, Bomb, and Freeze when the pressure rises — no joystick, no chasing camera, just tense lane battles.
howToPlay: Defend your fortress across five lanes. Enemies run toward your wall — tap a lane shield to spawn warriors (when cooldown is ready). When units clash, their power cancels out: the weaker is destroyed, the stronger keeps going with the leftover power. If an enemy reaches the wall, your base loses HP equal to that enemy’s power. How to win Clear each wave by defeating or blocking all enemies before your base HP drops to zero. Survive the wave to earn rewards, upgrade your lanes, and advance to the next wave. Upgrades & items Lane gears: upgrade tier and power with coins, cooldown with gems Wall HP bar: base upgrades and repair Inventory: Shield (arm a lane), Bomb (clear nearby enemies), Freeze (slow a lane) Tap coins on the field to collect them Ad Rewards: watch ads for gems and coins Items shop (tap an empty inventory slot): buy items with gems; in-apps when payments are available Controls Mouse / touch: tap a lane shield to spawn Inventory buttons: use Shield, Bomb, or Freeze during a wave Continue: after a win Soft Retry (watch an ad for an easier wave) or Back: after a defeat

title: Paint & Roll
description: Paint & Roll is a fun and satisfying color puzzle game where every move fills the world with vibrant paint 🎨✨ Roll your connected paint rollers across the board, cover every surface, and turn dull paths into colorful masterpieces 🌈🌀 Each level challenges your timing, direction, and planning skills as you glide, rotate, and paint your way to victory 🧠🎯 Simple controls make it easy to play, but mastering every level takes skill and strategy 😄🔥 Enjoy smooth animations, juicy paint effects, and relaxing yet challenging gameplay that feels great every time you roll 🎵💫 Perfect for quick sessions or long playtimes, Paint & Roll delivers a colorful experience that’s easy to learn and hard to put down 🚀🎮
howToPlay: Tap or click to switch control between the connected rollers and guide them carefully across the platforms Plan your moves and timing to paint every surface while staying balanced. Be careful—if any roller touches the water, the level is instantly lost Smooth switching and smart movement are the key to reaching the finish and winning the level

title: Precise Shooting
description: Test your aim and precision in Precise Shooting, a satisfying basketball shooting challenge! Launch the ball with perfect timing and angle to score into the hoop from various tricky positions and distances. The core idea is mastering trajectory and power — one well-timed shot can earn you massive points and combos. What makes it unique? Beautiful minimalist 3D visuals, realistic ball physics with satisfying arcs, increasing difficulty with moving hoops and obstacles, and the addictive “one more try” feeling as you chase perfect shots and high scores!
howToPlay: Your main goal is to shoot the basketball into the hoop with perfect precision. Hold and drag to adjust the power and angle, then release at the right moment to make the shot. Score as many points as possible by making clean shots — the better your timing and angle, the higher your score! PC Controls: Mouse: Click and hold on the player, drag to set power and angle, then release to shoot. Mobile Controls: Touchscreen: Tap and hold on the player, drag to adjust shooting power and angle, then release to shoot the ball.

title: Snake Slither.io Italian Brainrot
description: Snake Slither.io Italian Brainrot is a fast, funny, and totally unhinged snake game inspired by classic slither gameplay and viral Italian brainrot memes. Control your snake and slither across a chaotic arena filled with absurd Italian brainrot characters, strange creatures, and ridiculous surprises. Eat orbs, grow longer, and avoid crashing into other snakes while the screen explodes with nonsense, memes, and pure chaos. Featuring iconic brainrot-style characters, exaggerated animations, and colorful Italian-themed visuals, this game turns simple snake mechanics into a wild meme-filled experience. The bigger you grow, the harder it gets—one wrong move and it’s game over.
howToPlay: mouse only. Featuring iconic brainrot-style characters, exaggerated animations, and colorful Italian-themed visuals, this game turns simple snake mechanics into a wild meme-filled experience. The bigger you grow, the harder it gets—one wrong move and it’s game over.

title: Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon
description: Step into the role of a manager for a small Hotel. Open and upgrade rooms, restaurants, leisure areas, and various cafes. Embellish the exterior and interior of your Hotel to attract more visitors! Hire staff to service the rooms and open parking lots. Invest your profits back into your business and multiply your earnings! The core genre is Idle Tycoon. You'll need to continuously develop your business - a small Hotel - over an extended period. Open all rooms and leisure facilities (halls, cafes, parks) to increase your profits from each visitor. You can speed up service time by tapping on the progress bar located above each cashier's desk and at the reception. Additionally, you can watch short videos to receive temporary and instant bonuses to your earnings!
howToPlay: Access to all main game mechanics is available from the main screen. Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game UI.

title: Stackitaire
description: Stackitaire is an addictive solitaire card-sorting puzzle. Shuffle through stacks of mixed cards and sort them into complete suits — one suit per stack. Every level deals a new layout that gets trickier as locked cards, hidden decks, and tighter stacks are introduced. With hundreds of levels, daily bonuses, and handy boosters to rescue a tough hand, Stackitaire is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and satisfying puzzle play. Tips: Keep at least one stack empty as a holding spot — it gives you room to reorganize. Think a few moves ahead before placing a card; getting blocked is how levels get tough. Use Undo before spending a Hint.
howToPlay: Tap a stack to pick up the top card, then tap another stack to place it there. You can only place a card onto another card of the same suit, or into an empty stack. A stack is complete when it holds a full suit, sorted from bottom to top. Clear all stacks to finish the level. Boosters Undo — Take back your last move if you played the wrong card. Hint — Highlights the best next move when you're stuck. Key — Unlocks a sealed stack, flipping hidden cards face-up so you can play them.

title: Emoji Memory: Find a Pair
description: You need to turn over the cards, trying to find pairs of identical ones. If two different cards are turned over, they are automatically turned back over, giving the player a little time to memorize them. The level will be completed when the player opens all pairs of cards in the playing field. There are two additional game modes in which you can set records by competing with other players: for time and for the minimum number of moves.
howToPlay: Click on any inverted card with the mouse or your finger on the touchscreen to open it. When a player has unfolded two cards, the player is credited with opening one pair of cards if they turn out to be the same. And if the cards turn out to be different, then they will turn back over. After that, you can open the following cards.

title: Boba Blast
description: Fast, head-to-head pearl-duel game. You and a rival each face a spinning mega-ball of colorful boba pearls. Shoot matching pearls to pop them in satisfying chain reactions, chip away at the cluster, and be the first to clear your ball. Matches feel like a competitive arcade duel: aim carefully, manage limited shots, and race the clock while your opponent does the same. Wrong-color hits ricochet instead of popping, so every throw matters.
