Spend your hard-earned coins in the permanent garage to unlock new ships and max out your core stats, ensuring you get further in every run. Your run ends, but your power doesn't!
howToPlay: Astro shooter comes with easy controls. For desktop just use mouse cursor to controll the player ship and for mobile devices use on screen joysticks.

title: SpeedMatch Competition
description: A competitive fast-paced tile-matching & puzzle competition. Put your stakes on speed, accuracy or both to come on top of your opponents.
howToPlay: Click or tap on the screen to stop tiles, match & crush them all before your opponents. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Mouse Survivor
description: Get ready for the thrilling journey of Mouse Survivor! In this dynamic 2D game, you'll dodge dangerous snakes and tackle explosive obstacles while gathering cheese to explore new areas. Stay agile and quick to thrive in this constantly changing environment, available on both mobile and desktop!
howToPlay: How to play Mouse Survivor? Keyboard Controls W / Arrow Up / Spacebar: Jump A / Arrow Left: Left D / Arrow Right: Right For Mobile:Scroll 🐭 Run, Jump, and Explore Infinitely Divided Worlds with the Brave Mouse!🧀 Embark on an epic journey with our fearless mouse hero in this exciting 2D endless running game! 🏃 Endless Running Adventure: Guide your mouse through a dynamic world full of ever-changing tiles. Watch out for those with lower alpha; One touch can be dangerous! Dodge, jump and slide your way through endless challenges. 🐍 Encounter Sneaky Snakes: Watch out for crawling snakes! Snakes will try to hinder your progress. Swipe right, left or up to perform daring moves and escape their cunning clutches. Can you outsmart the serpentine enemies? 🧀 Cheese Collection and Upgrades: Munch on delicious cheeses scattered along the way to increase your cheese count. Acquire new tile types by spending your hard-earned cheeses. Customize your running experience with a variety of tiles, each with its own unique features and challenges! Good Luck...

title: Palkovil The Way Home
description: The unique world of "Palkovil" will allow you to immerse yourself in the crazy atmosphere of the New Year! Hundreds of monsters and mobs, favorite animals, fascinating riddles and quests, gifts, toys and sweets, huge laboratory spaces will help you learn the most terrible secrets of this place! Collect toys, feed squirrels, dogs and cats, fight with swords, defeat bosses, collect cards by looking at paintings, find connections and do everything to bring the Christmas tree home. Save your favorite holiday together with the heroes of this game.
howToPlay: The main task of this quest is to bring the Christmas tree back home. Do everything so that the aliens can not spoil the holiday. Turn on the lights in the right rooms to move around the laboratory. Fulfill the tasks of the aliens to get toys. Collect the whole collection of unique souvenirs to please your friends with beautiful gifts!

title: Art'N Ball
description: Art'N Ball is a mix between classic tennis and 3D platform game. The player will travel different locations within the Art’N Ball rolling-out world, skillfully returning his Earth-ball to have it pass walls, art exhibits, photo and puzzle challenges to finally set it free from its enclosed gallery pathway into infinite Space. He will experience different levels of complexity as the Earth-ball takes him from countryside or mountainous territories to the inner bowels of the underground, the depths of the seas, past frantic cityscapes towards arty lush landscapes and onto a surprise finish journey in orbit…
howToPlay: Play Ball With Art! The player has to ceaselessly return the ball with his racket in a gallery hallway, which takes twists and turns and narrows or widens as the player changes ambiance, until he meets a Level boss at the end of 3 Acts in order to exit the gallery. He constantly needs to keep an eye on the Earth-ball trajectory to anticipate its return and take it with the most appropriate angle to overcome obstacles and artfully squeeze his way out. He can maximize his gameplay by catching bonuses, completing image puzzles, taking in-game world screenshots, or lighting exhibits to uncover their art contents, while getting a comfortable view of the outside scenery through large bay windows and enjoying a cosy or rhythmic music atmosphere. He may also refine his strategy by prioritizing moving the ball forward to finish a level versus finishing puzzles or taking screenshots to earn extra lives and better score and level ranking. He has to beware of maluses which will slow down his progression, but the good news is that these can actually turn to his advantage, e.g getting a chance to retrieve an extra life (in completing the missing blocks of a puzzle or hitting a final screenshot)…

title: Moto Obby
description: Join the exciting world of Moto Obby, where your motorbike skills face intense challenges. Overcome tricky hazards like swinging hammers and sharp spikes in a quest for victory. Test your reflexes across various levels in this thrilling online game, available on phones and computers.
howToPlay: Use the arrows ⬆️⬇️ or "WS" to move and ⬅️➡️ or "AD" to spin. Sometimes you’ll need to slow down, and other times you’ll need to speed up to win. Try different tactics. If your bike gets stuck, press ⬅️➡️ or "AD" to hop!

title: Pool 8
description: Pool 8 is a brain-teasing puzzle game based on a Pool board. Pot the balls in the correct order to move through a series of increasingly difficult challenges! There's a multitude of difficulty levels that you naturally progress through, starting with the easiest "rookie" level. At the end of each difficulty level, you get a chance to win extra retries in the "smash the candies" bonus round. You can also earn these by watching a short video ad. Yes, but it starts out easy. As you progress, you reach higher difficulty levels.
howToPlay: The unique mechanics in this game mean you can only move up, down, left, and right. There are no diagonal movements, which poses a tricky challenge when several balls are on the table. The key to winning the level is to think about the order of each move to ensure you can line up all the shots successfully.

title: Cars Vs Blocks
description: Welcome to Cars & Blocks — a fun and satisfying color-match puzzle game where strategy meets smooth driving! Tap to blast colorful blocks and free the matching stickmen. Each stickman must enter the car with the same color. Clear the path, avoid traffic chaos, and make sure every car drives away safely! It starts simple… but don’t get too comfortable 😏 As you progress, levels become more challenging with tighter spaces, more colors, and smarter puzzles that test your logic. Game Features 🚗 • Addictive color-matching gameplay • Easy tap controls • Satisfying block blast effects • Smooth stickman animations • Challenging levels with increasing difficulty • Clean and colorful visuals Think fast. Plan smart. Clear the blocks. Can you master every level and create the perfect traffic flow?🚀
howToPlay: Use your mouse or finger to drag and place cubes on the board. Match the colors correctly to clear paths, free the stickmen, and help them enter the cars safely. Plan carefully and avoid blocking the road!

title: Summer Shore Hustle
description: Earn some money in this summer to relax in next coming summer!! What to do ? You run out of the money this summer so you decided to run a shop on the beach to earn some money! so that you can relax in the upcoming summer :) How to Play ? Play in game tutorial to find it out :) Note from Developer: Nothing :) (hope you liked the game) Team Members: JADU : Programmer and Developer Rahul : Artist and designer
howToPlay: Run a small shop at beach, sell products, cook food, server food to customer and earn money. Controls: WASD - walk Shift - Run Ctrl - Couch E - Pick up Q - Drop F - Alt. Interaction P - Pause X - Call customer (increase the chance for the near by customer to visit you shop) that's it the Controls are been displayed in the tutorial.

title: Match The Brainrot
description: Match the Brain Rot is a fast, colorful match-3 puzzle game built around viral meme characters. Players swap tiles, trigger cascades, earn XP, and climb endless levels with increasing goals. Its unique mix of chaotic humor, collectible character skins, highscore sharing, rewarded ads, and coin-powered purchases keeps every session fresh.
howToPlay: Swap adjacent character tiles to create matches of three or more, earn XP, trigger cascades, and reach each level’s XP target before running out of moves. Winning completes the level and unlocks the next endless challenge. Use mouse click-and-drag on desktop, or touch and swipe controls on mobile and tablet.

title: Blade Hit
description: Throw knives at logs to break them, collect coins, and unlock new knives. Collect up to 96 weapons (swords, staffs, knives, tridents, shurikens, and more), set records, and become a knife master in Blade Hit!
howToPlay: Left mouse button/tap on screen - throw knife. The player's task is to throw all the knives without hitting the previous ones.

title: Pop Sweet Fruits
description: 🎉 Dive into a fruit-filled adventure with Pop Sweet Fruits! 🍍🍑 🎮 Start with 2 fruits, pop more 💥 to unlock new ones 🔓 and boost your strength 🚀! 🔫 Upgrade bullet speed ⚡, fire rate 🔥, and earnings 💰! 🌍 Play worldwide with 7 languages (🇹🇷🇬🇧🇩🇪🇮🇹🇪🇸🇫🇷🇷🇺)! 🍒 Sweet fruits 🍇, quick reflexes ⏱️, and endless action await you! 🌀
howToPlay: 🎯 Get ready for endless fun with Pop Sweet Fruits! 🍓🍒 Start the game with 2 sweet fruits 🍑🍊, pop fruits 🍍🍉, unlock new ones, and boost your power! 🚀 Upgrade your bullet speed 🔫, fire rate 🔥, and earnings 💰 to collect them all! 🍇🍋 With 7 language options 🌍 (Turkish 🇹🇷, English 🇬🇧, German 🇩🇪, Italian 🇮🇹, Spanish 🇪🇸, French 🇫🇷, Russian 🇷🇺), enjoy the excitement worldwide! 🎮 Test your reflexes ⚡, level up 📈, catch the thrill 🎊, and join this addictive 🌀 juicy adventure! 🚀🍏

title: Cute Shapes
description: "Cute Shapes" is an adorable casual observation puzzle for the whole family. Spot the differences among cute shapes with eyes, solve fun little challenges, and train your powers of observation!
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to spot the differences! 1. Read the task at the top of the screen carefully. 2. Look for the one shape that is different from the others in its form, size, emotion, sound, or other feature. 3. Click on it with your mouse or tap it with your finger to proceed to the next level.

title: Mandala Meadow
description: Mandala Meadow is a relaxing mandala coloring game where you paint intricate designs, unwind, and create stunning art one tap at a time. Choose a mandala, fill each section with soft, calming colors, and watch detailed patterns bloom to life. With dozens of hand-crafted mandalas — from simple flowers to elaborate lotus, peacock, and animal designs — there's a soothing coloring puzzle for every mood. Perfect for mindfulness, stress relief, and creative relaxation. No timers, no pressure — just you, gentle music, and beautiful art
howToPlay: Find Your Calm, One Color at a Time! Step into a peaceful world of art and mindfulness with Mandala Meadow, the relaxing mandala coloring game. Pick a beautiful design, fill each section with soft, soothing colors, and watch intricate patterns bloom to life. From simple flowers to elaborate lotus, peacock, and animal mandalas, there's a calming coloring puzzle for every mood — no timers, no pressure, just you and your art. Perfect for relaxation, stress relief, and creative fun! Desktop Controls: Click a section: Select the area you want to color. Click & drag: Paint freely within the lines. Color palette: Click a swatch to pick your color. Brush / Fill toggle: Switch between hand-painting and instant fill. Zoom slider: Zoom in for fine detail. Undo / Reset: Fix mistakes or start a mandala fresh. Mobile Controls: Tap a section: Select where to paint. Drag to paint: Color with your finger, neatly inside the lines. Tap a swatch: Choose your color. Pinch to zoom: Get up close for intricate areas. Undo / Reset buttons: Adjust or restart anytime.

title: Cubic Coil
description: Guide a green-black voxel snake inside a rotatable cube. Spin both snake and cube to line up moves, collect voxel fruit squares and rare big fruits for bonus points. Classic Snake rules, reimagined in 3D with a crisp green backdrop.
howToPlay: PC: Rotate cube with WASD. Steer snake with Arrow Keys. Mobile: Swipe on the left side to rotate the cube; swipe on the right side to steer the snake.

title: Cards in Fool
description: Play Cards in Fool – a strategic turn-based online card game! Outsmart opponents, make them draw cards, and climb the leaderboard. Flip cards, win matches, and earn points in this classic multiplayer challenge!
howToPlay: In the game of "Cards a Fool", the classic rules are that the one with the smaller trump card goes first. There are 36 cards in the deck. At the beginning, one trump card is selected, which determines the highest suit over all. The principle of the game is the same, First one goes with any card, the other must fight off with the highest of the same suit or a trump card. If the one who strayed then he walks and so on in turn. The winner is the one who has no cards left and the deck is empty. In the case when no one has any cards left, a draw is recognized, in this case no points are awarded or taken away. Track your score on the leaderboard.

title: Watermelon: Falling Animals
description: Merge cute animals and create new, bigger, and rarer ones! 🐾 The more animals you combine, the higher your score and the faster you climb the leaderboard. Compete with players from all over the world for the top spot in the rankings. Plan your strategy, use powerful boosts and combos to earn even more points and outperform your rivals. Unlock new animals, set records, and prove that you are the true master of evolution! Download the game now and start an exciting adventure in the world of animals! Become the best and claim the title of the ultimate Animal Master! 🏆
howToPlay: Tap the screen to drop animals into the container. Try to make identical animals land on top of each other - when they match, they merge into a new, larger animal and give you points. Plan each drop carefully so the animals combine efficiently and don’t pile up too high. If the container becomes overfilled, the game will end. Use powerful bonuses to avoid losing, create bigger merges, and score even more points.

title: TANK ARENA MULTIPLAYER
description: 🔥 TANK ARENA MULTIPLAYER 🔥 Battle it out in this action-packed multiplayer tank arena! Fight against players from around the world or challenge AI bots in intense combat. ⭐ FEATURES: - Real-time Online Multiplayer (up to 4 players) - Smart AI Bots with 3 difficulty levels - Power-ups: Speed Boost, Shield, Rapid Fire - Multiple Arena Maps - Smooth Controls for Desktop & Mobile - Level Progression System 🏆 Become the ultimate tank commander! Destroy your enemies, collect power-ups, and domin
howToPlay: controls: 🖥️ Desktop (Keyboard + Mouse): ActionControl Move W A S D or Arrow Keys Aim Mouse Fire Primary Left Click Fire Secondary Right Click Ready Up (Lobby) R Pause ESC 📱 Mobile (Touch): ActionControl Move Left Joystick Aim Right Joystick Fire Auto-fire when aiming or Fire Button Ready Up Ready Button Pause Pause Button (top-right)

title: Stunsteval Siderollers
description: STUNSTEVAL SIDEROLLERS is an arcade race with a side view. Try to outrun a helicopter, a biplane or a fighter jet. Drive in the rain or on a dark highway.
howToPlay: PC control: D - forward Double-tap D to lower the gear A - back W - gear up S - gear low The control on the phone is carried out using the arrows.

title: Soccer Training
description: In Soccer Training, your aspirations in soccer become a reality as you enter the prestigious realm of the world’s top team. This sports game turns your device into a football pitch where your free-kick skills are challenged to the maximum. With 15 levels, each progressively tougher than the one before, you'll require all of your accuracy and strength to prevail.
howToPlay: Accuracy is essential in Soccer Training—focus on the corners of the goal to improve your scoring opportunities. Be mindful of moving targets—they increase your score but can be challenging! Don’t feel disheartened by shots that get blocked; instead, use them as a learning experience and modify your next attempt accordingly.

title: Money Maker
description: Money Maker is a merge game about running a banknote machine. Drop money, place power-up chips in the right spots, and let every bounce boost your income. Unlock upgrades and new chip slots to multiply profits and keep the cash flowing. How far can you scale your money machine?
howToPlay: How to play Money Maker - drag pins onto the board to increase profits. - drag one pin onto another to merge them into a higher-tier pin. - upgrade the Money Machine to raise the base banknote value and your earnings.

title: Gun and Roll
description: Roll your roller object, improve it to other shapes, press cards and improve your gun! Use it gun for shoot objects. Pick the correct doors to improve yourself in level, pass the levels!
howToPlay: Use mouse or finger to use roller object and gun. Avoid obstacles and get upgrades. Pick the correct doors.

title: Tile Match Puzzle
description: Are you a fan of match 3 and combination zen match games? Tile Match Puzzle fulfills your desire for puzzle fun with new puzzle challenges every day! Simply match three tiles to reveal even more tiles underneath. Find more combinations until you've cleared everything. But beware: If you select too many tiles without at least three matching each other, you will have to start your journey from the beginning. Each level presents you with a new addictive puzzle challenge. Take a fun and relaxing getaway as you enter beautiful new landscapes to test your brain. Game features Unique Tile Puzzles: With tiles in over 20 styles, there's no limit to the number of combinations you can make. Flex your brain muscles Test and improve your memory and pattern recognition skills with this fun and relaxing puzzle game!
howToPlay: How to play Tile Match Puzzles - Tap to place the tiles into the box. Match 3 or more of the same tiles to remove them from the puzzle board. - Remove all tiles from the board to win the level. - Beat each level as best as possible to win coins and collect them all! - Complete each level to progress through your journey. Hundreds of challenging and colorful tile matching puzzles await!

title: Lumbering At Sea
description: Set sail on an endless ocean adventure in Lumbering At Sea, a captivating 3D stickman runner with lumberjack action! Control a nimble stickman lumberjack dashing across glowing paths on tropical islands, chopping trees to harvest wood planks while racing toward distant checkpoints. The core idea is resource timing and raft-building progression—perfectly time your axe swings to collect enough lumber to construct a raft that propels you to the next island before falling into the sea or running out of momentum.
howToPlay: Your main goal is to run forward along the path, time axe swings to chop trees and automatically collect wood (guided by on-screen indicators or proximity), gather coins for upgrades, and reach the end gate or next island before falling off or losing progress. Build your raft with collected lumber to advance—survive longer runs for high scores by upgrading speed, cutting efficiency, and critical hits between attempts! PC Controls: Mouse: Click/tap (or hold/repeatedly click) to swing the axe when near trees or indicators appear. Mobile Controls: Touchscreen: Tap the screen to swing the axe and chop trees when close or prompted (follow indicators for timing).

title: Bomb Royale Online
description: Enter an explosive online battle royale inspired by classic bomber-style arcade games. Fight inside dangerous maze arenas where players compete in fast-paced multiplayer battles filled with traps, strategy, and nonstop action. Place bombs, destroy obstacles, outsmart your opponents, and survive chaotic chain reactions to become the last player standing. With unique bear characters and dynamic PvP combat, every match is a test of timing, positioning, and smart tactics.
howToPlay: Move through the maze using your controls and strategically place bombs to destroy blocks and trap enemies. Clear paths, block escape routes, and eliminate opponents with well-timed explosions. Avoid enemy blasts and stay out of chain reactions. Survive longer than everyone else to win the match and climb the leaderboard.

title: Eco Block Puzzle
description: Discover the intriguing realm of Eco Block Puzzle, where strategy and environmental healing converge. Solve complex puzzles to cleanse the planet and earn eco coins, introducing new life to the restored valley. Enjoy this unique blend of traditional puzzles and eco-friendly play on your device. Join the journey of creativity and restoration!
howToPlay: It's a classic block puzzle game with additional meta. Players should clean the environment after an ecological catastrophe. Expand cleaned land and purchase animals and lifeforms.

title: Evolution: Survival
description: A survival game where you begin as a tiny cell in the primordial soup. Collect DNA by consuming food and defeating enemies to trigger evolution and choose your mutation: speed, attack, defense, poison, regeneration, or intelligence. With each evolution, the world transforms — from open ocean to the deep sea, from shallow waters to dry land. Enemies grow stronger, elite opponents emerge, and fearsome bosses stand in your way. Combine mutations to unlock secret forms: Dragon, Leviathan, Phantom, Hive Mind, and more. Collect rare stars scattered across the map and invest them into permanent upgrades that carry over between runs. Use active abilities — dash, acid spit, death cloud, traps, and cover — to survive as long as possible. How many evolutions will you conquer?
howToPlay: Controls: - Mouse / finger — steer your creature's movement - WASD / arrow keys — alternative controls on PC - Ability buttons — displayed at the bottom of the screen (or press keys 1–5) - Spacebar — dash (if unlocked) Tips: - Don't rush strong enemies early on — build up your mutations first - Pick up enemy drops: healing, magnet, shield, explosion - Collect rare golden stars — they grant currency for permanent upgrades

title: BouncePop Quest
description: Join the adventure of BouncePop Quest, guiding Jumpo, a colorful jelly creature, through 150+ vibrant levels. Overcome obstacles, navigate moving platforms, and face challenges while collecting stars and defeating enemies. Experience exciting new worlds in this free game available for both phone and computer, delivering hours of fun!
howToPlay: Press, hold, and release to jump! With double-side jump active, tap left to jump left, right to jump right!

title: Fun Toy Pals
description: Step into a cozy playroom and explore a world full of charming toys! In this addictive merge game, your goal is to combine matching toys on the colorful carpet to create higher-level toys. Unlock achievements as you reach higher scores and compete with players around the world on the global leaderboard. Cute visuals, fun combinations, and endless merging challenges make this game perfect for casual gamers of all ages.
howToPlay: Combine toys of the same type by dragging them onto each other to create a new, higher-level toy. The more you merge, the higher your score! Complete achievements to unlock special rewards and climb the leaderboard to become the ultimate toy master. Desktop Controls: Mouse: Click and drag toys to merge them. Mobile Controls: Touch: Tap and drag toys to merge them.

title: Match Story: Weapons
description: 🔫 Match Story: Weapons takes you into an action-packed puzzle adventure! Match powerful weapons, expand your arsenal, and challenge your brain in this fun and addictive 3D puzzle game. ⏳ Solve tricky puzzles against the clock, keep your mind sharp, and become smarter with every level! 🧠 Each stage gets harder, testing your reflexes and thinking skills. ✨ Discover unique weapon models you’ve never seen before, build powerful combos, and master the art of matching! 🎯 Key Features: 🔥 Fun and addictive match-3 gameplay 🪖 Discover unique weapons never seen before ⏱️ Race against time – solve puzzles before time runs out 🎨 Colorful and eye-catching 3D graphics 🧩 Increasingly challenging puzzles and levels 🧠 Keep your brain active & boost your intelligence Merge your weapons, unlock new levels, and write your own matching story.
howToPlay: Match Story: Weapons is a fun 3-match puzzle game. Your goal is to carefully observe the weapons on the board and match 3 of the same kind. - Select weapons from the board and place them into the box. - When you get 3 identical weapons together, they will match and disappear. - Try to clear all matches before the timer runs out. - As you progress, the levels become more challenging with more weapon types and complex arrangements. Think strategically, act fast, and become the ultimate weapon master!

title: Block Sort Puzzle
description: Block Sort Puzzle is an exciting multi-colored block sorting puzzle that will test your logic and attentiveness! Sort as fast as possible to collect the highest tower, as well as to multiply your points! Nice animation of moving tiles.
howToPlay: How to play: - Drag the blocks onto the desired tile. - Put the same colors side by side to combine and score points. - When combining blocks, the multiplier of the current points increases.

title: Nullify - Merge Math
description: Nullify is a minimal abstract relaxing puzzle with the goal of clearing everything from the screen by merging numbers and math symbols. Improve your logic and math skills by completing unique handcrafted levels and infinite generated levels. Features: -56 Levels to complete -4 Infinite games modes -Simple and easy controls by dragging elements -13 math symbols
howToPlay: Nullify is a minimal abstract relaxing puzzle with the goal of clearing everything from the screen by merging numbers and math symbols. Improve your logic and math skills by completing unique handcrafted levels and infinite generated levels. Click and drag to move the symbols and merge them to clear everything from the screen.

title: Noobik Arena - 99 nights
description: Noobik Arena - 99 nights is a fast 3D survival arena where the hero fights waves of monsters, collects coins and experience, unlocks upgrades, and improves weapons. Between waves, you can build defenses: place turrets, fences, and barracks, select buildings with a click, and upgrade their stats. Survive as long as possible by combining weapons, grenades, dashes, perks, and defensive structures against increasingly dangerous enemies.
howToPlay: On desktop: WASD or arrow keys — move. Mouse — aim. Left mouse button — shoot. Space or Shift — dash. Q — switch weapon. G — throw a grenade. In the shop, click upgrade cards to improve your hero and weapons. During the building phase, choose a turret, fence, or barracks, then click the arena to place it. Click an existing building to select it, view its stats, and open building upgrades. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick and the buttons for shooting, dashing, switching weapons, and throwing grenades.

title: Quick Draw Cowboys
description: Quick Draw Cowboys is a fast reaction western duel game where every shot depends on timing, focus, and reading the cue before your opponent does. Play solo through escalating cowboy duels, unlock new guns and characters, or jump into online PvP matchmaking for real-time showdowns against other players. The game mixes simple one-touch controls with tense, skill-based duels, power-up shots, upgrades, rewards, and multiplayer cowboy battles.
howToPlay: Become the fastest cowboy in the duel. Watch the screen carefully, wait for the draw cue, then choose the correct direction before your opponent does. Win duels to earn coins, unlock stronger guns and new cowboys, and survive tougher enemies. You can also enter Online PvP to match with another player in a real-time quick draw battle. Desktop Controls: W: Shoot upward. S: Shoot downward. A: Shoot left. D: Shoot right. Local PvP Controls: Player 1 uses W/A/S/D. Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys. Enter / Spacebar: Confirm or continue on some screens. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Direction Buttons: Tap the matching arrow direction when the duel cue appears. Menu Buttons: Tap to choose Campaign, Local PvP, Online PvP, Shop, and upgrades.

title: Flag Learn
description: Flag Learn is a geography quiz game that helps you truly memorize every flag, capital, and US state — not just guess them. A smart spaced-repetition system tracks each flag you've seen and brings back the ones you struggle with until you master them all. Beyond the learning mode, you'll find a whole collection of challenges: Daily Flagle, Paint the Flag, Border Guess, timed Highscore speedruns with a global leaderboard, and real-time PvP battles against friends. Clean night-sky design, satisfying progress tracking, and quick rounds make it perfect for both short sessions and serious learning.
howToPlay: Learn and master all world flags, US states, and capitals. A flag appears — type its name and confirm. Answer correctly 3 times in a row to master a flag and add it to your collection. Mistakes cost a life; lives refill over time or by watching a short ad. Master the full collection to become a true Flag Master! Try the Challenges: guess the daily flag in Daily Flagle, identify blurred flags in Blur Mode, color flags in Paint the Flag, recognize countries by their outline in Border Guess, race the clock in Highscore speedruns, or battle friends in real-time PvP. Desktop Controls: Keyboard: Type the country, state, or capital name. Enter: Submit your answer. Mouse: Navigate menus, select modes, and pick colors in Paint the Flag. Mobile Controls: Tap: Navigate menus and select answers. On-Screen Keyboard: Type your answer, then tap Check.

title: Subby Quest
description: Welcome to a world swallowed by darkness. An underwater cave stretches endlessly before you, full of mystery, danger, and things you never expected to find. Explore it, survive it, and uncover what lies beneath. Coins are scattered all across the deep. Grab them and spend them wisely, whether that's growing your submarine fleet or loading up on boosts to push through the toughest moments the cave throws at you. And keep your eyes open. Rare gems are hiding in places most players never reach. Finding them is the real challenge. The cave doesn't care how far you've come. It just keeps going. Will you?
howToPlay: Pick your submarine and step into the shoes of a fearless marine. The underwater cave is vast and unforgiving, so stay sharp, trust your reflexes, dodge obstacles, grab every coin you spot, and hunt down the rarest minerals hiding in the deep. The best marines don't just survive, they explore every corner and leave nothing behind. Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow) or W: Move upward. ↓ (Down Arrow) or S: Move downward. ← (Left Arrow) or A: Move left. → (Right Arrow) or D: Move right. 1: trigger boost 1 2: trigger boost 2 3: trigger boost 3 Mobile Controls: • On-Screen Joystick: Drag to move in all directions • Boost Buttons: Tap to activate your boosts

title: Miner Jam
description: Miner Jam is a fun puzzle game where you strategically use colored axes to break boxes and advance through levels. Play online for free and enjoy vibrant gameplay. Unlock rewards and enhance your skills as you challenge yourself across iOS, Android, or desktop platforms.
howToPlay: In Miner Jam you should click or tap to match the pickaxes. Match the colors with the ores and mine them!

title: Mage Adventure: Mighty Raid
description: The game is simple but addictive: just aim and throw projectiles at enemies to clear wave after wave. As you progress, you'll unlock a variety of projectiles—each with its own unique twist.
howToPlay: Tap on the screen to set per direction for projectiles. Unlock new ones and enjoy the new possibilities!

title: Wednesday’s Battle: Monster Symphony
description: An endless action game that fuels the urge to try again after every defeat, keeping you hooked for ‘just one more round.’ Built around the popular Wednesday theme, it features various enemy types, gradual difficulty escalation, and smooth, satisfying animations that make each battle feel rewarding.
howToPlay: Use the arrow on your keyboard to switch lines for the direction of the shot. Mobile control - tap on the right and left side of the screen to switch.

title: Hoppy Stacky
description: A charming and captivating infinite game, Hoppy Stacky will keep players occupied for many hours! In this vibrant world, your mission is to help the main character build a sky-high tower out of flying logs (sliders). Think of that as straightforward? Just give it a try! The game will constantly put your reflexes to the test as the sliders appear completely at random: they vary in size, come from unexpected directions, and move at unpredictable speeds. Just one second of distraction and your tower could collapse. Do you have the agility and sharp timing to conquer the highest peak? Jump into Hoppy Stacky and prove your skills now!
howToPlay: The gameplay of Hoppy Stacky is easy to learn but incredibly hard to master. Here is how you can start stacking: - Observe Carefully: Keep a close eye on the incoming logs (sliders). They will fly in from the left or right with different sizes and at varying speeds. - Tap to Jump: Time it perfectly and tap the screen (or click your mouse) to make your character jump. - Land Accurately: Your ultimate goal is to safely land on top of the incoming log. Every successful landing adds a new layer to your ever-growing tower. - Avoid Collisions: Never jump too early or too late! If a flying log hits your character or you miss the landing and fall off, it is instantly Game Over. - Break Records: Keep up the rhythm, heap the logs as high as you can to set a new Best Score, and collect coins along the way!

title: Neon Snake
description: A fast-paced arcade snake game with neon visuals, combo multipliers, power-ups, and global leaderboards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.
howToPlay: Guide your glowing snake across a dark grid, eating orbs to grow and rack up points. Chain quick eats to build combo multipliers up to ×8 — but one wrong move and it's over. Grab speed boosts for high-risk high-reward runs, slow orbs for breathing room, and rare bonus stars for massive point spikes. Compete on global leaderboards across all-time and weekly rankings.

title: 99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads
description: 99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads - Defeat monsters and rescue lost children! What's in the game: 30 levels with various monsters from the forest! The ability to assemble a squad of different characters with unique abilities! Level up your characters and improve their skills!
howToPlay: All actions in the game can be performed using a mouse or by touching the touch screen. Gather a team of various characters. Complete levels one by one. Upgrade your characters' abilities using rubies!

title: FatBoy Dream
description: Join an exciting adventure in **FatBoy Dream** as a playful child hops between donuts, gathering delicious treats. This engaging online game promises a sugar-coated thrill for sweet enthusiasts, challenging you to leap higher without falling. Ideal for those seeking fun and excitement on **mobile and desktop** devices.
howToPlay: Click or tap to jump.

title: Square Sort
description: The game involves swiping colorful cubes in any direction to clear the board. The objective is to sort the squares by color, and the game gets progressively harder with each level. The user interface is simple and easy to use, with visually appealing graphics that are pleasing to the eye. The game has a relaxing soundtrack that complements its challenging gameplay. Square Sort offers a great way to exercise your brain while having fun, and it's perfect for those who enjoy puzzle games. The game is free to download and play, with no in-app purchases or ads to interrupt the gameplay.
howToPlay: Swipe to Move: Swipe the colorful cubes in any direction to move them across the board. Match Colors: Align cubes of the same color in a row or column to clear them from the board. Limited Moves: Each level has a set number of moves. Plan your swipes carefully to maximize efficiency. Progressive Difficulty: As you advance through levels, the complexity increases with more colors and larger grids.

title: Capybara Let's Go: Zombie Rush
description: Welcome to a relaxing casual game that combines merge gameplay and strategic auto battles! Start your journey with a group of adorable pets. Drag and place them on the battlefield, and merge two pets of the same level to get stronger upgraded ones. You can refresh the pet pool to get new companions and plan your layout carefully to make the most of limited space. Once your team is ready, start the battle! All pets will attack enemies automatically. As you clear foes, your team will level up and unlock random powerful skills, including damage boost, critical strike, healing and area attacks. Choose skills wisely to build your unique team. Advance through dozens of regular stages, challenge tough Boss levels and explore surprise bonus stages for rich rewards. Collect more styles of cute pets, raise and star them up to unlock greater power. Easy to pick up, fun to master! Experience endless joy with pet merging, strategic layout and exciting battles right now!
howToPlay: 1. Basic Setup & Controls Start a Battle: Tap/click the "Start" button to begin a new wave Deploy Capybaras: Drag and drop capybaras from your squad menu to the battlefield grid Activate Skills: Tap/click on a deployed capybara to use its special ability (when the skill bar is full) Upgrade Units: Merge two identical capybaras of the same level to create a more powerful version Pause Game: Tap/click the pause button in the top-right corner to adjust settings or take a break 2. Battle Mechanics Wave System: Enemies attack in increasing difficulty waves. Each wave introduces new enemy types with unique abilities Health System: Your camp has a base health (starts at 100). If enemies reach your camp, they'll reduce your health—game over when health reaches 0 Gold Collection: Defeat enemies to earn gold, which you can use to: Unlock new capybara units (10+ unique types available) Upgrade existing units' stats (attack, defense, speed) Purchase temporary battle buffs (damage boost, health regeneration) Energy Management: Skills require energy to use. Energy recharges over time or by defeating special enemies

title: Blocky Set - 3d brick constructions
description: A 3D emulator of real-life brick-building games, where you are presented with a complete model and must reproduce it by placing the pieces in the correct location. Enjoy!
howToPlay: Mouse to drag and drop blockys, and interacting with UI buttons A, W, S, D moves camera R rotates blockys

title: Pongoal
description: PONGOAL is an exciting fusion of classic Pong and high-stakes football action! Experience the timeless paddle gameplay you love, reimagined with the energy and intensity of a penalty shootout. Defend your goal, outsmart your opponent, and score spectacular goals in this fast-paced arcade sports challenge. Battle against intelligent AI opponents across three difficulty levels, or challenge a friend in local multiplayer mode. Every match is a test of reflexes, strategy, and precision as you race to be the first to reach the winning score. With dynamic physics, responsive touch controls, and thrilling goal celebrations, PONGOAL delivers non-stop competitive fun!
howToPlay: Mobile/Touch Devices: Tap the UP button to move your paddle upward Tap the DOWN button to move your paddle downward Hold buttons for continuous movement Desktop/Keyboard: Press UP ARROW or W to move paddle up Press DOWN ARROW or S to move paddle down

title: King of pirate
description: Try yourself as a brave pirate, able to repel the attack of enemy zombies! 🧟 Show dexterity and attentiveness!
howToPlay: Tap on the left half of the screen to move and attack to the left. ⬅️ Tap on the right half of the screen to move and attack to the right. ➡️

title: Prásino
description: Prásino is a small survival game set in a world drowned in trash. Your only lifeline is the trees - without them, there’s no air to breathe. Plant magic seeds to grow trees, restore barren zones, and carve a path forward. But stay alert, trash-born enemies lurk everywhere, ready to stop you.
howToPlay: Beware of enemies and collect magic seeds to plant trees. Manage your breath wisely, it’s your lifeline. Desktop Controls: ↑ (Up Arrow): Move Up ↓ (Down Arrow): Move Down ← (Left Arrow): Move Left → (Right Arrow): Move Right Z: Plant a Tree X: Attack / Break Loot Boxes Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Drag to move in any direction Plant Button: Tap to plant a tree Attack Button: Tap to attack enemies or break loot boxes

title: Colors&Forms
description: Colors&Forms is a thrilling online game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Enjoy a variety of entertaining puzzles and colorful designs without any downloads. With different game modes available, you’ll find countless challenges to complete as you progress through the levels.
howToPlay: The control is simple - move the pieces at the bottom of the tracks to match the falling elements and complete the missions on each level. Before the game, choose the appropriate game mode by speed. Be careful, there may be objects on the screen that you need to interact with by clicking on them. To switch the type of game, use the button with the image of a castle. Change the language, disable music and sound effects in the game settings.

title: Logic Islands
description: A logic puzzle game inspired by Nurikabe and Islands of Insight. Create islands with exact numbers while keeping walls connected. Navigate through 6 unique worlds with different rulesets - from Classic Nurikabe to advanced mechanics like Yin-Yang connectivity. Each world introduces new challenges with ice blocks, one-way arrows, and special orb mechanics across 240 hand-picked puzzles.
howToPlay: On PC: Click to toggle cells between island/wall. Double-click or Ctrl+click to fill connected areas. Mouse wheel or Space to switch draw modes. Z to undo, R to restart. On mobile: Tap to toggle. Double-tap to fill areas.

title: Magic Potion School For Witch
description: Magic Potion School for Witch is an enchanting match-3 puzzle game where young witches cast spells with a wand to connect and pop numbered magical bubbles and shapes like triangles and squares in a bubbling cauldron, mastering potion brewing through increasingly challenging levels in a whimsical wizarding academy.
howToPlay: Brew Magical Potions! Enroll in Magic Potion School for Witch, the enchanting puzzle adventure where you play as a young witch wielding a magic wand to cast spells as bouncing balls that strike and reduce numbered magical bubbles and shapes in a bubbling cauldron. Clear all enchantments before time runs out to brew potions successfully and conquer challenging levels in wizarding school! Desktop Controls: Mouse: Aim with the wand using the mouse, click to cast spell and launch magic ball. Mobile Controls: Touch: Drag to aim the wand, tap to cast spell and launch magic ball.

title: Nexusorbiter
description: Single-finger orbital-defense arcade. Your drone orbits a fragile space station and auto-fires at incoming hazards — tap to flip the orbit direction, that's your only control. Each stage layers in new threats: glue bombs you must shoot at range, homing suicide drones you can't miss, EMP drones that silence your auto-fire on contact, healing orbiters that protect bosses. Six upgrade tracks shape your build. 30+ stages, multi-boss waves, plus a fresh daily challenge for bonus scrap every day.
howToPlay: Click/Tap anywhere, to turn orbiting direction, satellite only fires at closeby asteroids. Click on rocket button to use consumable rockets. Click on upgrade buttons to upgrade your satellite.

title: Mystery Digger
description: Join the exciting journey of **Mystery Digger**, an addictive idle clicker game. Explore underground for treasures and stories. Upgrade your drill with each click to uncover fascinating finds. Enjoy this calming game on any device and satisfy your curiosity with every discovery.
howToPlay: Keyboard: Control is carried out by pressing buttons on the screen. Mobile: Control is carried out by pressing buttons on the screen.

title: Drone Dash - Time Challenges!
description: **How to Play** Welcome to **Drone Dash - Time Challenges** – a fast-paced arcade puzzler where quick thinking and precision bouncing are the keys to victory! You’ll control a zippy little drone that *dashes* between walls and platforms like a high-tech pinball. But this isn’t your typical platformer – no jumping, no gravity drops. Your drone glides and ricochets from surface to surface, smoothly darting through tight spaces full of traps and twists. Your mission? **Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out!** The more you grab, the more stars you’ll earn (up to 3 per level). Once you collect the minimum required, a glowing crystal spawns back at your starting point – reach it to complete the level. But watch out! Hit a trap or run out of time, and it's back to the start. Levels are short, intense, and packed with surprises. New traps and tricky tiles will keep you on your toes as you dash your way to perfection. Fast reflexes and smart movement make all the difference! **Controls:** 🖱️ On PC: Just click to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice! 📱 On Mobile: Just tap to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice! Ready to test your reflexes and g…
howToPlay: **How to Play** Welcome to **Drone Dash - Time Challenges** – a fast-paced arcade puzzler where quick thinking and precision bouncing are the keys to victory! You’ll control a zippy little drone that *dashes* between walls and platforms like a high-tech pinball. But this isn’t your typical platformer – no jumping, no gravity drops. Your drone glides and ricochets from surface to surface, smoothly darting through tight spaces full of traps and twists. Your mission? **Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out!** The more you grab, the more stars you’ll earn (up to 3 per level). Once you collect the minimum required, a glowing crystal spawns back at your starting point – reach it to complete the level. But watch out! Hit a trap or run out of time, and it's back to the start. Levels are short, intense, and packed with surprises. New traps and tricky tiles will keep you on your toes as you dash your way to perfection. Ready to test your reflexes and g…

title: TANKNAROK
description: Step into the explosive world of TANKNAROK, the definitive top-down multiplayer arena shooter built for intense, quick-fire web combat. Forget long downloads and complex setups—this is pure, competitive chaos delivered straight to your browser. If you love fast-paced action, dynamic destruction, and competitive gameplay, TANKNAROK is your next addiction.
howToPlay: Movement, WASD ,"Steer and move your tank forward, backward, left, and right." Aiming,Mouse,(Aim your turret 360 degrees around your tank.) Fire Weapon,Left Mouse Button (LMB),Fire your current weapon. Pause Game / Menu,Escape (Esc),Open the game menu or pause the action (Note: The SDK might pause the game automatically when you lose browse WARNING -- IN YOU JOIN LOBBY PRESS R TO READY AND START THE GAME IN SINGLE OF MULTIPLAYER MODE AND IF HOST MODE NOT WORK PLAY WITH SHARED MODE

title: Bounce TD
description: Welcome to Bounce TD — a unique fusion of classic Tower Defense strategy and addictive physics-based puzzles! Are you ready to test your precision and tactical thinking? In this game, your mission is to protect your base from endless waves of enemies. But there’s a twist: your towers only activate when hit by a special energy ball. Calculate the trajectory, use the ricochet, and create deadly chain reactions!
howToPlay: Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls that hide deep tactical depth. Hundreds of Levels: Increasing difficulty with new challenges at every stage. Are you ready to test your precision and tactical thinking? In this game, your mission is to protect your base from endless waves of enemies. But there’s a twist: your towers only activate when hit by a special energy ball. Calculate the trajectory, use the ricochet, and create deadly chain reactions! Only Mouse or Touch!

title: Blind Box Master
description: Blind Box Master is a cozy, hand-drawn blind box collection game. Open mystery boxes and discover 100 adorable collectibles across 6 rarities and 5 conditions (Broken to Mint). Features: • 4 box tiers, Lucky Charm upgrades & Legendary chases • 20 cute themed series to collect • Daily & weekly tasks, achievements, card-flip mini game • Sell, haggle, synthesize 3 items into higher rarity • Idle income & showcase your best finds Tap to play. Desktop & mobile.
howToPlay: Tap or click to play. Pick a box on the desk, buy and open it to discover cute collectible items of different rarities and conditions. Sell duplicates for coins, complete daily tasks and achievements, upgrade your luck and idle income, synthesize items, and collect all 100 collectibles. Controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps.

title: Find Visitors - 99 Nights
description: Find Visitors - 99 Nights - is an atmospheric game where you take on the role of the manager of a forest refuge. Let the forest creatures in and drive away the visitors. Check for signs and identify hidden monsters – the visitors!
howToPlay: All game actions can be customized using the mouse or a finger. The game has a "Rules" button—it's recommended to constantly review it for a better gaming experience. Brief rules: welcome forest dwellers into your hand and drive away visitors. Signs of a visitor include perfectly white teeth, blood on the teeth, a red white eye, a rapidly moving pupil, a red spot on the aura photo, and lack of movement.

title: Hook Arena 3D
description: Hook Arena is an action-packed game where you battle the opponents on opposite sides of a river using unique hook weapons. Your objective is to hook enemies to eliminate them one by one, pull in beneficial rune bottles, or escape by hooking yourself to a physical support like a pole. Before the match, you can choose your team's color, upgrade your character, and change their skin and weapon. In the treasure menu, you can hack and open chests with both a chest and a key. Who knows what secrets they hold, but all items will be placed in your inventory. Fight in matches, earn trophies, and climb the leaderboard rankings. Good luck in the battle!
howToPlay: PC Controls WASD / arrow keys = move Space / Left-click = throw hook Right-click = shift (escape skill) Move mouse = aim Mobile Controls Left half-screen joystick = move Right half-screen joystick = aim Hook button = throw hook Shift button = shift (escape skill)

title: Go! Up! Samurai
description: Go! Up! Samurai offers an action-packed HTML5 gaming experience. Dive into a vibrant samurai realm, where quick reflexes and smart tactics are essential. Players must skillfully maneuver through various challenges and foes, emphasizing accuracy and ability.
howToPlay: A, D (Left and Right Arrows) - Walking W (Up Arrow) - Jump S (Down Arrow) - Kick Shift - Jump R - Restart Esc - Exit

title: Toytopia
description: Toytopia is a cozy merge game where you are tasked to combine and produce art materials which you can use to fix broken toys. Each toy presents a unique challenge and difficulty.
howToPlay: In Toytopia, you simply need to fix the broken parts of a toy by merging art items to produce the required art materials. Use the mouse cursor (desktop) or finger (mobile) to drag and drop items on the board.

title: Bubble Stars boxes: Sirius & Najia
description: 104 characters and 1037 skins are waiting for you! 🎁 Loot & luck Open boxes and starr drops Unlock fighters and build your collection ⚔️ Action & progress Play tons of game modes Win battles and earn trophies 🏆 🌟 Events & season Complete events with challenges Level up the season pass and claim rewards 🔥 Ready? Open. Collect. Win. How far can you go?
howToPlay: Your goal is to open boxes, get new characters and skins, and complete events. You can upgrade your characters and tap on them, change backgrounds in the item shop, and earn trophies for victories.

title: Bus Jam: Pick up them all!
description: Bus Jam is an addictive traffic puzzle game where you navigate through a parking jam! Experience the rush of traffic mania as you strategically move cars out of the way to help your bus escape. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts who love traffic escape challenges!
howToPlay: The goal of Bus Jam is to help the bus escape the parking jam. To do this, you need to move the other vehicles out of the way. The colorful buses will pick up the same color passengers. Let's help all bus pick up all passengers. Desktop Controls: Click: click on the bus select that bus in the slot to pick up passengers. Mobile Controls: Tap: tap on the bus select that bus in the slot to pick up passengers.

title: Hex Mine 3D
description: Hex Mine 3D is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where every move matters. Explore beautiful spherical hex worlds, clear the correct tiles, and solve carefully designed levels with logic, focus, and precision. Each level presents a unique hex-tile pattern wrapped around a 3D globe. Your goal is simple: analyze the board, make smart choices, and complete the puzzle without mistakes. As levels progress, the layouts become more challenging with larger patterns, trickier tile placement, and deeper strategy. Rotate, inspect, and solve each hex puzzle at your own pace. Easy to understand, satisfying to play, and challenging to master. Features Unique 3D hex puzzle gameplay Beautiful globe-style puzzle boards Carefully designed level-based progression Simple controls and clean visual style Increasing difficulty across many handcrafted levels Relaxing but brain-teasing puzzle experience Perfect for short play sessions or focused puzzle solving
howToPlay: How to Play Rotate the hex globe, study the tile layout, and choose your moves carefully. Clear the correct hex tiles to complete each level. Think ahead, avoid mistakes, and master every pattern.

title: Noob Slingshot: Monsters
description: Meet Noob, a clumsy hero you load straight into a slingshot. Pull back the band, follow the dotted aiming line, and launch him at the block towers where cartoon monsters hide. Every level is a small physics puzzle built from glass, wood, stone, and TNT. Glass shatters at a touch, wood needs a solid hit, and stone takes two hits before it falls. Each broken block scores points, so a clean shot and a big collapse both pay off, and your shots are limited. TNT crates start chain reactions that can fold half a tower in one hit, but blow them at the wrong moment and the last monster stays safe behind cover. Bonus cards hidden in the levels give extra shots when you need another try, turning each stage into a mix of arcade action and light puzzle planning. Clear levels to earn coins, then spend them back in the main menu to build and grow Noob's house, a steady goal between the tower-smashing stages. Features: - Physics slingshot arcade with simple one-finger aiming - Dotted trajectory preview for planning every shot - Breakable glass, wood, and stone blocks with different durability - TNT crates for chain reactions and huge collapses - Points for broken blocks and efficient shots - Bonu…
howToPlay: Aim, shoot the slingshot, wreck the monsters' shelters and clear level after level. Every level is a new destruction puzzle: find the tower's weak spot and topple it with a single well-aimed shot. How many stars can you earn?

title: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training
description: Challenge your memory, speed and attention in "Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training". Watch boxes appear, remember the count, then submit your guess faster and more accurate each round wins. Enjoy single-player focus mode or competitive rounds vs local friend or multiplayer. Simple tap controls, short rounds, addictive replayability perfect for quick brain workouts on desktop and mobile. Train memory, logic, agility and reaction time now!
howToPlay: Watch a set of boxes appear briefly and memorize the total. When they vanish, tap to increase your guess or type the number, then press Done. Single-player: beat your time and accuracy. Multiplayer/local: play 20 rounds highest accuracy wins. Simple taps, short rounds, perfect for training memory, attention and reaction on desktop & mobile.

title: Tick-Tack-What?
description: Think you have mastered Tic-Tac-Toe? Think again! In this mind-bending twist on the classic game, you are playing against an AI opponent that absolutely refuses to play by the rules. As you progress through increasingly complex and irregular board shapes, the bot will use an arsenal of dirty tricks to stop you from winning. From erasing your precious X's and locking cells, to literally dropping bombs on the board and faking its own victories! You'll need to stay one step ahead of its gravity-shifting, glitching, and rule-breaking mechanics. Can you outsmart a machine that constantly cheats? Test your logic, adapt to unpredictable board mutations, and prove that human ingenuity can beat an unfair AI!
howToPlay: Simply click on any active cell to place your X, and try to form a line of three—but watch out as the cheating AI uses unexpected tricks and twists to disrupt your strategy!

title: Kitty Kitty
description: Kitty Kitty is a charming casual idle simulation game where players nurture and level up adorable kawaii cats in a festive snowy winter wonderland, collecting cat food as the core idle resource (with passive production like +50/s) to raise stats such as Sweetness and unlock new features via daily check-ins and challenges. Its unique appeal lies in the heartwarming blend of cozy cat-collection mechanics, customizable habitats (Toy Room, food bowls, Kitty Wiki, and recycling), and seasonal Christmas charm with Santa-hatted felines, decorated trees, and snowmen—all presented in vibrant, playful 2D art that emphasizes relaxed, feel-good feline care over competitive gameplay.
howToPlay: Become a Kitty Guardian! Step into the shoes of a loving cat caretaker and nurture adorable kawaii cats in a festive snowy winter wonderland. In this charming casual idle simulation game, you’ll collect cat food as the core idle resource (with passive production like +50/s) to level up your felines, raise their Sweetness stat, and unlock new features via daily check-ins and challenges. Manage cozy habitats, complete tasks, and show them who’s the best cat parent by building the ultimate heartwarming feline paradise! Desktop Controls: Left Mouse Button: Collect cat food and interact with cats or resource icons. Click on CheckIn icon: Claim daily rewards. Click on Challenges icon: Complete tasks and unlock features. Click on bottom icons: Access Toy Room, food bowl, Kitty Wiki, or Recycle. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Tap: Collect cat food and interact with all elements by tapping the screen. Tap Button: Tap CheckIn or Challenges for daily rewards and tasks. Tap Bottom Icons: Tap to open Toy Room, feed cats, view Kitty Wiki, or use Recycle.

title: Egging On
description: A fragile egg begins a dangerous journey toward the sky. The world around you is unstable — steep slopes, sharp edges, and tricky obstacles that can crack your shell at any moment. Master the physics of movement as you balance, tilt, and jump your way upward. Each level introduces new challenges, from simple inclines to complex platforms that require precision, timing, and steady control. Unlock a variety of fun and epic egg skins as you progress and turn your climb into a unique adventure. With realistic physics, challenging gameplay, and a colorful visual style, every move matters. Can you keep your balance, climb higher and higher, and reach the stars without cracking?
howToPlay: Control a fragile egg and guide it through challenging platforms by balancing, tilting, and jumping your way upward. Use movement and momentum carefully to overcome obstacles and avoid falling or breaking your shell. Precision and timing are key to mastering each level. Controls: • W / A / S / D — Move the egg forward, backward, left, and right • Space — Jump • P — Pause the game Use tilt and inertia to find the perfect angle for jumps, maintain balance on difficult surfaces, and carefully control your movement to reach the top.

title: Spinner Clicker 2D
description: Spinner Clikcer 2D is an engaging progression-based game featuring a roster of 34 uniquely designed 2D fidget spinner models categorized across four distinct rarities, where players master 3 core gameplay mechanics: the Idle & Upgrades system to manually spin and permanently boost stats, the Collection system to unlock visually striking new spinners, and challenging Battle Encounters where players put their momentum and upgraded configurations to the test against scaling bosses.
howToPlay: Browser/PC: Simply click (Left Mouse Button) on the fidget spinner repeatedly to generate spinning momentum. Use your mouse to navigate menus and purchase upgrades. Mobile: Tap repeatedly directly on the fidget spinner to rack up speed and coins. Tap on the UI buttons to upgrade stats and collect rewards.

title: Raised Knight
description: Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test! Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls!
howToPlay: Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test! Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls! [A] / [D] → Move: Use [A] and [D] to move left or right. Dodge obstacles, take advantage of openings, and be prepared for any challenge that comes your way. Your agility is key! [Space] → Jump / Float: Hold down the [Space] key to jump or float. Jump over obstacles or float in the air to avoid dangers that cross your path. Air control can be the difference between success and failure! [Ctrl] → Slide: Use [Ctrl] to slide under obstacles and save yourself from critical situations. Slide quickly to pass under low obstacles and keep advancing without missing a beat.

title: Ghost Guard
description: Shoot all ghosts before they reach you! Use arrow keys on PC, or tap on screen quadrants on mobile. Be careful, as some ghost will change directions!
howToPlay: Use arrow keys on PC, or tap on screen quadrants on mobile.

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle is a vibrant multiplayer party shooter that blends competition, speed, and pure joy. The core philosophy centers on "fast-paced chaotic fun," combining adorable mini-characters with intense firefights. Players face off in colorful miniature arenas, using the terrain and randomized weapon drops to outsmart opponents. What makes it stand out is its minimalist controls and high-energy gameplay, delivering an adrenaline-pumping shooting experience in bite-sized sessions, whether playing solo or against friends.
howToPlay: Become the ultimate sharpshooter of the party! In this chaotic showdown, your main goal is to maneuver skillfully and shoot accurately to eliminate all opponents while staying safe. The player who survives until the end or secures the highest kill count within the time limit wins. Keep an eye out for special weapon spawns—they are your key to turning the tide of battle! PC Controls: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys: Move your character in all directions. Left Mouse Click / Spacebar: Fire your weapon. Shift: Dash or boost speed. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Drag the left joystick to move. Fire Button: Tap the shoot icon on the right to attack. Boost Button: Tap to gain a temporary speed burst.

title: Mega Car Stunts
description: A high-intensity driving game where every track becomes a test of skill, speed, and control. Perform daring jumps, fly off massive ramps, survive dangerous obstacles, and push your car to the limit in extreme stunt challenges. It is not just about racing fast — every course demands precision, timing, and the ability to stay in control under pressure. Earn money by completing events, unlock new vehicles, and expand your collection with even more powerful cars. With varied modes, challenging tracks, and physics-based crashes, each run offers a new adrenaline-filled experience.
howToPlay: Drive through stunt-filled tracks, avoid hazards, perform jumps, and reach the finish while keeping control of your vehicle. Complete challenges to earn rewards, unlock new cars, and improve your performance in increasingly difficult events. Master each course, react quickly to obstacles, and prove yourself in a world of extreme driving challenges.

title: Pim Path
description: Reach the trophy at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem. You can't fall off the platforms; spikes and blades will be everywhere, making the levels more challenging. One wrong step and it's game over. You'll need to stay calm, pay attention, be agile, have good reflexes, and most importantly, don't get angry.
howToPlay: Objective: Reach the trophy at the end of the level. Complete all the levels. PC Controls: WASD or Arrow Keys – Character Movement Space – Jump Mobile Controls: On-screen buttons.

title: Dark City. Multiplayer
description: Dark City. Multiplayer is an online open-world horror game where players are divided into two factions: police and bandits, fighting for control over an abandoned city consumed by darkness. The world is alive and shared among all players — every step could lead to a confrontation with an enemy... or something far worse. The police try to restore order, protect survivors, and reclaim captured territories. The bandits aim to establish their rule by taking over zones, setting ambushes, and hiding in the shadows. Capture areas, hold control, fend off enemy attacks… and survive the horror slowly awakening in the depths of the city.
howToPlay: WASD – Move Space – Jump Enter – Game Chat E – Inventory After starting the game, join the bandit or police faction and capture as many districts as possible. Every 30 seconds, you will receive money for the districts you control.

title: Ragdoll Playground: Break Him
description: Welcome to Ragdoll Playground: Break Him! Control a ragdoll, smash it into dangerous traps, and score points. Crash into walls, jump into spikes, and fly across the arena! Place traps with your mouse to cause maximum damage. The more damage your ragdoll takes, the more traps you unlock!
howToPlay: PC: Use the mouse to place traps and control the character. Left-click to perform actions. Mobile: Use your fingers on the screen.

title: Zombie Derby 2
description: Zombie Derby 2 is a fast and fun driving game with zombies everywhere. Get in your car, run over the undead, and try to survive as long as you can. Use your fuel wisely - if you run out, the zombies will catch you. Collect upgrades, unlock new cars, and use nitro boosts to jump over hills and smash through big groups of zombies.
howToPlay: Accelerate - W/Arrow up Shoot gun - Spacebar Use nitro - Left Shift/N Tilt forward/backward - Left/Right arrow or A/D

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an intense zombie shooting survival game set in a post-apocalyptic city overrun by the undead. You play as one of the last survivors, armed with powerful weapons to fight endless waves of zombies. Combining action shooting, survival gameplay, and strategic movement, the game delivers thrilling combat and nonstop excitement. A glowing ring of colored segments spins at the center of the screen while colored dots rush inward toward a fixed gate at the top. There are no second chances — just you, your reflexes, and the next dot closing in. What makes Color Match Rush so addictive is how the pressure ramps up. You start with four colors and a calm pace, but

description: Craftsman Land – build your own farm and help the town recover! Craftsman Land is a farming and crafting game where your goal is to rebuild the inherited land, expand your farm, and support the local community. After a devastating flood, the town is in ruins. As the heir to the land, it’s up to you to restore your farm, help the townsfolk, and bring life back to the surrounding villages. Grow crops like corn and onions, go fishing, and construct new buildings such as a house, chicken coop, and cowshed. Inside your home, you can decorate and design the interior to your liking. Take care of your animals – feed chickens and cows, collect fresh eggs and milk, and use them for crafting or trading. Complete quests for local people, trade with merchants, and produce a wide variety of items thanks to the crafting system. Improve your skills, specialize in your favorite activities, and become a true master craftsman. The world of Craftsman Land is constantly growing with new places, tasks, and adventures waiting to be discovered
howToPlay: In Craftsman Land, playing is simple and intuitive. On mobile devices you tap the screen, while on PC you use the mouse. Actions are performed automatically – all you need are the required items and resources. With just a click, you can trigger different activities such as building houses, crafting tools, or producing goods. Complete quests given by townsfolk to earn rewards and progress in the story. title: Kinetic Puzzle
description: Kinetic Puzzle is a block and grid puzzle brain teaser. Blocks slide with momentum until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Drag them out through edge portals — but only if the order, direction, and dependencies line up. Master four block types: - Red simple — slides any direction, exits any portal. - Yellow constrained — only moves and exits in its arrow direction. - Blue dependent — locked until its prerequisite block leaves the board. - Gray obstacle — fixed walls that block momentum. Features: - 50++ hand-crafted levels, ramping from gentle slides to multi-step dependency chains - Slide momentum mechanics — every push counts - Neo-brutalism art style with chunky tiles and tactile feedback - No timers, no ads mid-puzzle - Auto-save progress, undo, and hint support - Plays great on mobile, tablet, and desktop - Perfect for puzzle fans who like to think before they move.
howToPlay: Goal Remove every red, yellow, and blue block from the board through the orange edge portals. Gray obstacle blocks stay where they are. Movement rule Blocks slide with momentum: they keep going in the swiped direction until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. To exit, line a block up with a portal and slide toward it. Desktop controls - Mouse swipe: click and drag a block in a cardinal direction (up / down / left / right), then release. The block slides until it hits something. - Drag-to-exit: drag a block past the board edge through an aligned portal to remove it. - Undo / Hint / Restart / Pause: bottom and top HUD buttons. Mobile / touch controls - Swipe: touch a block, swipe in a cardinal direction, release. Same momentum rule applies. - Drag-to-exit: hold a block and drag it past the edge through a portal to remove. - Tap: HUD buttons (undo, hint, restart, pause) all tap-friendly.
