Progress in battles directly supports farm development, creating a strong connection between combat and long term progression.
howToPlay: Craft weapons, fight monsters and enemy players, safeguard your clan temple and storm enemy castle. Destroy enemy clan temple to achieve victory in battle! Controls: W: move towards mouse pointer. S: move backwards from mouse pointer. A: strafe left. D: strafe right. Left Mouse Button: attack/gather. Right Mouse Button: automatically attack. Space: jump/dash.

title: Power ball soccer
description: Top down soccer game with special moves, 2 game modes, 16 characters, 32 levels. Unlock new characters. the next opponents are stronger than the previous ones.
howToPlay: Jump onto the field, use awesome powers, and score goals to beat your rivals! Try Challenge Mode for tougher matches and unlock cool new characters as you play. Desktop Controls: W: Move upward. A: Move downward. S: Move left. D: Move right. E: Special ability. Mobile Controls: On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick. Special ability: Tap to activate.

title: Hand Daily
description: A daily card roguelite. Every day, the same 52-card deck deals across the world. Build five-card hands, chain joker effects, climb 5 antes, build a daily streak. Five minutes per run, one chance per day. Same hand for every player. Free, no install, no microtransactions.
howToPlay: Pick 1–5 cards from your hand to play as a poker hand. Beat the ante's target score in 4 plays — discards swap up to 5 cards. Win an ante to earn coins, then buy a joker that boosts every play after. Joker effects stack (+chips, +mult, suit/rank bonuses). Clear all 5 antes to win the day. There's also an endless mode for after you finish.

title: Cube Smash
description: Enter the exciting realm of Cube Smash, a free online game where you break colorful cubes. Use strategy to choose projectiles, earn currency for upgrades, and unlock various ammo. Prepare for greater challenges, whether you're playing on mobile or desktop!
howToPlay: The controls are intuitive: on a smartphone, use the touchscreen for aiming and shooting, while on a computer, use the mouse for precise control and selection of projectiles. Get ready for exciting battles and an engaging gameplay experience!

title: Sleepwalkers
description: Discover a magical world with Sleepwalkers, where colorful characters need your help to find their beds. Navigate challenges and avoid dangers in this free online adventure. Play on any device and unveil the secrets of this captivating fairytale realm.
howToPlay: Keyboard: - Use the WASD or arrow keys to move Mobile: - Hold down finger on screen and move it to move sleepwalkers

title: 11 Kisses
description: Join the thrilling journey of "11 Kisses," where you aid Angel-Girl and Demon-Boy in their fight for love. Solve intriguing puzzles across diverse terrains to help them overcome obstacles. Accessible on both mobile and desktop, immerse yourself in this enchanting tale of passionate reunion.
howToPlay: Build a logical path to reunite the loving couple. Strategically place objects to guide them back together!

title: Sorcerers Refuge
description: You wake up in a strange living room. There are no doors. Only whispers behind the wall and darkness in the eyes. Welcome to the Sorcerer’s Hideout, a dark adventure with elements of magic, riddles, and quests. In this confusing and dangerous place, you will find: What Awaits You Mysterious corridors, hidden rooms, and sudden traps The magic of ice, fire, transformation, and true vision Mysterious creatures, demons, and a strange Buffoon with his own motives Intense dialogues, unexpected outcomes, and choices that affect the story Battles, puzzles, and ancient Contracts made with powerful forces You are trapped by a Sorcerer who has subjugated four demons. Will you be able to escape, or will you become another soul in his collection? Core Gameplay & Story Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do? A: It's a horror game where you need to solve a mystery and fight for your life. Q: Is there a storyline in the game? A: Yes, it's very intricate, interesting, and complex. Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players? A: The storyline, atmosphere, spells, and interesting mechanics. Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different? A: There are bosse…
howToPlay: Desktop WASD = move Q = open diary H = hint C = shop TAB = inventory F = heal 1/2/3/4 = skills E or Left Mouse Button = use combat magic Mobile Swipe from the right side of the screen = character rotation Virtual joystick on the left = move Tap the icon in the center of the screen = interact with objects Tap on the menu buttons = menu navigation

title: Puzzle Candle
description: Your goal is simple: Reach the end of each level -- but getting there won't be easy. Solve tricky puzzles and master precise platforming to clear the stages. Use a variety of helpful items to turn the challenge in your favor and find clever ways to progress. Explore a total of 50 levels set in different environments, each offering new obstacles and surprises.
howToPlay: Light up the candles by solving each puzzle. Tap or click the candles and puzzle objects to interact with them. Use the available clues and arrange the candles correctly to complete each stage. Clear the level by lighting all required candles. Goal: Solve the puzzle and light every candle.

title: Clicker Knights Vs Dragons
description: Clicker Knights vs Dragons is a pixel-art idle clicker RPG where players tap for "Hero Tap DMG" while auto-attacking foes like skeletons in progressive stages across fantasy biomes, as seen in this desert Stage 4-1 with 8.81 Total DPS. Its core revolves around addictive hero team-building and upgrades for exponential scaling against monsters and dragons, uniquely blending simple taps with spellcasting, offline progression, and epic boss raids for boundless medieval fantasy adventures.
howToPlay: Become a Legendary Knight Slayer! Assemble your team of pixel-art heroes and tap relentlessly to deliver "Hero Tap DMG" while auto-attacking skeletons and dragons across endless fantasy stages like this desert Stage 4-1. In this addictive idle clicker RPG, advance through progressive worlds by upgrading Striker DPS for exponential scaling, conquering epic bosses, and unlocking offline rewards to dominate monsters in boundless medieval adventures! Desktop Controls: Left Mouse Button: Tap anywhere on screen to deal Hero Tap DMG and attack enemies. Mobile Controls: Tap Screen: Tap anywhere to deal Hero Tap DMG and attack enemies. On-Screen Buttons: Tap upgrade icons and menus to hire heroes, level up, and activate abilities.

title: Animals Battle
description: Are you attracted to adorable animals, and do you have the talent of a great commander? The new game combines these two passions, giving you the chance to build an empire in a world of endless battles! Here, you'll lead armies of cute yet formidable animal warriors. Command your troops, employ clever tactics, and devise effective strategies to conquer various adversaries. Explore new lands, conquer islands, and discover unique biomes inhabited by fascinating animals. Summon new fighters to your army, level them up, and turn them into the most powerful and charming armada. Remember: with each island you conquer, your enemies become stronger. To fight back, collect powerful artifact cards that will enhance your pets and strengthen your growing empire. This exciting strategy game offers hours of deep gameplay for anyone who loves animals and wants to test their tactical skills, regardless of age or gaming experience.
howToPlay: In combat, everything is based on resource economics: food for your creatures is produced automatically. Use it to summon units to build your army and crush enemy bases — destroying enemy bases is the key to completing levels. After battles, it's time for development. With the coins you earn in battles, you can unlock new units and improve your base's stats. Additionally, collect artifact cards, which provide your army with powerful permanent bonuses that apply in every battle.

title: Cube Quiz
description: CubeQuiz is a relaxing 3D spatial-reasoning puzzle. Two sandy voxel blocks fit together when one slides down and the other slides up to form a solid box. Rotate the pieces, read their shapes, and decide which ones lock perfectly together. Progress through four puzzle packs of increasing difficulty, then test yourself in endless Challenge mode. No timers, no pressure — just you and your mental rotation skills.
howToPlay: Drag any block to rotate and inspect it from every angle. Each mode asks one thing: Find the Piece — tap the block that fits the one on top. Fit or Not — decide whether the two blocks fit, then tap Fits or Don't fit. Find the Pair — tap the two blocks that fit each other. Match All — pair up every block on the screen. Clear 10 puzzles in a pack to unlock the next one. In Challenge mode, one wrong answer ends the run — how far can you go?

title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
description: You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun! Oversee your business, upgrade your stations, and hire employees to keep everything running smoothly. Even when you're offline, your gas station continues to earn! This isn't just a simulator—it's your path to success and the fun of managing your own mini-empire. Game Features: ⛽ Upgrade your gas station and service more cars 🍔 Cook hot dogs and open a cozy cafe 🛒 Add a store and restroom for customers 💸 Earn money even when you're not playing 🏆 Become the ultimate gas station boss!
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to start with a small gas station and gradually grow it into a profitable empire. Maintain cars, upgrade equipment, build a store, cafe, and restroom, hire employees, and earn more and more money to become the boss of all gas stations!

title: Spartan fruits
description: The Spartan fruits must overcome obstacles and find chests containing coins to unlock rewards and advance to the next stages. They must also collect gems to unlock new types of fruit.
howToPlay: A or D or Left or Right arrow to move the character. W or Up arrow to jump. Hold F to throw the sword to hang and swing. Press G to attack or hold G to throw the sword forward. When it is hanging: Use the A or D keys, or the Left or Right arrow keys to swing. W or Up arrow to go up. Use S or the Down arrow to go down.

title: Numbers Match 2448
description: Numbers Match 2448 is a relaxing and addictive number puzzle game where you match, merge, and build bigger numbers with every move. Place number blocks carefully, create smart combinations, and complete each level’s goal before the board fills up. Easy to start and satisfying to master, it is a great brain teaser for players who enjoy number games, merge puzzles, and 2048-style challenges.
howToPlay: Controls Desktop: Use the mouse to select, drag, and drop number blocks. Mobile: Tap and drag with your finger to move and place blocks. Boosters: Tap a booster icon to use it when available. How to Play Match number blocks with the same value to merge them into a higher number. Plan your moves carefully to create longer chains, keep free space on the board, and reach the level objective. Use boosters such as swap, shuffle, or bomb when you get stuck. Complete the task to move on to the next level and keep building bigger numbers.

title: Maskinery Idle
description: Maskinery Idle is an incremental clicker game where you explore mysterious islands, fight enemies, and collect powerful masks that grant unique abilities. Clear all tiles on each location's grid to progress through 5 stages. Defeat the Boss on the final stage to complete the zone and unlock the next one. Collect gold to buy upgrades, earn energy to level up your masks, and use the Rebirth system
howToPlay: Controls Left click / Tap -> Attack a tile, activate a mask, press a button That's it — the entire game is played with a single click/tap. No keyboard required. Gameplay 1. Click tiles to deal damage equal to your Power stat. Destroyed tiles drop Gold and Energy. 2. Enemies (red tiles) fight back — they reflect damage to you. If your HP is too low to survive a hit, the enemy becomes locked until you heal. 3. Boss appears on stage 5 as a large 3x3 tile. Clear the tiles covering it first, then defeat it to complete the location. 4. Return to the Village (safe zone) to spend gold on upgrades: Max HP, HP Regen, and Power.

title: Mine Obby 3D: Minigame World
description: Dive into the exciting world of minigames! 🎮✨ 🏆 Compete and win For every victory, you earn golden apples and coins that can be spent on new rewards and upgrades. Prove that you deserve to be at the top! 👕 Unlock new skins Choose the looks you like and make your character truly unique. Play the way you want! 🎲 Try different modes A variety of minigames awaits you, where agility, attention, luck, and quick thinking will help you succeed. Every match brings new impressions and exciting challenges! 🌟 Can you overcome every challenge, outplay your rivals, and become a true champion?
howToPlay: PC controls: W, A, S, D or arrow keys — move Space — jump Mouse movement — rotate the camera Mobile controls: Left joystick — move Right button — jump Swipes on the right side of the screen — rotate the camera

title: Criss Cross Colors
description: Criss Cross Colors is a fun, addictive color-matching puzzle game that puts a vibrant twist on classic crosswords. Instead of letters, players drag and drop colorful blocks from the bottom palette to fill the grid, matching colors both horizontally and vertically to clear every square. With its simple one-tap drag controls, relaxing yet challenging gameplay, colorful cartoon style, daily rewards, hints, and timed levels, it delivers pure brain-teasing joy for all ages — the perfect mix of logic, color, and satisfaction!
howToPlay: Master the Grid! Become a color-matching genius in Criss Cross Colors! In this fun and addictive color puzzle game, your goal is to drag colorful blocks from the bottom palette and fill the entire grid so that every row and every column has matching colors. With simple drag-and-drop moves and clever logic, you’ll clear every square and win each level in the most satisfying way! Desktop Controls: Mouse: Click and drag any colored block from the bottom palette directly onto the grid. Left Mouse Button: Hold to drag, release to place. Mobile Controls: Finger: Tap and drag any colored block from the bottom palette onto the empty squares in the grid. No extra buttons — just one smooth drag to match colors and win!

title: Roll to Riches
description: Roll to Riches is a colorful 3D arcade simulator where you train your rolling wheel, race as far as possible, earn Cash and Trophies, collect pets, unlock new wheels and trails, claim rewards, rebirth for stronger progression, and work toward new worlds.
howToPlay: Train on the treadmill to gain Energy, then enter races to roll as far as possible and earn Cash and Trophies. Use your rewards to buy upgrades, unlock wheels and trails, collect pets, claim daily and playtime rewards, and rebirth to progress faster. Desktop: use WASD or Arrow Keys to move, drag the mouse to rotate the camera, press E to interact, and press Space or tap during races to build speed. Mobile: use the virtual joystick to move, drag the screen to rotate the camera, tap the Interact button near stations, and tap during races to build speed.

title: Stonks!
description: An arcade game about an amoeba with huge evolutionary ambitions and a very questionable plan: keep jumping higher until nature admits it has a point. The goal is simple: cling to platforms, gain height, and avoid finding out exactly how deep the abyss goes. The higher the run, the trickier the stages become: platforms change shape, routes get tighter, and every sloppy jump turns into a scientific experiment with a sad ending. Collect biomass to boost your jump, unlock new stages of evolution, and use a mid-air jump when ordinary amoeba determination is no longer enough. Every run is a chance to beat your personal record for height, time, and collected biomass. Stonks! starts fast, pulls you in easily, and keeps reminding you: evolution loves persistence, but gravity is still stronger.
howToPlay: Press and hold with your finger or the left mouse button on the game field, pull in a direction, and release to jump. Jump direction and power depend on the length and angle of the movement. Try to land on platforms and keep moving upward. Collect biomass: it strengthens your jump and helps you reach tougher sections. After unlocking the mid-air jump, you can push the amoeba one extra time while airborne: use it to adjust your trajectory or reach a platform.

title: Archer Madness: Crystal Defense
description: Archer Madness: Crystal Defense is an exciting casual tower defense game packed with endless waves of monsters, powerful archers, and addictive strategic gameplay! The Crystal Core is under attack, and only you can protect it from the invading monster army. Start as a rookie archer and gradually unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your weapons, and build the ultimate defense lineup. Place Arrow Towers wisely, combine different tower skills, and create unique strategies to stop increasingly dangerous enemies. Explore colorful worlds filled with forests, castles, and mysterious battlefields while enjoying smooth controls and satisfying combat. Collect resources, strengthen your archers, upgrade your towers, and discover powerful combinations to survive every wave. Game Features: • Fast-paced tower defense battles with endless monster waves • Multiple Arrow Towers with unique skills and attack styles • Train your archer and unlock powerful abilities • Build different defensive formations and strategies • Upgrade weapons, towers, and talents to defeat stronger enemies • Bright cartoon graphics with beautiful maps and animations • Easy to learn but challenging to master Be brave and def…
howToPlay: 1. Build Arrow Towers at strategic locations to stop incoming monsters. 2. Defeat enemies to earn coins and valuable resources. 3. Upgrade your towers and unlock stronger archer skills. 4. Create different defense formations to handle various enemy types. 5. Protect the Crystal Core at all costs and survive endless waves of attacks. 6. Experiment with different strategies to become the greatest Crystal Defender!

title: Purrfect Match
description: Welcome to a cozy casual match-3 game with cats, created for relaxation and pleasant emotions. In this match-3 puzzle, you connect identical cats by drawing a continuous line across the board using your finger or mouse. You can create combinations of three or more tiles horizontally, vertically, or in an L shape. Diagonal connections are not allowed, so each move requires attention and planning. The game has no rush — you play at a comfortable pace, enjoying the cute visual style and warm, relaxing atmosphere. Each level offers a new objective and gradually increases in difficulty while maintaining a balanced and enjoyable experience. Bright 2D graphics, soft colors, and adorable cats make the game perfect for unwinding. The vertical layout is ideal for mobile devices and one-handed play. The game is suitable for all ages and will especially appeal to fans of cats and relaxing puzzle games.
howToPlay: To make a move, draw a line through three or more identical cats by swiping your finger or mouse across the board. Connections can be made horizontally, vertically, or in an L shape. Diagonal lines are not counted. When the line is completed, the selected cats disappear from the board, making space for new tiles. The longer the combination, the more effective the result and the faster you progress toward the level goal. Each level has a specific objective — for example, reaching a target score or clearing certain cats. The number of moves may be limited, so it’s important to plan your connection path in advance. Controls are intuitive and perfectly adapted for a vertical screen. The game does not require fast reactions, making it ideal for calm, stress-free play anytime.

title: Object 73: Survival Clicker
description: A post-apocalyptic survival clicker with idle and RPG elements. You awaken inside the underground Jericho Complex as Object 73 — a clone who keeps returning to life after every death. Each new cycle is a chance to uncover the truth behind the Jericho Project. Explore ruined laboratories, collect resources and fight dangerous enemies including mutants, rogue synthetics and combat drones. Defeated enemies drop materials that can be used to craft weapons, upgrade equipment and survive longer. Discover multiple locations across the complex such as laboratories, armories, archives and contaminated sectors. Find memory fragments, hidden logs and secret files that slowly reveal the story of Colonel Dmitry Yankovsky. Craft powerful weapons, upgrade armor and improve your character to defeat elite enemies and story bosses. Your decisions influence the humanity level of the protagonist and change how the story unfolds.
howToPlay: You control Object 73, a clone exploring the underground Jericho Complex. Your goal is to survive, gather resources, upgrade equipment and uncover the truth behind the experiment. *Combat Click on enemies to attack them and deal damage. Defeated enemies drop resources, ammo and crafting materials. *Resources Collect food, water, materials, caps and ammunition. These resources are used for survival, crafting and buying items in the shop. *Crafting and Shop Use collected materials to craft new weapons and armor or buy equipment in the shop. Stronger gear allows you to defeat tougher enemies. *Story and Choices Throughout the game you will discover memory fragments and meet different characters. Your choices influence the humanity level of the hero and affect how the story develops. Upgrade your gear, defeat powerful enemies and uncover the dark secret of Project Jericho.

title: Draw Dot Picture Game
description: Welcome to Draw One Miss Part Brain Games, the addictive puzzle game where logic, drawing, and brain games come together! Think you’re good at spotting details? Test your skills by identifying the missing part in each scene, and use your finger to draw it back in. Sounds simple? These brain puzzles are trickier than you think!
howToPlay: - To click any button use mouse

title: Orbit Shift
description: You're locked in orbit around a dying star: two rings, two lanes, one chance. Tap to switch. Don't get hit. How long can you last? Orbit Shift is a one-tap lane-switching endless space arcade game where reflexes are everything. Comets, shooting stars, and meteors spawn at the top of two concentric rings and spiral clockwise toward your ship. Your only move is shifting between the inner and outer ring — but timing that one move perfectly, over and over, faster and faster, is everything. Each stage runs exactly one minute and escalates in speed and obstacle density, climaxing in a surge — a short, intense burst of rapid-fire obstacles that acts as a skill gate before the next stage unlocks. Difficulty pulses in waves: pressure builds to each surge, then briefly eases, before the next stage raises the floor. By Stage 5, gaps between hazards shrink to fractions of a second. Survival time is your score, tracked against your personal best. No checkpoints. Every run starts from zero. You'll have to earn every second. Cosmetics — trails, ships, and color schemes — unlock through achievements tied to real gameplay stats. All purely visual. No pay-to-win, no randomness. Play anywhere — no d…
howToPlay: Dodge obstacles. Collect shield crystals. Survive as long as you can. Tap, click, or press Space to instantly switch your ship between the inner and outer orbital rings. There is no cooldown or animation delay — the switch is immediate. Obstacles spawn at 12 o'clock and rotate clockwise toward your ship at 6 o'clock on both rings. Your job is to read the pattern and keep switching to whichever ring is clear, timing each move to slip through the gaps as they come. When a hazard is about to hit your ring, the ring itself flares red — a last-second visual danger warning. The best players are already on the safe ring before it lights up, but the flare is there to back you up when you lose track. **Shield crystals** appear between the two rings. To collect one, you need to time a switch so your ship passes through it. Collect three crystals and your shield activates and lasts until you get hit, protecting you from the next hit before it shatters. A shield can save a great run, so collect crystals whenever it's safe to do so. However, crystals sometimes appear in tight spots between obstacles — if you're still learning the rhythm, it's better to skip a risky crystal than to mistiming th…

title: Bicycle Mountain Xtreme
description: Bicycle Mountain Xtreme is a relaxing but challenging mountain biking game where you ride on epic trails, perform cool tricks, earn points, and unlock new trails as you get better. The game feels smooth and fun because it uses realistic physics, has procedurally generated trails, and includes a day/night cycle plus a dynamic weather system that changes while you ride.
howToPlay: Keep your bike balanced, control your speed, and stay stable on bumps and slopes. The physics are realistic, so smooth riding matters. Hit jumps, do stunts, and ride clean to earn more points. Use the points you gain from riding to upgrade things like stamina and strength (so you can ride longer and feel stronger).

title: Robot Unicorn Dash
description: Enter a dreamy, neon world full of sparkles, stars, and rainbow roads. In Robot Unicorn Dash, your Robot Unicorn runs nonstop through magical landscapes where every second gets faster and harder. Jump over gaps, dodge dangerous obstacles (like dark crystals), and keep the run alive as long as you can while chasing a new high score.
howToPlay: 1. Tap to jump, tap again for a double jump. 2. Fly across rainbows and avoid dark crystals. 3. Collect stars and keep your Robot Unicorn alive as long as you can. 4. Don’t stop running – it’s a true test of your reflexes and timing.

title: SWARM MINERS
description: SWARM MINERS is a cozy mining-idle adventure. Swing your pickaxe to smash gem-rich rocks, hatch a swarm of collectible pets that mine and fight alongside you, and unlock 40 vibrant worlds from sunny meadows to cosmic voids. Upgrade tools, chase treasure rocks, spin the Wheel of Fortune, blast ore with dynamite, and battle bosses. Easy to pick up, endlessly rewarding.
howToPlay: Move with WASD or the arrow keys (touch: drag the on-screen joystick). Walk up to a rock and your miner swings automatically — fill your backpack, then sell ore to the merchant for coins. Spend coins on stronger tools, bigger backpacks, new worlds, and pets. Press E (or tap) to talk to vendors and open menus; press 1-9 to switch hotbar items and place dynamite with E inside the mine. Unlock every world and build the strongest swarm!

title: Magic Aim
description: Magic Aim is a real-time arcade artillery game starring a chibi magician. Read the shifting wind, charge your wand, and fire arcing elemental blasts that split in mid-air to clear waves of monsters across hilly terrain. Dash for a better angle, raise an energy shield to block incoming fire, grab item drops that supercharge your next shots, then warp to a fresh layout. Unlike classic turn-based artillery games, every shot is live and fast — mastery is reading arcs and wind on the fly. Four elements (Fire, Water, Thunder, Earth) each fly differently, so swapping changes how you read the same shot. Pixel-art, juicy, and easy to pick up for a quick run.
howToPlay: Survive escalating waves of monsters and score as high as you can. Clear every monster in a layout to warp to the next, tougher one — your run ends when you're defeated. Score rewards kills, speed, accuracy and style (splits and perfect blocks). Aim toward your cursor and watch the wind gauge — wind pushes your shot mid-flight and shifts every few seconds. Hold to charge for power, release to fire; shots can split at the apex into a fan for crowd control. Raise your shield just before an enemy shot lands for a perfect block (mana refund + speed burst). Walk to reposition and grab item drops that buff your shots. Controls (desktop): • Aim — Mouse • Charge & fire — hold / release Left Mouse • Energy shield — Right Mouse or Space • Move — A / D (or ← / →) • Dash-warp — double-tap ← or → • Swap element — 1–4 • Pause — Esc Mobile: virtual joystick + drag-to-aim + on-screen fire/shield buttons.

title: Crazy Emoji Blast
description: Match colorful emojis, chain explosive combos, and blast your way through 10 increasingly challenging levels! Swap adjacent emojis to create matches of 3 or more — trigger row blasts, column blasts, cross explosions, and total nukes. Watch out for bombs hidden on the board — match near them to unleash devastating chain reactions
howToPlay: Tap or swipe two adjacent emojis to swap them. Match 3 in a row or column to blast them. Match 4 for a full row/column blast. Match 5 for a cross blast clearing entire rows AND columns. Match 6+ for a Total Nuke that resets the whole board with massive points. Bombs appear randomly — match emojis next to them to trigger an explosion blasting 15+ surrounding cells. Each level has a score target you must hit within limited moves. Run out of moves? Watch a rewarded ad to get 5 extra moves!

title: Love Archer Hero
description: Welcome to Love Archer Hero game - one of the games about inspiring love feelings! In this interesting project, you play as a cheerful tricky Cupid, using your archer skills, bow and magic arrows of love to connect everyone and create loving couples! Play have fun, solve puzzles and throw the arrow to a creature of your choice. After your arrow hits the target, they will fall in a beautiful garden and a magic of love will take them over. Are you ready, my tiny Cupid hero? Shot your love arrows right into funny creatures' hearts to make them love each other and born a baby. Even the different types of creatures can make a solid couple and become happy parents. Combine orc and human for example and see how love conquers all!
howToPlay: Aim and Shoot: Use your finger (on mobile) or mouse (on desktop) to drag and release, aiming your arrow at your intended target. A dashed line indicates the trajectory of your shot. Matchmaking: Your goal is to make two characters fall in love. This can involve hitting one or both individuals with your arrows. Obstacles and Features: Levels may include barriers like glass, ropes, or wooden planks. Utilize these elements to guide your arrows to the targets. Level Progression: Complete levels to unlock new ones. Each level presents unique challenges and characters.

title: Mike and Mia 1st Day School
description: Mike and Mia are very excited for their first day of school. Help them to clean their room and make a delicious snack box. Get dressed up with various cute clothes. Enjoy the first day at school with fun and loving playful activities!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Words Story
description: A man is framed and imprisoned, but he never gives up and plans to self-salvation. Persevere, day after day, year after year. He need your help to take freedom. Features: ♥ Simple, easy rules, type the correct word to win a game! ♥ ALL LEVELS are for all users! ♥ NEW word gameplay, good news for word gamer! ♥ No time limit, adjust your pace at any level ♥ 2000 levels without repeat, be a word master in our training! ♥ Kill time-no pressure no push!
howToPlay: ♥ Type the correct word to win a level! ♥ Get useful tools to help the man. ♥ Upgrade tools for faster progress.

title: Fun With Flags - Ultimate Quiz Game
description: Fun With Flags – Quiz Game is the ultimate challenge for players who love geography, trivia, and brain-teasing fun! Test your knowledge of world flags as you progress through levels filled with colorful flags from across the globe. Each level displays one flag along with four answer options—only one is correct! Choose wisely and unlock new levels as you master flags from every continent. Stuck on a tricky flag? No worries! Use the Hint button to get help by removing wrong choices or receiving clues that guide you to the correct answer. Perfect for kids, students, and adults—whether you're learning or sharpening your global IQ, this game makes world geography fun, engaging, and rewarding!
howToPlay: Each level shows a country flag Choose the Correct Answer from four options below the flag. If you’re unsure, tap the Hint button. Keep answering correctly to unlock new levels and test your world flag skills!

title: Magic Princess
description: Magic Princess - Dress up & Character Maker offline game, come and design the cutest doll👑! Magic Princess is a fashionable ultra-casual simulation girl game with a strong anime chibi style, suitable for all unique girls to play. 【Game Features】 👸 Avatar Creator & Memoji Maker 👸 Make up your own versions of international star girls or gothic charming dolls! 👸 More than 1000+ dress up items, skin tones and hairdressing! 👸 High quality animation in some clothes and items, you will definitely love it! 👸 Create more gorgeous photos, fabulous videos about your dolls 👸 Give your friends your painted, lovely doll girl. 👸 Keep track of every innovative designs
howToPlay: 💖Click to makeover with your finger 💖Put on suitable cosmetics 💖Dress up in a variety of clothing and items 💖Arrange the scenario 💖Create an unique photographic memory

title: Worms
description: Worms Puzzle is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you help cute, colorful worms find their way across small tile boards. Just swipe to move, collect dots, and reach the goal — it’s easy to learn but gets more interesting as you play! With bright visuals and bite-sized levels, it’s perfect for quick breaks or winding down anytime.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys on your keyboard or simply swipe on the screen to move the worms. Guide them across the tiles, collect all the dots, and reach the goal to complete each level. Plan your moves carefully as puzzles get trickier with every stage!

title: Pirates Tiles Challenge
description: Pirates Tiles Challenge is a delightful tile-matching puzzle game with a vibrant pirate adventure theme. The core gameplay revolves around scanning a grid of pirate icons (flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, etc.) to find identical pairs and connect them using at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked by other tiles — a classic “Mahjong Solitaire-style” matching rule that demands spatial awareness and quick thinking. As you clear the board, a treasure-hunt atmosphere unfolds with colorful pirate graphics, progressive difficulty, stars-based scoring, and fun power-ups, making it easy to pick up yet endlessly challenging for players of all ages.
howToPlay: Become a Pirate Legend! Step into the shoes of a fearless pirate captain and clear every treasure-filled board that stands in your way. In this delightful tile-matching puzzle game, you’ll scan the grid of pirate icons — flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, pistols, compasses and more — to find identical pairs and connect them with at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked. Match all tiles to clear the board, earn up to 3 stars, and conquer hundreds of progressively challenging levels in a vibrant pirate adventure atmosphere! Desktop Controls: Mouse: Click the first tile, then click the matching tile to connect them (valid path with ≤3 lines will automatically link). Hint Button: Click the lightbulb icon for help. Pause: Click the pause button. Mobile Controls: Tap: Tap the first tile, then tap the identical tile to match them (the game checks for a valid path with maximum 3 lines). Hint Button: Tap the lightbulb icon. Pause: Tap the pause button.

title: Cube Crushers
description: Welcome to Cube Crushers, a fun and satisfying sorting puzzle game filled with colorful cake slices, cute cube characters, and smart puzzle challenges. Tap the cake slices on the grid, send them to the conveyor, and unlock hidden cube crushers behind them. Each crusher has its own color and eats only the matching cake slices. Choose your moves carefully because every tap can change the puzzle result. Cube Crushers is easy to play but becomes more challenging as you progress. With cute characters, smooth effects, colorful visuals, and handcrafted levels, this game gives you a relaxing yet strategic puzzle experience.
howToPlay: Tap the cake slices on the puzzle grid. The selected cake slices move to the conveyor. Removing cake slices unlocks hidden cube crushers. Each crusher looks for cake slices of its matching color. Match the right crusher with the right cake slices. Clear all cake slices to complete the level. Think before every tap because your moves decide which crushers enter the game. Complete levels and enjoy new puzzle challenges.

title: Sand Tetris Pro
description: Sand Tetris Pro is a fresh take on the classic Tetris formula with realistic sand physics. When tetrominoes land, they crumble into hundreds of sand particles that behave like real sand, filling the level in dynamic and unpredictable ways. Instead of simply clearing rows, you must think about the flow of sand and how piles form and collapse. The game features two main modes: Endless Mode and Campaign Mode, which includes hundreds of levels with objectives and up to three stars to earn for completing challenges. Key features include dynamic sand physics, unique power-ups (bomb — destroys a large area; vacuum — removes accumulated sand; slow motion — gives you extra time to place pieces precisely), in-game currency, a booster shop, and a progression system.
howToPlay: Your goal is to place or guide falling tetrominoes so they form sand lines or structures. When enough sand fills a row or area, it clears and gives you points. Use boosters and bombs to control large sand piles and manage difficult situations. You can control the falling blocks using arrow keys on the keyboard or swipe gestures on mobile devices.

title: Kingdom Defense Mega
description: Kingdom Defense Mega. Play the classic tower defense game. Build towers! Defend your kingdom! Use magic! Battle powerful enemies and fearsome bosses! If you're a fan of the strategy genre, then Kingdom Defense is definitely for you.
howToPlay: Protect the kingdom. You will save the inhabitants and the peace of the kingdom. Upgrade your towers and spells, and unleash their full power on the battlefield. Features: * 12 levels. * Orcs, goblins, witches, spirits, trolls, zombies, giants, and a multitude of enemies. * Spells that can be summoned at any time. * Bosses at the end of levels. * 4 super bosses at the end of each location. * Stunning locations – forests, swamps, deserts, winter north, and volcanoes. * Upgrading towers and spells

title: Tile Harvest 3D
description: Tile Harvest 3D is a 3D tile-matching puzzle game with a satisfying merge twist. Clear a towering stack of colorful 3D tiles by collecting matching sets and chaining them into powerful merges. With unlimited levels, escalating challenge, and a set of special boosters to save you in a pinch, every puzzle is a fresh brain-teaser.
howToPlay: Your goal: Clear every tile from the 3D board to win the level. 1. Pick matching tiles Tap any accessible tile on the 3D stack. When you tap 3 tiles of the same type, they are collected and sent to your Factory Belt — a row of slots at the bottom of the screen. 2. Watch your Factory Belt The Factory Belt holds the tiles you've collected. When 3 identical items sit in the belt at the same time they automatically merge into a brand-new, higher-tier item — clearing those slots and making room for more. 3. Rotate & zoom the board The tiles are stacked in 3D. Swipe to rotate the board and expose hidden tiles underneath. Pinch to zoom in or out. Uncovering the right tiles at the right time is the key to a clean chain of merges. 4. Don't run out of space If your Factory Belt fills up with tiles that can't merge, you're stuck — and the level is lost. Think ahead, plan your picks, and keep the belt flowing. 5. Use boosters wisely Four boosters help you out of tight spots: 🔄 Throwback — Send the last tile in the belt back to the board. 🌀 Whirlwind — Shuffle the tiles on the board for a fresh look. 🔍 Magnifier — Highlights a set of 3 matching tiles for you. 🔨 Hammer — Smash and remove a…

title: Doodle RPG Survivor
description: Scribble your way through waves of classroom doodles in this notebook-themed survivor RPG. Spells auto-cast. You just dodge and pick upgrades. 16 stages from elementary to university. 64 unique bosses. Spells with crazy combos. Many gear pieces to loot, upgrade, and stack.
howToPlay: Move: WASD or Arrow Keys Open backpack: B Confirm / reroll: Space Pause: Escape Attacks auto-cast. Point-and-click to navigate menus; right-click or drag to equip items in the backpack.

title: This is Blast
description: Ready to blast your way through puzzles? Welcome to This is Blast, the exciting blast game that combines colorful puzzles, explosive chain reactions, and addictive ball blast mechanics. If you’re searching for a fun, free, and challenging puzzle blast game, you’ve found it. From the very first shot, This is Blast delivers an experience that is simple to play yet packed with depth. Aim carefully, unleash your balls, and trigger epic blasts that clear the board in a single swoop. With intuitive controls, smooth visuals, and clever puzzles, this game keeps you hooked whether you want a quick session or hours of puzzle-blasting fun.
howToPlay: Aim Carefully Drag or move your aim direction and choose the best place to shoot the balls. Shoot the Balls Release the balls toward the puzzle area. Try to hit the correct blocks, balls, or targets. Create Big Blasts Match and merge similar items to create powerful blast effects. Bigger matches can clear more space. Use Chain Reactions One good shot can create multiple blasts. Plan your shot so it clears many objects at once. Clear the Level Goal Every level has a puzzle layout. Your main goal is to clear the required targets and complete the level. Use Power-Ups When Needed If the level becomes hard, use boosters or power-ups to clear difficult parts and save your game. Think Before Every Move The game is easy to play, but later levels need better strategy, timing, and smart aiming.

title: Spin&Mow
description: You pilot a saw-chain robot — two spinning gears tethered by a serrated chain — across scalloped grass islands floating over deep water. Anchor one gear, watch the other orbit at chain length, then tap-swap to fling yourself across treacherous gaps. Cut grass to meet each stage's quota, dodge stumps, boulders and crystals, time landings on moving platforms, then touch the flag to escape. Upgrade Sharper Saws, Longer Chain, Reinforced Frame, Coin Magnet and Tuned Gearbox. Finish 20 stages to enter the Hall of Fame as a MOW-A-HERO.
howToPlay: click/space/tap to swap the anchor and launch the chain, mouse wheel or HUD buttons to adjust chain length. Go from island to island to reach the exiting pole.

title: Twist Your Path
description: This is a single-player arcade game about reaction and focus. The character runs forward along a rotating trunk, and your task is to turn the path at the right moment to avoid obstacles. The longer you survive, the higher your score becomes. You can collect coins during runs and use them to unlock new characters. The game is built for short sessions: the rules are simple, but the speed and direction changes quickly make every run tense.
howToPlay: Tap the screen or click the mouse button to rotate the trunk. Watch the branches ahead of the character: if the path is blocked, turn in time and keep moving. Try to survive as long as possible. Your score increases during the run, and your best result is saved. Collect coins along the way and unlock new characters in the selection menu.

title: Night Order: Pick & Pack
description: Choose the requested items from the shelf, collect them on a tray, and carefully pack each night order.
howToPlay: During the selection stage, tap the items shown in the order. The items you choose are placed on the tray. During the packing stage, drag items from the tray into the box. If an item does not fit, choose another spot or rotate it with the rotate button. You can return an unsuitable item to the tray or restart the whole layout. Use a hint when you are not sure what to do next. The more compactly you fill the box, the more stars you earn.

title: Color Dots Challenge
description: Color Dots is a simple yet addictive puzzle game where you'll Place each dot into its matching slot aim for precision Enjoy an experience that’s both easy to learn and fun to play, making it ideal for quick breaks or longer sessions.
howToPlay: - Tap on color dot to move right place. -Put the dots in their respective slots. -Avoid Hitting other dots. -Simple and fun puzzle game. - Enjoy an experience that’s both easy to learn and fun to play. - Play with fun.

title: skyfall siege
description: In this fast paced aerial battleground, I wanted to create a pure, adrenaline-driven experience where every second counts. You’ll face relentless waves of enemies descending from the skies, and survival depends on your reflexes, precision, and smart movement.
howToPlay: Play as a brave defender and defeat the threats falling from the sky. In this exciting tower defense game, you will use your turrets and fearless defensive structures to help you defeat countless enemies and ultimately protect your base. ⌨️ Desktop Controls *← Left Arrow: Move left *→ Right Arrow: Move right *Spacebar: Fire weapon *TAB:Open upgrade UI 📱 Mobile Controls *Tap left or right of the character**: Move left/right *Fire button**: Auto-fire 🛠 Building & Upgrading *Mouse / Tap the Build button**: Spend money to construct or upgrade defensive facilities

title: Besties on Wednesday
description: A young bestie goes to school to learn magic and make new friends. She has her own special style. The girl prefers black colors in clothes and a gothic look. Her roommate likes bright colors in her clothes. It will not be easy for new acquaintances to find a common language. However, this bright girl is not as simple as it seems at first glance. She has her secrets. Try to choose for each student an image that suits her perfectly. And one day these besties will be BFF.
howToPlay: Fate brings together two very different girls-students in the walls of the School of Magic. Help the girls create their own unique image: choose make up, hairstyles, outfits and accessories, that match the characters of the girls. And, perhaps, they will eventually become best friends. The result can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screen is used for control.

title: Brain Coloring Puzzle
description: Discover Italian Brainrot Meme Coloring Puzzle Game Step into the viral world of Italian Brainrot Meme Characters, where over thirty absurd creatures await your palette. No numbers, no hints—only your eye for color and a playful spirit. Meet the Stars Bombardiro Crocodilo: Our most fiendish color‑match boss. Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur: A viral sensation inspired by Italian Brainrot. Shimpanzinni Bananinni, Boneca Ambalabu, Tralalero Tralala and many more bring humor and challenge. Why You’ll Love It Brain‑Boosting Fun: Sharpens visual memory and logic. Creative Freedom: No right answer—trust your instincts. Offline Play: Dive in anytime, anywhere. Designed for Ages 12+: Simple enough for kids, intriguing for teens and adults. Ready to color outside the lines? Tap Install and unleash your inner artist on the most delightfully absurd paint‑puzzle around!
howToPlay: How to Play Select Your Palette: Pick from 4–5 vibrant hues. Tap to Color: Assign each color to outfit, shoes, hair and more—without numeric guidance. Solve the Puzzle: These surreal characters (think Fake Trippi Troppa, Bombardiro Crocodilo and Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur) will keep you guessing. Paint the characters with the correct colors from the palette within 60 seconds, matching their original colors to complete the puzzle!

title: Elska - dog vs zombies! Multiplayer co-op
description: The world has gone wild—but one dog hasn’t. Elska is a fast-paced, top-down cartoon shooter where you play as a brave, loyal dog named Elska, the only survivor of a mysterious lab explosion that turned all animals into bloodthirsty zombies. With nothing left but instinct, grit, and an experimental power pulsing through her veins, Elska takes the fight to the infected in a desperate mission to save the world. After the accident that unleashed Promethium Kyanite—a powerful energy source gone wrong—the animals Elska once called friends have mutated into savage creatures. Rats, cats, wolves, raccoons, and foxes... now roam the ruins of the lab and beyond, attacking anything in sight. But Elska isn’t running away. She’s loading up. Armed with unique weapons, unlockable abilities, and canine determination, you’ll face round-based zombie waves across 2 DIFFERENT maps, each more intense than the last. In game there are different classes to chose from. Each class has a different bundle of abilities. You can customize your dog and try different accessories with different effects.
howToPlay: WASD movement. 12345 To switch guns Left click to shoot Mouse to aim To use ability it's E/Q/G based on the class

title: The Goopies: Slime Puzzle
description: Casual 2D puzzle game where you guide slimes safely to the exit. Instead of controlling them directly, you place simple instructions on a grid to change how they move.
howToPlay: The Goopies: Slime Puzzle Puzzle game? Check. Slime physics? Check. The Goopies: Slime Puzzle is all about the path. Guide slimes to the exit using grid-based instructions. No direct control. Just smart placement and timing. How to Play The Goopies: Slime Puzzle Use four simple instructions: - Air – lifts slimes upward - Glide – moves them sideways in the air - Freefall – slows falling slimes for safe landings - Block – turns a slime into a wall to redirect others Avoid deadly traps like fire, water, and electricity, and remember: falls of 3 blocks or more are fatal. Collect keys, guide at least 3 slimes to the exit, and complete increasingly challenging levels. Who is The Goopies: Slime Puzzle for? Perfect for puzzle fans. Great for quick brain breaks. Ideal for players who want satisfying progression without chaos. Casual gameplay. Strategic depth. Fun for all ages. Developed by Exient and released in April 2026.
