title: Tile Matcher Triple Fun
description: Tile Matcher Triple Fun is a relaxing triple tile-matching puzzle game inspired by Mahjong Solitaire, where players tap to find and match three identical fruit-themed tiles (like peaches, blueberries, and bananas) to clear the vibrant, stacked board against a tropical beach backdrop. Its core concept revolves around strategic triple matching to conquer increasingly challenging levels, with unique vibrant fruit designs, a serene seaside theme featuring a surfer and palm islands, and helpful tools like hints and shuffles for endless addictive fun.
howToPlay: Clear the Tropical Tile Board! Dive into Tile Matcher – Triple Fun, a relaxing triple tile-matching puzzle inspired by Mahjong Solitaire. Tap to find and match three identical fruit-themed tiles—like peaches, blueberries, and bananas—to clear the vibrant, stacked board and conquer increasingly challenging levels against a serene beach backdrop with a surfer and palm islands. **Desktop Controls:** Mouse: Click to select and match tiles. Hint Button: Click the lightbulb icon for a helpful suggestion. Shuffle Button: Click to rearrange tiles on the board. **Mobile Controls:** Tap: Select tiles to match three identical ones and clear them. Hint Button: Tap the lightbulb icon for a suggestion. Shuffle Button: Tap to reshuffle tiles.

title: Merge Guns: Brainrot Battle
description: Open. Merge. Destroy Bosses. Dive into a fast-paced merge arcade where your goal is simple: assemble a deadly arsenal and take down bosses one after another. Buy mystery boxes, open them, and merge identical weapons to upgrade their power and unlock devastating stack combos. Strategically place guns, bombs, and knives into combat slots around the boss — they’ll attack automatically while you focus on optimizing your setup and tactics. Face off against bizarre and powerful bosses like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Sahur, and Cappuccino Assassino—each with unique behavior and escalating difficulty that will push your build to the limit. Watch out for rage phases, grab limited-time gift events, boost your damage, and activate auto-opening to speed up your progression. Every decision matters as difficulty scales endlessly. Defeat bosses, earn rewards, and see how far your build can go in an infinite challenge of power and strategy. Complete the tutorial, master the coin economy, and prove that your loadout can destroy any titan.
howToPlay: Tap / Click the Buy button — purchase a box Tap / Click a box — open it (may require multiple taps) Drag & Drop an item — move weapons between slots Drag an item onto an identical one — merge and upgrade Drag a weapon into a slot around the boss — it starts attacking automatically Tap boost buttons (Damage x2, Auto Open) — activate temporary power-ups

title: Escaping Arrows
description: Ready to test your logic in a game where every move matters? Escaping Arrows is a minimalistic and deep puzzle game in which you have to untangle a complex knot of directions and paths. The essence of the game is simple: there are arrows on the field, and your goal is to remove them all one by one. What awaits you inside: – 100 skill levels: Test yourself with tasks ranging from elementary to truly complex mazes. – Special challenges: Every 5th level tests your skills with increased difficulty. – The game is perfect for both short breaks and long evening sessions thanks to its anti-stress effect and smooth progression of difficulty. Can you clear the field without making a single mistake? Test yourself in Escaping Arrows! Good luck!
howToPlay: Click on the arrow, and it will fly in the specified direction. However, be careful: if the path is blocked by another arrow, you will lose one of your three precious lives. Only the correct sequence of actions will lead you to victory!

title: Block Puzzle: Prize Mania
description: A classic block-drop puzzle that transforms into a true collector’s experience! Drag pieces onto the grid, clear lines, and enjoy satisfying combos. But the real hook? 32 unique collectible items with awesome abilities. Before each match, you build your loadout: pick up to three items that work together. One boosts your score, another lets you blast blocks, and a third changes the board rules. Every combination delivers a fresh, highly engaging playstyle. All items are pulled from the gacha machine. Use a ticket, pull the lever, and feel the thrill as a capsule rolls out and pops open to reveal your newest gear.
howToPlay: Build Your Loadout! Before each match, choose items from your collection. They’re what make every run uniquely powerful and engaging. Play the Puzzle! Three shapes appear at the bottom. Drag them onto the board to fill complete rows or columns. Clear more lines in a single move for bigger combos and better rewards. The match ends when no remaining piece can fit. Activate Item Powers! Items trigger automatically or can be activated manually. Enjoy everything from simple score boosts to powerful active abilities like bombs, lightning strikes, or even an undo move. Earn Rewards! Collect coins after every match (with a daily cap). After a game ends, watch a short ad to double your coins or continue your run. Spin the Gacha! Spend tickets in the gacha machine to pull new gear. The more you spin, the closer you get to rare and legendary trophies.

title: Jelly Merge: Dooper
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Jelly Merge. Slide colorful jellies across the board, merge all jelly elements into one, and solve each level with smart moves. Plan carefully, avoid obstacles, and try to finish each puzzle in the fewest steps possible.
howToPlay: Swipe up, down, left, or right to move the jellies. Merge all jelly elements into one jelly to complete the level. Use fewer moves to get a better score, and plan around obstacles that block movement.

title: Hexholm
description: Hexholm is a fast, turn-based hex strategy game. Start from a single province and carve out a kingdom — recruit troops, claim the map hex by hex, and crush rival AI factions before they overrun you. Every battle is a tight tactical puzzle: manage your gold, position your units, and time your pushes to expand without overextending. Take on 100 hand-picked campaign stages, fight for the top of the global leaderboard in the daily challenge, or jump into a quick random skirmish. Climb the worldwide rankings for total stages cleared and daily high scores. No fluff, no waiting — just clean, snappy strategy you can play in a few minutes or sink hours into.
howToPlay: 1. Tap one of your territories, then pick a unit from the bottom bar and place it on an empty hex inside your land. 2. Tap a unit to see where it can go — highlighted hexes show valid moves. Tap one to move, or tap an enemy to attack. 3. Capturing neutral and enemy hexes expands your territory and raises your income. 4. Each turn you earn gold based on the land you hold. Spend it on stronger units — and merge matching units to upgrade them. 5. Tap END TURN when you're finished; the AI factions then take their turns. 6. Eliminate every rival faction to win the map. Slipped up? Use UNDO to roll back a turn.

title: Voxel Master
description: A 3D puzzle and builder in one! Assemble volumetric models from colored blocks using hints, or create your own masterpieces in sandbox mode. Two game modes: - Puzzle mode — hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty. You're shown a model and must recreate it block by block. - Sandbox — free 3D modeling on grids of various sizes. Save your creations and share them with friends.
howToPlay: Controls: - PC: left mouse button — place/remove a block, drag — rotate camera, scroll wheel — zoom, WASD — pan - Mobile: tap — place a block, swipe — rotate, pinch — zoom

title: Commit
description: Explore an isometric world full of puzzles where every move is permanent. Take control of a curious cat that must traverse all the tiles in each level to collect food—but beware: every tile you step on disappears forever. No turning back. Only pure strategy.
howToPlay: Controls Explanation: Use your mouse to click on the tiles where you want the cat to move. Each click makes the cat jump to that tile, and every tile you step on disappears forever. Plan your path carefully, as you cannot go back, and strategy is key to completing each level successfully.

title: Fire Hose
description: Think you can handle the pressure? Use your mouse or the left virtual joystick on mobile to move and aim, then click or hit the right trigger to spray and put out every fire before your water runs out. Each level gets harder with more flames, trickier layouts, and less room for mistakes. Waste too much water and you will fail. Stay sharp, move fast, and clear them all. Upgrade your water deposits to carry more water, spray longer, and survive tougher stages. Move with the left joystick Spray with the right trigger Put out every fire Upgrade your water deposits Beat fast and challenging levels Every drop counts. Start spraying now!
howToPlay: On desktop use the mouse to aim and click to release the water. Press Q to toggle mouse lock On mobile user the virtual joystick and the button to trigger the water from the hose. You win by extinguishing as many fires fires on the screen without running out of water

title: Transport Run
description: Navigate the roads in Transport Run, a thrilling 3D traffic avoidance arcade runner! Drive your colorful vehicle along winding highways lined with pink trees and multi-lane traffic, dodging oncoming cars and buses to reach the goal without any crashes. The core idea is careful timing and precision driving in dense traffic—unique for its relaxing yet tense endless run style, isometric cartoon visuals with vibrant environments, and easy upgrades earned through skillful play that make each run feel progressively smoother and more rewarding!
howToPlay: Your main goal is to drive forward as far as possible without crashing into other vehicles, survive the traffic to rack up distance-based scores, and use careful stops to upgrade your vehicle for better performance—reach high scores by mastering timing and avoiding collisions! PC Controls: Mouse / Arrows: Swipe or hold left/right to steer and change lanes. Hold Mouse Button / Space: Accelerate forward. Release: Stop or brake. Mobile Controls: Touchscreen: Tap and hold screen to drive forward; release to stop. Swipe left/right: Steer and switch lanes.

title: Crazy Bob
description: Ready for a crazy adventure across floating islands? Take control of Crazy Bob, battle dangerous enemies, cause explosive chaos, and fight for survival in a world full of challenges. Explore floating islands, overcome traps and obstacles, complete quests, and unlock new portals to unexplored lands.
howToPlay: HOW TO PLAY 🟥 Red button or RMB — Punch. 🟪 Purple button or R — Spin Attack. ⬆️ Spacebar — Jump. 🎮 W, A, S, D — Move. Not sure where to start? Check out the tutorial in the main menu!

title: Knight Crown Idle
description: Game Details What is Knight Crown Idle about? Knight Crown Idle is a pixel-style idle RPG where you battle monsters, earn gold and experience, and grow stronger with every fight. Upgrade your hero’s abilities and explore new areas filled with challenges. What’s the main goal in Knight Crown Idle? The main goal is to defeat monsters, earn gold and experience, and continuously upgrade your hero to become stronger. As you progress, you unlock new areas, rescue trapped animals, and complete achievements while building a more powerful character. Is Knight Crown Idle easy to control? Yes. Knight Crown Idle features simple and intuitive controls, making it easy to pick up while focusing on progression and upgrades. Can we play Knight Crown Idle on mobile? Yes. Knight Crown Idle can be played on both mobile devices and desktop computers. It runs directly in the browser and does not require any downloads. Is Knight Crown Idle free to play? Yes. Knight Crown Idle is free to play and runs directly in your browser. Can we play Knight Crown Idle in full screen mode? Yes. The game supports full screen mode for a more immersive experience.
howToPlay: How to Play Click or tap on enemies to defeat them. Earn gold and experience from battles, then use them to upgrade your hero’s stats and abilities. Progress through levels, unlock new areas, and continue strengthening your character as enemies become more challenging.

title: Fillblox
description: An engaging logic puzzle where your goal is to fill the playing field with shapes. You're given several blocks of different forms — drag each one into place so that not a single cell is left empty. Sounds simple? With every level, the board gets larger and the pieces grow more numerous and more intricate. An adaptive difficulty system adjusts to your pace — if you're blazing through levels too quickly, the game will throw a tougher challenge your way. Stuck? Use a hint to automatically place one piece in the right spot.
howToPlay: Drag a shape from the panel on the right onto the playing field. Position it so that it covers empty cells. Fill every cell on the board to complete the level. Shapes cannot be rotated or flipped — find the correct spot for each one.

title: USA Luxury 4x4 SUV Offroad Driving Simulator
description: 🚙 USA Luxury 4x4 SUV Offroad Driving Simulator 🌲 Drive. Explore. Conquer. Experience the ultimate offroad adventure with powerful luxury 4x4 SUVs across extreme terrains in one of the most realistic offroad driving simulator games ever made! 🌎💨 🌟 Product Features: 🛞 Realistic 4x4 Offroad Physics: True-to-life vehicle handling with suspension dynamics and terrain interaction. 🚗 Luxury SUV Selection: Drive premium offroad vehicles including Range-style SUVs, G-Class, and X-series 4x4s. 🎨 Customizable Vehicles: Change colors, wheels, accessories, and more to create your dream ride. 🌋 Challenging Terrain & Obstacles: Conquer mud, rocks, rivers, snow, and mountain paths like a pro driver. 🌅 Immersive HD Graphics: Realistic lighting, detailed environments, and smooth visuals bring every trail to life. 🌧️ Dynamic Weather & Day-Night Cycle: Drive in rain, fog, or sunshine, and explore the wilderness at sunrise or midnight. 🎮 Multiple Game Modes: Try Free Roam, Time Trial, or Obstacle Challenges to test your offroad mastery. 🕹️ Easy Controls: Choose between tilt, steering wheel, or touch controls for the best driving experience. 🏁 Product Description: Welcome to USA Luxury 4x…
howToPlay: 🕹️ How to Play: 🏁 Accelerate & Brake – Control your SUV’s speed with precision 🕹️ Tilt or Steer – Navigate sharp turns and steep slopes 🚧 Use 4x4 Mode – Get extra traction for mud and mountain trails 💰 Complete Challenges – Earn coins and unlock luxury SUVs 🎨 Customize Your Ride – Upgrade wheels, paint, and accessories

title: Funny Pet Haircut
description: Take your messy pets, alpaca and cat to the hair salon. Wash and dry your pets before giving them a brand new look by changing their colors and giving them pattern look. Dress up too. And turn them into a stylish beauty!
howToPlay: Responsive on all devices MOUSE (Desktop): Click items, tools, and buttons to interact TAP (Mobile): Touch screen to select and apply choices

title: Block Sculptor
description: Block Sculptor is a 3D puzzle game where you become the sculptor. Inside every block hides a colorful shape — your goal is to carefully remove all the extra gray cubes without touching the shape itself. The challenge grows steadily: shapes get bigger, and the margin for error gets smaller. Rotate the block, study it from every angle, and think through every move!
howToPlay: 1. Tap gray blocks to remove them 2. Don't tap colored blocks — that's a mistake! 3. Drag with your finger or mouse to rotate the shape 4. Remove all gray blocks to reveal the hidden figure 5. Fewer mistakes mean more stars and coins

title: Capi bar
description: Capi Bar is an idle game, business simulation and relaxing gameplay in one app. Combine fruits, save juice and gradually upgrade your bar!
howToPlay: Game Features: 🥤 Merge Fruits Combine watermelons, oranges, coconuts and other fruits. The game mechanics are simple and straightforward, and the process itself resembles cute games that are pleasant to come back to over and over again. 🐹 Capybara is the main character and your assistant in business! Manage the bar with capybara. 🏪 Development and upgrades Upgrade your equipment, buy new bars, counters and interior elements. Business development is built as a calm simulator in which every improvement feels useful. , Idle mechanics Income continues to accumulate even when you are not in the game. This idle game is great for those who appreciate slow progress and love offline games. , Antistress and ASMR Bright graphics, smooth animations and pleasant sounds create a relaxing atmosphere. The project fits perfectly into the casual game format, allowing you to relax and enjoy the process.

title: Flows
description: Flows is a cozy logic puzzle about sorting colored liquids between flasks. Tap one flask, then another, to pour the top color — your goal is to leave every flask filled with a single color (or empty). ✨ Features: • 40 hand-tuned levels with a smooth difficulty curve • Per-level time leaderboards — race the world for the fastest solve • Optional hint system (rewarded ad) • Clean minimalist visuals, calming palette • Plays in 4 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português • No accounts, no timers, no pressure — pick up and play Perfect for short coffee breaks or long focused sessions.
howToPlay: Tap a flask, then tap another flask to pour the top-most color into it. You can pour only when the destination flask is empty or its top color matches. The level is solved when every flask contains a single color or is empty. 🎯 Tips: • Plan ahead — once a color is buried under another, you must move the top one first • Use the Hint button (rewarded ad) if you get stuck • Each level has its own time leaderboard — finish fast to climb the ranks Controls: Mouse click on desktop, tap on mobile.

title: Draw Action Freestyle Fight
description: Unleash your creativity and power in Draw Action Freestyle Fight, a super fun draw-to-fight action game! Draw lines and shapes with your finger to command powerful punches, kicks, and combos against tough opponents in intense battles. Complete freedom to draw any attack you want, hilarious ragdoll physics when enemies get slapped or punched into the water, satisfying one-tap drawing mechanics, and addictive battles across different arenas!
howToPlay: Your main goal is to defeat your opponent by drawing powerful attack lines — drag from your fighter toward the enemy to punch, kick, or slap them. Knock your opponent off the platform into the water to win the round. The better and faster your drawings, the stronger your attacks! PC Controls: Mouse: Click and drag from your character toward the enemy to draw an attack line, then release to strike. Mobile Controls: Touchscreen: Tap and drag from your fighter toward the opponent to draw the attack line, then release to unleash the punch or kick.

title: 248 Scribble
description: 248 Scribble is a casual mobile merge puzzle game inspired by 2048, where players connect adjacent dots with matching numbers (like 2s, 4s, or 8s) horizontally or vertically on a colorful grid to merge them into higher values, aiming to achieve 248 while managing space and earning coins—its unique "scribble" art style with hand-drawn, vibrant, doodle-like tiles and intuitive touch controls sets it apart as an addictive, relaxing brain teaser.
howToPlay: Merge to 248 Mastery! Dive into 248 Scribble, the addictive casual merge puzzle where you connect adjacent dots with matching numbers (2s, 4s, 8s, and beyond) horizontally or vertically on a vibrant grid to merge them into higher values, strategically managing space to reach the ultimate 248 tile and claim victory while earning coins. Mobile Controls: Drag/Swipe: Touch and drag between adjacent matching-number dots horizontally or vertically to connect and merge them. Undo (↶): Tap the left arrow button to undo your last move (costs 100 coins). Hint (↗️): Tap the hint button for a suggested merge (costs 75 coins). Shuffle (🗑️): Tap the shuffle button to rearrange tiles (costs 50 coins). Boost (🔄): Tap the boost button for a game-changing power-up (costs 200 coins).

title: Extreme Balancer
description: Extreme Balancer is an exciting and challenging game where you have to balance a ball on narrow wooden bridges and guide it safely to the end of each level. Be careful, if the ball falls off, you will have to start over! The game has beautiful 3D graphics and realistic physics that make it feel like you are really balancing the ball.
howToPlay: Roll the ball forward carefully on the wooden bridges and narrow tracks When you see moving platforms / spinning parts, pause and watch the pattern first. Your goal is to roll the Balancer Ball across wooden bridges, dangerous paths, rotating blocks, and moving platforms. Time your movement, then cross quickly but controlled. If the ball falls, the level restarts—try again and improve your timing.

title: 3D Pyramid Maze
description: A 3D maze that IS a mountain. Roll a glowing ball up a stepped square pyramid, climbing terrace by terrace from the base edge to the golden summit — the maze wraps all four faces, so solving it and climbing it are the same act. A red chaser hunts you through the same open corridors you use. It paths as freely as you do, and catching you sends you back down the mountain. Gold coins are scattered across all four sides, most of them off the safe route, so every detour is a gamble. 25 hand-tuned pyramids, an overview map, a daily challenge, and four hand-lit looks that run from desert sunrise to starlit night — three of them unlocked by exploring, alongside ten cosmetic rewards that never expire. Pull the camera back at any moment and the whole pyramid frames itself. Not in the mood for a chase? The comfort settings are free and always available: slow the chaser, keep your progress when caught, or switch the chase off entirely and just climb.
howToPlay: GOAL Enter at the green START in the middle of a base edge and work inward and upward to the golden SUMMIT at the centre. Reach it to clear the level — you're carried straight into the next one. MOVE Arrow keys or WASD, or the orange arrows at the bottom left on touch. Movement is relative to the screen, and holds the direction you pressed until you release. CAMERA Drag the maze to turn it, or tap the two curved buttons at the bottom right to snap 45° at a time — handy for lining up square with a corridor. Q and E do the same on a keyboard. Pinch or scroll to zoom, or press + and −. Right-drag with a mouse, or drag with two fingers, to lean the view off the ball and peek around a corner; it springs back as soon as you move. Zoom right out and the view re-aims itself to frame the whole pyramid. The view never turns on its own. MAP Press M or tap the map icon for an overview showing you, the chaser, the summit and any coins still out there. The game pauses while it's open. Esc closes it. The route isn't on it — that's what Hint is for. HINT Opens that same map with the full route drawn on it, then leaves the route glowing on the floor for a few seconds after you close it. Where the…

title: Recycle Game
description: Turn trash into order and save the planet! Recycle Game is a relaxing and oddly satisfying waste-sorting game that combines casual fun with a meaningful eco-friendly mission. If you love cleanup games, and zen-like puzzles, this one's for you! Why you'll love Recycle Game: ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY – Smooth controls and calming sorting mechanics. The perfect way to de-stress after a long day. LEARN THROUGH PLAY – Master real-life recycling rules naturally. Paper, plastic, glass, metal – you'll become an expert without even noticing! Key Features: • Simple controls – just drag and drop, easy for all ages • Relaxing vibes – calm aesthetics and satisfying feedback • Global leaderboard – compete with players around the world • Family friendly – safe, educational, and fun for kids and adults alike • Progressive levels – from simple tasks to challenging recycling puzzles
howToPlay: Drag and drop with your mouse to sort each item into the right bin. On mobile, tap and drag. Perfect for fans of cleanup and organization games, ASMR and stress-relief, casual puzzles, and an eco-conscious lifestyle. The world is in your hands – sort the waste, clean the Earth!

title: Archer: Trial by Fate
description: Archer: Trial by Fate is a dynamic top-down action game. You control an archer who fights through dozens of rooms filled with monsters and bosses, challenging fate itself. What awaits you: * Dozens of unique abilities: ricochet, split arrows, meteors, orbs, ice and fire arrows, ghostly companions, and much more. Every run is a new combination of skills. * Battles against a wide variety of enemies and bosses, each with its own behavior, attacks, and weaknesses. * Progression between runs: unlock new heroes, upgrade your gear in the Forge, and invest coins into permanent stat improvements. * Randomized room and wave order, so no two attempts are ever the same. Can you clear every stage and defeat the final boss?
howToPlay: To control your character, use the virtual joystick or the WASD keys / arrow keys on your keyboard. Shooting is automatic: when the hero stands still, he aims at the nearest enemy and fires on his own. Move to dodge, stop to attack.

title: Arrows Idle
description: Clear the grid, trigger massive chain reactions, and upgrade your way to a perfect flow in this satisfying arrow-merging idle clicker!
howToPlay: Just click on the arrows and the upgrade buttons! You will also have skill buttons that give you extra money!

title: Tap Hunters
description: Clicker game with colorful and bright graphic. Tap to hunt monsters, build your team of heroes and upgrade them. Collect and power up with collection of weapons. Travel to new worlds to earn rewards, and grow stronger as you play. With each run you will able to reach higher levels.
howToPlay: - Tap or click with mouse on monsters to defeat them - Collect coins, by tapping on them or hovering them with mouse. Coins also collect automatically after few seconds. - Spend coins for upgrades, hire new heroes and their upgrades - Reach zone 50 to unlock portal to new world. Starting new world will rewards you with gems and souls. You can spend them for new upgrades, auto clicks and heroes upgrade and weapons. - Reach higher game zones to get better rewards in new worlds.

title: Red-Blue Forge
description: Red-Blue Forge is a fast reaction arcade game where you rotate core orbs to match incoming embers and survive as long as possible. Start in classic 2-core mode (Red/Blue), then unlock 4-core mode (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow) for higher intensity and a x3 score multiplier. The game features smooth touch/mouse controls, quick sessions, and a “Ready” start gate so each run begins on your command. Between runs, collected materials feed a persistent Forge Tree progression system. Temper upgrades to improve control, stability, scoring bonuses, and long-run mastery. Every match rewards precision and timing, while long-term progression gives players clear goals and replay value. Ideal for mobile and desktop, Red-Blue Forge combines skill-based gameplay, readable visuals, and satisfying build progression in short, addictive runs.
howToPlay: Tap/click left or right to rotate your core and match the color of incoming embers before they hit the center. Press Ready to start each run, build score by chaining correct matches, and avoid mismatches that end the session. Earn materials from runs, then spend them in the Forge Tree to unlock upgrades and, later, 4-core mode for all four colors and x3 score.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color
description: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color is a vibrant brain teaser that blends block placement, color matching, and a playful water park vibe. You guide falling cubes to help cheerful bears enjoy their splash time. You solve increasingly clever puzzles, plan every drop carefully, and enjoy lively water visuals that make each challenge feel refreshing and satisfying.
howToPlay: Players are tasked with matching colorful bears to their corresponding holes, allowing them to jump into a refreshing aqua lake. With the game’s increasing complexity, players must employ strategic thinking to navigate through the challenging levels.

title: Driftbound: Race in the Grip of Drift!
description: Driftbound: Race in the Grip of Drift! is a fast-paced arcade racing game built around a unique magnetic drifting mechanic. Attach your hook to magnets near the road, swing through sharp turns, and release at the perfect moment to stay on the track. Race through procedurally generated environments filled with bridges, intersections, changing weather, and challenging turns. Set new distance records in Solo mode or compete against AI rivals, collect cash, upgrade your car, and unlock new vehicles and control modes.
howToPlay: Your car accelerates automatically. Stay on the road, avoid crashes, collect cash, and master every turn. In Solo mode, travel as far as possible, complete increasingly difficult levels, and beat your distance record. In Rivals mode, overtake the AI drivers and cross the finish line first. Hook Controls: Hold the hook control near a turn to connect to the glowing magnet. Keep holding to swing the car around the corner. Release at the right moment to continue along the road. Steering Controls: Turn left or right while keeping the car on the track. Choose between an on-screen steering wheel and directional controls in Settings. Desktop Controls: Spacebar or hold the mouse button: Activate the magnetic hook. Release Spacebar or the mouse button: Release the hook. Left Arrow or A: Steer left. Right Arrow or D: Steer right. Mouse drag: Turn the on-screen steering wheel. Esc: Pause the game. Mobile Controls: Touch and hold the screen: Activate the magnetic hook. Release your finger: Release the hook. Drag the on-screen wheel: Steer the car. Directional mode: Hold the left or right side of the screen to steer.

title: Capyballra - Capybara Ball Collector!
description: Rotate the maze, roll to collect, unlock cute skins! Twist the maze with your mouse or your finger, send your capyballas rolling into the pipe. Simple one-touch controls, snappy physics, and clever level design make every run satisfying. Use coins to unlock new Capyballra skins—classic, seasonal, and rare animated variants—to show off your favorites. Perfect for quick runs or chasing full-collection completion: rotate, collect, unlock.
howToPlay: Rotate the maze to get the Capyballras out of the maze and into the pipe to complete the levels! Once in a while you will have a bonus level where you can collect even more Capyballras to score more points. Earn coins to spend them on unlocking newer Capyballra designs. Desktop Controls: Use your mouse to drag around the maze to rotate it clock wise or anti-clockwise Mobile Controls: Use your finger to drag around the maze to rotate it clock wise or anti-clockwise

title: Close Ads
description: A fast chaos arcade game where your only goal is simple: close ads. But every few levels, the ads become more annoying.
howToPlay: PC Left Mouse Button — click close buttons Mouse Move — aim and chase ads Double Left Click — required on some levels UI Button: Restart From Level 1 — restart progress Mobile / Tablet Tap — press close buttons Double Tap — required on some levels Drag finger / move finger — follow moving ads visually UI Button: Restart From Level 1 — restart progress

title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
description: Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today! Key Features • Choose Your Pace with Two Modes: o Relax Mode: Enjoy a stress-free experience with no lives limit and no time pressure. Simply relax and solve puzzles at your own speed. o Challenge Mode: Put your logic to the test! This mode features limited lives (represented by the heart icon) and a time limit, challenging you to solve the farm layout before time runs out. • Interactive Tutorial: Easy-to-follow instructions guide you through your first placements, helping you learn to "cross out" cells where animals cannot be placed. • Helpful Tools: Use the "Find" or "Hint" features if you get stuck on a tricky arrangement. • Challenging Levels: Progress through increasingly difficult grids as you move from Level 1 onwards. • Cozy Visuals: Enjoy a clean UI and charming animal icons designed for a pleasant gaming experience.
howToPlay: In each level, you are tasked with placing a specific number of animals (such as pigs) onto a color-coded grid. To solve the puzzle, you must satisfy the following logic rules: • One Per Row / Column: Each row and column can only contain exactly one animal. • Color Regions: Every distinct colored area on the grid must contain exactly one animal. • No Neighbors: Animals cannot be placed in adjacent cells (no touching allowed).

title: JigRot
description: JigRot is a chill puzzler: drag scattered pieces, snap them together, and merge clusters until the full crazy brainrot picture locks in. Easy to learn, smooth to play, and built for a relaxing flow — one oddball pack after another when you want to unwind without pressure.
howToPlay: Desktop (mouse & keyboard) Move pieces: Click and hold a piece or cluster, drag it, then release to drop. Matching edges snap together when they line up. Mobile (touch) Move pieces: Touch and drag a piece or cluster, then lift your finger to place. Edges merge when they align.

title: Container Auction
description: "Container Auction" — an exciting auction simulator! Bid on mysterious containers, competing against rivals. Peek inside through the door gap, assess the contents, and place your bid! Open containers and discover items — from old books to gold watches and diamond brooches. Every item has its own rarity: common, uncommon, rare, epic, or legendary!
howToPlay: 1. Choose a location — the higher the level, the more valuable the containers 2. Inspect 3 containers and select one for auction 3. Peek inside through the gap or watch an ad for a full preview 4. Negotiate with bots — raise your bid or pass 5. Win the auction, open the container and discover what's inside! 6. Sell items for profit, restore worn-out pieces

title: Shikaku Puzzle
description: Shikaku is a logic puzzle with simple rules and challenging solutions. The rules are simple. You have to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle.
howToPlay: You have to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle. Click and drag to draw a rectangle.

title: Zestful Match
description: Dive into a vibrant and refreshing tile-matching adventure with Zestful Match! Challenge your focus and strategy as you match three identical fruit tiles to clear the board. With juicy animations and premium aesthetics, it's the perfect game for quick sessions or hours of fun. Key Features: Juicy Match-3 Gameplay: Simple mechanics with satisfying visual effects. Powerful Boosters: Stuck? Use Undo, Hint, or Shuffle to keep the game going. Competitive Leaderboards: See how you rank against players worldwide! Achievement System: Unlock medals for your skill and progress. Fully Responsive: Flawless experience across mobile and desktop devices.
howToPlay: Tap or click on any fruit tile to move it into your tray at the bottom. Match 3 identical tiles in the tray to remove them and earn points. The tray has a maximum size of 7 tiles. If it fills up without any matches, you lose! Clear all the tiles from the game board to win the level. Use Undo to revert your move, Hint to find a match, or Shuffle to rearrange the board if you are stuck. Climb the Global Leaderboard by clearing levels and achieving high scores!

title: Home Decor Clicker
description: Build your dream home one click at a time! In this relaxing clicker game, you earn money by tapping on your house. Every click brings you closer to upgrading your home, earning gold, and unlocking beautiful decorations. As your income grows, you can customize your house with furniture, decorations, and upgrades that reflect your progress. The more you play, the more efficient your earnings become. Invest your gold wisely, decorate your home, and watch it transform from a simple house into a stunning living space. Perfect for fans of idle and clicker games, this game offers a satisfying sense of progress, customization, and relaxation.
howToPlay: Tap on the house to earn money Earn gold as you progress and increase your income Use gold to buy decorations and home upgrades Decorate and customize your house freely Progress continuously with simple and intuitive controls

title: Hard Puzzle
description: A fascinating puzzle for everyone. A huge number of different levels will not let you get bored. Come every day and train your brain.
howToPlay: Your task: To assemble a square from bright geometric figures. Open new levels of difficulty. If you get stuck, you can use a hint.

title: Crocodile Online - Draw and Guess
description: "Crocodile Online - Draw and Guess" is a cozy online party game where one player draws a word, and the others try to guess it as quickly as possible. You can play with friends in a private room or jump straight into a quick game with other players. The built-in chat helps you discuss your guesses and have fun, and the leaderboard system keeps track of your progress and shows you the best guessers. The game works directly in your browser, without downloading, supports keyboard and mouse, and is perfect for short sessions after school or work.
howToPlay: Log in to the game, enter your name, and choose between a quick game or a private room. In the quick game, you will automatically be placed in a suitable room. In the private room, create a room and send its ID to your friends. One player will be the artist, who will see the word and must draw it on the canvas using a pencil, marker, and eraser. The other players will enter their guesses in the chat. The first player to guess the word will earn a point and help advance in the leaderboard. Rounds are automatically switched, and the time is limited by a timer.

title: Eternal Dance
description: Eternal Dance is a calm, meditative arcade game about keeping balance. Two koi — one black, one white — endlessly circle a glowing orb in a hand-painted zen pond. Drifting ink threatens the orb from the dark, and only the koi of the matching color can dissolve it. Guide their dance, protect the orb, and lose yourself in the flow. Easy to learn, hard to master — a one-touch game that trades frantic reflexes for focus and serenity.
howToPlay: Goal: Protect the blue orb at the center. Two koi orbit it — spin them so each koi meets the ink of its own color: • Black koi dissolves black ink • White koi dissolves white ink Wrong-color koi can't stop the ink — it strikes the orb and cracks it. If the orb shatters, the dance ends. Modes: • Levels — survive until the timer runs out to clear each level. • Endless — last as long as you can; your survival time is ranked on the leaderboard. Powers (Shield, Slow, Cleanse, Heal) unlock as you progress, to help you hold the balance longer. Controls: • Desktop: hold SPACE (or ↑) to spin the koi; release to ease them to a stop. • Touch: tap and hold anywhere to spin; release to slow down.

title: SUM+SUM
description: Match the numbers. The numerical grid awaits your solution. Your task is to retain only those numbers that add up to the desired horizontal and vertical values. Eliminate the unnecessary, maintain balance, and uncover the logic behind each move
howToPlay: This is a logic game with numbers. You need to remove the extra numbers so that the sum in each row and column matches the specified one. 1 click = keep, 2 clicks = delete, 3 clicks = reset. The rows and columns must match their sums

title: Sheep commotion
description: Sheep Commotion is a cheerful path-drawing puzzle game about guiding every sheep to the right pen. Draw safe routes, collect stars, avoid wolves, rocks and puddles, and solve increasingly tricky levels with different sheep behaviors.
howToPlay: Draw a path from a sheep to the matching pen. White sheep go to the white pen, black sheep go to the black pen. Avoid wolves, rocks and puddles, keep greedy sheep away from apples, and finish levels faster to earn more stars.

title: Snake Wiggle Master!
description: Looking for a fun snake maze game that’s easy to start but keeps you thinking? In Snake Wiggle Master!, you guide a snake through clever mazes where one smart move can open the whole path. Move your snake through tight corridors, plan the right order, and race against the clock. ⏰ The challenge comes from thinking fast but smart. Some paths look safe at first, but one wrong move can block the maze completely. Choose carefully, move efficiently, and clear the level before time runs out. ✨ With simple controls and clean visuals, Snake Wiggle Master! is easy to play and exciting to master.
howToPlay: Tap to move the snake Plan your moves — order matters Beat the timer and protect your hearts Clear the maze to unlock the next level

title: Merge Items Build City
description: A game about building a city. Make houses and streets simple for the residents of the city and make the lives of the citizens happy.
howToPlay: - Control with the mouse on the computer screen or by pressing your finger on the smartphone screen; - To start construction, click on the building; - Select a task - click with the mouse or finger on the screen; - To connect objects, you need to drag and connect the same ones. - Connect stones to get bricks; - Connect the tree to get the boards; - A game about building a city, connect objects to build; - Build a hospital and a kindergarten; - Open shops and banks; - Each building generates income. Increase profits and get rich; - Complete tasks and complete quests to increase your income; - To build a building, you need to complete all the tasks; - Create stairs, windows and walls.

title: Tank Craft 2
description: Tank Craft 2 (also known as TankCraft 2: Hell Bosses War) is an exciting 2D action tank battle game with a unique crafting twist. Players build and customize their own tanks by assembling thousands of parts combinations, then engage in fast-paced side-scrolling combat to repel an infernal invasion from hellish bosses emerging from a raging volcano. The core idea revolves around experimentation: craft powerful, personalized war machines through upgrades and part tweaks, then battle waves of corrupted enemy tanks and towering demonic bosses in dynamic arenas filled with lava, rocks, and explosive action. Its standout features include endless build creativity, satisfying progression through levels, cartoonish yet intense visuals with cute tank characters, and the thrill of engineering your way to victory against apocalyptic threats.
howToPlay: Build Your Tank and Defeat Hell's Invasion! Step into the role of a master tank engineer in Tank Craft 2 (also known as TankCraft 2: Hell Bosses War), an exciting 2D action tank battle game with a unique crafting twist. Design and customize your ultimate war machine by combining thousands of parts—from hulls and turrets to cannons and tracks—to create a personalized tank balanced for firepower, armor, and speed. Then charge into fast-paced side-scrolling combat to repel waves of corrupted enemy tanks and colossal demonic bosses erupting from a raging volcano. Loot parts from defeated foes, upgrade your build, and evolve your tank to survive increasingly intense battles in explosive, lava-filled arenas. The main goal is to progress through levels by defeating all enemies and bosses in each stage, gathering resources to craft stronger tanks, and ultimately stopping the hellish invasion to save the tank world. Win by destroying every threat on the battlefield without your tank being destroyed, then advance to tougher challenges and epic boss confrontations. Desktop Controls (for web/browser versions or similar playstyles): A / ← (Left Arrow): Move left. D / → (Right Arrow): Move righ…

title: Walk Master: Stilt Walker
description: Ready for fun and a challenge? Walk Master: Stilt Walker is an arcade walking simulator where you'll test your agility! You start out clumsy, but the further you go, the cooler you become. Stumble through forests and fields, level up your skills and become a real stilt master. Unique levels and encounters with crazy creatures await you in Walk Master: Stilt Walker!
howToPlay: 💻 On PC: Hold the spacebar or left mouse button — the stilt lifts. Release — it lowers. Step by alternating presses! 📱 On smartphone or tablet: Hold your finger on the screen — the stilt lifts. Release — it lowers. Tap rhythmically to walk and keep your balance!

title: Square Crusher
description: Get ready for a fun and satisfying cube-crushing puzzle experience in SQUARE CRUSHER! In this game, you need to tap on unlocked fill cubes or boxes only. When you tap a cube or box, it falls into the crusher. The crusher breaks it and generates colorful balls. These balls fall onto the board and move toward the conveyor belt if there is space. Your main goal is to match the crushed balls with the correct front crates. When the balls pass near the crates, matching balls will automatically go inside the correct crate. Once a crate is full, the next crate in the queue moves forward. But be careful! Do not blindly tap on unlocked cubes or boxes. If you tap without planning, the generated balls may not match with the front crates. This can fill the conveyor belt quickly and create no space for new balls. Fill all crates, clear all boxes, and complete the level before the conveyor belt gets full!
howToPlay: -Tap on full cube or box. -The tapped cube or box will fall down into the crusher. -The crusher will crush it and generate balls. -The balls will fall onto the board. -If there is space, the balls will move onto the conveyor belt. -When balls pass near the front crates, matching balls will automatically go inside the correct crate. -If a crate becomes full, the next crate in the queue will move forward. -Your goal is to fill all crates and finish all boxes to win the level. -Think before you tap! If you blindly tap cubes or boxes, the crushed balls may not match with the current front crates. -If the conveyor belt becomes full and no ball can match with the front crates, the game will be over.

title: Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge
description: Tap the arrows and remove the blocks! A logical puzzle game for adults! Can you beat all levels? Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge is a relaxing puzzle game where you need to remove blocks by tapping the arrows. Clear the field, solve puzzles, and complete levels at your own pace. This is a casual logic game that combines puzzle gameplay, an anti-stress experience, and thinking challenges. Simple controls make it accessible for everyone, while gradually increasing difficulty keeps it engaging. The game is perfect for relaxing: easy gameplay, pleasant visual style and engaging levels help you unwind and take your mind off things. Sometimes you’ll need to think a bit to remove all the blocks and avoid getting stuck. Features: Casual puzzle game Logic and thinking games Puzzles with blocks and arrows Many levels Relaxing anti-stress gameplay Boosters for help If you enjoy puzzles, logic games, and casual games, try Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge.
howToPlay: 🎮 How to Play Tap on blocks with arrows A block disappears if there are no obstacles in front of it Gradually clear the entire field If you get stuck — try a different order of actions Use boosters to make levels easier

title: Sweet Flip
description: Match delicious cakes of the same color, clear the board, and earn points! Unlock new flavors and increase the challenge as you progress. A simple yet addictive puzzle game with bright, tasty desserts.
howToPlay: Dive into a delightful puzzle adventure where colorful cakes fall from above — and it's your job to line them up! React fast, create matches, clear the board, and keep the glass from overflowing. Unlock new flavors and take on increasingly tasty challenges as you progress! Desktop Controls: ← (Left Arrow): Move cake left ↓ (Down Arrow): Drop cake faster → (Right Arrow): Move cake right Mobile Controls: Left Button: Move cake left Down Button: Drop cake faster Right Button: Move cake right

title: Hunting Master
description: Become the ultimate hunter in Hunting Master, a fun and strategic archery shooting game set in a beautiful desert world! Jump between floating islands and use your bow to hunt wild animals like boars and wolves with precise shots. The core idea is aim, power, and chain reactions — shoot arrows to defeat animals and collect points while upgrading your bow with powerful abilities. What makes it unique? Stunning floating island visuals, satisfying bow-shooting mechanics with glowing effects, multiple power-ups (Meteorite, Thunder, etc.), and addictive progression as you become a stronger hunter in this desert hunting adventure!
howToPlay: Your main goal is to aim and shoot your bow at the animals on different floating islands. Pull back to adjust power and angle, then release to fire accurate arrows. Defeat as many animals as possible to earn points and stars. Use powerful abilities like Meteorite and Thunder to clear multiple targets at once! Mobile Controls: Touchscreen: Tap and drag on the screen to aim and pull the bowstring, then release to shoot.

title: Mem Brawl: Merge Simulator
description: Merge Brainrot memes! Combine Skibidi Toilet, Gugugaga, Granny and legendary brainrot characters. Clicker + Arena battles. Build the strongest meme squad!
howToPlay: "Mem Brawl: Merge Simulator" - Purchase — click on the store and buy new meme fighters. 🚀 Buy characters and match two identical characters to get a stronger one. The higher the level, the higher the income! 🚀 Farm memes bring passive income, and quick clicks on the screen give coins manually. Upgrade — go to the upgrade menu and download multipliers and passive earnings. 🚀 Arena — choose the 3 most powerful memes and send them into battle! Autoboys bring cups, gold and raise the ranking. The stronger your team is, the higher the rewards and crazier the memes! 🚀

title: Rotcalypse Idle
description: Rotcalypse is a satirical idle tycoon where you monetize digital decay. Transform questionable content into pure profit, scaling from primitive RotToks to a global Brainrot VR-machine. No thinking required—only expansion. Your goal is the total degradation of the internet for the sake of infinite numbers. Experience a dark reflection of social media addiction, perfect for "killing" time.
howToPlay: How to Play Click to Launch: Manually trigger production cycles to generate your initial capital and kickstart the economy. Invest & Upgrade: Spend earnings on Business Upgrades and Skill Improvements to increase the efficiency of every action. Expand Ventures: Purchase and unlock new Business Branches to diversify your portfolio and raise your profit ceiling. Automate Growth: Hire Managers to automate cycles, transforming manual clicks into a high-speed passive income stream. Prestige Reset: Perform a Reset to sacrifice current progress in exchange for permanent Prestige Multipliers, allowing you to reach significantly higher milestones in the next run.

title: Build And Run
description: Build And Run is an exciting arcade game where you navigate, construct, and triumph! Play instantly on various devices without downloads or sign-ups. Race through levels while building ramps and defeating foes with diverse weapons. Customize your character with stylish gear and enjoy endless fun in both modes!
howToPlay: Build the missing parts of the level. PC/Desktop Q to build a platform W to build a ramp E to build a slope R to use weapons Mobile Use on screen buttons

title: Mavy The Fish Mom
description: Mavy is a devoted fish mom who takes care of her children by cooking food for them. It's an Idle farming game.
howToPlay: You are starting with basic equipment, then upgrading it later when you can afford the money, which can be collected from the fish. You can buy fish eggs to drop more valuable coins. After buying the egg, equip it, then lay it on the nest and wait for your little child to hatch

title: Cube Island 3D
description: Welcome to the exciting world of survival and adventure! In the role of brave Steve, you have to start from scratch on a mysterious and uninhabited island. Your goal is to turn this corner of nature into a real paradise for life. Game Features: - Survival and Adventure. - Tasks and Achievements. - Construction and Development. - Resources and Crafting. - Discovery of New Islands. An exciting journey from survival to prosperity, where your creativity and strategic decisions will be the key to success. Get ready for the adventure of your life on an island of your own making!
howToPlay: The goal of the game is to turn a desert island into a prosperous paradise by completing tasks, constructing buildings, collecting resources and discovering new territories. The player develops the infrastructure, explores the secrets of the island and achieves a high level of survival and prosperity. Controls - Swipe/Left mouse button

title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
description: Welcome to Fruitsland – a unique amusement park where fun awaits at every turn! Colorful carousels, exciting rides, and entertainers dressed as fruits – apples, bananas, watermelons, and oranges – fill the park. Children’s laughter fills the air, as school groups with teachers and families with kids flock to enjoy the day. Everything seems perfect, but not all is as it seems... One careless step, and you fall through an old hatch, landing in a spooky, long-abandoned part of the park hidden underground. Before you lies a chilling, forgotten underground park where strange scientific experiments were once conducted. Only remnants of these experiments remain now, with crumbling rides and deserted game rooms that carry no joy. An eerie silence surrounds you, broken only by the sounds of old machinery and the shuffling of mysterious creatures. The first location is themed around apples – at first, it seems harmless, but soon you realize you’re trapped. As you study the remnants of the scientists’ journals, you uncover their plans to bring fruit to life, fruit that would entertain visitors around the clock. The sinister plan of the park’s owner aimed to turn fruits into real entertainers…
howToPlay: WASD - Move C - Crouch Space - Jump The main goal is to escape the park by solving puzzles. Find useful items and use them to your advantage.

title: Farm: Nubik Vs Zombies
description: Nubik has to get out! To do this, upgrade the base, upgrade him and his weapons. Use the mercenaries to help you. Find a portal that will get you out of here. Meditative gameplay.
howToPlay: Relaxing gameplay with a leaderboard. Get to the top of the murders. Your main goal is to escape and get out of here. Get resources and upgrade yourself and your base so that you can open new zones. Look for a portal with which you can get out of here, simultaneously destroying the zombie helpers! The bigger the zone, the more zombies there will be!

title: EdgeFire
description: EdgeFire is a fast-paced online shooter that throws you into thrilling battles against real players from around the world. Whether you're flying solo or teaming up with friends, every match is a chance to prove your dominance on the battlefield. Sharpen your aim and unleash lightning-fast reflexes, earn rewards, and become the top player in each round. Outsmart your opponents with clever tactics and strategic plays that turn the tide of battle in your favor. Dive into action-packed gameplay with a variety of stunning skins that enhance your experience and appeal to both seasoned shooter veterans and newcomers alike. Each battle is a fresh challenge, packed with intensity and adrenaline. Step into the arena, test your skills, and rise to glory. Are you ready to dominate the fight?
howToPlay: WASD - move R - reload Left mouse button - shoot Esc - pause menu

title: City Chase: Escape Police
description: Race through the city and survive the police chase for as long as you can! Dodge cops, collect coins, grab HP boosts, and pick up the Ram Bar to smash police cars and send them flying. Unlock new cars with unique traits, survive rising Wanted Levels, and keep beating your best time before the cops finally bust you.
howToPlay: Dodge the police cars and survive as long as you can to achieve the highest score. Collect coins to fill the garage with cars. Mobile Controls: Hold Left Side of Screen: Steer left. Hold Right Side of Screen: Steer right. Hold Both Sides: Reverse. Release: Straighten up — the car keeps accelerating on its own. Button Mode: Switch to on-screen arrows with GO and REVERSE pedals at any time; your choice is saved. Camera Button: Tap to drop the view in behind the car. Reset Button: Tap to free your car if it gets stuck. Desktop Controls: ← (Left Arrow) or A: Steer left. → (Right Arrow) or D: Steer right. ↓ (Down Arrow) or S: Reverse. ↑ (Up Arrow), W or Spacebar: Accelerate (in button mode — by default the car accelerates on its own). Mouse: Hold the left button on the left or right side of the screen to steer that way. R: Reset your car if it gets stuck, without ending the run. Esc or the on-screen pause button: Pause.
